With the genjutsu, the opponent's negative and hostile feelings towards Niyo are rewired into pure admiration and love for her. After gaining the trust of her enemies, Niyo can then execute them when she pleases.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_protect: Genjutsu Protect {{JutsuInfobox |image=Genjutsu barricades.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術プロテクト |romaji=Genjutsu Purotekuto |literal english=Illusion Technique Protect |english tv=Genjutsu Block |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime,
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_rinnega: Using their Rinnegan, the user is able to cast a genjutsu strong enough to take control of the nine tailed beasts simultaneously. Unlike other genjutsu, this technique apparently does not subdue the mind of the victim.

Genjutsu: Rinnegan is a Dōjutsu of the Rinnegan and a much more powerful version of the Genjutsu: Sharingan. It can only be used by those who have awakend their Rinnegan from the Sharingan (people with implanted Rinnegan are unable to use it).

Using his Rinnegan, is able to cast a genjutsu strong enough to take control of the nine tailed beasts simultaneously. Hagoromo Ōtsutsuki stated that Sasuke can use this technique through a single glance. Unlike other genjutsu, this technique apparently does not subdue the mind of the victim.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_sadisti: After looking directly at Raygen's eyes, everything around you will turn black and you'll be strapped on a wall full with rusty spikes. Raygen will ask you a couple of questions or force you to confess.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_seigaio: Genjutsu: Seigaio is the generic use of genjutsu employed by wielders of the Seigaio. By making direct eye contact with someone, the user is able to trap them inside of a genjutsu of their own choosing to achieve different effects.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_seigan_: The user of this threads a hallucinatory world of swords and mechanical gears, making it seem as if the one who executed the had just transported their opponent to another dimension altogether.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_self_co: Genjutsu: Self-Concealment is a special Genjutsu created by Nisshou Fuyutama in order to hide in plain sight. The technique is always active and is unique in that it is able to fool even the Sharingan. It allows the caster to mask their appearance from all those who observe them.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_shadowe: Genjutsu: Shadowed Moon: the user affects everyone nearby. Learned from rank 3.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_sharing: Genjutsu: Sharingan {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Genjutsu Sharingan.png |named=Yes |kanji=幻術・写輪眼 |romaji=Genjutsu: Sharingan |literal english=Illusion Technique: Copy Wheel Eye |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu= |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive, Supplementary |jutsu range=

This technique is exclusive to Keiji Kunitsu, it involves trapping the opponent in a Genjutsu world and siphoning their chakra. While their chakra is being used for the Genjutsu the user activates a secondary technique placed inside the Genjutsu to siphon the opponents' chakra supply.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_starry_: By gathering chakra in two points of the body, both thumbs, and touching the opponent with both thumbs, Ikido can cast a Genjutsu on his opponent. Once in the Genjutsu, it is difficult to escape by one's self, of course unless this person has amazing chakra control and can sense Genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_sylph.d: Genjutsu: Sylph a unique method of using Genjutsu developed and used by Akari Murakami. It allows her to trap any who come into contact with one of her Wind Release techniques to be trapped in a Genjutsu of her choosing.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_tenseig: This is an advance genjutsu as employed by Tenseigan wielders. After establishing direct eye contact with the user's opponent/opponents, the user can cast a genjutsu strong enough to control all nine-tail beast along with their jinchūriki completely controlling them.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_the_lab: This is an illusion technique associated with the Kazahan Clan. Using this genjutsu, the user creates a mental trap within the victim’s mind in the form of a vast labyrinth of mirrors. The technique begins by creating a disturbing reflection that the victim briefly catches sight of.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_the_sou: Genjutsu: The Sound of Drums is another of Kisui's Rinnegan techniques. By activating the genjutsu via eye contact, the victim's mind begins repeating a simple pattern. Four drum beats in a second by second loop, constantly repeating in their mind.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_torture: This Genjutsu was developed by Zetsumei to damage his enemies brain. He uses it at most of his battles. When he battled Ryuujin Entenka, he used this Genjutsu but failed because it was backfired by Ryuujin's left eye.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_trappin: Takara summons a large pink, translucent flower under the opponent that compresses them inside before exploding. This genjutsu seems to act fast as it is completed only after two seconds; one second for the compressing and another one second for the explosion.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_tree_bi: A two-fold attack whereby Kurenai first ensnares the opponent in a genjutsu, binding them with trees and then Asuma, using his Chakra Blades finishes them with his Flying Swallow.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/genjutsu_underwo: Genjutsu: Underworld is a powerful genjutsu performed with the Mangekyō Sharingan Dōjutsu and signature to Asana Uchiha. After making eye contact with a target, Asana traps them in an illusion of nightmarish underworld, and relaying destruction due to her unprecedented ability.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gensokaicho.desc: Gensōkaichō (幻想諧調, Phantasmal Melody) is a Kenjutsu fighting style developed by Fūgetsu Soga after training with her Legend Grave ability. The Gensōkaichō was developed by Fūgetsu after she met the spirit of a swords women when training with the Legend Grave.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gentle_fist_art_: Taking advantage of the opponent's movements and attempts to block against a physical attack, Seireitou utilizes the Byakugan to pinpoint the vulnerabilities in an opponent's seemingly invincible defense.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/getsurin_no_kekk: Getsurin no Kekkai is an advanced application of the Mangekyō Sharingan technique, Tsukuyomi, which was developed by Kazuhide. Incorporating the usage of the Yin-Yang Release this technique surpasses the effects of basic techniques, encapsulating both the victim and the practitioner in a .
ability.narutorpg.fanon/ghost_palm.desc: Ghost Palm is the taijutsu style developed by Kaname Soga. Like the Hyuga Clan's Gentle Fist style, Ghost Palm focuses on damaging an opponent's internal organs.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/glimpse_of_horro: Glimpse of Horror Technique (一目の恐れの術, Hitome no Osore no Jutsu) is a very dangerous Genjutsu developed by Kyōsuke.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/god_temple_of_ni: With his mastery over the Temple of Nirvana Technique, Jukan Nara doubles the effects using his senjutsu. Because of this enhancement, the effects are instantaneous, trapping people in genjutsu before they even realize. Escaping this technique is nearly impossible as those under its effects fall asleep instantly.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/great_world_rein: Great World Reincarnation (グレートワールドの生まれ変わり, Gurētowārudo no umarekawari) is a Genjutsu based on making hallucinations and reawakening things of the past with horrid images.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_av: Gushkin-banda: Avatamsaka is the quintessence of or rather beyond, utilizing mind, body, soul and spirit in unison to create one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence. This would be considered by some, the first "genjutsu" as it was created three millennia ago in the legendary The Isle of the Blooming Flowers.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_co: This Fuinjutsu named the shows the powerful chakras and fearsome ablilities of The Sage of Enlightenment when attempting to meld his spirit with those of the lower levels of existence.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_de: The Path Gold Alignment techniques or rather Gushkin-banda techniques usage are a symbolical and energetic representation of the spiritual illumination and physical transformation of the human race to its perfected state.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_di: Gushkin-banda: Diffusion of The Eight Immortals
The might of the Heavenly Sovereign diffused into eight separate entities. is an extremely advanced spiritual technique created by Gaoh Minazuki.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_el: This technique invented by Gaoh, is said to cause damage on both spiritual and physical level. After performing a few hand-signs an etheral bluish white flame will manifest at the end of each of Gaoh's fingers on his right hand. On it's own, the flames vary in size.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_ho: The , or also known as the is an exceedingly adept technique invented by Gaoh Minazuki, which exploits the properties of the Remote Chakra Manifestation Technique used by his clan ages ago. The ability itself was once considered to be the zenith of chakra manipulation.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_ji: This is an advanced technique that involves a physical manifestation of both chakra and spirit formed after a complex string of hand-signs that is able by being the Sage Of Enlightenment.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_ki: This is a powerful technique, but not the most powerful of its type given its singular effect. This technique requires a series of mudra along with a donation of a massive amount of chakra. For each use of this technique, a fourth of Gaoh's spiritual of chakra is employed, making it one of Gaoh’s most draining jutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_na: The is a powerful long range technique used by Gaoh Minazuki. With the essence of the Heavenly Sovereign imbedded within the Path Gold Alignment techniques, few find possible to surpass them in all their aspects.

The This is an advanced Gushkin-banda technique that is derived upon a physical transformation based around genetic recombination. In essense, this is an advanced transformation technique. Instead of just creating the image of a new form, this technique grants, temporarily, a new form.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_pa: This is an advanced Gushkin-banda jutsu that allows Gaoh to transcend the bounds of the physical world. This technique requires a special hand sign along with advanced chakra manipulation across the body. The end result of this technique is that Gaoh’s body is passed between the physical world and the spiritual realm.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_sa: Gushkin-banda: Sanjiva Naga - Art of The Infinitely Peerless One

Gushkin-banda: Sanjiva Naga - Art of The Infinitely Peerless One . The Path Gold Alignment techniques or rather Gushkin-banda techniques usage are a symbolical and energetic representation of the spiritual illumination and physical transformation of the human race to its perfected state.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_su: This is an alternate form of the summoning technique unique to the Sage of Enlightenment but now is able to be used by his former pupil Asu Rashoujin. The technique thrives upon the Sage of Enlightenment ability to form connections with the many spiritual realms.

The is an alternate form of the summoning technique unique to the Heavenly Sovereign, the Sage of Enlightenment. The technique thrives upon the Sage of Enlightenments ineffable ability to form connections with the many spiritual realms.
Gushkin-banda: Suppressing Holy Dragon of 8 Purifications
This is an advanced versatile ninjutsu, but because of the corrupt nature of the technique it is classified also as a kinjutsu at its highest fuuinjutsu level.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_ta: Gushkin-banda: Tanghasangii , meaning abiding in the sacred nature, is arguably one of the most fascinating techniques in recorded history as it is not a technique which drastically changes the or one to manipulate time or dimensions.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_th: The legendary and infamous or the is a simplistic technique that is modeled after The .
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gushkin_banda_yo: The technique was based off the exorcism techniques utilized by the monks of Thesmosphoros millennia ago. It was designed to be able to absolve any living being regardless of strength however, because of its slow movements, it became very easy to dodge effectively.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/gyakkai_kisho.de: Gyakkai Kishō stems from the — a facet of the elder sight known as Gōgan. Its working is a negotiation between sin and story: the ledger of a life is turned backward, line by line, until the ink runs clear — a sanctum where a lifetime can be endured inside a heartbeat.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hallucinating_ga: A wide-range genjutsu where the user excludes hallucigenic gas from their bodies which then spreads over a wide range. The gas causes hallucinations to anyone who breathes it, which can cause them to see things that aren't really there.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hankan.desc: Hankan is a powerful genjutsu created by Gekihen using the Byakugan. Fear is an emotion induced by a threat perceived by living entities, which causes a change in brain and organ function and ultimately a change in behavior, such as running away, hiding or freezing from traumatic events.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hazy_genjutsu.de: Hazy Genjutsu {{JutsuInfobox |image=Hazy Genjutsu.png |unnamed=Yes |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short, Mid |users= |debut anime= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga }} This technique casts an illusion on the enemy that blurs the target's vision of the entire area.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/heavenly_illusio: A single target, multiple senses jutsu that causes its target to see a pleasurable vision. Like Magen: Narakumi (Demonic Illusion: Hell Viewing), a circle of objects - typically items in quantity nearby such as sand or leaves depending on location - spins and envelops the target before falling away.
When this technique is performed, the user emits an omnidirectional wave of chakra that can ensnare multiple target's minds under its illusory effect.
Heavenly Illusion: Painting a Lively Picture of Fantasy
This specific illusion is one that, surprisingly, has beneficial effects on the victim. Although this depends on the context used.

This technique is reportedly Shirokaze Fuyutama's most powerful and original genjutsu is his arsenal. Using what he had learned from years of training with his he developed a technique designed to debilitate even the most cunning of shinobi.

This particular Genjutsu manipulates the chakra network of the victim in order to create a unique sensation. This sensation gives the victim the feeling that they are at penultimate physical ability, therefore lifting their morale substantially.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hell_s_eye.desc: Hell's Eye is Koshaku Kyuuketsuki's Genjutsu technique. Forming one handseal, he appears to grow "eyes" all over his body. This is merely a facet of Genjutsu. When an opponent looks at one of these "eyes", they will be caught in a powerful illusion where Koshaku can make them believe something is true, or false.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hells_vibe.desc: Hells Vibe *Name: Hells Vibe *Rank: C *Type(s): Genjutsu, Distraction *Element(s): None *User(s): *Description: An average genjutsu that forces the opponent(s) to feel chills running up and down their spine.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hidden_lightning: This is a collaboration technique developed by Hiroki, Yanoi and Minato developed in order to support Yanoi's Chidori and increase it's effectiveness. How it appears to the opponent is that Yanoi rushes out of their hiding place with her Chidori active, with Minato following soon after.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hinderance_genju: A product of the generic genjutsu granted by the Sharingan, the user is able to implant a Genjutsu onto his opponent, but only have the Genjutsu take effect later on after a set amount of time. Densetsu has been seen using it numerous times, mainly to confuse his opponents and create unexpected openings.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hito_funsou.desc: Hito Funsou - Human Disguise *Rank: D *Range: -- *Element: -- *Users: Kouseitan'i Clan Hito Funsou, or Human Disguise, is a pretty simple genjutsu that uses light and chakra to change the look of a demon to match that of a human.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hoderi.desc: Hoderi is the only Water Release Genjutsu used with the Byakugan in existence and it is considered to be one of the strongest genjutsu's so far. Hoderi being a deity of the bounty of the sea and enchanted fisherman,.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hyakki_yako.desc: The is a potent Genjutsu utilized by Nisshō Fuyutama. When activated, Nisshō's right eye appears to glow gold, and he emits a bright burst of light, using his . This light is the actual activation of the technique, and those who gaze upon it, are caught in its embrace.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hyuga_genjutsu_c: The user of this jutsu can cast illusions by manipulating the chakra points in the opponent's body. The user must have Byakugan and Yin Release to be able to cast this technique. The user has to focus on the opponent with their Byakugan to cast this genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hyuga_genjutsu_r: It's an advanced genjustu break which was developed by Haru Hyūga.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/hyuga_secret_tec: Hyūga Secret Technique: All Seeing White Eye
Hyūga Secret Technique: All Seeing White Eye.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/ikkibu.desc: With the essence of the Heavenly Sovereign imbedded within the Path Gold Alignment techniques, few find possible to surpass them in all their aspects.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/illusion_bee_buz: The user channels chakra through the buzzing of her bees. The bee's buzzing produces a particular sound wave, which travels from the inner ear directly to affect the brain. This causes her target to hallucinate, seeing multiple images of her, and making it very hard to tell the real one from the illusions.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/illusion_bell_ne: The user employs this technique with the bells attached to senbon, or in rather cases, kunai. The bell's ringing produces a particular sound wave, which travels from the inner ear directly to affect the brain.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/illusion_of_blad: Illusion of Blades Meeting is a Genjutsu employed by Shusen Nara. By using the sound of blades clashing, or sparking together, Shusen is able to use Sound as a trigger to trap his target in a perceived clash of blades with whatever bladed weapon they would naturally draw.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/illusionary_bell: The user runs chakra into one of their bells, causing it to emit an eerie sound like that of a chirping cicada. Anyone other than the user who hears it will have hallucinations that cicadas are swarming. If the illusion is not broken after a minute or two, the cicadas will engulf the hearers.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/illusionary_clou: A technique which Sujin based on the principles of A's Lightning Release Armor. However, it eventually resulted in something totally unlike the latter.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/illusionary_mist: The Three-Tails releases a mist created by its chakra to put intruders under an illusion. The illusion torments the target with events from their past. The illusion will vanish if the victim can break the illusion, either by themselves or with the assistance of another.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/infinite_demise_: Infinite Demise Technique (無限薨去の術, Mugen Kōkyo no Jutsu) is a Genjutsu that uses the concept of Killing Intent and applies it in the form of illusionary torture. The better the user is with Killing intent, the stronger he can push this technique.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/infinite_fear.de: This is a technique that can only be used by a person of the Kyōgan, The user makes direct eye contact with the target. After this the targets, fear is drawn out of their mind and used against them. Fears can also fight along with the user.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/infinite_ring_ge: This extremely powerful illusion, a creation of Hyouya's Kuzu-no-Ha spirit, causes the target to experience freefalling through a curving, colorless cavern, with extremely sharp spikes jutting out from the walls, which the user will try to avoid, by narrower and narrower margins.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/infinite_spirali: Infinite Spiraling Illusion Technique is one of the signature techniques of Mugan Uchiha of the Masked Shadows. This genjutsu uses the Sharingan to project it, so it requires no Hand Seals, only an eye contact.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/infinite_tsukuyo: Infinite Tsukuyomi {{JutsuInfobox |tabber=Yes |image1=Infinite Tsukuyomi.png |caption1=A light shines out to the world… |image2=Infinite Tsukuyomi effect.png |caption2=…which entraps the inhabitants in a genjutsu. |named=Yes |kanji=無限月読 |romaji=Mugen Tsukuyomi |literal english=Infinite Moon Reader |other jutsu=Yes |rel
ability.narutorpg.fanon/inner_sakura_rw1: Inner Sakura (RW109) broadly refers to a range of techniques performed by Sakura Haruno with her inner self. Inner Sakura is a manifestation of Sakura Haruno's inner emotions, representing Sakura’s actual opinion on things when she outwardly displays something completely different.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/instantaneous_me: By a single glance at the target, the user instantly enters its subconscious, manifesting an ephemeral image of his own body in his mind, the target is paralyzed until the user can exit.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/interrogation_ge: Interrogation Genjutsu {{JutsuInfobox |unnamed=Yes |image=Kakkō's Interrogation Genjutsu.png |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debut=Naruto: A Shinobi Story |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Novel }} This is a genjutsu used
ability.narutorpg.fanon/invocation_of_sh: This technique, which was historically associated with the the art of mysticism, utilizes precise chakra control in order to manipulate an opponent's actions through commands that are relayed via genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/invocation_of_th: This technique allows the user to construct a mental block in order to protect their mind from invasion, which was originally used by ancient mystics to protect themselves from being controlled by Yūgure.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/irozu_secret_gen: Irozu Secret Genjutsu: Paradigm of Corruption

This technique is a powerful and secret genjutsu created by the Irozu clan, guardians of the daimyo of the Land of Fire. Otoshi Nagare, who is a descendant of the Irozu clan, is capable of using this powerful technique to cripple his foes.
Irozu Secret Genjutsu: World of Shards

This is a powerful and secret genjutsu known by the members of the Irozu clan, guardians of the daimyo of the Land of Fire. Otoshi Nagare, a descendant of the Irozu clan, can use this technique to cripple his foes. Aichi Goron learned it by reflecting it back at Otoshi during their battle.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/isobu_rw109.desc: Isobu (RW109) , more commonly known as the , is one of the nine tailed beasts.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/izanagi.desc: Izanagi {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |tabber=Yes |image1=Izanagi 1.png |caption1=When Danzō is hit by Sasuke's Susanoo arrow… |image2=Izanagi 2.png |caption2=…he casts Izanagi to nullify the damage and continue as if nothing happened. |named=Yes |kanji=イザナギ |romaji=Izanagi |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Creation of All Things
ability.narutorpg.fanon/izanagi_rw109.de: Izanagi (RW109) is a dōjutsu of Shisui Uchiha’s Mangekyō Sharingan. With a normal genjutsu, a user will apply an illusion to a target’s senses, causing the target to experience things that are not real.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/izanagi_yakujo_s: Grasping the handle of Tanpopo, Yakujō will use the Wind Release: Deep Breath and blow through the metal tip of Tanpopo. The wind element will release through the hollow staff and release into the the end. The spores will release out of the end.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/izanami_rw109.de: Izanami (RW109) is a dōjutsu of Shisui Uchiha’s Mangekyō Sharingan. Like the various techniques used with the Sharingan and its Mangekyō counterpart, this technique is named after a .
ability.narutorpg.fanon/izanami_striking: After performing the hand seal, the user will use Izanami to create various sparrows. Once created the user can manipulate these sparrows to attack the opponent or circle around the user for defensive style similar to the Hyuga's rotation technique. The bird can also be absorbed to replenish small amounts of chakra.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/jibakugan.desc: This genjutsu brings out the victim's subconscious negative or hateful emotions. The caster can take advantage of these feelings and control the victim's actions. This technique can be cancelled by smelling the , using the Sharingan, or killing the caster.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/jump_style_air_s: The user jumps forth towards her opponent with a sword strike, leaving a trace of afterimage, which when seen by the target locks them in a genjutsu which causes them to hallucinate multiple swords. With the enemy off guard, the user is free to cut them down.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kalki.desc: Sacrificial Aspect - Sense of Touch This ability is contained within the right hand of Sakra Devanam Indra. In which it spawns the apocryphal "Kalki" a large sword capable of annihilating anything and everything, physical, spiritual, conceptual.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kamimusuhi.desc: Kamimusuhi is a unique ability awakened by Kurami Uchiha obtaining the Mangekyō Sharingan after some time, when she had been granted this gift is unknown. Unlike Tsukuyomi’s time control and torturing manners, Kamimusuhi goes a step further than this, and yet Kurami resent Kamimusuhi’s existence.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kamiyonanayo.des: Kamiyonanyo ((神世七代, Seven Generations of the Age of Gods) is a genjutsu of exceptional caliber, formed through the utilization of the . It was a technique developed by Shinpachi Nomura in order to effectively combat the native to the .
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kiryu_genso.desc: Kiryū Gensō (気流幻想, Literally: Illusory Air Current) is the trademark technique style of Megami Otsuihō which utilizes infrasonic pulses of sound, generated via the , in order to facilitate illusions.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kitsune_kenbu_sh: Kitsune Kenbu: Shinikajuen - Fox Sword Dance: Orchard of Death *Rank: A *Range: -- *Element: -- *Users: Kouseitan'i Clan The user begins this genjutsu by focusing a large amount of chakra into their eyes. They then look the opponent in the eyes and implant the chakra there.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kitsune_s_song.d: Ayumi in her half transformed state, sings a beautiful yet enchanting song that is used to lure her opponent's to her or control her opponent's mind. Ayumi usually uses this technique while hunting, however she won't hesitate to use it during battle. Opponent's with a strong will are resistant to this technique.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/koga_ryu.desc: Kōga-ryū is a multipurpose fighting style that the Koga Guild teach their shinobi. Unlike normally fighting style it isn't restricted to a single method of fighting, but instead is about giving its users a way to be prepared for anything. Kōga-ryū is fundamentally different from all other fighting styles.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kotoamatsukami.d: Kotoamatsukami {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Kotoamatsukami.png |named=Yes |kanji=別天神 |romaji=Kotoamatsukami |literal english=Distinguished Heavenly Gods |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga, Game
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kotoamatsukami_a: Kotoamatsukami: Afterglow {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Zanko.png |kanji=別天神・残光 |romaji=Kotoamatsukami: Zankō |literal english=Distinguished Heavenly Gods: Afterglow |game names=Koto Amatsukami: Zanko |parent jutsu=Kotoamatsukami |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kotoamatsukami_b: Kotoamatsukami: Beam of Light {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Kotoamatsukami Kobo.png |kanji=別天神・光芒 |romaji=Kotoamatsukami: Kōbō |literal english=Distinguished Heavenly Gods: Beam of Light |game names=Kotoamatsukami: Kobo |parent jutsu=Kotoamatsukami |jutsu classification=, Dōjutsu, Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kotoamatsukami_r: Kotoamatsukami (RW109) is the signature dōjutsu of Shisui Uchiha’s two Mangekyō Sharingan, casting a powerful yet subtle mind-controlling genjutsu on a target without their knowledge.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kouseitani_clan_: Kouseitani Clan Naibun Genjutsu: Shougai no Butai

Kouseitan'i Clan Naibun Genjutsu: Shougai no Butai - Kouseitan'i Clan Secret Genjutsu: Assault of the Elements *Rank: SS *Users: Kouseitan'i Clan The user focuses a small amount of chakra into their eyes and looks at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kuchisake_onna.d: Kuchisake-onna (口裂け女, Slit-Mouthed Woman) is a powerful illusion incorporating the use of Kirigakure's signature mist as well as the Magen: Kyōka Suigetsu. It is recognised by Heiwa as his most horrific and twisted illusion due to the traumatic side-effects victims whom it was face.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kuebiko_ender.de: Kuebiko is a Genjutsu Mangekyō Sharingan technique created and used by Seikan Uchiha. Though not a separate technique bound to one eye, it uses the Mangekyō Sharingan. To use it, a wielder of a Mangekyō Sharingan focuses their eyes to have the pinwheel pattern spin in a hypnotic manner.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/kuiaratame.desc: Kuiaratame (悔い改め} Kuiaratame is a very powerful form of illusion that rivals kotoamatsukami and infinite tsukuyomi in terms of strength is as powerful as kotoamatsukami except that Yasuhiro with his right eye can not only lock the victim into undetectable genjutsu but also chew his will or ideology against the victim.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/lament_of_sanzu_: Lament of Sanzu River is a powerful that seemingly stems from Koyomi’s Kindō Byakugan which traps the target into a seemingly endless illusion that forces them to live out the entirety of their life on a mental plane and eventually finds themselves upon the shores of the Sanzu river upon death in said illusion.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/leaf_style_phant: Leaf-Style Phantom Blade (木ノ葉流迷夢剣, Konoha-Ryū Meimuken) is a technique developed in Konohagakure. Famous amongst the Kinsei clan, used by many swordsmen in Konoha. It's based on an ancient Konoha Kenjutsu technique called Leaf-Style Willow, which was used in the past as a way to deceive the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/leaf_style_willo: The user waves their sword back and forth, which when seen by the target locks them in a genjutsu which causes them to hallucinate multiple waving arms. The movement resembles that of a blowing in the wind. With the enemy off guard, the user is free to cut them down.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/leaf_whistle_gen: A sound genjutsu made by whistling through a leaf infused with chakra. Due to the fact that this is a sound-based genjutsu, it doesn't require the enemy to look at the user for the genjutsu and it can be used from a distance which is a great advantage against other genjutsu which require eye-contact.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/light_and_dark_e: Light and Dark Exorcism Arts of Togakushi

This is a Hiden, or secret technique, that is also sometimes referred to as spiritual puppetry. Much like the true puppetry technique, it involves the manipulation of an inanimate physical body, such as that of a puppet.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/lightning_illusi: By converting one's chakra into countless microscopic electrical sparks through which the user will coordinate complex signaling to the target's nerves, thereby creating illusory objects or areas.

By converting one's chakra into tiny electrical sparks, the user will signal the targets nervous system in complex patterns. This signaling is intended to create an illusion scenario where the target is immobilized, often with their arms bound.

This two part technique allows a user to disrupt their own chakra flow, usually to break a genjutsu, and immediately follow up with illusory assault of their own. The first part of this technique is accomplished by falsely triggering one's own nerves with complex electrical signals via the Lightning Release.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/lightning_releas: Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Flash of Lightning Pillar

Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Flash of Lightning Pillar {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image1=Raigen Raikōchū Manga.png |caption1=The technique depicted in the manga. |image2=Lightning Flash Pillar.PNG |caption2=The technique depicted in the anime. |tabber=Yes |named=Yes |kanji=雷遁 • 雷幻雷光柱 |romaji=Raiton: Raigen Raikōchū

After doing the required seals, the user will take the victim to an illusionary cloud puff. Then, the clouds begin to turn black and lightning strikes the victim severely. In reality, the victim becomes paralyzed due to them believing they have been struck.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/living_nightmare: The Living Nightmare Technique is a special technique created by Ezemaru Kimza a few years before the events of Kimza Chronicles. It soon becomes his signature technique and is considered one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence as well as an incredible feat for a Kimza, who has little talent in genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/lovely_ladies_of: Lovely Ladies of the Leaf or Harem of the Eyes is a Genjutsu technique created by Happosai Hanju. This technique was created to distract interlopers who get in the way of Happosai's peaking, stealing, and any other action he uses when he is just being a big pervert.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/magen_denkosekka: Magen: Denkōsekka (魔幻:電光石火, Evil Illusion: That Which Matches the Speed of Lightning), is known as a high-speed movement based technique, that has allowed Yamanaka Akihiko to remain one of the fastest shinobi in all of the Hidden Leaf.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/magen_heki_chiso: Magen: Heki Chisoki - Demonic Illusion: False Speed Technique *Rank: SS *Range: Mid (0~15m) *Users: Emanyeru Kouseitan'i *Clan: Kouseitan'i Clan The user begins this jutsu by infusing their eyes with chakra while concentrating on the genjutsu at hand.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/magen_kyoka_suig: Magen: Kyōka Suigetsu (鏡花水月, lit.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/magen_saimin_no_: Magen: Saimin no Jutsu (魔幻:催眠術) is a low-level but extremely versatile genjutsu dojutsu used by Yamanaka Akihiko. Using the eyes as a medium, Akihiko is able to instantly trap his victims in an illusion of his choosing.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/magnet_release_d: After gathering magnet chakra in their hand, the user snaps their finger towards an opponent. This causes an invisible E.M.P to surge toward the opponent. Upon contact with the intended object the user can employ different effects.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/mangekyo_sharing: This is a more advanced form of Sharingan: Reverse Dimension. Now, in the victim's mind, all sense of direction is altered. The left is up. Up is right. Right is down. Down is left. The back is the front and the front is the back. Northwest is Southeast. Southeast is Southwest. Southwest is Northeast.

A very powerful Genjutsu. By using the Mangekyō Sharingan, the user can put the victim in a state where all senses, but the sense of touch/feeling, are disabled for five minutes. The victim can't see, hear, smell, or taste for a whole five minutes. Since this is a Mangekyō technique, this does put strain on the body.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/medical_illusion: The is a powerful that was created by an unknown member of the who was once a member of the . This powerful technique was created by a member of the who'd been apprenticed to during the .
ability.narutorpg.fanon/melody_of_decept: Melody of Deception (旋律の虚偽, Senritsu no Kyogi) is a technique created and utilized by Yūgetsu. He uses his flute in order to perform the technique. This jutsu is the base of all his melody related Genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/meshita.desc: Meshita {| align=center style="background:transparent;" | valign=center | This article, , is property of Jumpy Naruto. |} Meshita ((名) 若者, literally meaning young) is a genjutsu that forces the opponent to believe that he/she is a child.It is known to be quite effective as,as long as the genjutsu is in effect,the oppon
ability.narutorpg.fanon/midnight_mare.de: The Midnight Mare is a powerful lingering genjutsu that revolves around manipulating dream when the target fall asleep. The technique allows the user to manipulate and control the dream of the target when they fall asleep.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/mikaboshi.desc: Mikaboshi is a known technique that stems from the Inreki Clan, which has been passed onto to the evident members that inherited the strong spiritual chakra of their ancestor.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/mind_s_eye.desc: This genjutsu focuses on the opponent's nerves and mind, and targets them by using the collected information to project the opponent's worst fears and nightmares. It is said that this technique is powerful enough to cause the nerves of the opponent to become temporarily paralyzed.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/mirror_release_s: The ability of this powerful Genjutsu is to control the five senses to the point that it can make the target misinterpret another person's form, shape, mass, feel and smell to be that of the enemy. It also requires the victim to make eye contact with Riyan's left Mangekyo in order for that person to be trapped.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/mist_servant_tec: Mist Servant Technique {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Mist Servant Technique.png |named=Yes |kanji=霞従者の術 |romaji=Kasumi Jūsha no Jutsu |english tv=Misty Follower Jutsu |jutsu rank=D |jutsu classification=Genjutsu, Clone Techniques |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debu
ability.narutorpg.fanon/mountains_and_fo: Mountains and Forests Sutra is a technique crafted by Hijiko Kakurerakudo that is based among his fundamemtal reasonings of duality. The personality of the nonself brought forth distinguished attributes from multiple nature transformations which resulted in such a stoic jutsu. The nativity of the world's forest.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/movement_masking: Movement Masking is a technique where the user educes a genjutsu around their vicinity and mask their movements. For example, when throwing a left hook, people can tell a person is about to throw one because of the movement of their arm.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/mugenjo.desc: Mugenjō is a an addition-line ability: one of the aspects of illusion mastery. Seemingly simple, it is used to refer to the act of "layering" genjutsu: interweaving a genjutsu for back-to-back casting, or hiding a "timed" genjutsu within another one.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/mushroom_spore_t: The Takehoushi no Jutsu (Kanji: 茸胞子の術; English: Mushroom Spore Technique) is a Ninjutsu/Genjutsu utilized by the mushrooms. It allows them to expend chakra as a means of producing spores that are disproportionately high in spiritual energy.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/mutability_of_al: Mutability of All Senses Technique (万感無常の術,Bankan mujō no jutsu) is foul technique originating from a dark beast. This technique is a corruption of the imagination governing and form creation of via the infusion of . * Due to originating from the Namashiki those that possess its chakra are able to use this technique.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/negative_emotion: Negative Emotions Suppression Seal {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |kanji=阿閦如来 |romaji=Akshobhya |jutsu classification=Hiden, Genjutsu, Fūinjutsu |nature type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |users= |jutsu media=Anime, Manga }} The Negative Emotions Suppression Seal is a hiden technique that combines fūinjutsu and genjutsu
ability.narutorpg.fanon/nensha.desc: Nensha (念写,Thoughtography) is a technique awakened by Valden after consuming the 「 」and is useable with his Hametsugan.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/nightmare_crow_c: This is a genjutsu, which is cast by a crow, In this genjutsu a crow caws a few times which drops the opponent under the user's genjutsu. The user is free to manipulate the technique and make any illusion they wish their opponent to see.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/nightmare_illusi: The user's blood is smeared on the face of a victim and the scent of the blood unleashes a terrifying Genjutsu, which transforms the user into a terrifying and gory looking demon in the eyes of the victim.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/ninja_art_eterna: Ninpou: Fukyuu Kugyou - Ninja Art: Eternal Penance *Rank: S *Range: - *Users:Emanyeru Kouseitan'i The Eternal Penance is a technique that uses the old saying 'The eyes are the windows to the soul' and takes it to a whole new level.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/ninja_art_infini: Ninpou: Mugendai Akumu - Ninja Art: Infinite Nightmare *Rank: S *Range: - *Users:Emanyeru Kouseitan'i This genjutsu focuses on confusing the opponents optical and hearing nerve centers to create a sense of confusion while in a state of terror.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/nise_no_sekai_ge: Nise no sekai: Gensō is a powerful Genjutsu that only Raio's Rinne Sharingan has been shown able to perform. To use this technique the user must already have their Rinne Sharingan activated.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/nise_tengoku.des: Nise Tengoku is a Dōjutsu and Genjutsu accessed through both eyes of Kama Uchiha's Mangekyō Sharingan. It is a genjutsu of the highest calibre and it incorporates and synchronizes both Genjutsu used through Kama's eyes; Amenonaemasu and Amenowakahiko.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/nyorai.desc: Nyorai is one of the most powerful Genjutsu of the Uchiha Clan. This technique is similar to Izanami, but instead of deciding destiny, it forces the target to acknowledge it along with past mistakes and forgive themselves, thus gaining enlightenment.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/olfactory_genjut: Scent based illusion techniques remain among the rarest forms of Yin Release used to initiate genjutsu attacks on opponents. Though unusual they are highly effective methods of delivery often used as supplemental tactics in Kyrgyzishi Clan attack patterns.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/onogoroshima.des: Onogoroshima (淤能碁呂島おのごろじま, Spontaneously Congealed Island) is a powerful of the Goshintai. It allows the user to superimpose imagination over reality. *Onogoroshima was created when Izanagi and Izanami churned the sea with the Amenonuhoko.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/opalescence.desc: This is a secret genjutsu that was once handed down from head of the Hyūga to the next. Eventually, almost anyone with a Byakugan eye could learn this technique, though the head of the Hyūga clan has access to the most powerful version.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/order_of_glamour: Order of Glamour {{JutsuInfobox |named=Yes |image=Order of Glamour.png |kanji=蠱惑の号令 |romaji=Kowaku no Gōrei |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu= |jutsu classification=Genjutsu, Taijutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Offensive, Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |game debut= |jutsu media=Game }} Using Demonic Illusion
ability.narutorpg.fanon/otojutsu_thousan: Otojutsu: Thousand Cherry Blossoms Nightmare is an Otojutsu technique created by Samiya Kanari. By singing a specific melody, so long as her opponent hears it they become trapped in a nightmare. The world around them becomes a large cherry blossom forest.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/otojutsu_wild_an: Otojutsu: Wild Anthem is an Otojutsu technique created by Samiya Kanari. It is employed by simply screaming aloud, amplifying her voice to levels that send sound waves all around her.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/pale_rose_art_ro: Pale Rose Art: Rose Moon Dancing Blade

Pale Rose Art: Rose Moon Dancing Blade ---- Using this genjutsu, Ayaka creates the illusion of a pink full-moon in an evening sky. Then, she body flickers up into the air, so that the moon outlines her dark silhouette.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/paradise_path.de: The Paradise Path is Doujinn's unique ability using his Rinnegan. It utilizes a range of special genjutsu, and can seal victims inside of them. Doujinn uses his unique Paradise Genjutsu through this path when he wants.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/perfect_hypnosis: Perfect Hypnosis: Fake Object is a supplementary genjutsu used by the genjutsu master of the Masked Shadows, Kitsunekamen. This genjutsu fools the senses of vision and feeling and makes the target think there is an object that doesn't really exist.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/phagaro_rooho.de: Enter the enigmatic event . This technique is characterized by an illuminating black and white energy sphere, which forms in the vicinity of Gaoh's core, with anomalous markings surrounding it.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/phantom_veil_tec: The is an ancient technique that was once characteristic of the Noble , having originated from their teachings. It is a plain and basic illusionary technique used to set the foundations for their hiden .
ability.narutorpg.fanon/plant_release_ma: By using Plant Release: Mass Chaos, The user sprouts plants from the ground that releases spores and pheromones rapidly into the air.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/poison_moth_genj: Poison Moth Genjutsu {{JutsuInfobox |unnamed=Yes |tabber=Yes |image1=Poison Moth Genjutsu.png |caption1=Poison is breathed in by a target… |image2=Poison Moth Genjutsu 2.png |caption2=…causing them to imagine being swarmed by moths. |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu rang
ability.narutorpg.fanon/pradasa_seal_foo: The is a highly useful technique developed by Asu Rashoujin. This Fuuinjutsu is inspired by a Genjutsu that creates similar effects.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/prismatic_illusi: Name: Prismatic Illusion: Mirror Shuriken Torrent Type: Genjutsu Rank: B-rank Range: Short to long range (0-20 meters) Handseals: Inu, Mi and Ram User(s): Patorikku Purizumu Description: This Genjutsu is used by Patorikku to momentarily paralyze dozens of opponents with one single techniqu
ability.narutorpg.fanon/rabbit_god_ark_o: Rabbit God: Ark Of The Cosmos
One of Doujinn's most powerful attacks using Kaguya's chakra, the God: Ark Of The Cosmos technique transports the user and his targets while it also creates a genjutsu that can end life.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/radioactive_pois: Radioactive Poisoning Technique (放射性毒殺の術, Houshasei Dokusatsu no Jutsu) is a Tailed Beast Skill of the Storm Dragon. In a similar vein to Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Flash of Lightning Pillar, the beast can emit a bright flash from their body, blinding any one who sees for some time.
Ravenous Heaven (,) is a technique developed by Enmei Musubi after training with his uncle.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/remote_chakra_ma: The was once used by the Minazuki clan ages ago. The clan was only one branch of the Revered Paths of the Consecrated Blood Grail whose names were filled with grace and dignity.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/restricted_tsuku: The Restricted Tsukuyomi is a powerful genjutsu which is cast from the third eye of a Rinnegan user. The user casts the genjutsu with their third eye, causing this eye to emit a powerful light. Anyone who sees this light is then trapped within the realm of the genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/reverse_realm_te: Reverse Realm Technique (倒像国土の術, Tōzōkokudo no Jutsu) is a high tier Genjutsu. It's considered one of the masterpieces in illusionary arts. It's a technique that works on the perception of the target, altering it in order to puzzle their minds and create multiple openings for attacks.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/rising_dragon_cl: Rising Dragon Claw is one of Yaburu most favored attacks derived from his own combat form known as the, "Revolting Fist".
ability.narutorpg.fanon/riyan_s_unnamed_: By channeling his chakra into his opponent, Riyan is able to distort the target's perception, effectively making a person's five senses unable to properly register what is happening. This power can be negated by one using their chakra to close off their emotions before the hypnosis takes place.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sage_art_illusio: The user releases a part of his natural energy into the surrounding area and it forms an invisible mist. If the opponent is in this mist they start too hallucinate things.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sage_art_silver_: Sage Art: Silver Tongue (仙法・銀舌, Senpō: Ginshita) is a -enhanced and technique created by Yua Shimura based off her studies of the . It serves as a Fighting Style. Yua, through her Summon wrapped around her neck, is able to continuously gather and store it within a Fūinjutsu seal located on her tongue.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sage_art_triple_: Sage Art: Triple Element: Rhapsody of Endless Dreams

Sage Art: Triple Element: Rhapsody of Endless Dreams () is a collaboration technique preformed by Zenkichi Senju, Yoshikage Kurokami, and Kaname Soga. In order to use this technique, Zenkichi and Yoshikage will enter Sage Mode, while Kaname enter his Nature God Mode.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sainokawara.desc: Sainokawara is an extremely powerful Genjutsu that is used with the Mangekyou Sharingan. Like the Susanoo, Sainokawara isn't exclusive to an unique Mangekyou Sharingan. However, the conditions to use this ability are difficult.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sakra_devanam_in: Sakra Devanam Indra ---- f0EP95I0vHY ~Activation of Sakra Devanam Indra ---- one of Gaoh's only Buddhaic Existential Plane techniques is truly an extension of the Sage of Enlightenment's abilities and inner consciousness at their peak.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/scattered_clouds: Scattered Clouds Vanishing Mist is a contact-type that uses the -natured chakra, such as that from the Hiding in Mist Technique, as a medium. With this technique the user can selectively ensnare individuals withing the range of their mist in a variety of illusory effects according to their will.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/scattering_thous: Scattering Thousand Dreams Technique is an unique initiation maneuver that serves as a follow up maneuver to crow-based . While this technique was developed as a direct from the it can also be used in concert with the and Hiding with Crows Technique.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/scorch_release_i: The is a technique that compels Hōsōshi's imagination to execute his murderous intentions with the Scorch Release. The extremity of this technique is fully dependent on Hōsōshi's mood and killing intentions.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/seal_of_the_livi: Seal of the Living Law of Light

The Living Law of Light brings the individual into a harmonic balance with all aspects of his / her "destiny" field, which is not a set pattern, but a series of holo-realms within the experience, in which that soul may choose the highest forms of expression through evolution.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/secret_jutsu_hal: The user sends a pulse of sparks through the ground and the nearby enemies who are touched by it are put in a state of dysphoria and feel as if they are living in a sort of hell. This jutsu can also be used airborne, but is not typically used in such ways. The effects of this jutsu can vary.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/secret_medical_s: Secret Medical Skill: Surgical White Elephant Phantom

The Secret Medical Skill: Surgical White Elephant Phantom (秘伝医療 技能: 手術 有難迷惑 幻像, Hideniryō Ginō: Shujutsu Arigatameiwaku Genzō) is a powerful illusion technique incorporated by medical ninjutsu. It was created by Chūkode Caught deep without an illusion, the opponent is unable to unravel themselves!
ability.narutorpg.fanon/secret_technique: This technique requires the dojutsu Anshigan, and its ability to emit light. In this method the wielder can send signals understood by fireflies and have them execute commands. With their own chakra the user can then adjust the intensity, duration, and range of the cold light emitted by these fireflies.

The user taps the forehead of their target before performing the rat hand seal. The target will feel their vision go blank for a moment before finding themselves in an empty void surrounded by millions upon millions of insects.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/senshiryoku.desc: Senshiryoku {{Infobox/Jutsu/RW109 | title= | image= | caption=Taiyō using Senshiryoku. | kanji=千視力 | unnamed justu=No | romaji=Senshiryoku | literal english=Thousand Eyesight | novel debut=The Six Paths Chronicles | media=Novel | nature type= Yin Release | jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu | jutsu rank=S-rank |
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sephirothic_tree: The (עץ חיים) or is a term from the 's system of , named , to describe a diagram composed of 10 Numbers and 22 Letters. The ten Numbers are the ten sayings of God in the first chapter of (בראשית) in which He wrought the universe, with the 22 letters of the Hebrew alefbet interpolated between these powerful Numbers.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/shadow_paralysis: A rather simple application of Kotoshiro's manifestation of the Sharingan's Genjutsu capabilities put to action.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/shadow_strike_of: Shadow Strike of the Sages * Name: Shadow Strike of the Sages * Type: Unknown rank, Offensive * Users: Kakashi Namikaze (Ultimate Ninja 3 only) In Ultimate Ninja 3, Kakashi Namikaze calls forth shadows of himself to strike the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sharingan_autoge: Sharingan Autogenjutsu is a new approach of genjutsu developed by Maikeru Alexe. This technique opens a virtually unlimited options of controlling one's own psychology in any way imaginable, by directly manipulating the user's brain to create a wanted effect.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sharingan_blind_: Sharingan: Blind Reality (写輪眼・盲実, Sharingan: Mōjitsu) is a technique developed by Hidari with Kazuhide's assistance.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sharingan_chakra: The , is a created by Ayame Uchiha, through the extensive use of her Sharingan. After activating the Sharingan, the user applies its base technique when exerting their chakra, capturing the foe in a genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sharingan_halluc: A more advance form to the Sharingan's basic hypnosis ability. The user uses hypnosis to cause the enemy to hallucinate for a predetermined amount of time. The possibilities for this jutsu are near infinite as the user can cause the enemy to hallucinate about anything.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sharingan_illusi: Sharingan: Illusion Punch is a Genjutsu created by Oshino Uchiha, It's incredibly similar to Tsukuyomi as it also plays inside the Opponents head, the opponent perceives themselves being hit with punches over and over again at the full strength, it usually plays in their head for about 1,30/2 minutes and Is only visibl
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sharingan_pronge: Sharingan Pronged Hell: the user affects everyone nearby. Learned from rank 3.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sharingan_revers: This is rather a simple Genjutsu, all it does is that it makes it seem everything is upside down. Nothing more, nothing less.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sharingan_static: The Sharingan: Static Reality (写輪眼・静真, Sharingan: Seijin; English TV: "Copy Wheel Eye: Sage") is a technique which is derived from the principles of the Izanami in combination with the ability for the Sharingan to cast Genjutsu of varying degrees.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sharingan_truth_: The Sharingan: Truth Inversion (写輪眼・真経津, Sharingan: Mafutsu) is a unique technique that utilizes the hypnotic (催眠, Saimin) and insightful (洞察, Dōsatsu) properties of the Sharingan to create a highly unique and debilitating illusion that can cause repeated damage towards an enemy if the victim are left unaware.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sharingan_wights: Shisui can create creatures who follow any of his commands, generally involving espionage or the stalking of others. Each of these creatures bear his within their eyes, allowing him to see what they see and even cast additional illusions through their vision.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/shinatsuhiko_end: Shinatsuhiko is the left eye Mangekyō Sharingan ability of Kūiki Uchiha and is an extremely powerful Genjutsu. Sasuke Uchiha has been quoted as saying Shinatsuhiko could be just as powerful as Itachi Uchiha's Tsukuyomi, if not more powerful.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/shinigami_no_shi: Shinigami no shiren: the user affects everyone nearby. Learned from rank 3.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/shinjiro.desc: Named after the Death-Gods of the afterworld, the Shinigami, Shinziro is one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence. The Shinjiro's name literally means the 'Shinigami Stare of Shattered Souls'. It is also unique to the Shinigami's eyes flashing when the jutsu is initiated.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/shinkantoku.desc: Shinkantoku (, lit. Mind Control) was the first Mangekyō Sharingan technique awakened in Kane Soga's eyes. It is powerful genjutsu capable of manipulating a person's mind and memory.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/shinkiro_no_juts: Name:Shinkiro no Jutsu (Mirage Technique) Type: Genjutsu, A- Rank,Offensive,Defensive Users: Shinkiro,Yuri Kazahana This jutsu is more of a skill than a jutsu. The user can cast mirages on the opponent,making the opponent feel like the mirage is real or they are under Genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/shivering_whirlp: This genjutsu locks the target's vision span; in other words, their line of sight will not move even if the body is turned, and the target can only see what they were seeing when the genjutsu was first used until the genjutsu is dispelled.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/shroud_of_the_ga: Expelling forth the spores, similar to the Izanagi technique with the use of the Wind Release: Deep Breath Yakujō will trap her target within a powerful genjutsu. The target will believe they are laying in a bed of calm grass and being hit by a vivid wind.
Silent Nocturne (粛粛夜曲, Shukushuku Yakyoku).
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sky_style_dance_: Sky Style: Dance of the Crescent Moon

The Sky Style: Dance of the Crescent Moon is a variant of the Leaf Style: Dance of the Crescent Moon involving the usage of illusionary copies to psychologically overwhelm the opponent. This is done with combining the copies with blinding speed.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sly_mind_affect_: Sly Mind Affect Technique {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image1=Sly Mind Affect Technique part 1.png |caption1=The target is fooled into thinking they are making progress… |image2=Sly Mind Affect Technique part 2.png |caption2=…even though the distance remains the same all the time. |tabber=Yes |named=Yes |kanji=狐狸心中の術 |romaji=
ability.narutorpg.fanon/smoke_genjutsu.d: Kemuri blows a stream of smoke from her mouth, the trick is to make the target close there eyes. After they open there eyes they see terrible images of there friends and family turn into skulls.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/smoke_illusion_t: The user casts an illusion using smoke as a medium. The user creates shadowy replicas of themselves that vanish and appear throughout the smoke. The user can have these figures also "attack" the opponent. This technique can be further aided by using smoke clones that can actually harm the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/smoke_release_ge: The Smoke Release: Genjutsu is a Genjutsu that allows the user to create illusions by using the smoke created by the Smoke Release, a smoke based Kekkei Tōta.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/snake_slither_ge: Using his , Ken appear to turn himself into a giant that binds the target leaving them at his mercy.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sojobo.desc: Sōjōbō is a genjutsu utilized by Takumi Uchiha. It is said to be one of the most dangerous genjutsu/dōjutsu so far. This technique can create illusions that are so realistic and powerful they can cause physical effects (cuts, bruises, burns, etc) to appear on the target and affect surroundings as they were real.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/soul_judgment.de: Soul Judgment is a Genjutsu created and used by Akame no Nishiki. With the application of chakra, Nishiki's red eyes can be made to glow ethereally. An opponent looking at Nishiki will be drawn to look at the eyes, when a Genjutsu will activate.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/soulbane.desc: Soulbane is a powerful genjutsu known to be forbidden among the Konohagakure ninja. It targets the mind and causes the target to believe that anyone is a foe. While under the effects of the genjutsu, anyone affected will attack those who they believe to be enemies, even their closest friends.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/soulless_sandsto: This is a technique created by Shigai Daija That allows him to mess with and even kill opponents. It begins with him kicking up a massive amount of sediment from the ground that creates a sea of sand. He then creates a large gust of wind that turns the sea into a raging sandstorm.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/sound_release_il: This technique paralyzes the enemy. It starts if the enemy hears the little sound of the hand signs being performed. The enemy starts feeling dizy and is seen in a dark place. Then, he hears steps and fast moves.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/speak_of_the_dev: This particular Genjutsu is, unlike others, activated through verbal expression. In this regard, the Genjutsu utilizes the words spoken by the user, and subsequently employs them as a means to direct the chakra network's flow within the brain.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/spirit_amplifica: This technique, as its name suggests, allows the user to magnify and project composed primarily of spiritual energy into the surrounding area. By doing so one is able to induce effects upon targeted individuals within his immediate vicinity.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/spirit_illusion_: Spirit Illusion: False Flame Technique (精幻・偽炎の術, Seigen: Kaen no Jutsu) is the first of Koyone Takamori original illusions, developed just prior to her entry into the .

A refined and specific application of the Spirit Amplification Technique this slowly robs the victim of their ability to visually focus on the surrounding environment, effectively disrupting their ability to properly react to their opponents.

Spirit Illusion: Peerless Transcendence (精幻・無双超絶, Seigen: Musō Chōzetsu) is a developed by Kyōshi Takamori and later passed on to this sister, Koyone. Rare amongst illusory techniques this skill provides a supportive function, as opposed to the vast majority of genjutsu that distort or falsify an opponent's senses.

Spirit Illusion: Reverse Dream Technique (精幻・逆夢の術, Seigen: Sakayume no Jutsu) is a developed by Kyōshi Takamori and later passed on to this sister, Koyone. This technique allows the user to relay a target's sensory information to themselves.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/spirit_of_reckon: The Spirit of Reckoning Technique is a reasonably high level Genjutsu which is mainly used for interrogation purposes. The user exerts his chakra from his body in the direction of the opponent and forcibly puts them in a violent illusion to be 'judged' by a tall, thin, Grim Reaper like figure.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/strallilium_of_d: The Strallilium are the radials of etheric chakra which are designed to penetrate the subsuvial membrane of an ensouled being and infuse the corporeal body of that soul's matter expression with the codes of divine kinship (and thus service) beyond the tapestry of karmic revolutions.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/string_bean_bind: String Bean Binding Illusion {{JutsuInfobox |image1=String Bean Illusion 1.png |caption1=The target gets restrainted by bean strings... |image2=String Bean Illusion 2.png |caption2=...giving the user the opportunity to strike. |tabber=Yes |unnamed=Yes |other jutsu=Yes |parent jutsu=Demonic Illusion: Tree Binding Death
ability.narutorpg.fanon/substitution.des: Substitution is a B-rank technique requiring the user to create a minor genjutsu whilst replacing themselves with a block of wood or something similar when struck by an attack.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/suggestive_theme: Suggestive Themes *Name: *Type:  Genjutsu, No-Rank, Supplementary, Mid-Range *User: Kazeyo Fuyutama *Hand Seals: None This is a sharingan genjutsu that Kazeyo develops to quickly knock out low level enemies without any effort.  The technique does require eye contact but just a glimpse is good enough.  Wh
ability.narutorpg.fanon/taijou_shingon.d: Taijou Shingon is perhaps the only technique like it that exists on this level of power, though it may not be the case. Parting the clouds as it cut its path across the horizon. There are many techniques in the shinobi world that utilizes sound or devices for their usage, whether for reconstruction or destruction.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/taikonokodo.desc: Taikonokodō (太鼓の鼓動, Beat of the Drums) is the name coined to Kei's unique fighting style, which incorporates his multitude of techniques, tools and knowledge to form an art that is purely his, though it draws its origins from styles before. Many shinobi have one style of fighting, perhaps from one single range.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/takamagahara_wat: Takamagahara is a that casts a powerful and undetectable genjutsu over a specific area that remains active long after the caster's death. It is the true ultimate technique of Shisui Uchiha. Through their , Takamagahara can cast a genjutsu over a specific area, determined by how far the user's vision stretches.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/takamimusuhi.des: Takamimusuhi is a unique ability awakened by Kurami Uchiha after obtaining the Mangekyo Sharingan, when she had been granted this gift is unknown.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/temple_of_nirvan: Temple of Nirvana Technique {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Nirvana Temple Jutsu.png |named=Yes |kanji=涅槃精舎の術 |romaji=Nehan Shōja no Jutsu |english tv=Nirvana Temple Jutsu |game names=Feather Illusion Jutsu |other jutsu=Yes |derived jutsu=● God: Temple of Nirvana |related jutsu=Temple of Suffering Technique |jutsu rank=A |
ability.narutorpg.fanon/temple_of_suffer: This technique causes everyone within a specific area excruciating bodily pain. From the target's initial point of view, its as if they've been set-ablaze without being burnt, which serves as a distraction to allow the technique to take effect.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/ten_thousand_mom: This genjutsu is the personal creation of Genjiro Hirosame, the leader of the Death Guard. While concentrating chakra, Genjiro can make anyone relieve the pain of people they've wronged in the past.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/tennotama.desc: Tennotama (玉の天, Tennotama) is the unique ability of Saraya Hatake's Mangekyō Sharingan. Tennotama, simply put, allows Saraya to create "pockets" of Genjutsu in multiple areas of her choosing. These pockets can not be spotted without a Sharingan or other doujutsu. Each pocket differs depending on Saraya's wishes.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/tenzai_shoshin.d: Tenzai Shoshin is genjutsu born from the Mangekyō Sharingan and requires eye contact to be performed. This strong and dangerous genjutsu traps the target in an illusion, that is completely controlled by the user. Once the opponent locks eyes with the user the Genjutsu begins.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/terrestrial_illu: After weaving the needed hand seals, the user casts a genjutsu on the target. The illusion that the target has is that their body will suddenly stiffen and cease to move. Then the user's body will morph into a form akin to a tall tree's, complete with leaves and multiple limbs.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/the_defensive_ar: The Defensive Arts of the Heavenly Hermits

The is a truly archaic and highly protective fighting style first established by the priests at the Temple of Thesmosphoros centuries ago. This style of combat was once used to safeguard the priests from incoming attacks during ceremonial exorcisms against the countless foes who embellish in the stygian darkness.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/the_great_sakura: Sakura traps her opponent in a genjutsu in which the giant form of Inner Sakura raises up from beneath the opponent. Inner Sakura takes the opponent into the air and crushes the opponent with both her hands, and the genjutsu promptly ends with the opponent on the ground.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/the_path_gold_al: The Path Gold Alignment {|width="50%" align="center" !width="25%" style="border:5px outset #FFE920; border-radius:2ex; background: radial-gradient(white, gold, black); "|The Golden Path |} ---- lfH-RnHXQLA ~Theme of SahaTo ---- is the hiden ability of Gaoh Minazuki, Asu Rashoujin, Namino Majikina, Ukyo Hara and Sun Wuk
ability.narutorpg.fanon/the_right_hand_o: The Right Hand of God: Banishment Technique

The Right Hand of God: Banishment Technique is an advanced technique that targets the spiritual essence of the opponent. This technique requires a series of hand-signs, and can display its effects only on Gaoh’s hands.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/the_way_of_the_a: The Way of the Asura Path

The Way of the Asura Path is a branch of techniques the has roots traced to the Rinnegan’s Asura Path. This methodology or rather fighting style crafted by Hijiko Kakurerakudo exemplifies the term “adaptation”.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/the_way_of_the_e: The Way of the Evil Path: Akusei

The Way of the Evil Path: Akusei {|width="50%" align="center" !width="25%" style="border:5px outset black; border-radius:2ex; background: radial-gradient(red, darkred, black); "| The Evil Path |} A very simple technique used by Asu, that causes a temporary mutation of the face, eyes, ears, olfaction and throat.
The Way of the Evil Path: Emerging Malevolent God

A versatile jutsu that results in the formation of slender blades that protrude out from Asu's body. The blades are no thicker than an average katana, being black and red in appearance, though usually red along were a blood-drip would be found.
The Way of the Evil Path: Emerging Tendrils

The Way of the Evil Path: Emerging Tendrils {|width="50%" align="center" !width="25%" style="border:5px outset black; border-radius:2ex; background: radial-gradient(red, darkred, black); "| The Evil Path |} A seemingly painful technique, invented by Asu that is similar in some ways to the ability to summon hidden shado
The Way of the Evil Path: Indestructible Dominion

The Way of the Evil Path: Indestructible Dominion {|width="50%" align="center" !width="25%" style="border:5px outset black; border-radius:2ex; background: radial-gradient(red, darkred, black); "| The Evil Path |} This is one of the most versatile and the most feared technique branched from The Way of the Evil Path tech
The Way of the Evil Path: Inversion of Eternal Life

The Way of the Evil Path: Inversion of Eternal Life {|width="50%" align="center" !width="25%" style="border:5px outset black; border-radius:2ex; background: radial-gradient(red, darkred, black); "| The Evil Path |} The is considered a due to its all corrupting nature and its malevolence is only matched by its calamitou
The Way of the Evil Path: Sacred Armor of the Flagitious Abyss

The Way of the Evil Path: Sacred Armor of the Flagitious Abyss {|width="50%" align="center" !width="25%" style="border:5px outset black; border-radius:2ex; background: radial-gradient(red, darkred, black); "| The Evil Path |} The is an effective technique from the The Way of the Evil Path that is defensive in nature an
ability.narutorpg.fanon/the_wicked_night: The Wicked Nightmare: Terror From the Depths
The Wicked Nightmare: Terror From the Depths produces an eerily irresistible genjutsu amplified by the effects of the assimilated kekkei genkai of the and by the effects of the Shokuyoku.
The Wicked Nightmare: World of Dust and Bone Ash

Is a technique unique to Rinne Kusaregedo as it requires a mastery of both The Exposed Bone and that of the The Wicked Nightmare. By combining the two abilities, Rinne can generate a unique form of bone whose balance of yin and yang are set to the extreme.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/thousand_crimson: This technique exists solely to combat Genjutsu experts; to overwhelm opponents with quantity. When used by Juro, it traps any opponent in a series of Genjutsu which repeatedly multiply hundreds, and hundreds of times, until breaking through each one becomes a fruitless pursuit.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/time_reversal_te: Time Reversal Technique {{JutsuInfobox |image=Time Reversal Technique.png |kanji=時逆の術 |named=Yes |romaji=Jigyaku no Jutsu |english tv=Back To The Past Jutsu |game names=Restoration of the Memory |jutsu classification=Genjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |hand signs= |debut an
ability.narutorpg.fanon/tokigami.desc: Tokigami is Ryōta Uchiha’s Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu and is one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence. It is rivaled only by the Kotoamatsukami, Tsukuyomi, and Infinite Tsukuyomi. It is said to represent where only the caster has absolute control over time on another plane of existence.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/trinity_assault_: Trinity Assault - Eyes of the Great

Trinity Assault - Eyes of the Great is a [http://naruto.wikia.com/wiki/Collaboration_Jutsu collaboration] jutsu used by Shintoshu (Imi) Hyūga with Yomi Uchiha and Aezlea Nigaon. After preforming the hand seals yomi activates his Sharingan and preformes a genjutsu on the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/tsukimi_snow.des: A with which the user must establish direct eye contact onto their intended target. It will instantly trap the said opponent in a , showing its victim an image of the . Subsequently, accentuating both its pale glow and size to make the much more noticeable than it normally would be.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/tsukuyomi.desc: Tsukuyomi {{JutsuInfobox |ref= |image=Itachi's Tsukuyomi.png |named=Yes |kanji=月読 |romaji=Tsukuyomi |literal english=Moon Reader |jutsu classification=, Genjutsu, Dōjutsu |jutsu type= |jutsu class type=Supplementary |jutsu range=Short |users= |debut manga= |debut anime= |novel debut= |game debut= |jutsu media=Anime, Ma
ability.narutorpg.fanon/tsukuyomi_amazak: Tsukuyomi: Amazakaru is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu utilized by Seika Uchiha, serving as the antipode to Sasuke Uchiha's and Emiri Uchiha's Blaze Release: Kagutsuchi.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/tsukuyomi_mode.d: This technique is a variation of Tsukuyomi, a high level Genjutsu. The user transforms the Tsukuyomi into a barrier that slows the opponent down. This does not happen physically but rather mentally. It makes the opponent think they are being held back by a barrier.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/tsukuyomi_nejihy: This is the page for the technique as it appears in the Diaries of the Hidden Waterfall series. For the canon rendition, refer to . For the fanon rendition, refer to Tsukuyomi. Tsukuyomi is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu and one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/twinkling_maiden: Sakura smiles at her opponent before glaring and summoning her giant inner self. Inner Sakura yells, "I'm speaking from the heart!" as she punches her opponent. The screen shatters, revealing it all to have been a genjutsu and Sakura herself punched her opponent. The foe flies off into the distance.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/unending_fear_te: Unending Fear Technique {| align=center style="background:transparent;" | valign=center | This article, , is property of Jumpy Naruto. |} The Unending Fear Technique (永遠の恐れテクニック) is part of a long line of comical jutsu along with the Unending Laughter,Tears and Speech Techniques.The Unending Fear is a Genjutsu.It makes
ability.narutorpg.fanon/unending_tears_t: Unending Tears Technique {| align=center style="background:transparent;" | valign=center | This article, , is property of Jumpy Naruto. |} The Unending Tears Technique (永遠の悲しみテクニック) is another of the comical Unending line of Ninjutsu along with the Unending Laughter, Speech and Fear Techniques.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/unrivaled_tortur: Unrivaled Torture * Name: Unrivaled Torture ** Other names: none * Element: none * Rank: A * Range: Short * Type: Offensive, Kagirinaigan ability * Classification: Genjutsu * Hand Seals: Tiger * Users: Ryun Uchiha The jutsu consisted of Ryun gesturing with his hand and mentally reaching into the victim's mind, forcing
ability.narutorpg.fanon/upheaval_incisio: This technique is a combination of Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu and Genjutsu. It incorporates the use of Kama Uchiha's Mangekyō Sharingan. The user imbues the Tempest Shuriken with lightning-natured chakra, hurling it towards the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/upturned_realism: Upturned Realism: the user affects everyone nearby, then empowers the user. Learned from rank 3.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/vertigo_genjutsu: The user casts a genjutsu that causes the target to perceive everything around them in slow motion causing them to feel dizziness and confusion. In addition, the environment and people within the illusion become distorted in a wavy-like manner.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/very_hiden_wood_: Very Hiden-Wood Release: Song of Nature

Very Hiden-Wood Release: Song of Nature {|width="50%" align="center" !width="25%" style="border:5px outset black; border-radius:2ex; background: radial-gradient(#e5a0e1, #ce90ca, #b780b4, #a0709d, #896087, #725070, #5b405a); "|Goddess of the Double Blossomed Cherry Tree |} is an extremely powerful ethereal sound based
ability.narutorpg.fanon/virtual.desc: Virtual *Name: Virtual. *Element: Genjutsu. *Type: Supplementary. *Description: This technique is simple but quite ingenious. It is as simple as making the tharget perciev that they hear voices emanating from inanimate objects. Marek uses this to give the appearance that his puppet Blackout is in fact an actual person.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/voices_of_spirit: Voices of Spirits from the Past and Future
Voices of Spirits from the Past and Future is an infinitely subtle technique invented by for the sake of bending the minds of creation. It is considered a truly dangerous .
ability.narutorpg.fanon/wakaremichi.desc: After casting the Forest of Shadows, In'ei takes her opponent(s) to the center of a road under the treetops. She than presents different offshoots from the center, showing different "possibilities" that could befall the opponent, before forcing them to choose one.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/water_reflecting: Water-Reflecting Moonlight is a powerful genjutsu employed by Heiwa through his water-based techniques.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/water_release_dr: After the hand seals are formed, the user creates an illusionary beach like paradise. Then, the sand begins to turn into a pitch black ocean and the victim believes they are drowning. In reality, they cause pain to themselves due to them gasping for air in the illusion.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/water_release_ge: Water Release Genjutsu: Demonic Phantom Fog Prison
After the user performs the necessary hand seals, the Conch King opens its shell and releases a mist that puts the opponent under a genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/water_release_il: Water Release: Illusionary Water Prison: the user affects everyone nearby. Learned from rank 6.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/white_lotus.desc: Gekihen rapidly expels large quantities of scale powder imbued with large amounts of chakra, which have a luminous color that blinds targets and places them in genjutsu once seen. The chakra within them creates loud vibrations, which add another layer of the genjutsu once heard.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/white_marsh_tech: The White Marsh Technique (白沢の術, Hakutaku no Jutsu) is a highly advanced Genjutsu technique exclusive to those who have made themselves highly proficient in the ninja skill.
