While this technique is widespread, only a few users possess the knowledge and proficiency within the art in order to utilize it correctly.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/white_squall.des: White Squall(白疾風, Shiro Shippū) is a wind based illusion used by Ryūken Senju.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/wicked_tongue_cu: Wicked Tongue Curse is a technique created by Koji Yamanaka and is his most powerful technique. He describes this technique as the culmination of all his shinobi skills into one technique. Upon making the snake hand seal a tattoo appears on his tongue and extends to his cheeks.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/will_bending.des: Will Bending is a Genjutsu created and used by Akame no Nishiki. Nishiki waves his hand almost casually, and to any person looking at it a Genjutsu activates.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/wind_illusion_br: Wind Illusion Breeze of Wind Pillar
This genjutsu pushes the enemy with an extremely strong gust of wind that appears to emanate from the user's body. A secondary genjutsu can then be used within this genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/wind_release_san: The user creates a dome-shaped sandstorm which surrounds the opponent and hinders it from escaping.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/wind_release_tor: The user does the hand seals and creates an illusionary city. Then, the sky turns dark and a fearsome tornado starts destroying things and sucking them in. The victim is either sucked in or struck by a flying object. In reality, they feel the pain of wherever they were strucked or sliced.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/wood_release_aok: This technique was created by Sensha as a trump card of sorts. It is his most powerful wood release technique and possibly his most powerful technique he has. Sensha begins by slamming his hand into the ground to create an entire forest around him that spans an astounding range in every direction.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/wood_release_for: Wood Release: Forest of False Prophets

This is often said to be the most feared of all of someone's jutsu, and for good reason. Much like a traditional Wood style jutsu, the user is capable of creating an entire forest in the blink of an eye. But that is where all similarities end. Every tree in this forest is alive.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/wood_release_ill: Wood Release: Illusion Arm is a technique that allows multiple use of the two forbidden genjutsu techniques, Izanagi and Izanami. After performing the needed hand seals, the user creates an arm of Wood Release, which covers the original arm like an armor.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/wood_release_sec: Wood Release Secret Technique: Pitcher Plants Language of the Flowers

This technique uses wood nature chakra to physically and mentally paralyze targets, rendering them unable to move or think properly while killing them. It attacks targets simultaneously on two fronts, physically with ninjutsu and mentally with genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/wood_release_sta: Wood Release: Star Hailing from Heaven

Wood Release: Star Hailing from Heaven ---- Wood Release: Star Hailing from Heaven is a powerful cooperation ninjutsu made up of the kekkei genkais Wood Release and Scorch Release. It also uses the Mangekyō Sharingan and it's parent. It uses Yang Release for various purposes as well.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/world_reversing_: By casting a hallucinating effect on the targets eyes, the user casts a genjutsu that causes anyone who is affected to see everything backwards (e.g. Day is night, World is upside down, Allies looking like foes).
ability.narutorpg.fanon/world_serpent_tr: World Serpent Treasured Dharma Eye is an extremely dangerous genjutsu that combines both contact-type and visual-type along with components of senjutsu into one technique.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/yamako.desc: Yamako also referred to as the Out of Sight, Out of Mind Technique is a powerful genjutsu developed by Asuna Kurama.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/yang_release_whi: Doujinn teleports his victim to a black space and traps his victim. The area suddenly becomes white, and the victim's body begins to deteriorate into ash.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/yin_release_blac: This technique can only work when under any type of genjutsu that puts them under sleeping stasis like the Temple of Nirvana Technique, once the opponent is asleep the user weaves the necessary hand seals and cast this technique into the opponents mind where it'll manifest manifest shadow creatures each effecting certa
Doujinn teleports his victim to a white space and traps them. The space suddenly turns black, and all the chakra is absorbed from the victim, causing the body functions and mind to stop working.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/yin_release_insa: Yin Release: Insanity Scythe Technique by conjuring a form of pure Yin Release and forming it into the shape of a scythe the user is able to cast a unique illusion on anyone cut.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/yin_release_ment: After weaving the needed hand seals, the user places their index and middle finger on the target's head and releases Yin Release chakra into it.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/yin_release_mira: Activating the Mirage Genjutsu, Maomi will cast it on herself, making the victim unable to land any techniques on her. This jutsu is similar to Izanagi and Kamui since it gives the user intangibility and casts a genjutsu on themselves.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/yin_release_rain: This is a genjutsu that was created by Kashikoi during her training in genjutsu. How it works is that by using the Sukiru Secret Technique: Kaibyaku, she is able to open up her imagination to a point were blades start hitting the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/yin_release_thou: Yin Release: Thousand Droplets (陰遁千点滴, Inton Sententeki) is a technique devised by Yuto Chinoike. By swinging his in a certain pattern, Yuto draws the opponent into a trance-like state.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/yin_release_voic: Yin Release: Voice of the Forest Technique

The is one of the of the Noble . This technique is one that was originally developed during . Simple in execution, the caster first coats their vocal cords with chakra, allowing them to use their own voice as a medium for genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/yin_yang_release: After performing the needed hand seals, the user will touch the desired victim and take them to their own wonderland. After some words are spoken, the user will then use Killing Intent to destroy the victim's wonderland and it will then turn into a black and white space.
ability.narutorpg.fanon/zaiaku.desc: Zaiaku is a powerful Genjutsu created by Kawarama Uchiha. Like most genjutsu, Zaiaku requires eye contact to be performed, trapping the target within an illusion completely under the user's control. The genjutsu places the target in an empty dark place, with the standing in front of them.
ability.narutorpg.fantasy.desc: Itachi activates his Mangekyō Sharingan, and uses Tsukuyomi on the opponent. The illusion is similar to his original Tsukuyomi genjutsu, as he attacks with his clones, the pinned down opponent which he mentions is going to be for about three days, while it actually lasts for a few seconds in reality.
ability.narutorpg.fat_couple_attack.desc: Sabu sits astride Ponta as he attacks the enemy with a powerful paw slash, then leaps up and finishes them off with his axe. The attack can also be performed when Ponta rears up on his hind legs: he grabs the enemy with his forepaws, and Sabu delivers a sweeping blow with his axe.
ability.narutorpg.favourable_wind.desc: Manipulating her dimension, Kaguya creates a twister of sand that sucks in the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.feather_bombardment.de: San's bird releases numerous feathers with pin-point accuracy that act like explosive tags.
ability.narutorpg.feather_launching.desc: Satori launches its feathers towards opponents at high speeds, capable of piercing stone ground and chakra-enforced wood.
ability.narutorpg.feigning_sleep_techniq: Gaara uses this technique to force himself to fall asleep. This causes him to surrender control to Shukaku, who is sealed within him. While it is the dominant personality, Shukaku has complete access to its large chakra reserves, which it uses according to its inherently destructive tendencies.
ability.narutorpg.fierce_attack_wind_sph: Asura cups his hands to gather chakra into a small floating spiraling sphere.
ability.narutorpg.fierce_snake.desc: Stretching both his arms, Mitsuki delivers a rapid fire barrage of punches to his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.fierce_snake_trample.d: Anko summons snakes and repeatedly swings her opponent around, before releasing them into the air, and striking them away with snakes.
ability.narutorpg.fiery_paper_star_of_go: Through the Deva Path, Nagato imprisons his opponent with Chibaku Tensei. Once the sphere is complete, Konan embraces it with her paper wings, covering it in billions of explosive tags. She then sends a single origami bird that sets off the explosions.
ability.narutorpg.fighting_tongue_bind.d: After focusing senjutsu chakra to it, Shima's tongue grows to its maximum limit and is reshaped with a face. The tongue will then seek out the scent of its target. When the target is found, she ensnares it to prevent escape and marks it with a corrosive chemical.
By kneading senjutsu chakra, Fukasaku's long tongue gains utmost solidity and sharpness. It then leaps from his mouth with tremendous speed and force, enough to tear a hole through bedrock and metal pipes with ease. With that ground-splitting power, the enemy is cut in half.
ability.narutorpg.final_move.desc: Shikamaru gets the opponent caught with his Shadow Sewing Technique while Asuma extends the chakra on his Chakra Blades and slashes the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.finger_carving_seal.de: The user concentrates chakra into their finger and using the heat from that, can apply writing of whatever they want to a surface. This technique however requires them to be very delicate with their chakra control.
The user produces a massive wall of flames to distract the enemy. In the same moment, the user will make their escape.
Tsunade punches the ground, creating a massive shockwave. Using it as a cover, Orochimaru summons three Rashōmon gates, creating them in the form of a triangle, trapping the opponent in between. Then, Orochimaru and Jiraiya use Wind and Fire Release respectively to create a huge fiery vortex.
ability.narutorpg.fire_rat.desc: Yugito grows one of Matatabi's tails and scatters three fire rats which explode if approached.
ability.narutorpg.fire_rat_s_fur_coat.de: While in her lava dimension, Kaguya causes lava plumes to rise around her, either to attack nearby opponents or to block incoming attacks.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_ash_pile_: The user spews a stream of chakra-infused gunpowder from their mouth, which surrounds the region. As the gunpowder is composed entirely of ash, it stays in the air around the victim like a cloud, which can be used like a smokescreen.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_big_flame: This technique is a senjutsu altered version of the Fire Release: Flame Bullet. The user fills their mouth cavity with oil, created inside his body with senjutsu chakra. This oil is expelled and at the same time ignited, creating a massive flame, equivalent in power to a multitude of Flame Bullets.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_blast_wav: Fire Release: Blast Wave Wild Dance

The user expels fire from their mouths while simultaneously creating a whirlwind using Kamui. The swirling winds give momentum to the flames and cause them to spiral outward as they move towards the target. The vortex of fire and heat engulfs its victims, leaving them unable to breathe while their bodies burn.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_blazing_m: The user creates a myriad of small fireballs that are then directed towards the target.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_bullet_bl: The user launches a mass of fire at their opponent. When used through autonomous puppets, they can fire it in rapid succession, without hand seals. However, continuous firing can lead them to overheat, and thus disable them until they have cooled down.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_burning_c: The user creates a circle of fireballs around him, which revolve around him, protecting from attacks and striking the people attacking him with the flames.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_chakra_mo: The user cover themselves in flame, making it dangerous for opponents to engage in close combat. The flames can be manipulated to attack from afar.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_chaotic_p: The user focuses their blue flames into spiralling balls to be launched at the target.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_cooperati: Three users each breathe a long stream of intense fire, which combine to form a flaming dragon.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_crimson_e: The user spews out fire that both surrounds the enemy and then transforms into a spider that attacks the enemy. This technique effectively traps and attacks an opponent at the same time, and can be used to force them into another attack.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_deep_flam: The user punches the ground, causing flames to erupt, exploding all around them. The flames are strong to dig through the ground, offering an option for escape.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_demon_lan: This technique releases many floating fireballs around the user, which take the shape of ghosts at the final stage of the technique. After performing the required hand seal, they attack the opponent in swarms. Each fireball creates a huge flame at the moment of impact.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_dragon_fi: The user spits flames from their mouth that, like a dragon's, quickly travel forward in a straight direction. Upon contact with a target, the affected area is engulfed in flames.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_dragon_fl: Fire Release: Dragon Flame Release Song Technique

This is an advanced version of its parent technique. This technique allows the user to expel several dragon-headed fireballs from their mouth to cover the frontal, left, and right sides of the opponent. As the dragon-heads move in an erratic manner, it makes the technique much more difficult to avoid.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_exploding: Fire Release: Exploding Flame Formation is a technique that was a specialty of Hanzō.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_extinguis: Jiraiya stomps the ground with his foot, creating a crack that goes under the opponent. He then sends fire into the crack, boiling the earth below the opponent and finishes by clapping his hands together, creating a large and fiery explosion where the opponent is.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_fire_drag: A basic Fire Release technique, where the user exhales a flame breath from their mouth. As shown by Hiruzen, this technique can be used in conjunction with Earth Release: Earth Dragon Bullet to ignite the projectiles fired by the latter technique, making it more devastating.
Fire Release: Fire Dragon Flame Bullet
After kneading chakra, the user breathes fire from their mouth. The flames are manipulated into the shape of a dragon and divided to strike the target from the left, right, and front all at once.
The user forms a circular wall of fire around themselves and their opponent, preventing them from escaping during their fight.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_fire_wind: Fire Release: Fire Wind Wild Blade
Madara shoots a fireball and attacks the opponent with both his sickle and gunbai in the expelled flames.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_fired_pot: The user creates powerful flames inside the giant oven created by the Lightning Release: Sixteen Pillar Bind, cooking the opponent until they are burned. It's used together with Earth Release: Sticky Earth Drop to harden the mud covering the enemy's body and subsequently immobilising them.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flame_att: The user imbues their fists with Fire Release. Upon striking the target, they will be consumed by flames. In the anime, this technique is capable of throwing flames in the direction of the attacks, which was powerful enough to incinerate kunai.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flame_bul: This technique is executed by the user gathering oil in their mouth which is created by chakra, spitting it out, and igniting it. This technique simply shoots a flame bullet at the enemy. If the amount of oil that is prepared is kept down, the time it takes to invoke the technique is reduced.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flame_cap: The user creates a fire whip. It can knock an opponent a considerable distance, strong enough to damage rock.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flame_mur: After the chakra kneaded inside his body is converted into fire, Obito jumps a considerable amount of height and spews a large orb of flames straight to the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flame_spe: The user creates a blade of fire, the flames of which spread horizontally ahead of them. The fire will go out if the user loses consciousness.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flame_tig: Jakō Ryūdōin summons a tiger made of flames from the scroll on his back, inflicting massive damage to the player's team, additionally having the ability to attach to the opponent and explode with much impact.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flame_wav: Hikari spews flames that split into three waves in three separate directions.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flame_whi: Fire erupts around the user's body in a spiralling manner which is then launched with his hands towards the target. Once the technique hits the target, the opponent is sent into the air in a spiralling manner and their body burns into ashes.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flame_wra: Fire Release: Flame Wrapping Sickle Dance
Madara covers his kama in flames and spins around, slashing any opponent in his reach, finally slamming down from above.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flaming_h: The user conjures a barrage of arrows made of fire. Any arrows that miss will spread fire around the surroundings.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flint_yag: The user throws a lighter on the ground in front of his opponent and expands the flame into a wall of fire. It is noted to be a technique that "makes a small spark burst into a pillar of fire".
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_flying_fl: While in his level two cursed seal form, Sasuke exhales a stronger short-range version of the Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique.
The user manifests ten fire balls in a circle in front of them and launches them with their hand motions.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_great_bla: Itachi exhales a meteor-sized sphere of fire that carries the enemy away and causes a massive explosion on impact. The impact causes the ground around Itachi to break apart while he remains unfazed. This is much like Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique, but a larger and more destructive version.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_great_dra: Fire Release: Great Dragon Fire Technique

The user compresses a large amount of chakra built up inside their body and changes it into a dragon head-shaped fireball. The user then skilfully manipulates that great fire, and attacks their opponent. Even outside of the attack range, its power and reliability are stressed.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_great_fir: Fire Release: Great Fire Annihilation

The pinnacle of Uchiha Fire Release techniques, chakra kneaded inside the body is converted into fire, and then expelled from the mouth and shaped into a literal sea of flames, which covers a wide range as well.
Fire Release: Great Fire Annihilation: Dust
Madara attacks his opponent by creating trees that push them back, then throwing them up in the air. Madara jumps up as well, and sets his opponent and the trees he created on fire.
Fire Release: Great Fire Annihilation: Earth

Madara elbows his opponent, follows with a series of Susanoo sword slashes, strikes his opponent with his Susanoo's right arm, slamming its palm at the opponent. The palm attack lifts Madara in the air, where he finishes the opponent with a Fire Release.
Fire Release: Great Fire Annihilation: Heaven
Madara elbows his opponent, follows with a series of Susanoo sword slashes, the last two of which throw the opponent up into the air, where Madara then blows a large amount of flames at the opponent.
Fire Release: Great Fire Destruction

A technique where chakra kneaded inside the user's body is converted into fire, and then expelled from the mouth in a massive stream of intense flames that can set a vast area ablaze, engulfing the target in a veritable sea of flames.
Fire Release: Great Fire Heavenly Prison

A stronger version of the Fire Release: Heavenly Prison that can be used on larger targets. Unlike with the parent technique, when this is used the person's entire body is engulfed in flames as the cursed seal is branded on them.
Fire Release: Great Fire Wall Technique
The user expels a wall of flames to defend themselves and burn the opponent.
Fire Release: Great Fire Whirlwind
Madara swings his war fan and breathes fire into the swing, creating a wall of flaming whirlwinds.
Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique: Falling Fire
Sasuke elbows his opponent, followed by sword strikes and knee attacks, before jumping above and behind them and launching a fireball.
Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique: First Step
Obito lands a series of hits, finishing with an upwards double kick, sending his opponent up in the air. As they fall down, Obito shoots a burst of fire at them.
Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique: Onibi

Itachi attacks his opponent with a series of mixed methods, including kicks, punches, and stabs with kunai. During the attack string, he creates a shadow clone, which attacks with a flurry of shuriken, and the real Itachi finishes with a fireball attack.
Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique — Revolving Flame
Tobi fans a gust of wind at the opponent with his gunbai and sets the whirlwind ablaze with Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique creating a big fire storm attack to burn his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_great_fla: Kneading his chakra and then converting it to fire, the user creates a multitude of fireballs at the same time which then rain down on the target causing severe, widespread damage around the field. These fireballs can easily destroy Earth Release-created shelters and even overpower Water Release attacks.

Jiraiya creates a normal Rasengan, then spews fire onto it, causing it to turn black and be surrounded by a ring of flames. He then hits the opponent, causing a blazing maelstrom of fire, reducing the opponent to ashes.
The Fire Release: Great Flame Technique is a hiden Fire Release technique utilised by the Sarutobi clan.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_heavenly_: The Fire Release: Heavenly Prison is an used by Mui's clan.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_hiding_in: Fire Release: Hiding in Ash and Dust Technique

The user expels chakra-infused ash that blanket a wide area, burning anyone who comes in contact with it. The technique can also be used as a powerful deterrent from attacks as well as a highly effective smokescreen.
Fire Release: Hiding in Fire Technique

Using this technique, a user can hide themselves inside a flame. Upon leaving concealment, flames burn, revealing the user. A member of the Nokizaru Group made use of this technique during a mission to retrieve a stolen scroll from Kumogakure shinobi.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_hurricane: Fire Release: Hurricane Oil Flame Bullet
The user creates two shadow clones that shoot oil while the original shoots fire, creating a flaming twister.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_intellige: Kakuzu's fire-element mask fires a small fireball that erupts into a giant fire-storm after making contact with a surface, causing widespread destruction to the area. Since the flames travel along the ground, and cover such a wide area this is a difficult technique to evade.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_mist_blaz: Fire Release: Mist Blaze Dance Technique

The user is able to create and blow a flammable gas from their lungs. Once it comes in contact with fire or spark, the gas ignites into a large fireball. Kagerō used this technique while disguised as Kabuto Yakushi.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_nail_crim: Fire Release: Nail Crimson Crow Leap

Shisui delivers a series of swift strikes to his opponent, then proceeds to toss a volley of fire-infused kunai, from an aerial perspective, at the opponent, the flames of which spark a devastating explosion.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_phoenix_s: Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Fire Technique

The user spits a volley of small fireballs into the air; at a glance, it can appear as though there was only one fireball that then burst into many. The many small flames move wildly through the area, potentially mesmerising targets as they're surrounded.
Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Flower Nail Crimson

The user unleashes a volley of shuriken with one hand, and at the same time, exhales fire-infused chakra onto them in order to increase the weapons' destructive potential by making them capable of inflicting severe burns upon direct contact with either the intended victim, or any other object caught within their trajec
Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Formation Technique
Multiple users spit several fireballs while surrounding their opponent from above, making it impossible to avoid them.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_prison_fl: While in his long-range form, Kakuzu unleashes a torrent of fireballs at his opponent which explode on impact.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_roaring_f: Fugaku spews flames that envelop the opponent in a fiery sphere, bursting with them within it.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_running_f: This technique creates a stream of fire that can be manipulated into several forms (so far, rings of fire that run on the ground or a circle of fire flying through the air) before striking the target.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_smokescre: The user spits out a flaming tornado from their mouth, which was noted to be powerful enough to incinerate everything it comes into contact with like paper. When in contact with large volumes of water, the technique creates a dense cloud of steam.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_soaring_f: Fire Release: Soaring Flame Bullet Technique

The user gathers chakra from their stomach and spews a small ball of fire. The required hand seals needed for this technique have varied; Kawaki's first use required one hand seal (two in the anime) however, later in the anime, using four hand seals were used.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_toad_oil_: Fire Release: Toad Oil Flame Bullet

This is a cooperation ninjutsu performed by a toad and a fire user who have achieved mental and physical harmony with each other. The toad (specifically a large toad such as Gamabunta) uses its large lung capacity to spray toad oil from its mouth at a target.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_two_heade: Fire Release: Two-Headed Dragon Fire: Heaven
Sasuke creates two shadow clones, who breathe dragon-shaped fireballs at his opponents while he throws a kunai above them. Sasuke switches places with the kunai, raining a circle of fire from above.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_uchiha_gr: Fire Release: Uchiha Great Flame Sphere
Sasuke and Itachi both perform Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique which when combined form a giant fireball that explodes on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_water_mis: Kakashi creates a bird of flames under his complete control that quickly flies into a designated water source, burning hot enough to cause the water to evaporate. The bird disappears as soon as the water is gone. Alternatively, the bird can release streams of fire from its mouth for offensive purposes.
ability.narutorpg.fire_release_wind_rele: Fire Release: Wind Release: Blazing Wind Wild Wave
While in his long-range form and in mid-air, Kakuzu sends a powerful torrent of wind and fire.
ability.narutorpg.fire_sealing_method.de: The user first readies a scroll that they've previously inscribed with a special sealing formula, which has a blank space left in its centre. They then activate this technique, quickly sucking any nearby Fire Release into the blank space and sealing it there, signified by the appearance of the kanji for .
ability.narutorpg.fire_whirlwind_vortex_: First, the user uses Fire Release: Flint Yagura to create a wall of fire in front of the enemy and then uses Wind Release: Whirlwind Fist to blow the flames into the enemy, creating a blazing firestorm that leaves the surrounding area scorched.
ability.narutorpg.fireball_jutsu.desc: The user kneads chakra in their body and turns it into fire, which they then expel from their mouth; the more chakra they use, the more flames that are produced.
ability.narutorpg.first_axe_strike.desc: The user, using Kabutowari, strikes an obstacle first with an axe, then strikes it from above with a hammer, destroying the obstacle, be it a wall or an opponent's sword.
ability.narutorpg.fission_technique.desc: The Fission Technique is a highly advanced ninjutsu which allows Mū to literally split his own body into two identical — yet entirely independent — duplicates of himself.
ability.narutorpg.fist_slam.desc: A covers himself with electricity and slams both his fists on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.five_elements_seal.des: Orochimaru gathers "wicked" chakra to his five fingertips, which he forcefully applies over another seal. When this Five Elements Seal, being of an odd number, is applied over the Four Symbols Seal, being of an even number, the Four Symbols Seal is disrupted because of the odd—even imbalance.
ability.narutorpg.five_elements_unseal.d: This technique removes seals that are of similar power to itself. The user gathers chakra to their fingertips and hits the fingers against the seal that is to be removed, causing it to unravel and disappear.
ability.narutorpg.five_mountain_jump.des: Using the enhanced strength granted by his Steam Armour, Han delves a powerful punch to his opponent, sending them flying into the air. He jumps up after them and transforms into Kokuō, headbutts them, and using its hoof, smashes the opponent into the ground, which ruptures the ground and generates a fiery shock wave.
ability.narutorpg.five_release_great_com: The user creates four shadow clones and, alongside them, launch a different base-elemental attack at the target simultaneously.
ability.narutorpg.five_seal_barrier.desc: The user connects five tags to each other using their own chakra. One of the tags is applied to a central location that the user wishes to prevent access to, while the other four are applied to surfaces in the surrounding area.
ability.narutorpg.five_seal_barrier_pass: In order to enter the boundary created by the Five-Seal Barrier without dispelling the technique, Deidara used a technique which raised the rock blocking the entry to Akatsuki's hideout. It granted him and Sasori passage into the hideout, while keeping the barrier intact.
ability.narutorpg.flame_circuit.desc: Indra surrounds himself with flames, protecting himself and damaging any enemy that enters his surrounding area.
ability.narutorpg.flame_combo.desc: Sasori shoots a barrage of fireballs from the flamethrowers on the palms of his puppet body.
ability.narutorpg.flaming_arrow_of_amazi: The Flaming Arrow of Amazing Ability is a technique used by Nagato through the Asura Path.
The Flaming Arrow Warhead is a technique used by Nagato through the Asura Path.
ability.narutorpg.flaming_fang_petrifica: Garaga spits venom that is able to petrify victims moments after contact, an ability which Aoda links to Garaga's reverse scale.
ability.narutorpg.flash.desc: A swift ranged attack where the user swings their sword at a target after coating it in chakra, releasing a sharp crescent of chakra in the arc that the blade was swung.
ability.narutorpg.flash_cross_sever.desc: Asuma delivers multiple punches to the opponent before he slashes the opponent with his chakra blades in a cross-style.
ability.narutorpg.flash_mode.desc: Flash Mode is a recurring awakening mode used by Minato Namikaze throughout the Naruto Ultimate Ninja and Naruto Shippūden: Ultimate Ninja Heroes series. It greatly increases Minato's dash, attack and jump speed in all of its depictions.
ability.narutorpg.flash_revolving_foot.d: The spiral flash kick is a series of punches and slashes finishing with a spinning kick, sending the opponent flying.
ability.narutorpg.flash_slice.desc: From above the opponent, the user strikes the enemy with a kunai, stabbing them.
ability.narutorpg.flash_swallow_dance_he: Minato kicks his opponent upwards, and throws several Flying Thunder God Kunai at them. He teleports between the kunai, striking his opponent, before finishing above them, where he stabs them with one.
ability.narutorpg.flashing_bell_beams.de: Shion's bell flashes and sends a ray of flashing pink light towards the enemy. It is powerful enough to cleanly slice through three of Mōryō's Ghost Army soldiers.
ability.narutorpg.flawless_three.desc: Obito and Kakashi slash at their opponent, followed by Rin's back-flip kick. Rin cheers her teammates as they go forward. Emboldened by her support, Obito leapfrogs Kakashi, unleashing several small fireballs at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.flea_shuriken.desc: The ninneko stretches its body and rolls the joint of its neck, launching its fleas at a target. The jutsu's effects after that vary depending on the target's tolerances: Kiba Inuzuka and Akamaru fall to the ground in painful itching; Shino Aburame finds it curious, but otherwise isn't bothered.
ability.narutorpg.flight.desc: While fully transformed with the Cursed Seal of Heaven, Sasuke attacks his opponent with punches, kicks, and a rotating wing attack, before swinging an electrified sword at them.
ability.narutorpg.flight_mode.desc: This is the mode in which Mecha-Naruto takes a plane-like form, allowing it to fly at high speeds, and its fingers into machine gun-like extensions.
ability.narutorpg.flight_of_the_oblitera: Haku gathers a larger amount of water from the air and surrounding environment into more than a thousand needles. He then directs the needles to a specific opponent, and leaps back to avoid damage to himself.
ability.narutorpg.floating_bugs.desc: Shino fires a cloud like projectile of destruction bugs at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.flower_dance.desc: Kurenai creates a cherry blossom clone that spins around her, creating a barrier of cherry petals striking the opponent multiple times, and lifting them into the air.
ability.narutorpg.flower_ninja_art.desc: Flower Ninja Art is a subset of ninjutsu and genjutsu involving secret flower-oriented techniques used by a clan in the Land of Vegetables. The two known users of flower ninja art are Kikunojō and Yurinojō.
ability.narutorpg.flower_ninja_art_many_: Flower Ninja Art: Many Blooming Flowers
After surrounding the opponent with flowers, the user will ignite the flowers. These flames will then shoot towards and explode on the target.
Flower Ninja Art: Many Releasing Flowers
This technique turns flowers into bombs that can be detonated like explosive tags.
ability.narutorpg.flower_ninja_art_mirro: Flower Ninja Art: Mirror Flower Water
The user casts an illusion which surrounds the target in flower petals and darkens the surroundings around them.
ability.narutorpg.flower_shuriken_fallin: Flower Shuriken: Falling Blossoms and Scattering Leaves

This technique will make flowers hover in the air before hardening and spinning at high speeds. The flowers will then be launched at the target. Their hardened state will allow them to cut targets as effectively as metal shuriken.
ability.narutorpg.flowerfruit_mountain.d: The Flower-Fruit Mountain is a Lava Release technique utilised by Son Gokū and its jinchuriki Rōshi. While in his transformed state, Rōshi creates a volcano which then explodes violently, sending molten rock flying up in all directions the effects of which resemble a giant flower.
ability.narutorpg.flowing_blade.desc: Shizune gets in close and uses a spinning sweep kick before she spins back to her original position. She then slashes the opponent with a chakra scalpel.
ability.narutorpg.flowing_wall_sand.desc: After hitting his opponent with a barrage of sand, Gaara flows three walls of sand to end it.
ability.narutorpg.fluttering_heaven.desc: Utakata jumps up into the air, delivers a strike with his bubble blower, followed by two empty-handed swipes, and finishes it with a spinning kick which sends his opponent crashing down.
ability.narutorpg.flying_attack.desc: Ōnoki creates a rock to hit and send the opponent up, then he flies up to attack the opponent and then slams the opponent down.
ability.narutorpg.flying_claw.desc: Yugito lunges at an airborne opponent and delivers a powerful cross slash.
ability.narutorpg.flying_nail_mist_soari: The user exhales a flying stream composed of hundreds of very small nails from their mouth.
ability.narutorpg.flying_revolving_sword: The wielder throws Kubikiribōchō at the opponent, dealing damage as it spins towards them. If the Kubikiribōchō gets lodged in something in its path, such as the trunk of a tree, a person can stand on it.
ability.narutorpg.flying_single_foot.des: After manifesting Chōmei's wings, Fū flies high up in the air and descends, landing a kick on her opponent.
ability.narutorpg.flying_swallow.desc: This is an " that augments the killing power of a bladed weapon, such as a kunai or sword, by flowing chakra into it. The infused chakra materialises around the weapon in the form of a blade, increasing both its cutting power and effective reach.
ability.narutorpg.flying_swallow_barrage: Asuma uses his Flying Swallow and start a sequence of slashes finishing with a falling slash.
ability.narutorpg.flying_swallow_cross_c: Asuma punches the opponent a few times and finishes them with two final slashes.
ability.narutorpg.flying_thunder_formati: This is a cooperation Space–Time Ninjutsu taught to the Hokage Guard Platoon by the Fourth Hokage to better aid in their duties of protecting the seated Hokage.
ability.narutorpg.flying_thunder_god_gui: The Flying Thunder God: Guiding Thunder is a technique.
ability.narutorpg.flying_thunder_god_mut: Flying Thunder God Mutually Instantaneous Revolving Technique
The Flying Thunder God Mutually Instantaneous Revolving Technique is a technique which can be utilised when at least two Flying Thunder God Technique users are present.
ability.narutorpg.flying_thunder_god_sec: The Flying Thunder God — Second Step is a technique developed by Minato from the Flying Thunder God Technique.
ability.narutorpg.flying_thunder_god_seq: Minato places his formula mark on the opponent and kicks them in the air where he teleports behind the airborne opponent and hits the opponent with a Rasengan, knocking them down towards the ground, where he then teleports again to the falling opponent to use his charged Rasengan to slam them to the ground, creating an
ability.narutorpg.flying_thunder_god_sla: A technique combining the use of a bladed weapon and space–time ninjutsu. The user teleports to a marked target, with weapon in hand, to instantaneously deliver a swift, devastating slash to his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.flying_thunder_god_spa: Flying Thunder God: Space–Time Hurricane Flash Sequential Steps: Style Zero

Minato throws several Flying Thunder God kunai at his opponent, teleports to one of them, and kicks the opponent, sending them flying back. While they are still in the air, he creates a shadow clone which teleports repeatedly to the Flying Thunder God kunai around the opponent, constantly slashing them.
ability.narutorpg.flying_thunder_god_tec: The Flying Thunder God Technique is a space–time ninjutsu originally developed by Tobirama Senju. It was later recreated by Boruto Uzumaki.
The Flying Thunder God Technique is a space–time ninjutsu created by Boruto Uzumaki, inspired by the technique of the same name.
ability.narutorpg.forbidden_individual_c: The Forbidden Individual Curse Tag is a juinjutsu utilised by Madara Uchiha.
ability.narutorpg.forbidden_summoning_te: Forbidden Summoning Technique: Fire Rats Cometh
Dōshin summons rats, immersed by fire, to burn any objects such as the forest or attack the opponents.
ability.narutorpg.forbidden_technique_de: Kabuto summons two corpses in his image to attack his opponent with their chakra scalpel forward and backward and then he slashes his opponent with his chakra scalpel.
ability.narutorpg.forbidden_technique_ge: A kinjutsu developed by Orochimaru during the Second Shinobi World War. It combines the two powers of seal and confusion into one technique, giving them the names and when using them separately.
ability.narutorpg.forbidden_technique_im: Forbidden Technique: Impure World Seal Destruction

Orochimaru summons a coffin like the one used in the Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation technique. Ghostly hands come out of the coffin, extending through the body of the opponent, damaging them, until a larger hand grasps them, crushes them, and pulls them into the ethereal dark void within the coffin.
ability.narutorpg.forbidden_technique_mu: Dōshin can make duplicates of his opponents using his Earth Release. This technique, however, costs a significant amount of chakra and makes the user tired from using it.
Formation Ino–Shika–Chō are formations used by the members of the Yamanaka, Nara, and Akimichi clan members/Team 10 designed as a result of their long history of working together.
ability.narutorpg.formation_of_ten_thous: With this technique, a countless number of summoned snakes crawl out of Orochimaru's mouth and hunt down the enemy. With such overwhelming numbers, a true "wall of snakes" is formed, making defence and evasion meaningless. The enemy can do nothing but become buried by the snakes.
ability.narutorpg.forward_trampling_jump: Transformed as Kokuō, Han tramples his opponent with his front legs three times, from his left, right, and centre.
ability.narutorpg.four_black_fogs_format: The members of the Sound Four stand at four directions around their target as they, in unison, perform this technique. They create a dark, dense fog high in the air that descends on the target, engulfing them and creating a powerful barrier that seals them off from all outside forces, even death.
ability.narutorpg.four_black_snakes_form: The four users stand in a square formation, erecting a large barrier between them. On command, it incinerates its contents.
ability.narutorpg.four_corner_seal_telep: The user places a sealing tag on the designated area. If anyone crosses it, whether it be an ally or an enemy, toads are summoned to stop them. This technique is useful to protect an object from falling into enemy hands, and it is said that only Jiraiya and Minato were able to remove it.
ability.narutorpg.four_corner_sealing_ba: This technique was designed by Tsunade for the purpose of sealing a tailed beast. The technique is performed with four separate scrolls and a sample of blood similar to a Summoning Technique. Shizune mentioned that good chakra control and concentration are needed to perform the sealing technique.
ability.narutorpg.four_legs_technique.de: One of the , this technique allows the user to move in the same way as an animal. By surrounding their body with chakra and moving about on all fours, the user's speed and accuracy are significantly enhanced, which in turn makes their attacks more damaging.
ability.narutorpg.four_red_yang_formatio: A powerful barrier formation noted to only be usable by those of Kage calibre, whereby four shinobi, standing in a square formation, erect a large barrier that is red in colour. It was stated to be several times stronger than the Four Violet Flames Formation, and is highly malleable and elastic.
ability.narutorpg.four_snakes_intimidati: Kabuto slashes his opponent with a chakra scalpel, and with three strikes from his navel snake. Three giant white snakes emerge from the ground in sequence, each biting his opponent, and in the end, four of those emerge behind Kabuto, raise themselves high, and lunge at his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.four_symbols_puppet_sh: Akatsuki members are given a special human-shaped seal created by Nagato that takes a physical form known as the Four Symbols Puppet Shinobi, to fight or stall the enemy. The Puppet Shinobi goes to a faraway location to create numerous copies of itself.
ability.narutorpg.four_symbols_seal.desc: This technique requires a great deal of talent to perform. The user applies the seal's formula to an object or a human's body, sealing a large enemy or an evil spirit within them. If two Four Symbols Seal are used, a stronger seal is created; this is called the Eight Trigrams Sealing Style.
ability.narutorpg.four_violet_flames_for: A team of four stands in a square formation and then performs this technique, erecting a solid barrier between them. The barrier is made of purple flames, which will instantly engulf those who come into contact with it, thus preventing anyone from entering or leaving the area.
Transformed into Saiken, Utakata forms a purple-coloured Tailed Beast Ball, mixed with his Soap Bubble Ninjutsu that he launches at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.frog.desc: While in the second state of his Cursed Seal of Earth, Kimimaro jumps in the air, hits his opponent with his tail with a vertical spin, throws behind himself, and spins sideways, creating several bone spikes from his body, hitting his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.frog_kata.desc: The Frog Kata is a fighting style used exclusively by those who have mastered Sage Mode and trained with the toads of Mount Myōboku. The senjutsu chakra used during Sage Mode "activates" the body in various ways, enhancing the user's speed, reflexes, strength, stamina and durability.
ability.narutorpg.frog_kata_dual_gale.de: Jiraiya and Naruto, the latter who is in Sage Mode, use the Frog Kata to uppercut the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.frog_kata_frog_throw.d: Naruto and two shadow clones punch and kick the opponent towards each other's direction, before kicking them up in the air, and punching them down to the ground, where Naruto grabs and throws them aside.
ability.narutorpg.frog_kata_heaven_retur: Naruto lands a series of punches and kicks using shadow clones, some of which extended with natural energy. One of these attacks sends his opponent up in the air, where the original Naruto follows and delivers an upwards spinning kick, sending his opponent even higher.
ability.narutorpg.frog_kata_roaring_atta: Naruto lands a series of kicks and punches using a few shadow clones. The penultimate attack hits the opponent in the air, throwing them towards the ground, but the original Naruto intercepts the opponent half-way, extending the reach of his punch with natural energy, sending his opponent flying.
ability.narutorpg.frog_strike.desc: While performing the Frog Kata, Naruto delivers a powerful open-handed strike, sending ripples of senjutsu chakra that emanate through the struck target from the initial point of contact, causing massive damage from the inside. This makes the technique extremely useful against the targets with strong defences.
ability.narutorpg.front_lotus.desc: The user delivers an upward kick to their opponent, sending them high into the air. The user follows the opponent along their upward trajectory, taking tight hold of them so that they can't move or escape; Rock Lee wraps opponents with the bandages he wears to help in this regard.
ability.narutorpg.front_lotus_eight_trig: Front Lotus: Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven

Neji jumps into the air while Lee wraps him in his bandages. At the same time Lee performs the Front Lotus, Neji releases chakra from his entire body. The spinning that occurs in the Front Lotus substitutes for the rotation involved in the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven technique.
ability.narutorpg.front_lotus_guy_versio: This technique is essentially the same as the Front Lotus, only more damaging. Might Guy ends it with a thumbs up.
ability.narutorpg.front_lotus_of_love_an: Front Lotus of Love and Youth

Rock Lee kicks the enemy, and then Guy tackles the enemy to launch them into the air. They both grab the enemy and crash them into the ground with the use of Front Lotus at the same time on the same opponent.
ability.narutorpg.frying_pan_attack.desc: The user rushes towards the opponent and hits them with a frying pan with enough force to knock them off their feet. The strength and power of this technique depends on the user.
ability.narutorpg.frying_pan_rapid_fire_: Kosuke pulls out his massive frying pan and delivers swift, sweeping blows to his opponent, leaving behind trailing afterimages of the pan.
ability.narutorpg.frying_pan_shield.desc: Kosuke puts a huge frying pan in front of him like a shield and, covering it with chakra, is able to repel opponents' attacks.
ability.narutorpg.fuinjutsu_trap.desc: Once the technique is activated, the target is sealed into a different dimensional space, within the location of the seal. Before noting that there existed few ways to escape the seal, Kakashi tried to break the seal with his Lightning Cutter, but to no avail.
ability.narutorpg.fuma_shuriken_shadow_c: Hashirama throws a fūma shuriken and creates three clones of the shuriken at his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.furious_smelting.desc: The user has the ability to manifest special red, glowing, malleable chakra, which, when on standby, float in a chakram-like formation behind their back. The user is able to manipulate it to form various makeshift tools and weapons, similar to Truth-Seeking Balls.
Kinshiki manifests a club and slams his opponent up in the air, where he morphs his weapon into trench knives and slashes at them. He flashes past them, binding them in chains, and throwing them back to and through the ground.
ability.narutorpg.furious_smelting_scyth: Kinshiki creates a scythe which he swings upwards, hooking the opponent onto the blade and making a powerful sweeping motion, crushing them into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.furious_smelting_whirl: Kinshiki simultaneously creates a machete and sickle, wielding them in both hands and spinning rapidly to create a whirlwind of blades that strikes all enemies it touches.
ability.narutorpg.furious_tail_strike.de: Releasing six tails, Kinkaku violently attacks with his tails, unleashing rapid, devastating strikes.
ability.narutorpg.fury.desc: Fury is a technique which could create a massive explosion, capable of wiping out an entire village. It was developed by En no Gyōja, and his granddaughter Hotaru had the kinjutsu implanted on her back. Tonbee stated that En no Gyōja gave him the scroll to unseal and destroy the deadly kinjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.future_telling.desc: This dōjutsu is more of an involuntary ability. It allows Shion to predict when someone is going to die. While the predicting is in process, her eyes take on a sacred geometric pattern, shifting somewhat like a kaleidoscope.
ability.narutorpg.gale_bullet.desc: In his second Cursed Seal state, Sasuke flies swirling into the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.gamaken_s_clumsy_shake: After Jiraiya grabs and throws the opponent in the air, he summons Gamaken, who strikes them down with his sasumata.
ability.narutorpg.gedo_seal_release.desc: This technique was created by Hiruzen in the Second Shinobi World War to cure the shinobi from the Forbidden Technique: Gedō Seal. Tsunade uses this technique to heal Kakashi's Sharingan.
ability.narutorpg.gelel_rasengan.desc: A technique that incorporates the Rasengan with energy from the Stone of Gelel. It has been used alongside the Demon Fox Rasengan as part of the Twin Rasengan. Its power is presumed equal in strength to a Demon Fox Rasengan, as it can burn part of an opponent's body. It is bluish-green in colour.
ability.narutorpg.genes_of_the_first.des: Yamato has two giant wood branches emerge from the ground, which spiral upwards, striking the opponent higher into the air. He then ends the attack by causing the branches to come from both sides of the airborne opponent and crush them.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_ball_trap.des: A series of traps that placed in bridge dimension that bridged the Moon and Earth. It was created from a dangerous bubble-like substance that traps victims in a genjutsu dream, where they live out their memories.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_bell_sound_cl: The user utilises the ringing of bells to produce a sound wave that travels through the eardrum directly into the target's brain. This paralyses the victim while also causing them to hallucinate, seeing multiple images of the user, which makes it difficult for them to tell the real one from the illusions.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_binding.desc: As the name suggests, the user binds the opponent in a genjutsu, rendering them incapable of movement. As Tsunade demonstrates when facing the Legendary Stupid Brothers, this genjutsu can be used on more than one target at the same time.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_communication: This technique is a projection-type genjutsu used as a means of communication.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_cursed_seal.d: The user applies a spiral-shaped cursed seal that manifests a genjutsu on the victim's subconscious, allowing the user to alter selective memories from their mind and manipulate them under their subliminal control. The more powerful the genjutsu is applied to the victim, the further the seal spreads across their body.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_flower_hill.d: The user summons up illusionary purple flowers from the ground in front of them, which damages enemies with a chance to paralyse them.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_flower_petal_: When trapped inside of a genjutsu or wishing to appear trapped, Kurenai uses this technique to dissolve her body into lots of flower petals which then consume her enemy's body.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_ghost_fire.de: Using their flames, the user manipulates the flames into an illusion of a dog-cat hybrid.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_ketsuryugan.d: By establishing direct skin or eye contact with a target, the user can lock them within a genjutsu for one of various purposes. They can brainwash them into mindless drones with a set order to follow, or trap them into a dream-like state.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_kiss.desc: Gamariki kisses the opponent, placing them in an illusionary world. When the user's trapped in his genjutsu, everyone that the person sees in this illusory world will also have Gamakiri's face. When Naruto was trapped in the genjutsu he saw floating hearts and a mist of purple fog.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_mirage.desc: Kurenai stands up straight with her head bowed and her hands to her chest. As she stomps on the ground, pink leaves surround her, and the area is enveloped in a pink mist. The opponent is confused as to where Kurenai went.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_protect.desc: The user can use this technique to place a genjutsu protection in form of mental blocks in the target's mind that contains valuable information in case the one with the information is captured and interrogated. According to Inoichi Yamanaka, it is very effective against truth serums.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_sharingan.des: Genjutsu: Sharingan broadly refers to a range of genjutsu performed with the Sharingan. It has also been shown to be performed through the Sharingan's higher evolutions: the Mangekyō Sharingan and the Rinnegan.
This genjutsu is cast by pointing at the opponent and a faded purple wave is released from the finger that when it reaches the target, causes them to see a ring of blue fire around them and then see themselves ablaze with blue flames.
ability.narutorpg.genjutsu_yaksha_shark_: Itachi casts a crow genjutsu while Kisame creates numerous water sharks that jump over and onto the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.gentle_fist.desc: The is a form of hand-to-hand combat used by members of the Hyūga clan. Considered a peerless martial art, It inflicts internal damage through attacking the body's Chakra Pathway System, subsequently injuring organs which are closely intertwined with the area of the network which has been struck.
ability.narutorpg.gentle_fist_art_exorci: Hinata delivers a two-handed palm strike, jumps toward her opponent, delivering another two-handed palm strike to their chest, and finally pushes herself backward with her feet from her opponent's chest, knocking them back.
ability.narutorpg.gentle_fist_art_one_bl: Gentle Fist Art One Blow Body

A technique born from their innate ability to expel chakra from every tenketsu on their body, a member of the Hyūga clan can hit their opponent with a blast of chakra that will send them flying away from the user.
ability.narutorpg.gentle_fist_instructio: Hanabi strikes her opponent with several Gentle Fist moves, causing them to fall to the ground. Hanabi then goes to her father, Hiashi, and asks him how she did. Hiashi notices the opponent starts to get up, and with incredible speed finishes off the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.gentle_fist_tenketsu_n: Targeting a single chakra point, the user delivers a two-fingered strike at the opponent, in an attempt to plug the chakra that's being used and halt its flow.
ability.narutorpg.gentle_phoenix_spirall: Gentle Phoenix Spiralling Twin Lion Fists
Naruto, while in his Tailed Beast Mode, transfers his chakra to Hinata, who launches an Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm at the opponent to knock them off balance before grabbing Naruto's hand.
ability.narutorpg.gentle_step_tailed_bea: Gentle Step Tailed Beast Twin Lion Fists

Naruto and Hinata create a cooperative Rasengan, implementing both of their chakra, with which they hit the opponent. Afterwards, Naruto transforms into his Tailed Beast Mode and, with Hinata's help, launches a Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists-enhanced Tailed Beast Ball at the opponent, creating a huge explosion.
ability.narutorpg.gentle_step_twin_lion_: The Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists is a high-level secret Gentle Fist technique taught only to the main branch of the Hyūga clan.
ability.narutorpg.gentle_step_twin_palms: Hinata dashes towards her opponent and hits them with two chakra-enhanced palm strikes, damaging them and knocking them back.
ability.narutorpg.gentle_wind_spiralling: Gentle Wind Spiralling Twin Lion Fists: Snow White

The users combine their chakra and create a gigantic lion head where their hands meet, within it a Rasengan, empowered by both users' chakra is formed. This technique is strong enough to completely destroy the Tenseigan.
ability.narutorpg.giant_insect_fang_sixt: After Shino releases a swarm of kidaichū, Kiba transforms into the three-headed wolf and rapidly spins towards the enemy along with Shino's bugs. Hinata then jumps into the spinning vortex and uses her Byakugan to lodge the bugs onto the opponent's tenketsu.
ability.narutorpg.giant_sphere.desc: Satori forms a large sphere of red energy from its mouth or feet to fire at its foe. A single hit forced Gamabunta to retreat, and the resulting explosion is larger than the Hōzuki Castle itself.
ability.narutorpg.giant_spider_drop.desc: Kidōmaru summons Kyodaigumo above his opponent, who then falls down and crushes them.
ability.narutorpg.giant_spinning_axe.des: Sitting astride Ponta, Sabu throws his massive axe at his opponent, which spins wildly, cutting through its target before returning to Sabu's hands.
ability.narutorpg.giant_stick_rampage.de: Kotetsu summons his Conch Shell Mace and begins to spin wildly, beating the opponent, and at the end makes a powerful swing with the mace from the bottom up and sends the opponent flying with a powerful blow.
ability.narutorpg.giant_swing.desc: A grabs his opponent by the legs, spins around, and throws them.
ability.narutorpg.giant_tree_strong_drop: Yamato creates a large pillar of wood and Sakura punches the wooden pillar which falls on top of the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.god_nativity_of_a_worl: God: Nativity of a World of Trees

God: Nativity of a World of Trees is a technique used to manipulate the roots of the God Tree, spreading them around the entire world to encase those caught within the Infinite Tsukuyomi in the roots' bark.
ability.narutorpg.god_of_tides.desc: The users gathers red chakra into their fist and slams down into the ground, sending numerous waves of the red chakra all around them.
ability.narutorpg.goemon_hellfire.desc: Jiraiya and Naruto, with their respective toad summons, work together to create a large flaming wave of toad oil.
ability.narutorpg.gold_and_silver_traini: Gold and Silver Training: Treasured Tools Wild Dance

Kinkaku uses Bashōsen: Coil of Lightning, attacking the enemy with lightning bolts and paralyzing them, while Ginkaku spins around with Shichiseiken in his hands, cutting through the paralyzed enemies.
ability.narutorpg.gold_dust_cloud_spear_: Gold Dust Cloud Spear: Thrust Away
Rasa goes to the air using Desert Suspension and delivers a series of strikes with his Gold Dust. Then, he forms several bullets and uses them to attack the opponent in rapid succession.
ability.narutorpg.gold_dust_drizzle.desc: Rasa gathers gold dust into the air that strikes downward on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.gold_dust_imperial_fun: Rasa uses his Gold Dust to trap the opponent and then creates a shock wave, crushing the opponent beneath the dust.
ability.narutorpg.gold_dust_press.desc: Rasa deals several blows with his Gold Dust, with a couple slashes, rising spikes, a downward projectile, before finally crushing his target with a block of Gold Dust.
ability.narutorpg.gold_dust_strong_spear: Rasa attacks with his Gold Dust, delivering two slashes, followed by rising spikes, two waves, and finishes with a drill-like spear.
ability.narutorpg.gold_dust_twin_spear.d: Rasa deals several blows with his Gold Dust, slashing his target twice, followed by a wave of rising spikes, and a blast that sends them up in the air. While in the air, two spears rising from the ground, piercing the target.
ability.narutorpg.gold_dust_world_method: The Fourth Kazekage sends a mass of gold dust toward his opponent, and causes spikes to emerge from it, hitting them within reach.
ability.narutorpg.golden_wheel_reincarna: The Golden Wheel Reincarnation Explosion is a powerful technique utilised by Toneri Ōtsutsuki.
ability.narutorpg.gospel_of_the_angel.de: The user creates a spear out of pieces of paper and throws it at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.gozu_tenno.desc: The Gozu Tennō is a fūinjutsu developed by Root's Tanuki Shigaraki under orders from Danzō Shimura. Sasuke Uchiha remarked that it came close to replicating Kaguya Ōtsutsuki's secret techniques.
ability.narutorpg.grass_shadow_style_emi: A pure taijutsu attack in which the user delivers a set of open-handed as well as closed-fist hits along with kicks to the opponent. This series of attacks is so fast that it can barely be followed by the naked eye.
ability.narutorpg.great_barrage_strike.d: The user hits the opponent with a series of punches followed with an uppercut, lifting the opponent into the air and then appearing behind them as they fall near to the ground and finish with a barrage of quick short punches.
ability.narutorpg.great_burial_bullet.de: Kawaki pins the opponent down with stakes, following with him bringing down large stone columns down on top of them, and then finishing with a blast of red chakra gather from his Kāma.
Matatabi, or Yugito in her Tailed Beast Mode, delivers a solid hit with their right paw.
ability.narutorpg.great_dance_slash.desc: Kisame jumps high up into the air and spins around cutting the opponent with Samehada.
ability.narutorpg.great_entrance_of_burn: Guy first unlocks seven chakra gates, then kicks his opponent high into the air. He then quickly jumps after his opponent and uses a chakra-powered punch to send them back down.
ability.narutorpg.great_fire_lightning_f: The user expels a fireball from their mouth, and then proceeds to use Chidori to strike the opponent while they are engulfed in flames.
ability.narutorpg.great_gunpowder_attack: The user utilises their gunpowder mist to combust with every punch they strike at the opponent. They finish the opponent a large slam, causing a large explosion.
Konohamaru clones himself and holds his opponent in place. He then transform himself and his clones into bikini-clad girls who swarm his opponent. While the opponent is distracted, Konohamaru and a clone ram them with a Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.great_roar.desc: A tailed beast uses its massive chakra reserve to turn a roar into a powerful force of pressure and destruction. When Naruto was in control of Kurama's power, he too could produce these shockwaves by roaring.
ability.narutorpg.great_rotating_pushing: Tobi punches his opponent three times, strikes again with an eye-poking motion, jumps up in the air to kick his opponent with both feet, before failing to properly land a spinning kick, ending laid on the ground.
ability.narutorpg.great_sand_downpour.de: Gaara, whilst riding on the floating sand, manipulates his sand to create a small amount of sand in the air which he controls to fall down towards the opponent. Before reaching the opponent the sand splits into multiple shots increasing the spread of its attack range.
ability.narutorpg.great_sand_eater.desc: While in her sand dimension, Kaguya sends a flowing wave of sand at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.great_sandstorm_techni: This is a cooperation ninjutsu between a Wind Release user and an Earth Release user, where they create a sand tornado.
ability.narutorpg.great_sickle_weasel_te: Using her Giant Folding Fan, Temari causes many currents of wind to collide with each other, creating vacuum pockets. As the wind moves outward from her, it cuts up whatever it comes into contact with and deflects any attacks coming towards her, even sound-based genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.great_snake_binding.de: Kabuto grabs his opponent with his navel snake, pulling them towards him, and then delivers a cross cut with two chakra scalpels.
ability.narutorpg.great_snake_charmer_te: Orochimaru transforms into a giant snake that grabs the opponent with its mouth and slams them down on the ground with the giant snake bursting into many smaller snakes. He then reforms out of the snakes.
ability.narutorpg.great_snake_thrust.des: In Sage Mode, the user thrusts their chakra snakes at the opponent.
The user creates an exceptionally powerful Spiralling Ring that can cause massive destruction on impact. Menma used this technique to destroy most of Konoha, similarly to Pain's assault on the village.
Transformed as Son Gokū, Rōshi jumps into the air and comes down punching the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.great_trample_circle.d: Transformed as Kokuō, Han reels back, lifting his front legs, and comes back down crushing his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.great_tree_spear.desc: With his wood human, Hashirama uses it to create a large wooden spear to throw at the opponent. The landing of the wooden spear can also sprout branching trees that can damage the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.great_tree_world_metho: After placing his palm on the ground, Danzō creates a giant tree that knocks back anyone caught in its vicinity.
ability.narutorpg.great_twin_circles.des: Obito delivers a series of strikes with a combo of Kamui, a shuriken and the Wood Release: Cutting Technique. He then kicks the opponent in the air and summons two giant shuriken from Kamui's Dimension, and sends them at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.great_vacuum_cannon.de: This technique utilises the Takumi Village's special Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords. The user shoots small, powerful and near-invisible blasts of wind from the blades.
ability.narutorpg.great_wild_snake.desc: The user rapidly slithers in a circle-like fashion, brushing off any incoming targets. The strength and speed of this technique is great enough to leave sparks on the surrounding terrain.
ability.narutorpg.great_wind_violent_wal: Temari swings her Giant Folding Fan and a giant vortex swirls around and lifts the opponent into the sky. They are zapped by lightning three times before falling to the ground, giving off black smoke.
ability.narutorpg.green_egg_bombs.desc: The Animal Path's Giant Drill-Beaked Bird lays eggs that explode at its command.
ability.narutorpg.green_impact.desc: Naruto performs Leaf Whirlwind to disable the opponent then sweep them off their feet using Leaf Gale. After that, he launches the opponent into the sky using Rasengan. Naruto can only use this technique as "Might Suit" Naruto.
ability.narutorpg.green_rain_ground_leve: Sarada jumps high and throws a bunch of kunai with healing seals on them in a large circle, healing all allies within the radius of the healing field.
ability.narutorpg.green_roar.desc: The user grabs the opponent and then gets behind them and flips using both feet to kick them away.
ability.narutorpg.ground_splitting.desc: With Sage Mode activated, Naruto kicks his opponents around, before heel-kicking the ground, causing it to crack, sending his opponents up in the air.
ability.narutorpg.ground_splitting_techn: After forming the necessary hand seals, the user slams their hands into the ground which causes the earth to erupt below their target's feet. This technique can also effectively create barricades that would take quite some time for a regular person to surmount.
ability.narutorpg.grudge_rain.desc: This technique requires a considerable amount of users. The users create a large storm cloud to produce rain. The large amount of rain can turn into a large wave of water and sweeps the enemy off their feet. As long as the targets are trapped by the water, their chakra will be continuously drained.
ability.narutorpg.grudge_sand_cloud_rend: Gaara thrusts his arm into a cloud of sand, transforming his arm into Shukaku's which strikes the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.grudge_sand_cloud_tear: Gaara uppercuts a cloud of sand, transforming his arm into Shukaku's which strikes the opponent into the air.
ability.narutorpg.guillotine_drop.desc: After covering himself in his Lightning Release Chakra Mode, A jumps into the air above his opponent and performs a downwards kick, using the momentum of the fall to increase the power behind the attack.
ability.narutorpg.gunbai_fanned_wind.des: The user waves their gunbai as a fan to create powerful gusts of wind, strong enough to blow away several enemies in one swing.
ability.narutorpg.gunpowder_fist.desc: Ultilising the gunpowder mixed in his black mist, Boro covers his fists with mist and ignites it with each punch he delivers to the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.guts_rasengan.desc: Remembering Jiraiya's words about never abandoning his ninja way, Naruto creates a fully charged Rasengan, but increases its mass and raw force. It has shown enough power to blast away an entire wall of a fortress and even decimate it in a matter of minutes.
ability.narutorpg.hair_binding_technique: Using their chakra, the user is able to stimulate their hair, granting them the ability to freely manipulate it. Because of the malleability of the hair, the user can use it to entangle their opponents, cutting off their movements or even use it to grab their target and send them hurtling some distance away.
ability.narutorpg.hair_camouflage.desc: Using this technique, Kurenai's hair will lengthen and completely cover her whole body. Exactly what this technique serves for is unknown.
ability.narutorpg.hair_needle_senbon.des: This technique hardens the hair on user's head and shoots a multitude of hair senbon at the enemy. The sharpened points of the hair can turn the target's entire body into a pincushion.
ability.narutorpg.hanabi_style_eight_tri: Hanabi Style: Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms
Hanabi uses the Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms technique to hit and shut down sixty-four of the opponent's tenketsu, with the final hit making the opponent spin in a vortex-like fashion.
ability.narutorpg.hanabi_style_revolving: After releasing chakra from the tenketsu in her palms, Hanabi spins rapidly, creating a undefined vortex of chakra around herself, which is capable of blocking an attack and harming any nearby opponent.
ability.narutorpg.hands_of_bonds.desc: After amassing a large amount of chakra, Asura can use it to manifest up to four large arms. These chakra arms are capable of repelling Indra Ōtsutsuki's Susanoo.
ability.narutorpg.hands_of_flame.desc: Using the ignited flames from his jinchūriki transformation, Obito shapes them into hands to attack with.
ability.narutorpg.harem_technique.desc: After using the Shadow Clone Technique to create many copies of the user, the user and their shadow clones each perform the Sexy Technique to change their appearances into beautiful naked women. The naked forms swarm their target and hang upon them, the intention being to overpower targets with lustful thoughts.
ability.narutorpg.haze_clone_technique.d: The user creates hundreds of copies of themselves, each of which, like the standard Clone Technique, has no physical substance and thus cannot be attacked.
ability.narutorpg.haze_ninja_art_forbidd: Haze Ninja Art: Forbidden Technique: Afterlife Opening Gate

The user summons a gateway that can be used to presumably send anyone to anywhere that the user desires. It can be used to bypass impenetrable barrier ninjutsu. The cost of the technique ages the user greatly to the point of their death.
Haze Ninja Art: Forbidden Technique: Ephemeral Life
The user sacrifices their life to summon an otherworldly spectre. As they begin the hand seals, green seals spread across their body, and the user prays to the spectre.
Haze Ninja Art: Forbidden Technique: Hellish Obliteration

The user summons tar-like sludge in the area around them and those caught in the sludge will sink to their deaths. If the targets try to get close to the user, they will sink faster. The user can also form tendrils of the sludge to hold down the victims' limbs or defend themselves.
Haze Ninja Art: Forbidden Technique: Red Spider Lily

The user grabs the intended target with the intention of incinerating both themselves and the target in a burst of powerful red energy. If the opponent has a strong enough defence, they can survive the technique unscathed.
ability.narutorpg.hazy_genjutsu.desc: This technique casts an illusion on the enemy that blurs the target's vision of the entire area. In addition, it causes the victim to react as though they're sinking in quicksand, effectively immobilising the target.
ability.narutorpg.hazy_moon.desc: Kakashi summons all eight of his ninken to cross-slash the opponent, followed by him delivering a deadly, swift sword slash.
ability.narutorpg.hazy_moon_night.desc: Yūgao swings her sword in a circular motion, leaving a trace of afterimages behind, which befitting the technique's name, mirrors that of a moon. Yugaō will then rush at them to deliver a blow, taking advantage of the difficulty in following her movement.
ability.narutorpg.headbutt.desc: After entering his four-tailed transformation, Killer B uses the two chakra horns that protrude out of his chakra cloak to headbutt the opponent. According to Sabu, this attack is strong enough to decapitate someone.
ability.narutorpg.headbutt_game.desc: Gengetsu grabs the opponent and headbutts them.
ability.narutorpg.heal_bite.desc: Through biting and consuming the user's chakra, they can heal the injuries of others, as well as themselves.
ability.narutorpg.healing_resuscitation_: This is a medical ninjutsu that is used to heal severe, life-threatening injuries. To perform, it requires a full intensive care unit, staffed by medics with refined chakra control.
ability.narutorpg.healing_technique.desc: The user gathers healing chakra into a white orb and moves it over injured areas. Sakura used this trying to heal Kakeru Tsuki. But, because too much time had passed since Ishidate's Petrification Gauntlet inflicted the wound, she was unable to heal the injuries or ultimately save the king.
ability.narutorpg.heart_acceleration_tec: Murasame changes the way his chakra flows, allowing him to release more of his chakra for techniques and greatly increases his speed. This technique makes the user run out of chakra much faster than usual.
ability.narutorpg.heaven_and_earth_explo: Tobi rushes forwards through the opponent while intangible, leaving a trail of explosive tags behind him, which detonate after he stops.
ability.narutorpg.heaven_and_earth_light: With the swipe of a hand, the user brings down four bolts of thunder on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.heaven_bending_bomb_as: Tobi warps backwards and then quickly returns, throwing five explosive tags at the opponent's feet.
ability.narutorpg.heaven_collapse.desc: The user first punches the opponent four times, sending them crashing into a large boulder. The user then jumps onto the boulder, and uses the 1000 Metre Punch on the opponent, sending them flying far away, and the boulder crumbling to pieces.
ability.narutorpg.heaven_cutter.desc: Zabuza kicks his opponent, and delivers a series of slashes with his Kubikiribōchō, finishing with an upwards slash that sends his opponent up in midair.
ability.narutorpg.heaven_gold.desc: Fukurokumaru lifts a gold bar into the air, causing huge gold bars to rain down on his opponents from the sky, injuring them.
ability.narutorpg.heaven_s_blessing.desc: Sakura summons a giant Inner Sakura to throw four giant kunai which then fall upon the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.heaven_s_needle_barrag: Komachi moves forward and delivers a quick slashing attack with her sword, pushing the opponent away from her. She then leaps high into the air above the opponent and removes the ornamental needles in her hair before throwing them downward in a fast-moving barrage.
ability.narutorpg.heaven_twin_fang.desc: Kiba and Akamaru jump into the air and uses the Fang Passing Fang technique. The two then merge creating a giant Passing Fang. They then tunnel far into the ground creating a large, deep hole.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_advent.desc: In his avatar, Asura slams down the opponent with a palm strike, causing golden chakra to rise beneath them.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_chidori_cherr: Sasuke strikes the opponent with Chidori, switches places with Sakura, who punches them down, and switches back again, channelling Chidori into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_defending_foo: Much like the Heavenly Foot of Pain, the user concentrates their chakra onto their foot, causing a purple clash of light when the user kicks the opponent with this technique. This does immense damage to the opponent, and the result of this technique is a very large crater into the ground.
Tsunade leaps into the air and concentrates all her strength into her heel. She then rapidly swings her heel down, not only doing severe damage to anyone she hits, but also cratering the ground and decimating the surrounding structures.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_foot_of_pain_: Sakura charges towards the opponent using taijutsu, while Sasuke in his Susanoo prepares imbuing Sakura in Kirin, coming down on the opponent with an lightning-empowered kick.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_ice_chamber.d: While in her ice dimension, Kaguya causes ice to condense and freeze around her opponents, holding them in place, the intense cold injuring them.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_insertion_ham: Obito throws the opponent up in the air while using his Wood Release: Cutting Technique. The opponent lands and Obito wraps them in a wooden ball. Madara then summons his Tengai Shinsei, while Obito uses Kamui to escape from the blast, which crashes down on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_kick_wild_dan: The user kicks the opponent once on their knee, and then kicks them twice on their face in rapid succession, sending them spiralling upwards.
