ability.narutorpg.heavenly_lightning.des: The user brings down a bolt of thunder on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_palm_wild_dan: Neji grabs the opponent, flips them around and then strikes them thrice in the back, sending them flying away.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_prison_fire_s: The user brings up a large flame in his right hand, which soon after takes the form of a sword. If someone is hit by the sword, they will be engulfed in flames. The sword can also easily pierce flesh.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_punishment.de: This is a suicidal technique which is done when the user covers their torso with explosive tags and detonates themselves while in range of the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_spear_foot.de: Tsunade leaps to great heights and comes down crashing into her opponent with a massive amount of force, powerful enough to crack the ribcage of Madara Uchiha's Susanoo.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_transfer_tech: With this technique, Mabui is able to transport objects anywhere at the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Speed_of_light speed of light]. When being transferred, the object is engulfed in light and moves to any desired destination through a narrow beam, reminiscent of a bolt of lightning.
ability.narutorpg.heavenly_weeping.desc: The Heavenly Weeping is a ninjutsu used by Tobirama Senju.
ability.narutorpg.heavy_hammer_spark.des: When Mecha-Naruto is in vehicle form, and the opponent is in a position near the wheels (for example, Chōji Akimichi tried to attack by rolling towards Mecha-Naruto), he extends a huge hammer from the bottom and hits the opponent, sending them flying.
ability.narutorpg.heel_falling_attack.de: While in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, Naruto jumps up in the air, kicks his opponents from multiple directions, and finishes by heel-kicking them into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.hell_dark_formation.de: The Sound Four activate their second stage Cursed Seals and create a four-way barrier formation that pulses out dark energy. The four shinobi seal the opponent inside the barrier formation, creating an erupting explosion of dark energy and leaving no trace of their target.
ability.narutorpg.hell_drop.desc: A grabs the opponent and uses his palm to push the opponent in the air, where A then smashes his elbow onto the opponent's head, smashing them into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.hell_stab.desc: The Hell Stab is the strongest technique of the Third Raikage, whereby he concentrates a considerable amount of lightning chakra into just the fingertips of a single hand and then performs a thrusting motion, which allows him to pierce a target in a somewhat similar manner to the Chidori and Lightning Cutter.
ability.narutorpg.hell_stab_four_finger_: Hell Stab Four-Finger Spear Hand: Sky Drop

A delivers a series of hits to the opponent, sending the opponent into the air. Then A cloaks himself in lightning and uses his Hell Stab to deliver a strike to the opponent, sending them crashing into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.hell_stab_one_finger_n: A uses his Hell Stab and smashes his hand into the ground, creating several pillars of earth from the impact. Then, the Raikage uses one finger to create a spear covered in lightning and enters the Lightning Release Chakra Mode.
ability.narutorpg.hell_stab_three_finger: Hell Stab Three-Finger Spear Hand: Side Swipe
A uses his Hell Stab and swings with a horizontal chop at his opponent, unleashing a wave of electricity that sends them flying back.
ability.narutorpg.hellfire_gale.desc: Kakuzu, after using the Wind Release: Pressure Damage to create a whirlwind in the centre of the battlefield, releases through his fire-mask a large fireball into the whirlwind, causing the fireball to split into several smaller ones that are sent in all directions in a fixed pattern.
ability.narutorpg.hero_of_the_hidden_san: Pakura covers herself with fire, amplifying the effect of her Scorch Release attacks.
Obito performs the Fire Release: Great Fireball Technique and after the opponent gets burned by the flames, he appears behind the opponent and stabs them with a kunai.
ability.narutorpg.hidden_doorway_techniq: The user extends their palm out towards a wall, causing a hole that ripples and shapes into a doorway. Additionally, a seal can be placed on the wall to secure the contents behind it.
ability.narutorpg.hidden_rock_trap.desc: This trap was amongst the many ones that protected Mount Katsuragi. After crossing the spot where it's placed, a rock cylinder pops out and pushes the enemy off the mountain track.
ability.narutorpg.hidden_shadow_snake_bu: The user burrows underground and extends their limbs to grab their opponent by their ankles, and drags them into the ground, burying them.
ability.narutorpg.hidden_shadow_snake_ha: The user summons several snakes from under their sleeve, deploying them against a target as a surprise. The snakes do as their summoner commands, attacking or capturing targets by biting or constricting them.
ability.narutorpg.hidden_shadow_wild_sna: The user summons a large amounts of snakes that emerge from underground to attack a target.
ability.narutorpg.hiden_hiding_in_scale_: Hiden: Hiding in Scale Powder Technique
The user exhales a large quantity of fine powder from their mouth, which due to its luminous quality, shines so brightly that it can temporarily blind multiple targets within its area of effect.
ability.narutorpg.hiden_scale_powder_enf: Hiden: Scale Powder Enfolding Attack Technique
Fū transformed as Chōmei flaps its wings to release a perculiar powder. While in this state Fū can also use this generated powder to shoot several small spheres at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.hiden_scale_powder_tec: Fū manifests Chōmei's wings and flaps them at her opponent, sending a wave of scale powder.
ability.narutorpg.hideout_destruction_tr: A timed trapping technique created by Orochimaru to destroy any evidence of the location it is placed on. Once activated, the entirety of the area is completely erased, by what appears to be a mud water vortex, destroying everything within the predefined vicinity.
ability.narutorpg.hiding_in_a_toad_techn: The user summons a special from Mount Myōboku and hides inside its stomach.
ability.narutorpg.hiding_in_black_fog_te: The user emits a black fog from their body to conceal themselves.
ability.narutorpg.hiding_in_cloth_techni: The user covers themselves and the surrounding area with a giant roll of cloth which conceals the user as they escape, allowing them to leave the battlefield unnoticed.
ability.narutorpg.hiding_in_frost_techni: The Hiding in Frost Technique produces visually clouding frost by causing the temperature of air to fall below the freezing point, effectively freezing any ambient water vapour in the vicinity. The frost allows the user to become transparent within it. Upon being struck with an attack, the user becomes visible.
ability.narutorpg.hiding_in_mist_techniq: This technique is a specialty of Kirigakure ninja. Users fill the air with mist and control its thickness with their chakra. Once the mists are thick enough that opponents cannot see, that in turn means they cannot manage much defence against the user.
ability.narutorpg.hiding_in_shadow_techn: A technique in which the user is capable of concealing themselves in a shadow.
ability.narutorpg.hiding_in_surface_tech: With this technique, the user can phase through their surroundings, allowing them to quickly avoid an incoming attack and can travel undetected as well. Using this method of approach, the user can execute a surprise attack on their enemy.
ability.narutorpg.hiding_with_camouflage: The user controls the reflection of light around their body using chakra, causing their form, shadow, and even breathing to become invisible to the unaided eye. Because they perfectly blend in with their surroundings, the user can sneak up behind an enemy without being noticed.
ability.narutorpg.hinokagutsuchi.desc: Hinokagutsuchi is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu unique to Indra Ōtsutsuki's left eye. It strongly resembles Amaterasu in both form and function, allowing him to produce black flames at the focal point of his vision.
ability.narutorpg.hog_release_crazed_fir: Shizune surrounds the opponent with the poison mist, then jumps up and throws senbon at the opponent. Tonton then finishes the opponent by tossing eight large bombs at the opponent in the poisonous mist. After throwing eight of them, an explosion appears.
ability.narutorpg.hog_release_tonton.des: Tonton is thrown to the opponent by Shizune, who then constantly attacks the opponent in various directions. Tonton then spins fiercely upward under their opponent, leaving them in the air, which then causes a crash once the opponent knock into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.hokage_style_sixty_yea: Hokage-Style Sixty-Year-Old Technique — Kakuan Entering Society with Bliss-Bringing Hands
The Hokage-Style Sixty-Year-Old Technique — Kakuan Entering Society with Bliss-Bringing Hands technique utilises the power of the Wood Release to forcibly suppress a tailed beast's chakra.
ability.narutorpg.holly.desc: Kimimaro dives at the opponent with his bone sword spinning rapidly like a drill and strikes them rapidly in different places.
ability.narutorpg.honey_spit_trap.desc: After being summoned, the Giant Bee spits massive amounts of honey on its opponent which encases and immobilises them.
ability.narutorpg.horizon_meteor.desc: The user launches a series of Truth-Seeking Balls at the opponent, forcing them straight into the ground. Then, several platforms, alongside the opponent, are lifted into the air, with the user creating an invisible clone to strike the opponent hard enough to blow them onto another floating platform.
ability.narutorpg.horn_breaking.desc: Kokuō drives its horns directly into the opponent using a powerful charge. The force of this attack was so great that it sent Gyūki flying a considerable distance away.
ability.narutorpg.horror_of_akatsuki.des: Hidan slashes the opponent with his Triple-Bladed Scythe, creating an opening for Kakuzu, who grabs them and throws them at the ground. Zetsu emerges from the ground with his flytrap extensions "chewing" the opponent as he spins upwards.
ability.narutorpg.host_transformation.de: Host Transformation is a ninjutsu exclusive to the player avatars in Naruto to Boruto: Shinobi Striker. The player momentarily takes the form of one of the following Tailed Beasts:.
ability.narutorpg.hot_blooded_dynamic_en: Guy and Lee combine their Dynamic Entries and kick the opponent together as one.
ability.narutorpg.hot_sand_waterfall_fun: Gaara while in Shukaku form grabs the opponent, jumps into the air with them, and throws them back down to the ground while crushing them with sand.
ability.narutorpg.howling_hair_sound_wav: By whipping around locks of their hair, the user generates high-frequency sound waves that are capable of simultaneously disorienting the foe by overwhelming their hearing and likewise able to slice at the target.
ability.narutorpg.human_beast_combinatio: Human Beast Combination Transformation: Double-Headed Wolf

This technique is a specialty of the Inuzuka clan. The Inuzuka and their ninken companion perform the Combination Transformation to take the shared form of a two-headed wolf. Because of the transformation's size, its strong claws, and its two sets of fangs, its standard attacks are quite powerful.
ability.narutorpg.human_beast_mixture_tr: Human Beast Mixture Transformation — Three-Headed Wolf
This technique is a speciality of Konohagakure's Inuzuka clan.
Chōji performs his Human Bullet Tank in unison with Multi-Size Technique, and slams into his opponent, leaving a gaping hole in the ground.
ability.narutorpg.human_bullet_heavy_tan: Chōji performs Human Bullet Tank and begins bouncing until brutally bouncing on the opponent two times while driving them into the ground on the third.
ability.narutorpg.human_bullet_tank.desc: This is a "showy" taijutsu unique to members of the Akimichi clan. The user tucks themselves into a ball and rolls towards a target. Due to force of their rotation, most obstacles are pulverised upon contact.
ability.narutorpg.human_bullet_yo_yo.des: The Human Bullet Yo-Yo is the technique derived from used by the 16th generation of the Ino–Shika–Chō trio.
ability.narutorpg.human_cocoon_technique: The user creates a cocoon around themselves to use it as a waterproof "sleeping bag". It can also be used to hide from enemies or to spy on them.
ability.narutorpg.human_path.desc: The grants a Rinnegan user the ability to read the mind of any target by placing their hand on the target's head or chest, thus obtaining even the most well-guarded secrets. This process kills the target, with their souls being physically removed from their body once users pull their hand away.
ability.narutorpg.human_shadow_simulatio: Shikamaru materialises and personifies his shadow into two different Shikamaru shaped shadows. Each shadow punches the opponent once and then both shadows coil around the opponent and crushes them.
ability.narutorpg.hundred_blooming_flowe: While having the target under the effects of the Odourless Poison Mist, Karenbana releases flower petals, before casting the illusion that she had turned into a multitude of flower petals herself, which flow through the air and circle the target.
After activating her Byakugan, Hinata then hits the opponent ninety-nine times. After the last, hundredth hit, they are sent flying.
ability.narutorpg.hundred_puppet_soul_bi: After having their target destroy ninety-nine of their puppets with each puppet driving a "bolt" into the target, the destruction of the hundredth puppet allows the user to effectively take full control of a person's body in a similar manner to the Puppet Performance: Skilful Achievement with a Human Body technique wit
ability.narutorpg.hungry_shark_drop.desc: Kisame jumps into the air and then points Samehada down towards the opponent and then enveloping it in water. He then manipulates its shape moulding it into a shark and drilling the opponent into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.hunt.desc: The user stretches out their Truth-Seeking Balls into a rope-like form that pierce the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.hurricane_head_butt.de: Mecha-Naruto uses its jet boosts to rush into the opponent and headbutt them before spinning rapidly as it lifts them up into the air.
Akaboshi and his group surround and entrap their opponent in a pyramidal, pink-glowing barrier, then cause the barrier to explode, injuring or, ideally, killing the person within it.
ability.narutorpg.hurricane_thunderclap_: Hurricane Thunderclap — Majestic Attire Sword Stroke
Naruto and Sasuke deliver a series of physical attacks on their opponent. Naruto fully manifests Kurama, and Sasuke armours it with Susanoo, also manifesting its sword, cutting the opponent down.
ability.narutorpg.husband_and_wife_rasen: Kushina delivers a barrage of punches, following with Minato teleporting above the opponent to slash down on them, finished with the couple forming together a Rasengan that is charged towards the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.hydrification_techniqu: This jutsu, a hallmark of the Hōzuki clan, allows the user to liquefy any part of their body at will, from the hair on their head to the muscles in their arms. Gengetsu Hōzuki liquefies into a mixture of oil and water, but it's not clear if this same mixture is used by other members.
ability.narutorpg.hypnotic_genjutsu_wild: By exhaling the Kotarō that their bodies are able to produce, members of the Kodon clan hypnotise Rōen, putting it under their control. Most forms of attack that might be directed against Rōen won't disrupt the hypnotism, but large quantities of blue fire powder will.
ability.narutorpg.hyuga_great_combo_palm: Neji, Hinata and Hanabi use Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm to distance themselves from the opponent, after which Hiashi arrives and uses Eight Trigrams Vacuum Wall Palm.
ability.narutorpg.hyuga_great_revolving_: A collaboration technique performed by two Hyūga clan members. One performs the Protecting Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms technique and the other uses the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven around it. This creates a huge sphere with both offensive and defensive power, causing great damage to the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.hyuga_main_family_s_ju: This cursed seal is used by the Hyūga clan in order to protect their kekkei genkai, the Byakugan. Members of the clan's main house brand members of the clan's branch houses with the cursed seal so that, when they die, their Byakugan will be sealed away, preventing its secrets from being learned by enemies.
ability.narutorpg.i_won_t_let_you_go.des: Kushina hits her opponent with a frying pan a bunch of times. Then, she becomes enraged and punches the target, sending them a considerable distance away.
ability.narutorpg.iai_beheading.desc: Adhering to the principles of Iaidō, the user performs a quick and powerful slash with their sword in order to cut the intended target, before immediately re-sheathing the blade afterwards.
ability.narutorpg.iaido.desc: The term refers to a specific style of kenjutsu that is concerned with the smooth, controlled movements of drawing the sword from its scabbard, striking or cutting an opponent, removing blood from the blade, and then replacing the sword in the scabbard.
ability.narutorpg.ibuse_s_poison_mist.de: Hanzō summons Ibuse from the ground, who launches a poison cloud, which travels in a straight line and poisons his opponent by enveloping them.
ability.narutorpg.ice_breaking_fist.desc: The user surrounds their fist with ice to block incoming taijutsu attacks. With this technique, Rahyō was able to successfully stop Might Guy's Leaf Whirlwind.
ability.narutorpg.ice_disk_technique.des: This technique turns the moisture particles in the air into ice disks of multiple uses. They can be hurled with tremendous force at a target, and are hard to dodge because of their transparency. They can create highly durable shields against enemy attacks. They can be stand on as platforms for hovering in the air.
ability.narutorpg.ice_prison_technique.d: This technique allows the user to infuse their chakra with ice on the ground and bring it to the surface. The user can then trap their opponent within the ice by controlling its movements and completely surrounding them in the ice.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_black_drag: An Ice Release technique formed from already existing ice. After forming the needed hand seal Dotō will thrust his arm to send out a black ether-like dragon to strike his opponent. As it flies through the air it will begin to turn. When it hits the target it will use its motion to launch the opponent high into the air.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_crystal_wa: The user creates walls out of ice crystals to detain their opponents. The reflective surfaces of ice can serve as mirrors for certain genjutsu that requires mirrors to work.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_earthen_co: Ice Release: Earthen Consecutive Chains of Ice
The user, either through physical contact or remotely, causes ice particles to form on a target. If used on a living creature, the target will freeze to death unless they are able to mould chakra.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_frozen_cap: Upon making a one-handed hand seal, the user freezes the ground underneath a target to immobilise and freeze their feet, rendering them motionless for a period of time.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_ice_breaki: The user surrounds their fists with ice, increasing their striking power or, alternatively, allowing them to use their fists to block attacks stronger than they would be able to otherwise.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_ice_peak_c: Haku creates thin spikes of ice that protrude from the ground underneath the opponent, sending them flying high into the air.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_ice_rock_d: Ice Release: Ice Rock Dome of Magnificent Nothingness

Haku can quickly freeze the surrounding air and create an icy, transparent igloo-like dome around himself and/or allies to act as a defence. It is strong enough to withstand the air assault of many explosive tags at once, remaining almost undamaged.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_icicle_com: Haku delivers a series of slashes with senbon, followed by some kicks, before resuming to slash at the opponent. He then kicks the opponent away, generating multiple large needles of ice in the air to fly at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_icicle_swa: After backflipping in the air, Haku quickly launches several ice needles at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_one_horned: Ice Release: One Horned White Whale

This technique allows the user to create a humongous whale with a long narwhal horn out of preexisting ice to attack their opponent. The user needs a source of ice in order to use this technique. The large bulk of this technique is capable of creating great destruction upon landing.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_swallow_sn: This technique creates a cluster of ice needles in the shape of miniature swallows out of preexisting ice, which the user then launches at the opponent. These needles can change direction in midair and will maim the opponent with their sharp wings.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_tearing_dr: Ice Release: Tearing Dragon Fierce Tiger
The user manipulates pre-existing ice and forms it into a giant tiger. It is cold enough to freeze any Water Release technique that it comes into contact with.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_ten_thousa: Ice Release: Ten Thousand Ice Petals

The user unleashes a barrage of ice darts. The intensity of the cold is so great, that should a person attempt to block them, it will cause severe damage to the afflicted limb. The user can also use this defensively by creating a wall of ice to create distance between the user and their combatant.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_twin_drago: An advanced version of Ice Release: Black Dragon Blizzard in which Dotō releases two dragons of black snow that merge into a massive tornado. This technique manipulates existing ice instead of creating ice.
Aiming their hand at a target, the user shoots shards of ice rapidly around the target which entraps them in a whirlwind, leading to the target becoming partially encased in ice.
ability.narutorpg.ice_release_wolf_fang_: Ice Release: Wolf Fang Avalanche Technique

This technique allows Nadare to cause an avalanche when near a mountain and transform the falling snow into a pack of wolves to attack the opponent. This technique has a weakness to lightning-based techniques, as seen when the wolves completely dissolve when attacked by Kakashi Hatake's Lightning Cutter.
ability.narutorpg.ice_sword_technique.de: The user condenses the moisture in the atmosphere into swords of ice that can then be used for close-range combat or shot at a target. The swords can be formed from great distances away.
ability.narutorpg.illusionary_mist.desc: The Three-Tails releases a mist created by its chakra to put intruders under an illusion. The illusion torments the target with events from their past. The illusion will vanish if the victim can break the illusion, either by themselves or with the assistance of another.
ability.narutorpg.immortal_body.desc: Hidan's immortal body releases a wave of energy, damaging his opponents, briefly cursing them while enhancing his own attributes.
ability.narutorpg.impaling_spear_tree.de: The user grows trees with sharp pointed branches, impaling any that are beneath them.
ability.narutorpg.impermanence_of_worldl: The Magaki Group creates a shard that breaks up into multiple shards and impales the opponent. According to Yamato, it is said to be quite a formidable technique.
ability.narutorpg.improvised_secret_tech: Improvised Secret Technique: Lightning Ball Shuriken Technique
A cooperation ninjutsu developed by Boruto that has Sarada create a series of Lightning Balls that are then infused with Lightning Release-charged shuriken by Boruto and are launched at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.incursion_of_clarity.d: Kabuto uppercuts his opponent and then spins around slicing their throat with a chakra scalpel.
ability.narutorpg.indra_s_arrow.desc: Indra's Arrow is Sasuke Uchiha's strongest offensive technique.
ability.narutorpg.infinite_embrace.desc: A special barrier of bright purple chakra that subdues the enemy by pushing down on them and rapidly draining their chakra. It's quite difficult to resist it, but Naruto Uzumaki managed to do it using the Nine-Tails' chakra.
ability.narutorpg.infinite_tsukuyomi.des: The Infinite Tsukuyomi is an extremely powerful genjutsu that traps the entire world in an illusion, enslaving the human and animal populations in a dream so that their chakra may be drawn upon by the God Tree.
ability.narutorpg.infinite_wild_dance.de: After opening seven chakra gates, Lee punches the ground, creating an earthquake that launches his opponent into the air. He then attacks his foe many times at the speed of light, moving so fast that it seems as if there are three Lees attacking at once.
ability.narutorpg.ink_clone_technique.de: A technique that infuses chakra into ink to form clones of the user. If struck, the ink clones revert back to plain ink.
ability.narutorpg.ink_creation.desc: This is a unique ability of Gyūki that allows it to produce ink. Though Gyūki is the sole inheritor of the ability, it can be passed on to its jinchūriki.
ability.narutorpg.ink_flush.desc: By directly pouring out his ink instead of using it to draw, Sai can create a large amount of creatures such as a nest of snakes to attack the target.
ability.narutorpg.ink_lariat.desc: Killer B rushes back and forth on the opponent using Lariat with ink on his arm.
ability.narutorpg.ink_mist_technique.des: The user wraps their body in chakra-infused ink to hide themselves creating an effective smokescreen. When used in combination with the Body Flicker Technique, the user can quickly leave the battlefield without being noticed.
ability.narutorpg.inner_sakura.desc: Inner Sakura broadly refers to a range of techniques performed by Sakura Haruno with her inner self that sleeps in her heart in the Naruto video games.
ability.narutorpg.insect_clone_technique: An Aburame has thousands of their kikaichū gather together until they've taken on the size and appearance of the Aburame, to be used either as a decoy or a diversion. The insect clone can be created anywhere that the kikaichū are positioned or sent to, making it more useful for certain tasks than a shadow clone.
ability.narutorpg.insect_deception_techn: Shibi sends his insects underneath the opponent before springing them upon the enemy, feeding on their chakra. The technique isn't as effective if the opponent has chakra reserves which surpass the kikaichū's capacity to feed on said chakra.
ability.narutorpg.insect_jamming_techniq: The user has a large amount of their kikaichū spread out over a wide area around themselves, having them emit a small amount of the chakra they usually feed on to confuse sensor-type shinobi.
ability.narutorpg.insect_jar_technique.d: A technique capable of protecting against attacks by using kikaichū to fly in a dome shape at high speed, similar to the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven. While proving defensive, a sufficient amount of explosive force can break through it.
ability.narutorpg.insect_pillar.desc: Shino disappears and seemingly transforms into a pillar of kikaichū that attacks the opponent. This attack can be used on multiple opponents at once as extra pillar appears per target.
ability.narutorpg.insect_pillar_techniqu: Shino summons many kikaichū to form pillars the attack the opponent form below in various ways, either as a row of advancing pillars, or a spike from the ground which multiplies per target.
The user releases a large number of kikaichū that form a rope that can easily support the target's weight.
ability.narutorpg.insect_spying_techniqu: By linking themselves to an insect, they are able to see and hear what it experiences, providing a long-range and relatively safe and inconspicuous way to gather intel. The user is also able to tell when the bug had been killed.
ability.narutorpg.insect_webbing.desc: The user is able to create excrete webbing from the palms of their hands, extending their reach mainly for restraining and trapping their target.
ability.narutorpg.instant.desc: Sasuke appears in front of his opponent and unsheaths his sword. He then slashes many times and reappears behind his opponent. The opponent collapses after he sheathes his sword back in the hilt.
ability.narutorpg.instant_earth_burial.d: Isshiki flies towards the opponent and grabs them by the throat, dragging them into the ground and tossing them.
ability.narutorpg.instant_ice_encasing_t: The user fires ice at the target, causing them to become completely frozen.
ability.narutorpg.instant_lightning_blad: Minato dashes towards his opponent with such high speed that he looks like a blur and hits them as he passes them. He then stops behind them and slashes them with a kunai.
ability.narutorpg.instant_lightning_comb: Sasuke and Naruto blitz the opponent at incredible speed from both sides, making it difficult for them to make a move against the pair.
ability.narutorpg.instant_path.desc: The user instantaneously teleports in front of the opponent and hits them with their shakujō coated in lightning.
ability.narutorpg.instant_water.desc: Employing their mastery of Water Release, the user releases a wave of water below their feet to act as jets to increase their speed which allows them to dash towards the opponent and attack with a full-body blow.
ability.narutorpg.intelligence_transmiss: With this ability, Motoi can mentally transmit commands to Fukuemon, and he attacks the enemy with wings on the fly, and lifting shinobi into the air and dropping into a pre-prepared trap.
ability.narutorpg.intense_passion_feroci: Intense Passion: Ferocious Tiger Lotus Peacock Attack
Guy and Lee both activate the Eight Gates, Guy entering the Seventh Gate and Lee the Sixth. After a streak of hits throwing the opponent up in the air, Lee uses the Reverse Lotus sending them down.
ability.narutorpg.internal_weapon.desc: The Deva Path begins with a kick, followed by two slashes with chakra disruption blades and a Shinra Tensei. Then, the Asura Path performs a jumping attack with Flaming Arrow of Amazing Ability and finishes off with the Asura Attack.
ability.narutorpg.interrogation_genjutsu: Kakkō uses this genjutsu to break the will of his captured target, to make them give as much information as possible. However, if the target has a strong will, the technique will be useless.
ability.narutorpg.intersection_method.de: With this technique, the user is able to intercept and counter an oncoming taijutsu technique by raising the knee, and driving the elbow downwards at the same time. This catches the attacking limb between their two limbs, and drives the elbow down with great force, effectively shattering the bone.
ability.narutorpg.inukaitakerunomikoto.d: A technique where the user creates ferocious canine chakra avatars from the land itself. They will pursue their targets relentlessly in order to clamp down on them with their jaws, restraining and crushing them, and their tracking speed is so great that they were even able to catch Sasuke Uchiha.
ability.narutorpg.inuzuka_clan_glory.des: First, the Three Haimaru Brothers attack the enemy from different sides, moving very quickly, attacking with claws and teeth, after which Hana Inuzuka finishes him off with her sharp fingernails, enhanced with chakra, which is accompanied by bright red flashes.
ability.narutorpg.invariant_connection.d: Naruto jumps into the air where he creates many shadow clones that form a chain whip for Sakura to wield. She then spins the chain like a tornado and drops it down on their opponent with intense force.
ability.narutorpg.iq200.desc: Shikamaru throws a myriad of kunai, all but one of which have wire strings attached to them, with a single one having explosive grenades instead, at the opponent. He then pulls on the strings, creating a friction that cuts down a bunch of tree branches, creating a debris that triggers the grenades, causing an explosion
ability.narutorpg.iron_armour_seal.desc: Iron Armour Seal is the fūinjutsu used by Kumogakure to seal Gyūki into its respective hosts.
ability.narutorpg.iron_ball_trap.desc: The user summons a huge steel ball with spikes from the scroll, and crushes the enemy with it, dropping it from a height on their head.
ability.narutorpg.iron_claw.desc: This move simply entails A squeezing the target's face with his hand. He uses this technique on Killer B whenever he get irritated with B's behaviour. Gyūki has seen A do this to B several times to the point it even mentions he would give B the Iron Claw for helping Naruto escape from Genbu.
ability.narutorpg.iron_hammer_of_kirigak: Jinin smashes the hammer portion of Kabutowari down at the ground, the heavy impact of which breaks it and stuns his opponent. He follows it with a slash from the axe portion, before placing it on his opponent to hammer it inwards with the other portion.
After creating an insect clone, Shino and the clone run towards the opponent and simply tackle them. The force of this attack is strong enough to send the target flying away from them.
ability.narutorpg.iron_pan_furious_attac: Kosuke holds the frying pan he usually carries on his back in front of him and attacks the opponent like a projectile, spinning wildly as he does so.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_black_iron_w: The user creates wings out of Iron Sand that can be used for flight. Using these wings, the user can also generate feathers in the form of homing missiles, as well as can combine the wings to form a giant spear.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_body.desc: Ryū instantly dissolves into a body of iron sand. In this form, he is able to freely move about in the air, while being invulnerable to damage, and retains control of his sand.
Sasori uses the Third Kazekage human puppet to release a series long spike of Iron Sand surrounding him to stab the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_clone.desc: The user creates a clone out of Iron Sand that can be used for diversionary tactics.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_drizzle.desc: It is a gunshot-like attack which uses Iron Sand hardened into minuscule grains to attack simultaneously across a vast range. The bullets are so fast that they are difficult to see. The moment the user has finished preparing the attack, evading it becomes extremely difficult.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_funeral.desc: While using the Third Kazekage puppet, Sasori makes it grab the opponent and lift them into the air. Then he controls the puppet to make small spikes of Iron Sand fly towards and stab the limp opponent before exploding, knocking the opponent backwards.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_gathering_as: The Iron Sand Gathering Assault is a technique which gathers a great volume of Iron Sand and compresses it into a high-density shape.
Sasori uses his Third Kazekage human puppet to create a Giant Hammer made of Iron Sand and drops it on the opponent.
Iron Sand Gathering Assault: Giant Hammer
Sasori jumps up into the air, and then he manipulates the Third Kazekage human puppet to smash a great mass of Iron Sand against his opponent.
Sasori uses his Third Kazekage human puppet to manipulate a large quantity of Iron Sand into a pyramid-shaped figure that lengthens towards his opponent while spinning from left to right.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_marking.desc: The user tags their opponent with a special marking, ensuring that all Iron Sand-based attacks are magnetically drawn to their target.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_mountain_ran: Sasori uses his Third Kazekage human puppet to create a wall of Iron Sand in front of him, which he then causes several variable sized spikes to protrude and strikes the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_scattered_sh: Sasori uses his Third Kazekage human puppet to create a series of large Iron Sand senbon in mid air that fall down upon the opponent piercing them.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_sky_wings.de: The Third Kazekage manipulates countless Iron Sand particles to cover the ground. He takes flight, causing the sand and iron on the ground to transform into numerous sharp spikes to attack the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_wall.desc: Shinki uses his Iron Sand to create a cloak around himself as a means of protection from incoming attacks.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_wave.desc: Shinki launches a wave of Iron Sand to descend upon his target. It is similar to Gaara's Quicksand Waterfall Flow, but on a much smaller scale. He can also use this technique to bind a target and crush them.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_weaponry.des: Using Iron Sand, the user can create weapons charged with magnetism, such as spikes, spears, and swords, that can be used offensively against the opponent. In addition, the user can place special markings on their opponents to ensure that the weapons hit their target.
ability.narutorpg.iron_sand_world_method: This technique uses Iron Sand to create a gigantic sphere of branching spikes. The user first creates two masses of Iron Sand of opposing magnetic fields and then merges them together.
Iron Sand World Method: Earth Break
Using the Third Kazekage puppet, Sasori shapes the iron sand into four large cubes around his target, which grow spikes.
ability.narutorpg.iwagakure_kinjutsu.des: This is an unnamed kinjutsu which was passed down through generations in Iwagakure.
ability.narutorpg.izanagi.desc: Izanagi is a genjutsu performed with the Sharingan.
ability.narutorpg.izanami.desc: The Izanami is one of the Uchiha clan's ultimate dōjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.jade_crystal_clone_tec: By using the Crystal Release: Jade Crystal Mirror as a medium, Guren creates six clones of herself that emerge from the mirror. Due to them being made of crystal, those said clones can endure further damage than that of a shadow clone can.
ability.narutorpg.jar_of_poison_techniqu: Using his rinkaichū, Torune gathers multiple infected corpses and contains them within a barrier where the decaying flesh will release a gas that in time will ignite an explosion and release the venomous insects in a huge swarm that could cover the surrounding landscape.
ability.narutorpg.jawbreaker.desc: Sakura lands a series of punches, before sending her opponent up in the air with a backwards cartwheel kick and jumping to kick them even higher.
ability.narutorpg.jet_booster_jump.desc: Jūgo, while in his transformed state, creates many jet-like appendages on his back to create very powerful blasts. He then jumps, giving him enough power to rapidly manoeuvre through the air, as well as tremendously enhance his speed on the ground.
ability.narutorpg.jibakugan.desc: This genjutsu brings out the victim's subconscious negative or hateful emotions. The caster can take advantage of these feelings and control the victim's actions. This technique can be cancelled by smelling the New Moon Flower Perfume, using the Sharingan, or killing the caster.
ability.narutorpg.jogan.desc: The is a unique dōjutsu that is known only by the Ōtsutsuki Clan, whose members claim that it is troublesome and a power strongly inherited from their clan. In the manga, the dōjutsu is featureless in appearance with a barely visible pupil.
ability.narutorpg.kagura_shuriken.desc: Tenten throws a barrage of shuriken which automatically target the opponent and break through their guard.
ability.narutorpg.kagura_square_formatio: Karin surrounds herself in an orb of pink light to immobilise the opponent before throwing multiple senbon at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.kagutsuchi_rasengan.de: Sasuke and Naruto prepare a Scorch Release: Halo Hurricane Jet Black Arrow Style Zero, which Naruto throws at their opponent. When the opponent is pushed back by it, Sasuke teleports behind them, kicking them back, positioning them between Naruto and himself.
ability.narutorpg.kaima_form.desc: This technique, developed by Amachi due to Orochimaru's initial interest in creating the ultimate underwater shinobi, drastically changes the user's appearance, giving them green scale-like skin, fins, and gills.
ability.narutorpg.kama.desc: Kāma is a seal that serves as a compressed backup of an Ōtsutsuki clan member's biological data that they can embed in the body of a compatible recipient known as a . Over time, the Kāma will gradually overwrite the vessel's genetic profile until they transform into a perfect Ōtsutsuki.
ability.narutorpg.kama_great_burial_wave: The user impales the opponent with their modified limb and disintegrates them with a large blast of chakra gathered from their Kāma.
ability.narutorpg.kama_rasengan.desc: Boruto creates three shadow clones, one flings another downward on the opponent to perform a taijutsu combo with the third continuing the combo, then Boruto gathers an enormous supply of chakra stored in his Kāma to create a massive Rasengan to finish them off.
ability.narutorpg.kama_spiral.desc: Boruto and Kawaki charge together at the opponent, combining the gathered red chakra from Kawaki's Kāma and Boruto's Rasengan, creating a large explosion.
ability.narutorpg.kamui.desc: Kamui is a space–time ninjutsu that can be used with Obito Uchiha's Mangekyō Sharingan.
ability.narutorpg.kamui_lightning_cutter: After receiving Obito's Six Paths Power, Kakashi forms a Lightning Cutter imbued with the power of Kamui. Anything pierced by this technique is instantly warped to Kamui's dimension. Combined with Kamui's intangibility, this technique allows for Kakashi to avoid an enemy's counter.
ability.narutorpg.kamui_running.desc: Obito charges forward to his destination, using Kamui to make his body completely intangible, avoiding damage from any incoming attacks.
ability.narutorpg.kamui_running_brutal.d: Obito dashes to the opponent while using Kamui, to impale them with branches grown from his arm.
ability.narutorpg.kamui_shuriken.desc: Kamui Shuriken is a technique utilised by Kakashi Hatake through his Susanoo.
ability.narutorpg.kanzeon_lotus_king.des: While using Yamato as a medium, Tobi creates a massive statue, similar to Hashirama Senju's Sage Art Wood Release: True Several Thousand Hands technique. Unlike Hashirama's much larger variant however, this creation does not utilise senjutsu chakra.
ability.narutorpg.kara_savagery.desc: Jigen brings the members of Kara through portals to attack the opponent. Delta rushes flying at them, modifying her leg to stab them from above. Boro follows with a gunpowder-laced punch, both it and the explosion tossing the target aside towards Koji as he summons flames.
ability.narutorpg.katsuyu_immense_networ: Katsuyu: Immense Network Healing is a cooperation ninjutsu used by Katsuyu and its summoner using the link shared via the Strength of a Hundred Seal.
ability.narutorpg.ketsuryugan.desc: The , is a dōjutsu, which appears in certain individuals of the Chinoike clan. The Ketsuryūgan is recognised by its reddish colour, giving a special appearance for the users of this dōjutsu, characterised as holders of "eyes as red as blood". Its power earned it comparison to the Three Great Dōjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.kick_attack_crash.desc: Obito attacks with his kunai and gunbai, kicking his opponent up in the air, teleporting above them and kicking them back down.
ability.narutorpg.kido_s_juinjutsu.desc: The user places a cursed seal on a target as a way to protect secrets, the target is aware involving the user, from leaking. The seal is designed to cause its wearer to explode if they divulge sensitive information.
ability.narutorpg.killing_cursed_seal.de: The user leaves a seal on the victim's body in the form of black patterns, allowing them to be kept under control, killing at any convenient moment.
ability.narutorpg.kirin.desc: Kirin is an extremely powerful Lightning Release technique created by Sasuke Uchiha.
ability.narutorpg.kokugan.desc: The Kokugan is a dōjutsu used by Isshiki Ōtsutsuki and later Kawaki through his Kāma. It features a black pupil which glows gold when jutsu are used, and a black wheel-like pattern with eight spokes coming out of the centre. The iris area between adjacent spokes is gold.
ability.narutorpg.kongukan.desc: Three of Kakuzu's masks combine their Fire Release: Intelligent Hard Work, Lightning Release: False Darkness, and Wind Release: Pressure Damage to create a massive explosion reminiscent of an atomic blast.
ability.narutorpg.konoha_joseki_formatio: Izumo uses Water Release: Starch Syrup Capturing Field to create a big pool of water, after which, he, alongside Asuma and Kotetsu, moulds with the water in order to get close to their opponent.
ability.narutorpg.konoha_true_thousand_h: In Sage Mode, Hashirama creates a gigantic wooden statue. The other five Hokage all channel their chakra through it, causing it to glow with power.
ability.narutorpg.konohamaru_army_corps_: Konohamaru Army Corps! Reach the Goal!

First, Moegi attacks the opponent with water projectiles, after which Udon creates a tree from snot, which pierces them with sharp branches, and in the end Konohamaru summons Gamagorō, who smashes the tree and the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.kotoamatsukami.desc: Kotoamatsukami is the signature dōjutsu of Shisui Uchiha's two Mangekyō Sharingan, which casts a powerful yet subtle mind-controlling genjutsu on a target.
ability.narutorpg.kotoamatsukami_aftergl: Shisui casts Kotoamatsukami on all his opponents, confusing their movements and obscuring their vision.
ability.narutorpg.kotoamatsukami_beam_of: Shisui places the opponent under a genjutsu using Kotoamatsukami, which shows a large Mangekyō Sharingan that shines down rays of light to blast the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.kumogakure_taijutsu_wo: Yurui performs a full body horizontal spin with his swords, attacking in quick succession.
ability.narutorpg.kunoichi_rumble.desc: Sakura throws some shuriken at the opponent, followed by Ino using her Mind Body Switch Technique, and finally Sakura finishes with a powerful punch.
ability.narutorpg.kurama_arm_attack.desc: Naruto concentrates Kurama's chakra into his arm, greatly enhancing his punching capabilities. With it, Naruto is also able to remove Toneri's Puppet-Cursing Sphere from others, freeing them from his control.
ability.narutorpg.kurama_claw_slice.desc: Kurama slices either the ground or the air with great force, creating slashing waves.
ability.narutorpg.kurama_great_crumbling: Naruto, in his full Tailed Beast transformation, gathers chakra in his right fist, leaps into the air, and comes crashing down, delivering a chakra-enhanced punch to his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.kurama_great_rotating_: In Tailed Beast Mode, Naruto coils himself with his tails to perform a spinning attack around the surrounding enemies.
ability.narutorpg.kurama_s_shroud.desc: Naruto briefly enters a tailless Version 1 state to swipe at the opponent with his shroud's claw.
ability.narutorpg.kurama_twin_palms_atta: Naruto slams a Super Mini-Tailed Beast Ball into the ground with a chakra arm.
ability.narutorpg.kuramitsuha.desc: Kaguya shapes out Black Zetsu into a black wave, which traps the opponent while she forms huge blocks of ice to crash down on them.
ability.narutorpg.labyrinth_barrier.desc: Suien can create a maze by blowing up a mountain and hammering stakes into the ground, with each carrying a special technique.
ability.narutorpg.labyrinth_genjutsu.des: This is a genjutsu used by Ōga, placing her victims in labyrinth like simulations with puzzles to solve for her experiments, with the assistance of the technology provided by Kara.
ability.narutorpg.lacquer_bloom.desc: The user places shrunken black rods beneath the opponent and brings them to their original size to impale them and keep them immobilised.
ability.narutorpg.landmine_field_techniq: Tobi burrows underground and places a few mines underneath the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.landmine_great_plain_t: Tobi burrows underground and circles the opponent with many mines. While burrowing out, he is stuck and struck by the blast, resulting in him being knocked over with fire on his cloak. Though Tobi is caught in the explosion, no damage is inflicted on him as a result of this attack.
ability.narutorpg.landmine_lance_ificati: A cooperation ninjutsu performed by Earth Release and Lightning Release users. The Earth Release user uses their chakra to create a spear made of earth, which is thrown to the ground. The Lightning Release user then electrifies the spear, causing severe damage to the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.landslide_assault.desc: Sakon swirls in front of the opponent, attacking them.
ability.narutorpg.last_resort_eight_gate: Last Resort: Eight Gates Crumbling Attack
An extremely high level tenketsu attack, this technique involves attacking and closing the Eight Gates. Neji Hyūga activates his Byakugan and attacks the Eight Gates.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_ash_stone: Lava Release: Ash Stone Seal Technique

The user spews out a thick cloud of ash from their mouth, which wraps around their opponent to restrain them. By focusing their chakra, the user can maintain, as well as, enhance the binding properties of the technique.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_chakra_mo: The Lava Release Chakra Mode is a heightened state utilised by Rōshi after manifesting one of Son Gokū's tails.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_dissolvin: Mei surrounds her opponent with her acid mist, immobilising them, and then blows a kiss at the opponent, sending out a large lava sphere which creates a powerful explosion on contact.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_expanding: The user expands a ring of melting flames, which can be sealed inside a projectile to melt it and change it into a spiral shape. The sealed flames then cause a high-pressure shock wave that melts the projectile and explodes in a storm of flames.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_fiery_roc: The user expels a single lava boulder at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_melting_a: The Lava Release: Melting Apparition Technique, utilised by Mei Terumī through her unique Lava Release, manipulates a strong acidic mud flow, even capable of corroding flesh. Mei changes chakra inside her body into a powerful acidic fluid that will melt anything and spits out the viscous fluid from her mouth.
Lava Release: Melting Apparition Technique: Flowing Crest
Attacking the opponent with torrents of water initially, Mei finishes them off using Lava Release, spitting a small high force shot of lava from her mouth at a high speed.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_planet_br: Using Lava Release, the user can either expel acid from their mouth as a projectile, or create the substance from beneath the ground to erupt as a large explosion. The liquid is capable of melting objects.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_quicklime: This technique makes use of the Lava Release kekkei genkai where the user expels a large quantity of quicklime from their mouth, capable of inflicting damage to an opponent.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_rubber_ba: The user expels a large glob of lava from their mouth, which quickly solidifies into a hollow ball that can be used to protect an object by surrounding it with the durable rubber-like material.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_rubber_de: The user creates a short tube with lava converted into a rubber-like material which can be used to guard against enemy's attacks.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_rubber_ro: The user creates a rope with lava converted into a rubber-like material. It can be used to quickly withdraw an ally from the attack line, being more efficient when combined with a distraction.
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_rubber_wa: The user creates an enormous torrent of lava from the ground directly in front of them, which then forms into a wall possessing immense durability due to its rubbery consistency that allows the material to deform when attacked, meaning it can both absorb and dissipate the force behind a blow rather than just simply obs
ability.narutorpg.lava_release_scorching: Rōshi coats himself in lava and punches the opponent. Even if the punch fails to connect, the intense heat from the lava can still burn his opponent if they're close enough.
Rōshi jumps up in the air, covers his fist in lava, and delivers a punch, sending his opponent crashing down.
Lava Release: Scorching Flow Peak Rock
Rōshi creates circles of lava that erupt molten rock towards the opponent, sending them into the air.
Lava Release: Scorching Flower Great Crumbling
Rōshi coats one arm in molten rock to stop the opponent in their tracks, then coats the other arm with molten rock and punches them, which bursts upon contact, and sends the opponent flying back.
Rōshi covers his foot in lava and delivers an upwards kick to his opponent.
Lava Release: Scorching Stream Rock Technique
The user expels a large amount of lava from their mouth, which quickly solidifies into multiple boulders of molten rock that are fired towards the target with tremendous force.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_broadminded.desc: Guy kicks his opponent twice — one overhead and one under, before slamming them into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_coiling_whirlwind: A variant of the Leaf Whirlwind where Guy and Lee attack a single target with a roundhouse kick.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_coiling_wind.desc: Guy spins while making a handstand with his legs outstretched. It creates enough wind to clear a small area of thick mist.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_dragon_god.desc: This is the ultimate taijutsu technique created by the legendary taijutsu master Chen. It appears to be initiated by an upward spin kick at which point it quickly becomes a tornado.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_drop.desc: The user delivers a falling kick, strong enough to bring the environment crumbling down.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_flash_kick.desc: Rock Lee performs a technique similar to the Heavenly Foot of Pain, but without any chakra enhancement, to deliver a heel drop to the opponent using only sheer physical strength that causes small alteration to the ground on impact.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_gale.desc: The user delivers a spinning low kick from behind, throwing the target off balance. Because of the kick's speed and how it's delivered, targets are unlikely to be able to defend against it.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_great_combo_attac: The user strikes the opponent rapidly with Leaf Gale, Leaf Whirlwind, and Leaf Rising Wind.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_great_flash.desc: The user charges at their opponent and unleashes a powerful lateral kick aiming at the head that will send his opponent flying away.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_great_violent_sky: Rock Lee attacks the opponent and punches them into the sky. Upon leaping off the ground, Lee performs a spinning attack headfirst and kicks his opponent into the ground. Finally, he poses by raising his arms and bringing his legs together.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_great_whirlwind.d: While spinning, the user delivers a series of kicks. As they spin faster, they are lifted from the ground, allowing them to kick different areas of their target: first a low kick, then a middle kick, then a high kick. These are finished off with a heel drop.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_gust.desc: Using simple, yet effective strikes, the user begins to spin rapidly and with a strong rotative high kick to hit the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_hot_wind.desc: After opening five of the Eight Gates, Lee swiftly kicks his opponent high into the air. He then jumps up and does a kick so powerful that his opponent is set on fire.
The user being airborne, delivers a powerful drop kick that sends the opponent flying.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_revolving_light.d: Lee knocks his opponent off their feet, launching them into the air, after which he delivers a series of revolving kicks to their stomach and face, leading to a finishing kick that sends the opponent straight into the ground. This technique is very similar to Youth Full Power.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_rising_wind.desc: This technique uses the entire body as a spring, by amassing power through taking a posture where the back of the body falls down. With this powerful taijutsu, the user kicks just above the head.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_roaring_flame_hur: Rock Lee unlocks five of the Eight Gates and begins a kick so fast that his leg catches fire. Lee spins around into the air, creating a spiral of flame before bringing his leg down through the centre and into the ground. The fire bursts outwards, blasting any enemy within close proximity.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_rock_destroying_r: A taijutsu technique where the user smashes their elbow into their opponent using the other arm as support. It deals a powerful blow to the target and as the name suggests, it was even strong enough to destroy Yagura's coral.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_shuriken.desc: Metal attacks the enemy, sending him flying with a strong kick, and then finishes him off in the air using Fūma Shuriken.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_springtime_of_lif: After opening the First Gate, Guy punches the opponent into the air and grabs their arms, fracturing them and pile-drives the opponent into the ground.
Might Guy, using his great talent with taijutsu, concentrates all his skill into a spinning backwards kick. The kick is so fast that it cannot be seen, much less dodged, and it is delivered with such power that targets are unlikely to get up once they're struck, much less block.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_style_empty_cicad: After waving his hand seals, Rō disappears into thin air. Shortly afterwards, he reappears behind the opponent, and uses a kunai to strike their back.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_style_swift_sword: Hayate draws his sword and, with swift, abrupt movements, like a dance, attacks the enemy, slicing them open. In some cases, he can place an explosive tag on the ground, causing the enemy to fall after the sword attack and be blown up.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_style_willow.desc: The user waves their sword back and forth, which when seen by the target locks them in a genjutsu which causes them to hallucinate multiple waving arms out to slash them. The movement resembles that of a willow tree blowing in the wind. With the enemy off guard, the user is free to cut them down.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_sweet_riot_car.de: Anko kicks her opponent into the air then kicks again higher and jumps on their shoulders and spins them into the ground through rapid somersaults before getting off of them upon landing.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_taijutsu_whirlwin: Guy dashes a considerable distance and performs a powerful kick, sending the opponent flying.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_whirlwind.desc: The user delivers a series of high and low kicks, each of which is fast enough that even the Sharingan can't react to them. When Rock Lee performs it against Sasuke Uchiha, he starts with a backwards high kick using his left foot, the motion of which then helps him deliver a low kick with his right.
ability.narutorpg.leaf_windstorm.desc: Lee focuses for a moment, and launches a spinning kick. He covers a short distance while spinning on the ground, and then jumps while still spinning, hitting several opponents.
ability.narutorpg.leaping_bullet_shell_t: Transformed as Isobu, Yagura curls himself into a ball and bounces, allowing himself to either crash down at an opponent, or to quickly move around.
ability.narutorpg.leaping_flame_blowing_: Transformed as Matatabi, Yugito leaps above in the air, spews fire on her opponents, and finally lands on top of them.
ability.narutorpg.leech_gap.desc: While in his transformed state, Utakata can ooze an extremely alkaline liquid, which burns upon contact. Killer B while in his full Eight-Tails form commented that the substance was strong enough to burn through his skin.
ability.narutorpg.legend_of_the_white_fa: Kakashi strikes down the opponent with the White Light Chakra Sabre and then attacks them with Chidori, causing a lightning explosion.
ability.narutorpg.legend_s_portion.desc: Tsunade punches the opponent towards Jiraiya, who summons a warrior toad to strike the opponent to the ground. The toad then crushes the opponent by falling on them.
ability.narutorpg.liger_bomb.desc: The Liger Bomb is a certain-kill technique used by the Fourth Raikage.
ability.narutorpg.liger_two_platoons_bom: A and Bee start their combo by using Cross Lariat to launch the opponent. Bee grabs ahold of the opponent's arms and waist, while Ay takes the legs; the team then link arms from a back-to-back position and drive their foe into the ground stomach-first.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_ball.desc: The user creates spheres of electrical energy and launches them at the enemy. When they make contact with the enemy, the spheres electrocute them and throw them back. This technique can also be used in rapid succession or fire multiple balls at once.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_beast_runnin: Kakashi sends out two lightning hounds at his opponent, which run and attack his target from their sides.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_blade_kunai_: Lightning Blade Kunai Cutter is a technique developed by Kakashi Hatake. Kakashi channels his lightning chakra into a kunai, increasing its piercing power. Then he strikes his opponent several times.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_bolt.desc: Killer B jumps into the air with his seven swords and tackles the opponent whilst coated in lightning chakra.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_burial_banqu: The user creates several thunderbolts that cut through the ground or air until they hit the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_cutter.desc: The Lightning Cutter is the special name for Kakashi Hatake's Chidori.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_cutter_combo: This combo attack has the user elbowing the opponent, then punching them in the face, sweeping their feet, double kicking the enemy twice and sending them high into the air, then using Lightning Cutter on the falling victim as they land on it with their back. This can only be performed with Kakashi's Sharingan active.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_cutter_doubl: Kakashi submerges into the earth or water, comes up and punches the jaw of his opponent, jumps back away from the opponent to form a Lightning Cutter in-between his two hands.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_cutter_one_a: Kakashi appears underneath his opponent and launches them into the air. He gets above them, before slamming them into the ground with his Lightning Cutter.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_cutter_one_f: Kakashi uses Lightning Cutter and runs extremely fast towards his opponent, he then grabs them, dragging their body on the ground for a long time and finally ejecting them.
Wielding his lightning-infused sword, the user swiftly delivers a slash to his opponent, temporarily sealing their ability to use chakra to perform jutsu.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_cutter_swift: Kakashi uses Lightning Release: Lightning Beast Tracking Fang to impale the opponent, then throws multiple chakra kunai. He activates his Kamui to teleport some kunai to the hound, which turns into a shadow clone, where he throws the rest.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_cutter_twin_: Kakashi forms two Lightning Cutters instead of just one. He runs towards the opponent and plunges one into the target, followed by the other.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_cutter_two_s: This is a technique used by Kakashi Hatake. He first creates a slightly larger Lightning Cutter than usual with both hands, but then quickly grasps the lightning and pulls it apart into two hands. He then charges at the enemy with one Lightning Cutter, uppercutting the enemy into the air.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_dragon_torna: Raiga will draw lightning down upon his body. The current will be contained within and around Raiga's form. He will then begin to spin in place forming a whirling vortex of wind and electricity. The vortex will take on the form of a dragon's head and will cover the area in front of him.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_fish.desc: The user produces a large shark-like structure of lightning that travels independently under water, striking at the target it is locked on to.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_flash.desc: The user launches a lightning-infused fūma shuriken at their opponent, knocking them back. The lightning trail it leaves behind is also capable of temporarily stunning their opponents. This attack can also be used mid-air, albeit at a shorter range.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_flash_attack: Kakashi attacks with three shadow clones in a forward arc, each channelling Lightning Release through their White Light Chakra Sabre. Enemies' movements are impaired, and hidden traps are revealed.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_flash_game.d: The user launches a lightning-infused fūma shuriken at their opponent, knocking them back. The lightning trail it leaves behind is also capable of temporarily stunning their opponents. This attack can also be used mid-air, albeit at a shorter range.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_flash_lion_c: Sasuke slashes the opponent into the air with his sword and jumps after them. He then proceeds to kick, backfist and slash them while still in midair as he tumbles around, ending in a heel drop akin to the original Lion Combo.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_flash_palm.d: The user gathers lightning chakra on their hand to strike the target.
Kakashi channels Lightning Release through a sword to deliver a series of strikes before jumping up in the air and finishing it with a downward slash.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_jutsu.desc: A smaller version of the Tailed Beast Ball that has been infused with lightning chakra which Killer B or the Eight-Tails can use to bring down a target's defences and inflict major damage.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_kunai.desc: The user throws lightning infused kunai at their opponent.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_oppression_h: After covering himself in his Lightning Release Chakra Mode, A performs a simple backhanded horizontal chop against his opponent, which is powerful enough to snap even the bones of Sasuke Uchiha's Susanoo's ribcage.

Covered in the Lightning Release Chakra Mode, A leaps from a high vantage point and performs a simple yet powerful horizontal chop on his opponent from above, seemingly using the momentum gained in the previous fall to increase the force behind his strike.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_rat_violent_: The user releases a discharge of electricity that fires several destructive disks of electricity which home in on the targets.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_blac: After generating black lightning from their body, Darui releases it in the form of a panther to shock anyone that comes into contact with it. Its quick movement allows it to be used to take out multiple opponents. By using this in a battle on water, it can be spread out to cover a wide range.
Darui extends his arms from both sides and channels the Black Lightning from his fists, shocking anybody nearby.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_bull: The user creates a condensed surge of lightning in their fist. Upon doing so, the user thrusts it forward, unleashing a powerful lightning bolt. It can also be conducted by a water source to hit multiple targets.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_chak: The user wraps their body in a layer of lightning chakra to increase their physical parameters and , with more lightning causing greater increases. As users coat more lightning chakra around themselves, the more their hair sticks up.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_co_o: This is a cooperation ninjutsu where the users unite the extremities of their weapons, discharging a strong voltage across the blades, targeting multiple opponents simultaneously.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_dept: After enveloping themselves with lightning chakra, the user can inflict damage to the opponent by either touching or emanating a powerful bolt of electricity from any part of their body.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_doub: The Lightning Release: Double Lariat is a stronger version of the Lightning Release: Lariat, whereby two users perform the technique from both behind and in front of the opponent, creating a scissor effect, up to close to light-speed.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_elec: The user surrounds themselves with countless tiny lights. After the lights are shaped into needles, they are quickly fired at a target and pierce the skin. Because of how small the needles are, they do little to no actual damage on their own.

A Lightning Release technique that allows the user to create a wave of electricity from their hands. The user can vary its power from a small surge to shock an opponent to a powerful stream of lightning capable of ripping through solid rock.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_elek: The user concentrates lightning-natured chakra directly into the palm of their hand, the user then channels this gathered electricity to shock and electrocute an opponent at close range.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_fals: The user emits lightning in the shape of a spear from its mouth, which then pierces the enemy. Its destructive power is great enough to even pierce through rock, meaning it has a high killing potential. The user can increase the number of spears to attack multiple enemies.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_four: Four giant rock pillars are summoned around the enemy, which then shoot bolts of lightning between them, immobilising the target and possibly doing great damage to them.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_heav: The user strikes with lightning bolts. The bolts can be produced either from storm clouds or the user themselves. Additionally, the bolts can be channelled through structures so as to strike at targets from multiple sources.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_lari: The Lightning Release: Lariat is a powerful taijutsu technique whereby the user charges at their opponent with quickness-like light speed, striking them with a Lariat move, which can be coated in chakra.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_ligh: Lightning Release: Lighting Flash
With his Susanoo, Kakashi gathers electricity in his hand and showers down lightning bolts on the opponent.
Lightning Release: Lightning Beast Tracking Fang
Kakashi forms a Lightning Cutter in his hand and launches it at the opponent in the form a hound. The hound is highly fast and its movements are unpredictable, making it is very difficult to avoid.
Lightning Release: Lightning Bind
The user sends a thin stream of electricity through the ground, which briefly paralyzes an opponent upon contact.
Lightning Release: Lightning Bullet

First, C blinds his opponent, then bombards them with multiple kunai infused with lightning chakra, and finally finishes them off with a Fūma Shuriken that spins wildly, cutting through the opponent's flesh.
Lightning Release: Lightning Eel
While standing in water, the user generates a burst of electricity, shocking anyone also in the water with them.
Lightning Release: Lightning Fang
Using Kiba, the user sends bolts of lightning to electrocute their enemies.
Lightning Release: Lightning Flash
Karui thrusts her sword into the ground and lightning strikes it, striking and paralyzing her opponent, after which Karui pulls out her sword and finishes him off.
Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Flash of Lightning Pillar
The Lightning Release: Lightning Illusion Flash of Lightning Pillar is a genjutsu that utilises lightning-natured chakra.
Lightning Release: Lightning Net Technique
The user fires a beam of Lightning Release chakra from their hand at a target, which stops them in their tracks for a short time.
Lightning Release: Lightning Quake Flash

The user releases a current of purplish lightning from their hands forward, damaging and knocking away opponents. This technique is similar to Chidori Current as they both have the effect of shooting lightning currents at their opponent. Its range, unlike that of Chidori Current, is much smaller.
Lightning Release: Lightning Rod

After coming into physical contact with the opponent, the user raises their arm into the air, generating a powerful bolt of electricity which travels through their body transferring the electricity to the body of the opponent.
Lightning Release: Lightning Signal Fire

After forming the necessary hand seals, the user points their hands towards a certain direction and triggers an electrical discharge, which then explodes in a specific form. When the hands are raised to the sky, this technique can be used as a signal flare.
Lightning Release: Lightning Slash
Denki releases an X-shaped wave of Lightning Release chakra that is capable of temporarily stunning his target.
Lightning Release: Lightning Violent Soak

Darui channels lightning chakra through his cleaver sword and stabs the ground, which hits the nearby opponent, paralysing them. Darui then attacks with a side sweep with his sword, knocking them away.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_over: By utilising Lightning Release, the user can speed up the signals that are sent from the brain to the muscles to increase the user's striking speed. The technique also gives the user cutting capabilities from barehanded attacks.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_pulv: The user channels their lightning chakra around their club, enhancing the force of the strikes launched.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_purp: The user shoots a bolt of electricity from their hand to strike a target. It was invented by Kakashi Hatake as a replacement for the Lightning Cutter, which he could no longer safely use after the loss of his Sharingan.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_reve: Darui lands a series of hits with his cleaver sword, followed by a lightning infused stab, which pushes his opponent back, and finishes it by sending a burst of lightning chakra through the ground with his sword, throwing his opponent up in the air.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_shad: This technique allows the user to make a shadow clone infused with lightning. Because it is a shadow clone, it is able to perform techniques and interact with the environment. If the clone is injured, it will revert to its natural lightning-state, at the same time electrocuting whatever makes contact with it.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_sixt: A more powerful version of Lightning Release: Four Pillar Bind, the user creates sixteen giant pillars, which then form a giant oven-like structure to trap the target.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_snak: The Lightning Release: Snake Lightning technique allows the user to generate a discharge of yellow electricity from their hand, which can electrocute a target by either emitting it around the user's body while they're submerged in water, thrusting it into a target, or manifesting a snake from the concentrated chakra to
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_spid: After kneading chakra in the body and converting it to lightning, the user places their hand on the ground, releasing a surge of electricity around them in the form of a web, which electrocutes anyone caught in its vicinity.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_thun: With the flick of their wrist the user is capable of firing countless small sparks of lightning towards a target.

This technique lets the user create a three-sided wall of electricity to bind their opponent. The user must have three conductors to stick in the ground to create the points. Furthermore, once the enemy is inside, if they come into contact with the wall they will be electrocuted.

The user first buries Kiba’s blades into the ground and then sends out an electrical charge towards the sky, which in turn, causes lightning to fall from the sky decimating the immediate area around the user, burning everything to a crisp.
By wrapping chains around their arms, the user channels lightning to their kunai attached to the chains.

The user extends one or both arms, releasing a high electrical discharge through said palms, targeting multiple opponents simultaneously. It is possible to increase the power using this technique in combination with a water source.
The user moulds, then shapes lightning-natured chakra. They can then throw the lightning as a projectile-based attack, or combine it with a Water Release technique to electrocute a target.
Boruto expels a large wave of water from his mouth and throws lightning at the wave, electrifying anything that is caught in it.

Several users gather around a scroll with the kanji for lightning in it, and gather their chakra. The kanji begins glowing, and the chakra is sent to the sky, gathering storm clouds, which then unleash lightning.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_tige: Similar to a bear trap, this technique being much larger and brimming with lightning. The technique is capable of materialising from the ground and locking down onto the target with its blade surging with lightning.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_wall: This technique is deployed by the bandits and shinobi from Yumegakure by creating a wall of lightning bolts that repels anyone who touches it and causes damage to them.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_wave: This is a , which employs Water and Lightning Release. After releasing a large water wave from his mouth, Darui mixes lightning into it, instantly electrocuting the target caught in it.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_release_whip: Lightning Release: Whip Dance of Fools
After the user ensnares their target with their barbed metallic whip, they will channel lightning into it, shocking the target.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_speed_kakash: Kakashi uses Lightning Cutter and zig-zags around his enemies, attacking them.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_speed_minato: Lightning Speed: the user dashes in and strikes. Learned from rank 6.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_straight.des: While in their Lightning Release Chakra Mode, the user runs towards the opponent and punches them at maximum speed.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_strike.desc: The user creates an electric current that can hit multiple individuals at the same time. Furthermore, it can extend incredible distances and avoid obstacles.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_strike_armou: By using Lightning Release, the user surrounds themselves with electricity in the form of armour. The intense electric field enhances the user's speed, and protects them by electrocuting anyone who makes contact with it. The armour appears very strong, as it's capable of withstanding Rock Lee's Drunken Fist.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_surge.desc: Indra releases a current of electricity, damaging any opponent that is near his vicinity.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_sword.desc: Kakashi hits the opponent into the air where Yūgao kicks them and then attacks with her sword and Kakashi strikes them with Lightning Cutter.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_tackle.desc: In his insect form, Taisa covers himself in electricity and tackles the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_thrust.desc: Sasuke charges his Chidori and Kakashi charges his Lightning Cutter together. They strike the opponent at the same time either killing or causing major damage to them.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_transmission: Kakashi and a shadow clone both perform the Lightning Cutter on opposite hands, which they connect together with a sharp cord of lightning between themselves. It was powerful enough to slice through several tailed beast chakra arms with relative ease.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_water_dragon: This Lightning Water Dragon Bullet is a cooperation ninjutsu used by Mei Terumī and A.
ability.narutorpg.lightning_wood_flow_pa: Yamato attacks the opponent with Wood Release: Great Forest Technique and then Kakashi strikes the wood with Lightning Cutter that hits the opponent.
