ability.narutorpg.like_a_whirlwind.desc: Asura creates four whirlwinds that circle around the opponent and converge on them, combining into a large wind dragon that rises underneath them.
ability.narutorpg.limbo_border_jail.desc: Limbo: Border Jail is a unique dōjutsu awakened by Madara Uchiha's Rinnegan.
ability.narutorpg.limbo_tengai_shinsei.d: Madara uses his shadows to bind his opponent in lightning while he brings down a meteor on them.
ability.narutorpg.limelight.desc: Limelight is a lightning-based technique that is used when all four users take place in the cardinal directions. They will then join their lightning-chakra in the form of four connecting streams that shoot high into the sky above the target area.
ability.narutorpg.lion_combo.desc: This technique is unique to Sasuke Uchiha, relying on his advanced physical condition and his "knack" for rapid combo attacks. Sasuke kicks a target into the air and follows close behind them.
ability.narutorpg.lion_flame_bullet.desc: Sasuke stuns his opponent with his electrified sword, sending them up in the air, where he slashes them with it, lands physical attacks, and ultimately delivers a fireball.
ability.narutorpg.little_toe_attack.desc: After opening the Eight Gates, Guy attacks the opponent with a very powerful downwards kick. Guy used this attack against the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path to literally attack its little toe, the force of which helped topple the statue over.
ability.narutorpg.living_corpse_reincarn: The Living Corpse Reincarnation is a technique that was developed by Orochimaru that allows him to transfer his soul to someone else's body. It is also referred to as the "Eternal Youth and Immortality Technique".
ability.narutorpg.localised_reincarnatio: The Localised Reincarnation Explosion is one of the powerful techniques utilised by Toneri Ōtsutsuki.
Tobi reveals two bombs and throws them at his opponent, the first one knocking them far back.
ability.narutorpg.long_range_mind_s_eye_: Long Range Mind's Eye of the Kagura

Karin uses her Mind's Eye of the Kagura to sense her opponent at a long range, alerting her whenever her opponent uses projectile attacks. This prevents her from being hit by their projectile attacks.
ability.narutorpg.longsword_ninja_art_ea: Longsword Ninja Art — Earth Spider Sewing

Using the Nuibari, the user buries the sword's attached razor sharp wire string underground. Once a person stumbles into the area, they pull the string to trap their feet in a formation of wire, cutting them off. The power and force behind the wires can be controlled by the user by applying additional strength.
ability.narutorpg.longsword_ninja_art_ma: Longsword Ninja Art: Massacre Method Formation

Using Nuibari and wire strings, the user strings their opponents in a way that leaves their bodies looking as though they were crucified. The final blow is given by piercing them with Nuibari, leaving the opponents to die a slow, painful death.
ability.narutorpg.lorentz_gun.desc: The user erects a field of lightning to connect two points. Any metallic object (such as a kunai) that enters the field will rapidly accelerate from one point to the other, quickly surpassing the speed of sound.
ability.narutorpg.love_roar.desc: Iruka yells at the opponent producing a sound wave that knocks the back and then teleports himself near the opponent. Then he slams his fist onto their head, creating a shockwave and leaving a large bump on the opponent's head.
ability.narutorpg.mach_boomerang.desc: Mecha-Kurama pulls a large boomerang from its back and throws it at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.magatsuhi_no_kami.desc: Kaguya sends Black Zetsu out of her sleeve to cover the enemy, contracting and then exploding in the process.
ability.narutorpg.magic_lantern_body_tec: The Akatsuki members sit down and send out , converted into chakra. These thought waves are then picked up by Pain, acting as a kind of control tower. This technique amplifies the thought waves and broadcasts them to a specific location through illusionary bodies.
ability.narutorpg.magnet_iron_grain_seal: Shinki uses his Iron Sand to seal an individual in a sphere. As long as the user is alive, the seal will remain active and the individual will be in stasis. Only the user can release the seal.
ability.narutorpg.magnet_ninja_art.desc: This technique enables Jiga to magnetise anything he touches, thus fully manipulating objects at his discretion and allowing him a variety of attacks against his enemies, in areas with large quantities of iron ore, Jiga was even able to change direction in mid-air aswell as float momentarily.
ability.narutorpg.magnet_ninja_art_elect: This technique unleashes a wave of iron sand that stops the brainwaves of anyone who is caught in its vicinity. By disrupting the electrical waves in the brain, the opponent is rendered unable to think or move.
ability.narutorpg.magnet_ninja_art_infin: Jiga uses this technique, after magnetising the rock walls of a deep pit, to give him the ability to attack a target with many rocks. Once magnetised, Jiga can completely manipulate the rocks' shape and form at his discretion. He also made use of this technique in order to bury his brother Ruiga alive.
ability.narutorpg.magnet_release_body_co: By coating a person's body with enough Iron Sand, the user can effectively control all physical actions of the target. Akin to puppetry, the user cannot force the target to use any chakra-based techniques, only the skills that come from their physical conditioning.
ability.narutorpg.magnet_release_conserv: Magnet Release: Conserving Bee Twin Blades

Through the Magnet Release kekkei genkai, the user is able to magnetise anything they touch, and then subsequently anything that touches something they have already magnetised, and so on. However, the magnetic force weakens from object to object.
ability.narutorpg.magnet_release_gold_du: Magnet Release: Gold Dust Imperial Funeral

Rasa causes a considerable quantity of Gold Dust to erupt from beneath the surface, by placing both of his palms onto the ground directly in front of him, before manipulating the resulting substance into a wave of tidal proportions.
Magnet Release: Gold Dust Imperial Funeral Sending
Rasa traps his opponent in a mount of gold dust, and causes it to crash upon itself, crushing those inside.
ability.narutorpg.magnet_release_lightni: The user uses electromagnetic powers to absorb the iron sand in a swirling vortex around themselves and expand their body's size to that of a 20-meter tall giant. Due to their size, their footsteps then crush the graphite in the earth and cause electric discharge.
ability.narutorpg.magnet_release_spiral_: Naruto forms a Magnet Release Rasengan while Sasuke uses an enhanced Chidori to strike the opponent from both sides, sealing their movements from the Rasengan's cursed seal markings.
ability.narutorpg.magnetic_iron_sand_sea: With Shinki's chakra coating Araya's blade, he can manipulate the latter's Iron Sand through the use of Wind Release. Because Ryū is modeled from Shinki, Araya was able to use the jutsu to free others manipulated by the same material.
ability.narutorpg.mail_manipulation_tech: A technique which employs the use of mail to be manipulated to the user's will. Using it, the user can cut objects and create barriers that are capable of withstanding shurikens.
ability.narutorpg.majestic_attire_susano: The user shapes their Susanoo into an armour for Kurama, enhancing its defence and preventing its chakra from being suppressed. Kurama can wield Susanoo's bladed weaponry as well as combine it with its own Tailed Beast Balls to give the latter cutting power, making them impossible to catch.
ability.narutorpg.mangekyo_sharingan.des: The is an advanced form of the Sharingan that has only been activated by a handful of Uchiha when enduring a traumatic enough experience. They are noted to be the .
ability.narutorpg.mangekyo_sharingan_jut: The user activates their Mangekyō Sharingan when in the Sharingan Mode and traps their target in an illusion that confuses them for a short period of time as they drop to their knees.
ability.narutorpg.mangekyo_shark_sword.d: Itachi uses his Mangekyō Sharingan on the opponent to trap them inside the Tsukuyomi, then comes walking up behind the opponent and stabs them in the back. Left open to attack, Kisame comes up from the water below to finish the foe with a slash from his Samehada.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_shuriken_t: With this technique a translucent string, both elastic and highly durable, is attached to a shuriken, making it possible to alter its path after having thrown it. An expert will have the ability to freely glide the shuriken in any direction with just a single movement of their fingertip.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_shuriken_w: By using shuriken with wire strings attached to them, the user can set a trap for their target.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_bind: Tenten summons a manriki-gusari from one of her scrolls and uses it to restrain her opponent. When her opponent is restrained, she uses the scroll to launch a barrage of weapons at them and then finally slams them into the ground with the manriki-gusari.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_blad: Tenten summons several weapons connected together by strings and jumps into the air, reeling them together to stack on top of each other. She then stands on the top weapon on one foot, and twirls backwards, rapidly shooting the ninja tools at the opponent like a machine gun.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_dead: Tenten pulls out a scroll and rotates it around herself. Many spiked metal balls burst forth from the scroll to strike any nearby opponents or discourage them from using close ranged attacks.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_expl: Tenten sends out multiple Exploding Spheres from her scroll, which explode upon contact.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_floa: Tenten unrolls two scrolls under her opponent and summons a barrage of different weapons from them, launching the opponent into the air. She then wraps their legs with a chain and pulls them down, sending them crashing into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_giga: Tenten throws five spiked iron balls at her opponent, then she unrolls her giant scroll and summons a giant spiked iron ball connected by wire strings to her hand, which she slams onto her opponent.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_grea: Tenten takes out a big scroll and waves it in a circle. It turns into a giant chain hammer with a huge metal ball at the end that she then crushes the opponent with. After crushing her opponent, the metal ball turns back into a scroll.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_heav: The Manipulated Tools: Heavenly Chain Disaster is a stronger version of Tenten's Twin Rising Dragons technique.

Tenten tosses and unrolls her large scroll over the opponent, summoning countless kunai from the scroll to rain down on the opponent. She then summons four large chains that collapse on the opponent, forcing them down to the ground.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_one_: Manipulated Tools: One Thousand Blades Attack

This technique is very similar to Twin Rising Dragons. But in this version, Tenten only summons countless kunai from her two scrolls, which are connected by strings on her fingers. She then throws all the kunai at the same time on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_spin: Tenten repeatedly hits her opponent with a pair of tonfa, then tosses a scroll in the air to summon a bō and continues hitting them with it, ultimately knocking them to the ground. When the opponent is lying on the ground, she then summons a huge spiked club and crushes them with it.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_stee: Manipulated Tools: Steel Needles Wild Flower
Using one of her smaller scrolls, Tenten summons several Exploding Spheres, which are scattered over the battlefield and then explode after a time firing out projectiles at the same time.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_ten_: Manipulated Tools: Ten Thousand Wild Heavenly Blades

Tenten summons multiple weapons connected with wire strings to her fingertips from one of her scrolls, directing them towards her opponent in a stream formation. After the final weapon hits the opponent, Tenten uses the strings to make the weapons fly above her opponent.
ability.narutorpg.manipulated_tools_thou: Manipulated Tools: Thousand Blades Attack Performance
Tenten performs a back-flip and opens a scroll in the air, releasing a variety of bladed weapons that are then directed at her opponent.
ability.narutorpg.manipulating_attack_bl: This technique allows the user to control multiple kunai - or a similar weapon - at once. By releasing chakra from the hand over an area, the user can freely manipulate any kunai within that area.

An identical technique to the Manipulating Attack Blades technique, but instead, the kunai thrown have explosive tags attached to them and as a result, the attack is more lethal, causing an explosion on contact.
ability.narutorpg.manipulating_windmill_: The user attaches one end of a wire string to a shuriken and the other end to a kunai. The user throws the shuriken at a target, expecting that the target will dodge it. The user then loops the kunai around a tree (or something similar) and throws the kunai, which the target will also dodge.
ability.narutorpg.many_hidden_shadow_sna: By increasing the amount of snakes summoned with the Hidden Shadow Snake Hands, the diversity of this ninjutsu is increased. The swarm of big snakes appear in an instant, each snake individually doing something like intimidating, diverting, or capturing the enemy in a cooperative attack.
ability.narutorpg.married_couple_combina: Sasuke uses Banshō Ten'in to pull in any nearby opponents, with Sakura finishing with a strong punch.
ability.narutorpg.master_and_student_s_m: Sasuke throws his sword at the opponent, which is actually a transformed shadow clone of Boruto, who attacks them with a Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.maximum_entry.desc: The user attacks his opponent at high speed and then finishes them off with a powerful version of Dynamic Entry.
ability.narutorpg.may_rain_blood_river.d: Shura uses his umbrella to shoot senbon from the bottom of it, similar to the Senbon Shower technique. Also, while gliding in the air, he can spin the umbrella to help further disperse the senbon, shooting it at targets underneath him.
ability.narutorpg.mayfly.desc: The Mayfly is an infiltration technique, which is a signature characteristic of White Zetsu and its clone siblings, due to being infused with the cells of Hashirama Senju.
ability.narutorpg.mayfly_antlion.desc: Zetsu digs underground, then emerges, with his flytrap extensions "chewing" the opponent as he spins upwards.
ability.narutorpg.mecha_naruto_taijutsu_: Mecha-Naruto pulls out chakra blades from his head, using which he aggressively attacks his opponent with a barrage of blows.
ability.narutorpg.mechanical_eight_trigr: A technique used by Konohagakure to trap the enemy in a maze of tall walls. The user bangs a giant Taiko drum which causes countless walls to appear around the village, cornering the enemy. Additionally, if one tries to escape by scaling the walls, net traps will make short work of said escape.
ability.narutorpg.mechanical_light_shiel: This technique is a chakra-based shield that is used to defend against attacks. This form of defence is usually installed into puppets, where the user opens their segmented arms and radiates chakra through to form a light blue, thin shield.
ability.narutorpg.mechanical_wings.desc: While in vehicle mode, Mecha-Naruto releases blades from his arms and head, which rotate at high speeds, cutting through anything in their path. The blades are powerful enough to easily slice through thick trees and the snakes summoned by Orochimaru.
ability.narutorpg.medical_empress_gamble: Tsunade and Sakura concentrate on performing the Cherry Blossom Impact, crushing the ground, which damages everything surrounding the two users in a very long distance.
ability.narutorpg.medical_mode.desc: This mode envelops the user in a flowing blue chakra and allows them to constantly heal themselves in the middle of the battle while at the same time, boost their strength and speed.
ability.narutorpg.medical_ninjutsu_stron: Sakura uses the chakra scalpel to deliver a double palm strike on the opponent, sending them flying back.
ability.narutorpg.medical_technique_trip: Medical Technique: Triple Unity of Death
Using two dark chakra scalpels, Kabuto sends cuts inside his opponent's body three times and strikes them to death the final time.
ability.narutorpg.medical_water_release_: By applying jellyfish to a person's form in advance, the jellyfish can store up and spread chakra throughout its host to allow for quick recovery from a recent injury. This technique appears to drain the jellyfish completely as it can only be used once.
The user creates water mosquitoes, that can be used to nullify poison in a target's body. The full extent of this technique was not seen, but it is apparently very painful when applied.

The user can form giant insect-like claws on their arms made of water, extending the range of attack. One can also apply chakra flow through the claws akin to the chakra scalpel, increasing the attack's sharpness and thus penetrative force.
ability.narutorpg.medullary_cut.desc: Kurenai kicks the opponent in the side, hooking them with their foot before spinning around with their other foot and sending them flying in a spinning-like way.
ability.narutorpg.melting_lightning_burs: Dodai spits out a large amount of rubber lava, which sticks the opponent to a stone object, and then the Fourth Raikage falls from above, crushing his victim along with the object they are stuck to.
ability.narutorpg.memory_blocking_techni: A secret technique passed down through the Shiin Clan that erases another's memory. Menma uses this by playing his ocarina. This technique is claimed to cause permanent amnesia, but when Menma performed the technique it lasted only a few hours.
ability.narutorpg.memory_concealing_mani: The user seals away the target's memories by burying an extremely small needle into the brain's memory centre. The memories can be restored by cancelling the technique, thereby destroying the needle.
ability.narutorpg.memory_erasing_seal.de: This technique erases certain memories of all those who are in the range of the seal, including the caster, with the command . However, it is possible that the target may once again remember what was erased as a vague dream.
ability.narutorpg.memory_erasing_techniq: Yota can erase anyone's memory by touching them. By doing so, the targets are knocked out and once awakened, they have no recollection of targeted memories. However, Yota can restore the target's memories by flicking them on the forehead.
ability.narutorpg.menacing_shark.desc: Kisame uses Exploding Water Colliding Wave and slashes the opponent underwater with Samehada.
ability.narutorpg.mental_replacement_dev: Mecha-Naruto gets within range and forms a hand seal which then makes an unknown type of chakra rush out of his hands and into his opponent; in turn switching their minds. The user of this technique is able to sound exactly like and use any technique that the original could.
ability.narutorpg.mental_resistance_tech: A highly advanced technique primarily used by Konoha's Anbu that prevents the user from being interrogated or having their mind taken over by an enemy. When the invader enters the user's mind, this technique generates a horrific illusion to repel them.
ability.narutorpg.meteorite_rasengan.des: While controlling the body of Boruto Uzumaki, Momoshiki cloaks himself in an aura of deep blue chakra and flies high into the sky, momentarily vanishing from view. He then arcs back down and dives toward his opponent at high speed while forming a Rasengan in his right palm, striking them with it at the moment of impact
ability.narutorpg.miasma_stroke.desc: In his Version 1 chakra shroud, Naruto swipes at the opponent with an extended chakra arm from the left, right, upwards, and then from below.
ability.narutorpg.middle_aged_attack.des: After channelling chakra into one's hand, the user grabs the target. The effects of the technique are unknown, but it seems to pose a serious threat as Minato Namikaze stopped Might Guy from performing the technique against the toads from Mount Myōboku.
ability.narutorpg.mifune_style_first_tac: The user grips their sword with both hands, focusing their chakra into the blade. Once the chakra has been sufficiently concentrated, the user unleashes a powerful downward slash, releasing a tremendous force capable of dispersing even a massive fireball.
ability.narutorpg.might_cyclone.desc: Guy jumps up in the air, delivers three kicks to his opponent, and finishes with a drill-like kick with both feet, sending his opponent crashing to the ground.
Shino calls forth kikaichū from all around him to engulf the opponent in a small barrier that implodes.
ability.narutorpg.mind_body_confusion_te: This technique causes damage to all foes on the battlefield as well as confuses the main target. It also leaves the opponent at a wide range to attack without being in defence to protect themselves.
ability.narutorpg.mind_body_disturbance_: The user sends their chakra into a target's nervous system, giving them full control over the target's body. Unlike the Mind Body Switch Technique, the user's consciousness remains within their own body while they use this technique, meaning that it can safely be used even when the user is outnumbered.
ability.narutorpg.mind_body_switch_techn: The Mind Body Switch Technique is the signature technique of the Yamanaka clan.
ability.narutorpg.mind_body_transmission: The Mind Body Transmission Formation is a technique created by Inojin Yamanaka to combat the Human God Trees and their ability to suppress their chakra signatures.

The Mind Body Transmission Technique is a hijutsu utilised by members of the Yamanaka clan to telepathically communicate with people. With focus the user can communicate with multiple people at once and the targets can also communicate with one another while the technique is in effect.
ability.narutorpg.mind_clone_switch_tech: This technique allows the user to transfer their consciousness into more than one target by cloning their consciousness, giving them complete control of the bodies for a short period of time. Like the Mind Body Switch Technique, the user's body is left defenceless while the technique is in use.
ability.narutorpg.mind_disturbance_dance: This is simply a large-scale version of the Mind Body Disturbance Technique, where the sheer volume of people affected in a given area is much greater. Like its parent technique, it causes the user to gain complete control of the target's body, often forcing allies to attack each other.
ability.narutorpg.mind_mystical_palm_tra: The user continuously heals themselves and all people telepathically linked to them by Mind Body Transmission Technique. The user is unable to move while the technique is active.
ability.narutorpg.mind_puppet_switch_cur: Mind Puppet Switch Cursed Seal Technique
The user of this technique firstly transfers their mind into a puppet laid somewhere in advance, near the vicinity of an enemy's predicted path, before manipulating it to attack an intended opponent.
ability.narutorpg.mind_s_eye_of_the_kagu: The Mind's Eye of the Kagura is a technique that allows one to sense chakra from exceptional distances in great detail. These sensory capabilities bless Karin with abilities that even surpass dōjutsu with comparable powers.
ability.narutorpg.mingling_arm_flying_th: Fū delivers a sequence of punches and kicks, manifests Chōmei's wings to flap a quick burst of wind, and flies towards her opponent, ramming them with her arms crossed in front of her.
ability.narutorpg.mini_rasenshuriken.des: This is a miniature, yet powerful version of the Rasenshuriken.
ability.narutorpg.miniature_tailed_beast: Miniature Tailed Beast Ball Sniper Shot
Jura charges a small Tailed Beast Ball from one of his eyes as a projectile or beam to pierce through his target from a far distance. Whether the Ball explodes on contact or not is up to the user.
ability.narutorpg.mirrored_sudden_attack: A secondary trap is laid under the Five-Seal Barrier. This technique is automatically started when the "forbidden" tags are removed. An exact copy of the person who removed the tag appears with their appearance, weapons, battle skills, and so on.
ability.narutorpg.missile.desc: Mecha-Naruto launches either a single or a multitude of missiles from its mechanised chest cavity. When Mecha-Naruto does this, its forehead protector changes to read .
ability.narutorpg.mist_servant_technique: This technique creates several ghost-like figures clad in black that emerge from the surrounding environment. When Mubi uses this technique, the figures are somewhat similar in appearance to him, but are not his exact lookalikes in the same that other clone techniques resemble their users.
ability.narutorpg.molten_earth_wild_erup: A cooperation ninjutsu performed by an Earth Release user and a Fire Release user, where one erupts chunks of earth from the ground, while the other burns the earth chunks, it then explodes on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.molten_wave.desc: From her dimension, Kaguya brings forth a large wave of lava to crash down on the opponent, leaving a small pool of lava.
ability.narutorpg.monkey_flame_arson.des: Son Gokū or Rōshi in Tailed Beast Mode spews green flames at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.monkey_rock.desc: This technique creates a giant stone monkey by accumulating surrounding ground and shaping it into the animal, which is then reinforced with fire. It's powerful enough to keep up with a fully manifested Kurama and even put it down, requiring a Susanoo support to defeat it.
ability.narutorpg.monstrous_sand_arm.des: After gathering a large amount of sand, Gaara forms it into a replica of Shukaku's arm to grab and/or crush an opponent.
ability.narutorpg.monstrous_sand_arm_bre: Gaara jumps up in the air and sends two twisting sand arms straight at his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.monstrous_sand_arm_gri: After trapping the opponent in a giant sphere of sand, Gaara creates two enormous sand arms to press the subdued opponent between them.
Under the moonlight, the user can manifest multiple target's shadows as tangible clones. While mute and void of personality or specific characteristics, they are exact physical copies of the target, able to use all the same raw might, techniques and abilities.
ability.narutorpg.moonlight.desc: Sasuke attacks with his sword, stabs it into the ground, balances himself on it and kicks his opponent away. His kick is usually aimed at the upper abdomen or the neck area.
ability.narutorpg.morning_moon.desc: Obito attacks the opponent while also planting a Truth-Seeking Ball on them, where it expands and creates a large explosion around the target.
ability.narutorpg.morning_peacock.desc: The Morning Peacock is a certain-kill taijutsu born from the philosophy of Might Guy. The principle of this taijutsu is to rapidly increase the body's abilities by opening up to and including the sixth of the Eight Gates, and then to strike the enemy down with countless punches.
ability.narutorpg.mortality_of_all_creat: Obito slashes the opponent with the Sword of Nunoboko, following with a scythe shaped from the Truth-Seeking Balls, and then shapes them into two large arms that forms a sphere of chakra at the palms.
ability.narutorpg.moulded_beauty.desc: Deidara hits the opponent and then jumps on a giant clay bird. After that, he releases six clay spiders that detonate around the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.mountain_face.desc: Jirōbō strikes the opponent with a combo of two punches before lowering his stance, and then raises his head up to headbutt the opponent into the air.
ability.narutorpg.mouse_hairball.desc: The user transforms their spit into a flaming ball of hair that assumes the shape of a mouse engulfed in flames, which then continually splits into individual and similarly ablaze balls of hair. These flaming projectiles pursue the intended targets before exploding, once they come into contact with an object.
ability.narutorpg.mud_release_bottomless: The user turns the ground beneath their target into a deep, muddy pit that the target will slowly sink into. To prevent targets from escaping, the walls of the pit are lined with hands made out of mud that pull the target deeper.
After performing a long sequence of hand seals, the user converts much of a mountainside into mud, creating a landslide that crushes everything in its path. Ameyuki used this technique to destroy Shangri-la.
ability.narutorpg.mud_release_mud_doll.d: The user creates one or more humanoid shapes out of mud that carry out their bidding. Like sand clones, the mud dolls can recover from most damage they receive. When a mud doll captures an opponent, it can force its hand down their throat, drowning them with mud.
ability.narutorpg.mud_release_muddy_wate: By putting both hands on the ground, the user turns it into mud that erupts like a wall and swoops down on the enemy in a wave of muddy water. The mud clings to the target's body and, as it hardens, slows their movements.
ability.narutorpg.mudshot_technique.desc: The user fires mud straight from their mouth at an enemy; the chakra-enhanced mud is able to trap and slow an opponent down.
ability.narutorpg.multi_size_technique.d: This is the trademark ability passed down through the Akimichi clan. When performed, the Akimichi grows in size, proportionately increasing their weight and strength and thus making their physical attacks more powerful.
ability.narutorpg.multiple_connected_fee: While occupying Sakon's body, Ukon adds his feet to Sakon's kicks; when Sakon is about to kick something, both of Ukon's legs sprout from Sakon's leg.
ability.narutorpg.multiple_connected_fis: While occupying Sakon's body, Ukon adds his hands to Sakon's punches; when Sakon is about to punch something, both of Ukon's arms sprout from Sakon's arm.

Sakon and Ukon create some distance between themselves and their opponent with a kick. They split, and summon a Rashōmon behind their opponent, before merging and activating their cursed seal. They pummel their opponent with their fists against the Rashōmon until it breaks.
ability.narutorpg.multiple_connected_whi: Sakon and Ukon use their legs to spin with strong force to generate a whirlwind capable of deflecting any incoming attacks.
ability.narutorpg.multiple_infinite_embr: This technique has exactly the same effect as Infinite Embrace, but this version is much larger and stronger as it could completely subdue and incapacitate Naruto Uzumaki, despite him using the Nine-Tails' chakra.
ability.narutorpg.multiple_lotus_nonself: While in the second state of their Sage Transformation, the user grows more of their jet booster-like appendages, extends them, and then uses them to gather natural energy before releasing it as a powerful chakra blast, covering a wide range.
ability.narutorpg.multiple_phantom_shuri: This technique is very similar in both execution and result to the Shuriken Shadow Clone Technique.
ability.narutorpg.multiple_shadow_clone_: This technique is a larger-scale version of the standard Shadow Clone Technique; there is no real difference between them beyond the number of shadow clones being created.
Multiple Shadow Clone Technique: Lightning Cutter
Kakashi creates multiple shadow clones, each of which attacks the enemy using Lightning Cutter, after which Kakashi himself, using an enhanced version of Lightning Cutter, finishes off the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.multiple_shadows_attac: Naruto punches the enemy and jumps from their shoulders into the air where performs Multiple Shadow Clone Technique to create countless clones that throws each other at the enemy. Naruto proceeds with entering his one-tailed form.
ability.narutorpg.multiple_smoke_clone.d: After creating a smoke clone, should it be sufficiently struck, it will disperse into smoke and then form into multiple smoke clones.
ability.narutorpg.multiple_string_light_: By having more than one person using the String Light Formation, the effects of the jutsu are amplified, making it so even weaker users can successfully entrap a stronger opponent if they have enough users.
ability.narutorpg.multiple_wood_release_: This technique is essentially a large-scale version of the Wood Clone Technique where the user uses pre-existing vegetation in their immediate vicinity as a medium to create a large number of wood clones.
ability.narutorpg.murderous_grasp.desc: This technique uses a metal string strengthened with chakra to make a thread capable of constricting a target and cutting through steel with little difficulty. The user can also use the wire to form complex string figure design with his hands, and launch the figure from the string as a powerful cutting attack.
ability.narutorpg.mutability_killing_spi: Fuen summons a number of stone columns that trap the opponent in a vise-like grip, after which massive, venomous spiders descend along these columns to attack, tearing their victim to pieces.
ability.narutorpg.mutually_multiplying_e: The Mutually Multiplying Explosive Tags is a technique which forms part of a fighting style purposely designed for those who have been reincarnated, and employs the use of special explosive tags to create a near infinite series of explosions.
ability.narutorpg.mysterious_peacock_met: The Mysterious Peacock Method is a trademark technique of Hoshigakure and utilises chakra-enriching radiation produced by a meteorite that fell 200 years prior to the start of the series.
ability.narutorpg.mysterious_storm_techn: While under the influence of dark chakra, Setsuna and Shizuku combine their elemental ninjutsu ability to create a thunderstorm that could disperse bolts of lightning in order to demolish areas. Doing so quickly drained both dark chakra and regular chakra reserves.
ability.narutorpg.mystic_safety_bell_sea: This technique is used by Shion. She releases power through her bell, and completely transforms. This allows her to send a huge ray of light which can penetrate Mōryō's darkness. In this form, she has the ability to, and attempted to, completely destroy Mōryō along with herself.
ability.narutorpg.mystical_palm_techniqu: The user applies their hand to a wounded part of the body and sends chakra into it, accelerating the body's natural healing abilities. Although its most obvious use is as a way of treating external injuries, it can also be used for internal illnesses.
ability.narutorpg.nadeshiko_style_deep_c: The user throws a continuous barrage of kunai with deadly accuracy. This technique is seemingly difficult to evade, as Naruto was praised for doing so.
ability.narutorpg.nadeshiko_style_hardli: By covering one's own hand with wind-natured chakra, the user attacks the enemy with it. The force of the strike is great enough to produce a powerful shockwave that can cause noticeable fissures without direct contact.
The user covers one leg with wind chakra and delivers a powerful falling kick to her opponent. This kick was powerful enough to slice through a mechanical puppet.
ability.narutorpg.nagi_snake_tail.desc: This ability consists of the snake swinging its tail and striking its opponent. The tail also serves to defend against projectiles launched at the user.
ability.narutorpg.naka_shrine_pass_techn: In order to enter the Uchiha's secret meeting place under the Naka Shrine, one must perform a specific technique, akin to a password. Performing the technique moves a slab of rock which has the Sharingan wrapped in sealing formulae in the centre, revealing stairs to the meeting place.
ability.narutorpg.naraka_path.desc: The grants the user two main abilities: interrogation and restoration, by using the King of Hell. Pain channelled the power of the Naraka Path through the body of a priest.
ability.narutorpg.narutimate_blaster.des: In his Mecha-Kurama form, Mecha-Naruto fires a purple beam of electricity.
ability.narutorpg.narutimate_tornado.des: In his Mecha-Kurama form, Mecha-Naruto generates black whirlwinds around each arm and unleashes them as powerful projectiles directed at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.naruto_and_shion_s_sup: Naruto and Shion's Super Chakra Rasengan
An enormous purple and blue Rasengan created with the combined chakra and emotions of Naruto and Shion. It was powerful enough to completely destroy Mōryō.
ability.narutorpg.naruto_beam.desc: Mecha-Naruto locks onto its target and fires an laser beam from its eyes. It is capable of destroying several buildings in one fell swoop.
ability.narutorpg.naruto_cannon.desc: Naruto creates a shadow clone that grabs and flings him to a distant point of the player's choosing. This technique is not meant for combat purposes, being only a method used in Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm to get around the Konoha hub faster.
ability.narutorpg.naruto_punch.desc: Mecha-Naruto strikes the opponent with a jet powered punch.
ability.narutorpg.naruto_region_combo.de: The Naruto Region Combo is a taijutsu attack used by Naruto Uzumaki while having Six Paths Sage Mode and Nine-Tails Chakra Mode active at the same time. The attack, enhanced by Six Paths Senjutsu, is the strongest taijutsu in his arsenal.
ability.narutorpg.naruto_uzumaki_combo.d: Naruto creates four shadow clones to assist him for this technique. The clones kick or punch the target into the air, each yelling "U-ZU-MA-KI" ("NA-RU-TO" in some English translations) as they do so as the real Naruto himself leaps off a clone to chase after the target.
ability.narutorpg.naruto_uzumaki_combo_a: Naruto creates two clones that punch the enemy, then Naruto comes from the left, punching them again, after which a clone kicks the enemy in the air. All three Naruto jump in the air and grab the enemy throwing them on the ground.
ability.narutorpg.naruto_uzumaki_five_th: The user creates several shadow clones, which kick the opponent in succession, launching them into the air. Then, the user creates five thousand shadow clones, which, taking the form similar to that of the Fang Passing Fang, strike the opponent from both sides.
ability.narutorpg.naruto_uzumaki_s_shino: Naruto Uzumaki's Shinobi Handbook could refer to one of two techniques used by Naruto Uzumaki:.
Naruto Uzumaki's Shinobi Handbook (Ultimate Ninja Storm)

Naruto creates a huge amount of shadow clones with the clones piling on the opponent where Naruto grabs one of the clones that grabs on to each another to form a chain whip and slams the opponent down onto the ground.
ability.narutorpg.naruto_uzumaki_spirall: Naruto uses his Naruto Uzumaki Combo, kicking the enemy while creating several airborne clones that kick the enemy to the ground. Naruto jumps onto a clone that charges a Rasengan that Naruto uses on the enemy while falling.
ability.narutorpg.naruto_uzumaki_two_tho: Naruto uses the Multiple Shadow Clone Technique, creating a total of one thousand Narutos. Some of the Narutos then kick the target high into the air while yelling "U-ZU-MA-KI", just as is done with the original Naruto Uzumaki Combo.
ability.narutorpg.needle_hell.desc: After using Needle Jizō to extend their hair around their body, the user shoots a barrage of hardened hair needles towards their opponent. The hairs themselves are strong enough to pierce through and destroy boulders.
ability.narutorpg.needle_jizo.desc: Jiraiya uses chakra to harden his hair and shape it into spikes, which are as sharp as metallic weapons. His hair also grows long enough to wrap around him, serving as armour.
ability.narutorpg.negative_emotions_sens: This technique enables the user to sense hostility, hatred and other evil emotions within others.
ability.narutorpg.net_shadow_paralysis_t: The user projects their shadow into multiple blobs that latch to a surface. From there, they will crawl about the surface, seeking its targets. When latching on to the target, it will meld with its shadow, paralysing them on the spot.
ability.narutorpg.net_shaped_prison.desc: The user manipulates the webs. When used by the spiders, the emitted web hardens into spikes. The user can also emit web from their mouth or hands and use it in the form of a net to trap opponents.
ability.narutorpg.new_naruto_uzumaki_com: Naruto strings together a series of kicks and punches, constantly having two shadow clones to make the hits land. A shadow clone kicks his opponent up in the air, another lands an uppercut, and finally the original uses the last shadow clone to land a kick, throwing the opponent further up in the air.
ability.narutorpg.new_sexy_technique.des: During his two-and-a-half years of training with Jiraiya, Naruto Uzumaki on one occasion uses the Sexy Technique against Jiraiya; Naruto transforms into a woman wearing a revealing devil outfit and short shorts.
ability.narutorpg.new_summoning_three_wa: Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura summon Gamakichi, Aoda, and Katsuyu, respectively. Katsuyu jumps into the air and slams down on the opponent, Aoda then attacks from underground and pushes the opponent up in the air where Gamakichi slashes the opponent with his sword.
ability.narutorpg.newly_invented_lightni: Boruto lands a few hits on the opponent between Sarada's shuriken being thrown and hitting her target. With the opponent stunned, Sarada lands an uppercut, sending the opponent into the air, while she and Boruto jump backwards, putting distance between themselves and their opponent.
ability.narutorpg.night_guy.desc: The Night Guy is a forbidden taijutsu of the highest level and can only be performed after opening all Eight Gates.
ability.narutorpg.night_phoenix.desc: Guy is covered by flames, in a specific shape as though resembling a phoenix. When the move hits, the opponent goes ablaze.
ability.narutorpg.nine_masked_beasts.des: The are entities created by Menma through the use of the Black Nine-Tails' chakra. Five of these beasts are described as , while the other four are referred to as .
ability.narutorpg.nine_tailed_fox_barrag: In his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto slashes the opponent and then strikes downward upon them.
ability.narutorpg.nine_tailed_fox_rapid_: While in his one-tailed form, Naruto knocks the opponent to the ground then throws them into the air and follows up by jumping into the air and slashing them. He then lands and repeats the process several times before finally slashing through them.
ability.narutorpg.nine_tailed_naruto_wil: In his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto first rushes forward with a shoulder charge. Once he connects, he then unleashes a brutal series of claw slashes until he rise-slashes ending with a downward slash, then in an instant releases all built-up chakra in a powerful Nine-Tails Burst which blasts away the victim.
ability.narutorpg.nine_tails_beam.desc: The Nine-Tails can fire a powerful beam of chakra, capable of piercing through rock.
ability.narutorpg.nine_tails_chakra_bomb: Mecha-Naruto transforms part of its body into a cannon and fires a powerful laser, made from the chakra of Kurama, at its opponent.
ability.narutorpg.nine_tails_chakra_mode: The Nine-Tails Chakra Mode is a unique form of transformation that is granted to the jinchūriki of the Nine-Tails.
ability.narutorpg.nine_tails_claw_fissio: In his four-tailed Version 2 cloak, Naruto swipes at his opponent while in the air, "drills" them with his tails, and briefly manifests a second upper body that throws his opponent back down.
ability.narutorpg.nine_tails_claw_great_: In his four-tails form, Naruto swipes downwards at his opponent with his right claws, makes a half spin, this time hitting with his claws, followed by a second chakra body emerging from his to strike with his right claw.
ability.narutorpg.nine_tails_power.desc: When in his one-tailed form, Naruto roars and causes a fire-like orb made of chakra, if it connects he slashes the opponent with his claws downward, then upward, then downward again, then leftward, then upward again to launch the opponent into the air. He then jumps into the air to slash the opponent away from himself.
ability.narutorpg.nine_tails_surge.desc: In his one-tailed form, Naruto brushes his claws past each other, releasing a powerful horizontal crescent wave that rips though the opponent and causes them to crumple to the ground in pain.
ability.narutorpg.nine_tails_swirling_or: The Nine-Tails creates orbs of black-red chakra that swirl around its body and damage anyone who touches them. The orbs then spread out while continuing to swirl even faster until they disappear. This has only been shown used by a false Nine-Tails.
ability.narutorpg.nine_tails_twister.des: With a swipe of its claws, Kurama can create a miniature tornado.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_bare_handed_: This taijutsu allows its user to avoid being slashed with blade weapons. The user has to stop the weapon literally with their bare hands, clamping the blade between palms.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_creation_reb: Ninja Art Creation Rebirth — Strength of a Hundred Technique
The Ninja Art Creation Rebirth — Strength of a Hundred Technique is a forbidden technique that is only accessible to those who have mastered the Creation Rebirth technique.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_dance_of_the: Ninja Art: Dance of the Snowy Cherry Blossom

Sakura proceeds to throw four small white bags at them filled with exploding tags, which are disguised as cherry blossom petals in the opponent's eyes. She shatters them by throwing kunai at them and the exploding tags begin to fall gently towards the target.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_fierce_drago: Rokkaku Ryūdōin summons a dragon made from chakra to attack the enemy, inflicting major damage to the opponent. This attack may also lower the target's defence.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_hollow_decep: After waving his hand seals, Rō creates a projection in mist-like fashion.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_hurricane.de: Temari jumps and swings her Giant Folding Fan to create two powerful hurricane-level torrents of wind that travel towards the opponent, severely damaging them upon making contact.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_infinite_sea: The user produces a fog by forcibly extracting all water within the grass, trees, earth and all other living beings throughout the entire area, trapping all within the area in a powerful illusion of themselves.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_moonlight_be: Ino jumps into the air and manipulates countless flower petals to surround, confuse and blind her opponent. She then stomps them into the ground with a powerful kick.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_new_moon_flo: Ninja Art: New Moon Flower Wheel

Ino twirls a bundle of moon flowers into the air which transforms into a circular blade, somewhat resembling a chakram. She then throws the blade at the opponent, slashing anything in its way. Once it gets to the opponent, it slashes through them and explodes into moon flower petals.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_profusion_of: Ino casts an illusion that tricks the enemy, causing them to see a storm of flowers. This technique has different variations ranging from a field of flowing petals to an overflow of petals surrounding the enemy. With a clear shot, she throws the poisonous wolfsbane flower at the enemy hitting them in the head.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_shuriken_gia: Ninja Art: Shuriken Giant Body Technique
The user throws a fūma shuriken towards the opponent and uses their chakra to massively enlarge it, brutally striking the opponent and sending them flying.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_art_ten_thousand: Ninja Art: Ten Thousand Flowers Profusion

After Ino kicks the opponent in the face and throws a wolfbane, she twirls elegantly around in the air and throws a barrage of poisonous purple flowers at the opponent. The flowers explode upon impact, releasing a shower of poisonous mist and purple petals.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_tools_barrier_re: Ninja Tools Barrier: Reverse Fish Scales Formation

This is a technique used by the Four Celestial Symbols Men. Devised to counter Gaara's sand, the formation draws upon their weapons (Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, Garian Sword and Hōki's unnamed fire-shooting sword), arranged in a triangle with Gaara at the centre.
ability.narutorpg.ninja_wolfsbane.desc: Ino throws poisonous wolfsbane flowers which amount varies depending on how much she charged. This poisons the victim, decreasing their health.
ability.narutorpg.ninken_ninja_art_dance: Ninken Ninja Art: Dance of the Dust Cloud

Using their strong front limbs, the ninken dig into the ground. This creates a cloud of dust which they can use to conceal their movements. It can also be used to create large holes in a short period of time.
ability.narutorpg.ninken_ninja_art_hound: Using the hair he sheds, Pakkun creates dozens of clones of himself. These clones are able to float in the air, in a similar manner that hair is able to stay airborne.
ability.narutorpg.ninshu_flame.desc: Indra concentrates his chakra and attacks the enemy with a massive stream of fire.
ability.narutorpg.noisy_riot_super_beast: Noisy Riot: Super Beast Imitating Drawing Picture Scroll
Naruto and Sai unleash a series of alternating physical attacks at their opponent. Naruto performs a drop kick, and Sai finishes it off with three ink lions.
ability.narutorpg.nose_water_tree.desc: Using nasal fluid, the user creates a water source. They can manipulate the liquid at will to expand into multiple tendrils, able to ensnare or pierce a target. The water can also solidify to maintain its shape and integrity to act as a support structure.
ability.narutorpg.nosedive.desc: Jūgo jumps at his opponent and slams them at the ground with an engorged left hand.
ability.narutorpg.nuibari_fall.desc: Kushimaru throws Nuibari high into the air and, using the wire strings attached to the sword, pulls it down with all his might towards his desired opponent, inflicting considerable damage, knocking them down and even cracking the ground around where it hit, depending on the maximum height reached.
ability.narutorpg.nunchaku_combo.desc: Using nunchakus, Might Guy lands a series of blows on the opponent and finishes with his Dynamic Entry, kicking them far away.
ability.narutorpg.object_extraction_tech: This is a technique used by Koharu to extract a concealed explosive tag from its hiding place that could be a wall or a stud. The user must first detect the hidden object, as the technique forcibly pulls the object into their hand. The affected object will also phase through other objects in its way.
ability.narutorpg.object_manipulation_te: This Mangekyō Sharingan technique allows the user to telekinetically control objects and after marking them with a seal on their hand.
ability.narutorpg.oblique_shadow_slash.d: Darui repeatedly slashes his opponent with his cleaver sword, finishing it with a powerful spinning attack that knocks them far back.
ability.narutorpg.octopus_hug.desc: B manifests two of Gyūki's tails to hold down his opponent, pulls himself towards his opponent, and lands a punch, his hand also transformed into Gyūki's. As he's about to land the hit, B releases his opponent, allowing to hit to knock them back.
ability.narutorpg.octopus_leg_clone_tech: By using a small portion of Gyūki's chakra and sacrificing one of its tentacles, Killer B can create a flawless clone of himself that neither the Sharingan, nor the Akatsuki, could distinguish.
ability.narutorpg.odachi_mow_down.desc: Kinshiki manifests a giant axe, flies at his opponent, and delivers a sweeping slash at them.
ability.narutorpg.odour_concealing_bubbl: The user first smells the scent of their allies and produces sweat with movements. After sucking up sweat, it is then mixed with saliva to create a bubble from their mouth that lets them conceal natural body odour of their allies and themselves.
ability.narutorpg.offering_flowers_funer: Ino lies about having feelings for her opponent after throwing a bouquet of flowers with a hidden exploding tag attached at them. While Ino runs away from the explosion, the confused opponent is caught in the blast.
ability.narutorpg.offsetting_sound.desc: A genjutsu that relies on the sound of the ocarina. While playing the melody, the user is able to release his allies from powerful genjutsu, such as the ones used by Shiin and his clansmen.
ability.narutorpg.ohirume.desc: Ōhirume is a dōjutsu that can be used with Sarada Uchiha's Mangekyō Sharingan.
ability.narutorpg.one_man_front_lotus.de: A singular version of its parent technique, Lee instead starts spinning by himself creating strong winds around him, and dives down on the opponent rather than with them.
ability.narutorpg.one_s_own_life_reincar: The One's Own Life Reincarnation is a technique that was developed in Sunagakure's Puppet Brigade.
ability.narutorpg.one_thousand_years_of_: The user tightly clasps their hands together and extends their middle and index fingers, resembling the Tiger hand seal. Using the full weight of their body, the user thrusts these four fingers between the target's buttocks. Despite the technique's dramatic name, it is not actually harmful.
ability.narutorpg.oneself_s_rule.desc: Guy pins the opponent down and does a hundred push-ups on top of them in five seconds. After this, he spins around so fast that his legs catch fire and then he kicks the opponent into the air.
ability.narutorpg.onikuma_clan_s_hijutsu: A unique Hiden jutsu that is passed down to members of the Onikuma clan. Described as a "possession-type" Summoning Technique, the technique mutates the users arms into a beast-like form granting them enhanced strength and allowing them to stretch similarly to the Soft Physique Modification.
ability.narutorpg.opening_and_closing_of: Opening and Closing of the Universe
Obito sends the opponent into his pocket dimension and uses the block formations to crush them.
ability.narutorpg.orbs_of_light.desc: This is a technique that creates a numerous amount of small balls of light to attack the target. Just a single hit from one can result in the target feeling a burning sensation.
ability.narutorpg.order_of_glamour.desc: Using his signature genjutsu, Gengo suppresses the will of his followers and forces them to attack his opponent with taijutsu.
ability.narutorpg.origami_replacement_te: Prior to being struck by an attack, Urashiki activates his tomoe-less Rinnegan and causes it to glow blue. His body then disappears without warning, leaving behind ten glowing red orizuru, which slowly float to the ground before fading away.
ability.narutorpg.origami_skewer.desc: Konan morphs her right hand into paper and hits her opponent before spinning and doing the same with her left hand. She then sends two flurries of paper butterflies, separated by a spin, hovers toward her opponent covered in swirling paper that hits her opponent, and with a last attack, knocks her opponent far back.
ability.narutorpg.origin_of_ninshu.desc: Hagoromo is joined by Asura and Indra, both in their avatars, as they charge their long distance ninjutsu while Hagoromo combines his Truth-Seeking Balls into a large single ball that are all thrown at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.orochimaru_s_juinjutsu: Orochimaru's Juinjutsu is a transformation-based cursed seal that Orochimaru can apply to others for various purposes.
ability.narutorpg.orochimaru_style_body_: The Orochimaru-Style Body Replacement Technique is a unique form of substitution that was created by Orochimaru.
ability.narutorpg.ostrich_aerial.desc: Condor delivers a powerful aerial kick to the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.ostrich_meteor_blast.d: Condor jumps high in the air to slam his opponent down with both his feet. A powerful shock wave is released from the impact point.
ability.narutorpg.ostrich_rising_dragon_: Condor gives a rising kick to the opponent's stomach.
ability.narutorpg.ostrich_whirlwind_atta: Condor uses his leg to jab the opponent hard in the stomach.
ability.narutorpg.otsutsuki_teleportatio: This technique is a Space–Time Ninjutsu used by the Ōtsutsuki clan. The user creates a rift, which allows anyone enveloped to transfer to a chosen location including foreign dimensions.
ability.narutorpg.outcry_of_earth.desc: Sakura summons a giant Inner Sakura to deliver a series of punches.
ability.narutorpg.outer_path.desc: The is one of the seven abilities of the Six Paths Technique granted to the wielder of the Rinnegan, standing out from the other six Paths. It grants the user the power to control and transcend life and death.
ability.narutorpg.outer_path_samsara_of_: Outer Path — Samsara of Heavenly Life Technique

The Outer Path — Samsara of Heavenly Life Technique is a reincarnation ninjutsu used through the Outer Path, which can infuse new life into the bodies of the dead in exchange for the user's own life by reuniting the separated soul to the body using .
ability.narutorpg.overwhelm_rasengan.des: Naruto delivers a string of punches and kicks using shadow clones. The penultimate of these attacks are enhanced with natural energy, which stuns his opponent. Naruto then jumps at his opponent and kicks them down, bouncing off them, going up high, and comes crashing down with a Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.overwind_raid.desc: Using his Kote, Boruto sends a Wind Release-infused shuriken at his opponent, pushing them back. Boruto then uses a Kote Water Release technique to flood the place, holding the opponent in place, and while surfing on the waves, sends a Vanishing Rasengan through the water, pushing the opponent up when it hits.
ability.narutorpg.owl_drop.desc: Obito jumps up in the air, attacks his opponent with three kunai slashes and kicks them down.
ability.narutorpg.owl_guardian_pursuit.d: Motoi summons Fukuemon and gives him commands mentally, and owl attacks the enemy with rapid strikes from his wings and beak.
ability.narutorpg.pachinko_technique.des: By using the Chakra Liquid that bound their hands together, Naruto and Sasuke stretch the sticky substance, and launch a golden statue at the target like a slingshot with enough force to knock them out.
ability.narutorpg.pacification_of_the_gr: Jūgo hits the enemy at extreme speeds while part of his body is transformed.
ability.narutorpg.pair_of_maidens.desc: Kankurō summons Kuroari to sneak up behind the opponent, pinning their arms. Kankurō then uses a mouth-bomb wielding Karasu that rushes toward the opponent, causing the bomb to explode.
ability.narutorpg.pair_s_kamui.desc: Kakashi and Obito use Kamui to transport the opponent inside their pocket dimension, where they strike their target with a series of cooperative taijutsu attacks. After gaining enough distance, Obito creates a Black Receiver, through which Kakashi channels his Lightning Cutter.
ability.narutorpg.palm_bottom.desc: This attack consists of a quick, precise thrust of the user's palm to the opponent's body. The attack sends chakra into the area of the foe where struck to either stun them, or if a more sufficient amount of chakra is used, cause severe internal damage.
ability.narutorpg.palm_wave.desc: Shizune attacks her opponent a few times, then spins around with her arm outstretched to hit them with a chakra scalpel. She finishes by hitting her opponent high into the air with another chakra scalpel.
ability.narutorpg.pampas.desc: Kimimaro uses his bone sword to strike the opponent with amazing speed at different vital areas of their body. This attack can be used repeatedly in succession to not give the opponent a chance to attack back.
ability.narutorpg.paper_chakram.desc: Konan gathers a large quantity of paper sheets into a single chakram-like shape, which she then throws at the intended target. While in flight, the disc spins with tremendous speed, with its trajectory and inclination being freely manipulated by her.
ability.narutorpg.paper_clone.desc: A technique which employs the use of Konan's ability to manipulate the shape and colour of her paper by forming it into one or more replicas of herself. When a clone is hit, it will merely turn back into sheets of paper.
ability.narutorpg.paper_drizzle.desc: After creating wings out of her paper, Konan uses them to launch a multitude of paper in rapid succession at the target. In the anime, this attack was strong enough to overpower Jiraiya's Fire Release: Flame Bullet technique.
ability.narutorpg.paper_person_of_god_te: Konan disguises six hundred billion explosive tags as the surrounding scenery, be it earth or water, with enough sophistication that even the Sharingan cannot see through it. When the target is in position, Konan causes the scenery to split in half, resulting in the rapid creation of a huge abyss beneath the target.
ability.narutorpg.paper_shuriken.desc: A technique that consists of using chakra to harden and shape paper into shuriken. The user can increase the power of the shuriken by further altering its final shape. Konan could fold the paper shuriken into different shapes, including the normal four-pointed star shape and a more kunai-like shape.
ability.narutorpg.parachute.desc: Naruto punches his opponent into the air, creates two to four shadow clones that jump in the air as well, before jumping himself. The clones hold his opponent down as they fall, with Naruto landing on them knee-first.
ability.narutorpg.paralysing_flute_genju: An illusion that relies on the sound of the flute. After the user plays a melody though the flute, whoever hears it will become paralysed as if their bodies became heavier.
ability.narutorpg.paralyzing_chakra_fiel: The user strikes the ground with his fist and releases a large amount of chakra, creating a pulsating field that paralyzes anyone it hits.
ability.narutorpg.parasite_clone.desc: The Parasite Clone technique is one utilised by Akatsuki's White Zetsu.
ability.narutorpg.parasite_demon_demolit: Ukon can only perform this technique after activating his cursed seal's second level. Using his chakra, he disassembles his body on a cellular and proteinic level so that he can enter a target's body.
ability.narutorpg.parasite_technique.des: The user spits out parasites at a target, which will burrow inside them. This allows the user to kill the target, inflict great pain, or take control over their movements. It is possible to resist it, though quite painful, and is preferable to remove the parasite before it burrows completely.
ability.narutorpg.parasitic_bugs.desc: Shino manipulates his kikaichū to swarm around the opponent and absorb their chakra and then providing the stolen chakra to Shino, allowing him to replenish his own.
ability.narutorpg.parasitic_destruction_: Parasitic Destruction Insect Fang

Kiba uses his Passing Fang to send the opponent flying, then Shino uses his Insect Pillar to send the opponent flying and Akamaru uses the Beast Human Clone to become Kiba and finish with the Fang Passing Fang.
Parasitic Destruction Insect Technique

Shortly after a member of the Aburame clan is born, thousands of insects are allowed to colonise his or her body. In exchange for getting to feed off of their host's chakra, the insects follow the host's every command: from attack to defence to reconnaissance, and everything in between.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Arrowhead Swarm

Shino reveals several kikaichū behind his opponent, which begin to wrap around them. At the same time, Shino sends more insects in a spiralling pattern. All the insects swarm at the opponent, damaging them, and then dispersing.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Bind
Shino creates a cloud of kikaichū that lifts the opponent into the air. Then, many spheres of them repeatedly strike the opponent before sending them crashing to the ground.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Eclipse

Shino manipulates his kikaichū to form a giant pillar that collapses into a wave that engulfs the opponent. The bugs then turn into a whirlpool that drag the opponent below ground before spouting out as a pillar that implodes.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Hail

Shino releases hundreds of thousands of kikaichū from his body into the air. On his command, the insects attack the opponent in five waves. They then coalesce into a large cloud and rain down on the opponent, and then the insects form a giant meteor-like insect sphere crashing down on the opponent.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Hollow

Shino manipulates the kikaichū to form a large airborne cloud that descends on the opponent. After the insects are on the ground surrounding the opponent, the insects swarm upon them, and quickly erupt into an explosion of insects.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Pupa
Shino uses his kikaichū to form a tornado that traps the opponent. He then walks into the tornado and sends another cluster to crush the opponent.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Round Mass
This technique is a larger and more powerful version of the Floating Bugs technique.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Spear
Shino's kikaichū combine into two spear-like forms that spiral towards the enemy and carries them into the air, where they brutally feast upon their chakra.
Parasitic Destruction Insects: Whirl
Shino uses his kikaichū to form a funnel that traps the opponent, spins them around violently, and then throws them away.
ability.narutorpg.parasitic_giant_insect: Following an Aburame clan member placing a number of kidaichū onto the skin of an enemy, these insects immediately burrow into the victim's body and begin to devour its flesh and chakra. This process causes the insects to grow rapidly in size, until the host body is completely eaten away from the inside out.
ability.narutorpg.parent_and_child_rasen: The Parent and Child Rasengan is cooperation ninjutsu where two shinobi — a parent and a child as the name suggests — combine their Rasengan to create a massive one.
ability.narutorpg.partial_multi_size_leg: The user expands their leg and sends the opponent flying with a kick.
ability.narutorpg.partial_multi_size_tec: This is a more practical application of the Multi-Size Technique. Rather than increase the size of their entire body, the user increases the size of only specific body parts, typically the arms and legs. Because of the larger size, physical attacks made with the expanded limbs do greater damage than normal.
ability.narutorpg.partial_super_multi_si: Chōji uses the Super Multi-Size Technique only in one part of his body, similar to the Partial Multi-Size Technique.
ability.narutorpg.passing_fang.desc: The user moves at a target at high speeds and delivers a body slam. Because of how quickly they move, the user travels in a fairly straight line, necessitating that they anticipate the target's movements in order to ensure a successful strike.
ability.narutorpg.past_vision_sharing.de: This technique allows the user to share their past and experiences with a Byakugan user. The user will expel a glowing bubble from their mouth that releases blinding violet rays, which reacts to the person's Byakugan to project images into their mind.
ability.narutorpg.peacock_whirlwind.desc: Utilising the Takumi Village special Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, the user swings one of the blades to create a powerful whirling gust of wind.
ability.narutorpg.peacock_whirlwind_form: This is a technique utilising the Takumi Village special Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, to create a vortex to push away materials covering the user's body. Seimei used it to free himself of Gaara's sand.
ability.narutorpg.peacock_wisdom_queen.d: After forming the neccessary hand seals and reciting an incantation, On Mayura Girante Sowaka, Mukade absorbs the seal placed by the Fourth Hokage, allowing him to time travel. Those caught in the blast are also sent through time.
ability.narutorpg.peerless_great_flame_b: Sasuke headbutts his opponent, and jumps over them, kicking them in the head. He then kicks them up in the air, punches them back on the ground, and finishes with a Fire Release technique.
ability.narutorpg.peerless_great_wind_fo: While in his Level 2 Cursed Seal form, Sasuke kicks upward to launch the opponent into the air. He then glides after them and performs another flipping kick to slam the opponent into the ground, then finishes up with a Chidori.
ability.narutorpg.peerless_hurricane_for: Sasuke kicks the opponent. He then dashes behind and punches the opponent from behind. He then jumps into the air and performs an axe kick. He then rushes behind the opponent again and sweeps off their feet, upward flip kicking the opponent as he does.
ability.narutorpg.peony_snow.desc: Kurenai attacks her opponent first by lowering her stance and then spinning into the opponent to deal a knee strike, followed with a kick that pushes the opponent backwards, where she then grabs the opponent, lifting them into the air.
The user grabs a falling opponent by their waist, wraps their legs around their upper body, and drives them head first into the ground, similar to the Front Lotus.
ability.narutorpg.perfume_spray.desc: Karin sprays a massive amount of pink perfume that does low to medium damage while poisoning the opponent in the process. Besides poisoning the opponent, it can also lower her opponent's speed and defence. While in Awakening Mode, it also acts as a guard breaker.
ability.narutorpg.petal_dancing_flower_g: Ino skates towards her opponent with chakra on her feet and purple flowers surrounding her. She then knees them into the air, jumps after them, and twirls gracefully before delivering a powerful, chakra-enhanced kick.
ability.narutorpg.petal_diversion_chakra: Ino rushes forward to the opponent and disappears in a curtain of purple petals. She appears behind the opponent and concentrates her chakra into a rope of petals, then hits the opponent with a powerful punch.
ability.narutorpg.petal_diversion_flower: Ino runs forward to the opponent and then disappears in a curtain of purple petals. She appears behind the opponent and concentrates chakra into a rope of petals, then kicks the opponent and throws a kunai attached to an explosive tag at them.
ability.narutorpg.pheasant_hunter.desc: The user creates a giant flamed pheasant that they direct at a target. In Boruto: Naruto the Movie, the pheasant merely grapples with Naruto Uzumaki's Tailed Beast Mode until it is torn apart by Naruto. In the Boruto anime, it explodes on impact with its target, doing extensive damage to the surroundings.
ability.narutorpg.piercing_burning_emoti: Lee unlocks several chakra gates, and then charges into the opponent, lifting them upwards into the sky like a rocket. After reaching a certain distance, Lee crashes back into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.piercing_cloud_spear.d: Chiriku powers up the spear with golden chakra, similar to that emitted by Welcoming Approach: Thousand-Armed Murder, and then delivers a slash, first from top to bottom, then from bottom to top, and finally leaps into the air, where she throws the spear with great force, impaling the opponent.
Isshiki uses his immense strength to deliver a fast and powerful dropkick to the opponent, strong enough to knock a Susanoo user out of their avatar.
ability.narutorpg.piercing_separation_sp: Transformed as Isobu, Yagura pounds the ground, causing water to spring up at his opponent, throwing them up in the air.
ability.narutorpg.piercing_showers.desc: Komachi throws multitudinous needles at the opponent, causing major damage.
ability.narutorpg.piercing_stab.desc: Mifune slashes at his opponent a few times, kicks them away, and them stabs them down with a reverse grip of his sword.
ability.narutorpg.pinching_rage_rasengan: Naruto charges at his opponent, swiftly generating two shadow clones. The clones efficiently craft Rasengan, and with precision timing, the original Naruto propels his opponent towards the clones.
ability.narutorpg.pink_lightning.desc: The user creates high-impact lightning with a pink hue from their hands. Tsukiyo was able to launch bolts of this pink lightning from his fingertips, powerful enough to shatter rock. A single precise blast to the head apparently will cause instant death.
ability.narutorpg.piston_fist.desc: While using his Sage Transformation ability, Jūgo can alter his arm into a piston to increase his attack power. To increase it even more, Jūgo can form jets on his hands or elbows.
The user uses their transformation to grow jet booster-like arms that increases his attacking and throwing power. This is a more powerful version of Piston Fist, with the combination of the Jet Booster Jump.
ability.narutorpg.piston_fist_style_zero: Jūgo punches the opponent and then rushes up to them to deliver a more powerful punch.
ability.narutorpg.planetary_rasengan.des: Naruto Uzumaki — while in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode — creates a Big Ball Rasengan in one of his hands, which is then surrounded by three regular-sized Rasengan, in a similar manner to moons around a planet.
ability.narutorpg.poison_cloud.desc: Sasori while inside Hiruko swirls around spraying a green poison cloud around himself affecting nearby opponents.
ability.narutorpg.poison_cloud_technique: Torune puts his hands together to form a small poisonous smokescreen sphere from his rinkaichū between his hands, Torune can then blow the smokescreen across the area in front of him, the poisonous smokescreen when spread gets bigger. If touched or inhaled, it is a guaranteed fatality.
ability.narutorpg.poison_missile.desc: Hiruko slams the opponent with his tail and fires a poison missile at them. If the missile itself does not kill the opponent then the poison most likely will.
ability.narutorpg.poison_mist.desc: This technique combines ninjutsu, chemistry, and medical knowledge, thus requiring fine chakra control and advanced ability in medical ninjutsu. The user converts chakra in their body into a special chemical that they then exhale from their mouth.
ability.narutorpg.poison_mist_hell_hundr: Poison Mist Hell: Hundred Continuous Firing

Using his Puppet Technique, Kankurō spins Karasu and Kuroari around his target at high speed. Karasu launches poison gas bombs at the opponent, surrounding them with a gas cloud. Then both puppets fire a barrage of senbon from their arms at the now blinded victim.
ability.narutorpg.poison_mist_needle_sho: Shizune first uses her Poison Mist on her opponent and then attacks with her chakra scalpels a few times. Finally, she jumps in the air and throws senbon at her opponent.
ability.narutorpg.poison_moth_genjutsu.d: Fuen first uses poison that is thin and tiny enough to be taken in the air. Her target will inhale the poison and start to see the things that Fuen chooses, like caves, moths, or allies of the target trying to kill the target. When her target is imprisoned in her genjutsu, Fuen charges and kills her target.
ability.narutorpg.poison_senbon.desc: The user jumps up and throws the some amount poisoned senbon into the opponent with a swing.
ability.narutorpg.poisonous_claw.desc: User rushes at the enemy and attacks with poison-lubricated Metal Gauntlets, leaving a trail of poisonous claws.
ability.narutorpg.polarised_sand_formati: Polarised Sand Formation: Hot Sand Camouflage

The user infuses chakra by placing both hands on the ground, making sand particles polarise which is able to bend light, they erupt in the direction of the users comrades, covering them and rendering them invisible and much harder to detect, save by a sensor.
ability.narutorpg.possession.desc: Possession is a unique ability possessed by Black Zetsu allows it to take advantage of its malleable body to coat itself over a target. This technique is mainly used to restrict the movement of the target by coating a target's body, and forcibly make them do its bidding by directly channelling its will through them.
ability.narutorpg.power_bomb.desc: The user jumps up into the air, lands a couple powerful physical attacks, grabs there opponent, and powerbombs them.
ability.narutorpg.power_of_the_hokage.de: Tsunade enters Sannin Mode and punches her enemy's abdomen (warning them to brace themselves) with such might that in slow motion it appears as though he or she will be snapped in two.
ability.narutorpg.power_of_the_sage.desc: Jiraiya uses his Wild Lion's Mane Technique to extend his hair, then swings it 360 degrees to slam the opponent and send them flying into the air.
ability.narutorpg.prepared_needle_shot.d: Shizune wears a device on her forearm that's loaded with five senbon. While contained within the device, the senbon are immersed in a poison potent enough to leave victims near-death from a mere scratch.
ability.narutorpg.prepared_puppet_eight_: Prepared Puppet: Eight Waves of Needles

Sasori, while inside of his puppet Hiruko, makes the puppet spit a rapid stream of countless senbon from its mouth, in a fashion similar to a machine gun. These senbon can be poisoned for increased lethality.
ability.narutorpg.pressure_points_of_har: Pressure Points of Harm and Death

Guren releases two tenketsu points to greatly increase her chakra and physical capabilities for a short time by changing her life force into chakra. This allows the use of taxing techniques such as Crystal Release: String of Glory.
ability.narutorpg.pressurisation.desc: Jūgo grows his hand to great proportions and swats at his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.preta_path.desc: The grants the user the ability to absorb chakra in any form. Pain channelled the Preta Path through the corpse of a Kusagakure shinobi.
ability.narutorpg.prison_flame_funeral.d: Sasuke slashes his opponent with both an electrified sword and a black flame sword, before using Amaterasu.
ability.narutorpg.prison_gate_palm_botto: A delivers a series of palm strikes to the opponent, with the last one sending the opponent into the air.
ability.narutorpg.prison_sand_burial.des: Using his chakra, Gaara breaks open the earth and uses his sand to pull a target up to two hundred metres underground; targets are dragged down so quickly that they cannot escape it. Because of the depth that they're buried at, targets are rendered unable to move even a finger.
ability.narutorpg.prisoner_cursed_seal.d: The user applies a red seal on the prisoner's neck, should they be granted limited movement outside prison. The user can instantly activate the seal to kill the prisoner should they disobey orders.
ability.narutorpg.problem_children_of_th: Naruto, Konohamaru, and Iruka throw their fūma shuriken at the opponent. Then Naruto and Konohamaru perform their Sexy Technique, sending Iruka flying towards the opponent, knocking them out of the sky. Afterwards, Iruka hits both Naruto and Konohamaru in the head.
ability.narutorpg.projection_technique.d: This technique enables the user to make a hologram of themselves in order to send a message.
ability.narutorpg.protecting_eight_trigr: Protecting Eight Trigrams One Hundred Twenty-Eight Palms
This is the upgraded version of the Protecting Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms. This technique sends out an outward burst of the chakra dome created.

Created by Hinata, this is a highly versatile technique which affords both offensive and defensive capabilities whereby she emits a constant stream of chakra from her palms, which are formed into extremely thin, sharp, blades.
Maki uses her cloth for defensive means by wrapping it around her and any nearby allies, she can form a protective barrier. The cloth can be made around a nearby object such as a rock, to better hold down the fortification.
ability.narutorpg.protective_sphere_of_l: This is a technique in which Shion's bell illuminates and negates any negative occurence. It was powerful enough to protect Shion from Mōryō's darkness.
