ability.narutorpg.psycho_mind_transmissi: The user enters the target's subconscious by placing a hand on the target's head and extracts any information needed, even if the target has forgotten it or has had it blocked. A special device can be used to decrease the time it takes to read the target's mind and allows other ninja to assist.
ability.narutorpg.pulverisation.desc: Jūgo grows many jet-like appendages to propel himself towards his opponent, and lands a series of punches and swipes.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_burning_blade.d: After using Karasu and Kuroari to strike the opponent, Kankurō then proceeds to use his Sanshōuo puppet to launch a burning attack towards the opponent causing massive damage.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_corpse_crow.des: Kankurō has Karasu tackle the opponent, breaking its own body apart in the process. Kankurō then uses the puppet parts to deliver a series of swift strikes to the opponent, after which Karasu picks the target's body up and carries them through the air, with the finishing blow being a strong slam into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_curse.desc: Hiruko uses this technique to take control of people. It can be activated long after the technique is first applied. The appearance is a red eye with another circle in it resembling the pupil, with four lines stemming from the upper line of the eye and two big thick lines stemming from the side of the eye.
Toneri moulds his chakra into the form of a green-coloured sphere. The sphere can be used for various purposes such as controlling targets by entering their body, rendering a target unconscious, absorbing chakra from a distance, and detonating if needed.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_dance_of_the_ch: Puppet: Dance of the Cherry Blossom

Chiyo uses chakra threads to control Sakura and dozens of kunai at the same time. Sakura runs at the opponent and Chiyo launches the kunai behind her, using Sakura to hide them from the opponent's view. At the last second, Sakura is pulled back by the threads, the opponent taking the shower of kunai.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_degeneration.de: Kankurō sends his puppet, Crow, rapidly dashing toward the opponent. Crow's six hands then project spikes and stab the opponent, sending them crashing to the ground. Crow then slams them with the spikes when they are on the ground.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_demon_castle_ma: Kankurō has Karasu deliver a few swift slashes to the opponent, after which Kuroari opens itself up, dropping a bunch of explosives onto the opponent. Kankurō proceeds to take cover within Sanshōuo as the grenades detonate.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_early_summer_ra: Kankurō uses Karasu and Kuroari to shower the opponent with bombs.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_father_and_moth: The Mother and Father puppets join hands, extending a razor wire that Chiyo uses to initiate a flurry of deadly attacks. The wire is strong enough to slice cleanly through the Third Kazekage puppet's Thousand Hands technique.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_imitation_techn: After taking a sample of the target's hair with the use of a puppet, the user forms a specific hand seal, and takes control of the target.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_inexhaustible_e: Karasu's four arms open and shoot a barrage of kunai with explosive tags attached, which home in on the opponent and explode on impact.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_iron_sand_priso: Sasori uses the Third Kazekage puppet to release a spike of Iron Sand at the opponent that then drills them into some rocks. He then makes a huge cube of iron sand to fall on the opponent, crushing them.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_performance_one: Puppet Performance: One in Body and Soul
Chiyo uses the Mother and Father puppets to attack the opponent with a flurry of attacks.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_performance_ski: Puppet Performance: Skilful Achievement with a Human Body

A puppet performance technique where chakra threads are attached to various spots on a person's body; the head, torso, both arms, and both legs. The person being manipulated gains the ability to not only use their own techniques, but the skills of the puppeteer as well.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_reincarnation.d: As a last resort, Toneri summons countless Byakugan from the disintegrated Energy Vessel and infuses them into himself. The Byakugan seemingly grants him immense power, which he claimed to be capable of bringing about the end of the world.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_revolving_blade: Kankurō has Karasu sprout many poison-covered blades on his arms and mouth and sends them spinning towards the opponent like a tornado, slashing them several times. After launching the opponent into the air, Karasu explodes near them. Karasu is unharmed by this explosion.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_rotation_attack: This is a technique used by Mukade while in his Ultimate Form. By taking advantage of his puppet body, Mukade extends additional blades and spikes on his centipede-segmented body. He then spins his own body at every joint, creating powerful gusts of wind and inflicting massive area damage to his vicinity.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_scatter_shot.de: Kankurō uses Karasu to shoot multiple poison covered kunai from its body at his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_shadow_actor.de: Kankurō attacks his opponent using close-range taijutsu, then, as his face begins to crack, Kankurō is revealed to be Kuroari in disguise, and the real Kankurō is controlling the puppet from within the cloth on his back. Kankurō then uses Kuroari to capture the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_smoke_bombs.des: Kankurō jumps and then makes his puppet Karasu shoot smoke bombs at an angle the poison smoke will spread and damage them nearby.
Kankurō detaches the head of his puppet, Karasu, just as the opponent is approaching. Its head then projects a spike from its mouth, stabbing the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_spring_punishin: Using her Puppet Performance: Skilful Achievement with a Human Body, Chiyo launches Sakura high into the air to deliver a chakra-enhanced punch. It was powerful enough to destroy Sasori's ultimate defence, Hiruko.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_technique.desc: The Puppet Technique is the core skill of a fighting style, whereby they control a puppet.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_technique_bisha: While inside his puppet Hiruko, Sasori sends the puppet's iron tail towards the opponent, hitting them repeatedly and causing them to fall to the ground. Finally he stabs them in the torso with a powerful thrust of the tail.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_technique_combo: Using a puppet in the form of himself, Araya makes it fight quickly and effectively with a long sword (or spear) from different sides, after which he himself jumps into the air with a sword, and together with the puppet they fall on the enemy, piercing him.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_technique_heavy: While inside his puppet Hiruko, Sasori summons two large torpedo-shaped containers. When opened, the two containers release thousands of kunai that pierce into the target's body. Then, another set of kunai are loaded into the wooden cylinders attached to the containers.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_technique_prost: While inside of his puppet Hiruko, Sasori fires the puppet's torpedo-shaped left arm towards the enemy. The arm rotates at high speed, launching the wooden cylinders attached to it. The cylinders then open, each one releasing a large amount of senbon, creating a quick rain of poisoned needles in all directions.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_technique_spear: Using a puppet in the form of himself, Araya makes it fight quickly and effectively with a long spear, easily inflicting injuries even on an opponent with the Sharingan.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_technique_sword: Using a puppet in the form of himself, Araya makes it fight quickly and effectively with a long sword.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_water_release_d: Puppet Water Release: Dance of Mystic Rain

The puppeteer wraps the enemy with chakra strings in an effort to bind and restrict their movements, and then has their puppets spew water onto the opponent. This technique was especially effective on Gaara as it prevented him from manipulating his sand which was soaked in water.
ability.narutorpg.puppet_white_attack.de: While under the control of Kaguya, Hamura kicks his opponent into the air then activates his Byakugan and leaps after them, unleashing a rapid barrage of punches and then a single powerful strike with his right hand, knocking them back to the ground.
Tsunade punches the ground, creating a shockwave that launches her opponent in mid-air. Then using her chakra enhanced strength, she punches the falling opponent in the gut with such force that it sends them flying up into the sky.
ability.narutorpg.quaking_leg.desc: Sakura concentrates chakra into her foot and then stomps down on the opponent with tremendous force. A follow-up kick can be used directly after the stomp.
ability.narutorpg.quarantine_wall.desc: Using his shield as a medium, Renga creates a massive chakra barrier. It is strong enough to withstand a bomb detonation.
ability.narutorpg.quicksand_waterfall_fl: Using his personal sand, Gaara grinds up rocks and minerals underground into a huge volume of sand that he brings above ground. The earth shakes as the sand surfaces, which Gaara then manipulates like a tsunami that he crashes against his targets.
Gaara performs Quicksand Waterfall Flow with Kankurō coating the sand wave with poison.
ability.narutorpg.rabbit_hair_needle.des: The Rabbit Hair Needle is a Kekkei Mōra taijutsu used by Kaguya Ōtsutsuki.
ability.narutorpg.raging_pounce.desc: Hana attacks her opponent with rapid strikes, slicing them with her sharp claws. A more powerful version of this technique allows Hana to summon the Three Haimaru Brothers, who fall upon the opponent from above, pinning them to the ground before tearing them with their fangs.
ability.narutorpg.raging_snakes.desc: Orochimaru, in his true form, attacks the opponent with a multitude of white snakes from his own body and finishes the opponent with a slash from his Sword of Kusanagi that came out of his mouth.
ability.narutorpg.raging_thunder.desc: Raging Thunder is a sword technique utilised by Temujin by drawing energy from the Stone of Gelel.
ability.narutorpg.rain_of_spiders.desc: Kidōmaru summons Kyodaigumo high above his target. Kyodaigumo then produces a sac of baby spiders, which Kidōmaru cuts open to release them. The many baby spiders rain down on the target, spinning out strings of chakra as they fall.
ability.narutorpg.rain_tiger_at_will_tec: The Rain Tiger at Will Technique is a contact-type perception ninjutsu, allowing one to freely manipulate rain infused with the user's own chakra.
ability.narutorpg.rampaging_barrage.desc: In his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto delivers a series of punches to the opponent and finishes with a kick.
ability.narutorpg.rapid_fire.desc: Kusune uses Tsurukame to fire massive amounts of thick senbon.
ability.narutorpg.rasengan.desc: The Rasengan is a jutsu that takes form as a spinning ball of chakra, invented by Minato Namikaze.
ability.narutorpg.rasengan_aerial_attack: Naruto and a couple shadow clones string together a series of physical attacks, and jump in the air to finish with a triple strike, consisting in a kunai slash, a kick, and a Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.rasengan_connection.de: Naruto creates a shadow clone that charges chakra in his palm while kicking the enemy before disappearing, leaving the real Naruto to use the fully charged Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.rasengan_crown_of_the_: Naruto attacks his opponent along aside a couple of shadow clones, stringing a few hits, throws a shadow clone at the opponent, and finishes it with a Rasengan to their head, created with a third shadow clone.
ability.narutorpg.rasengan_ensemble.desc: Naruto, in his Six Paths Sage Mode and Kawaki utilising his Scientific Ninja Tool alterations, attack the opponent and finish them by attacking from both sides with a Rasengan and a chakra blast from Kawaki's Kāma.
ability.narutorpg.rasengan_flash.desc: After infusing Kurama's chakra into Naruto's Wind Release: Rasengan, he fires it as a beam, which has enough power to clear an explosion, or uses it to propel himself into the air.
ability.narutorpg.rasengan_hail.desc: Naruto uses shadow clones to land a few hits on his opponent, briefly stunning them. He and two shadow clones use the stunned opponent as a stepping stone to jump back up in the air, Naruto sends a volley of shadow clones crashing at the opponent, and finally lands a Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.rasengan_nosedive.desc: Naruto punches his opponent up in the air, sends in two shadow clones to hold them down as they fall, and then lands two Rasengan right on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.rasengan_parachute.des: Naruto punches his opponent into the air, creates two shadow clones that jump in the air as well, and creates a third to help him form a Rasengan. The two clones hold his opponent down as they fall, with Naruto jumping towards the opponent and landing the Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.rasengan_unison.desc: While activating their respective Kāma, one person channels their energy into the other, greatly increasing the size and explosive power of the Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.rasengan_uzuhiko.desc: Rasengan: "Uzuhiko" is a unique Rasengan variant developed by Boruto Uzumaki that harnesses the user's own chakra along with what Boruto calls planetary chakra—energy generated by the centrifugal force that works alongside the planet’s rotation and.
ability.narutorpg.rasenshuriken_orange_p: Naruto forms three orange coloured Rasenshuriken by himself and throws one after the other at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.ravaging_chakra_knives: Kagura will sink several knives attached to strings of chakra underground and shoot up from the ground under the opponent, launching them into the air.
ability.narutorpg.red_banded_snake.desc: Orochimaru releases several snakes from his sleeves that attack the opponent and then lift them into the air, where the snakes then detach from him and spin around the opponent whilst attacking them multiple times before dispersing.
ability.narutorpg.red_chakra.desc: After entering his jinchūriki form, Naruto is consumed in red chakra and throws a strong punch to the opponent's face. He then grabs their face, flips them around, and smacks the opponent into the ground. Ending it, Naruto gathers his chakra and runs toward the opponent to deliver a devastating uppercut.
ability.narutorpg.red_flash.desc: Minato throws a Flying Thunder God Kunai in front of the opponent and Kushina appears where it lands, hitting the target with a frying pan. Minato goes above the opponent and uses Rasengan, and Kushina finishes with a powerful punch that breaks the ground.
ability.narutorpg.red_secret_technique_m: Using the Sasori puppet, Kankurō detaches its head and launches several triangular blades with explosive balls attached to them from the neck and palms of the puppet.
ability.narutorpg.red_secret_technique_p: Red Secret Technique: Performance of a Hundred Puppets

To begin this technique, Sasori removes one summoning scroll from his back. He then opens his right chest compartment to emit more than a hundred chakra strings, which reach into the scroll. From the scroll, more than a hundred puppets wearing red cloaks emerge.
ability.narutorpg.red_secret_technique_r: Using the flamethrowers attached to the puppet Sasori, the user fires a spreading wave of flames at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.redaku_reincarnation_n: This reincarnation ninjutsu is one of the many subjects documented at the centuries-old Astronomy Research Institute, an archive of knowledge for the Land of Redaku.
ability.narutorpg.regeneration_ability.d: The Regeneration Ability is a power lying inside the cells of Hashirama Senju, which is able to heal the injuries of anyone imbued with them in mere moments.
ability.narutorpg.repent.desc: Kushina hits her opponent with a frying pan several times and delivers a series of kicks. Then, she uses her pan to send the opponent flying into the air.
ability.narutorpg.repulsion_technique.de: By expelling a significant amount of chakra from their palm, the user can generate a powerful repulsive force capable of pushing targets at a considerable distance. This technique can also be employed defensively, allowing the user to unleash it from any point on their body to negate the force of an enemy attack.
ability.narutorpg.resonance_blast.desc: Obito grows a large tree from beneath the ground with four flowers that forms four large Tailed Beast Balls. To ensure the balls would not miss, Obito had used Six Red Yang Formation to contain the blast, although the Allied Shinobi Forces had teleported outside the barrier to avoid it.
Dosu Kinuta uses the Resonating Echo Speaker worn on his arm to generate powerful sound waves. The Speaker amplifies sounds from the arm's mere movements, but can make even louder sounds if the Speaker is physically struck.
Mifune jumps back and draws his sword. His drawing is so fast it creates a shockwave that damages his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.return_of_the_devil.de: Suigetsu first uses his Water Release: Water Dragon Bullet Technique on the opponent, damaging them and leaving them in the air. He then strikes them down, crashing the opponent onto the ground with his Kubikiribōchō sword.
ability.narutorpg.reverse_four_symbols_s: The Reverse Four Symbols Sealing is a powerful fūinjutsu activated upon the user's death. The user must, beforehand, place the seal across their chest. Upon activation, it releases four symbols from the user's own blood that then forms a large, black sphere around them.
ability.narutorpg.reverse_lotus.desc: The user first opens at least three of the Eight Gates, removing their body's limitations on their maximum speed. Once this is done, the user - who is so fast that it's difficult to follow their movements - continually strikes the target from multiple directions, pummelling them into the air.
ability.narutorpg.reverse_mist_beheading: After creating several shadow clones which surround the enemy and attack them simultaneously forcing them to jump into the air, the real user will then attack them from above.
ability.narutorpg.reverse_summoning_tech: Like the standard Summoning Technique, this technique allows the user to transport a target to a location. But whereas the regular Summoning Technique functions identically from one use to the next, the Reverse Summoning Technique has had two distinct uses seen in the series:.
ability.narutorpg.reverse_white_secret_t: Reverse White Secret Technique: The Uematsu Collection of Ten Puppets
After taking control of ten bodies, the user lets them attack a single spot from all sides at once, leaving little to no time to react.
ability.narutorpg.reversible_technique.d: Ordering one of his giant snakes to completely swallow a target, Orochimaru has the snake shed its skin. Orochimaru then commands the snake to immediately digest the target.
ability.narutorpg.revival_fist.desc: By gathering dark chakra into both hands, the user can unleash a powerful and focused shock wave that, when it hits a person at close range, will cause tremendous internal damage.
ability.narutorpg.revolt_of_the_demon_wo: Tayuya plays a melody - her "finale" - with the Demonic Flute, causing many-mouthed, worm-like spirits made of chakra to emerge from the mouths of the Doki. The chakra of the spirits is almost entirely spiritual energy, causing them to ravenously seek out physical energy in order to achieve balance.
ability.narutorpg.revolving_throw.desc: Yagura strikes his opponent with a few water attacks using his staff, and finishes by hooking them with it and throwing them far back.
While the opponent's attention is on Sakon, Ukon jumps behind them to slam his fists down on their head.
The user strikes their opponent with a chakra enhanced punch, sending them flying. When reinforced, the user dashes forward and delivers the punch.
ability.narutorpg.rinne_sharingan.desc: The is a dōjutsu kekkei mōra and the predecessor to the Rinnegan and Sharingan. It is characterised by red sclerae and irides, with a ripple pattern spreading over the eyeball and nine tomoe.
ability.narutorpg.rinne_six_paths.desc: The Six Paths of Pain simultaneously punch the opponent, then Asura Path throws them in the air and the other Paths impale them with their black receivers.
ability.narutorpg.rinnegan.desc: The is reputed as the most exalted eye amongst the "Three Great Dōjutsu", the others being the Sharingan and the Byakugan, and the strongest dōjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.rising_bomber.desc: Killer B charges lightning-natured chakra through his arm, and runs towards his opponent in a similar manner to the Lightning Release: Lariat.
ability.narutorpg.rising_sun.desc: Itachi ignites Amaterasu on a rock behind the opponent, then he ignites Amaterasu again buring a hole behind the opponent to scare him. Itachi then ignites a final Amaterasu that burns the opponent and creates a huge crater.
ability.narutorpg.rivalling_wills.desc: Madara instructs Hashirama to follow his lead and uses Fire Release: Great Fire Annihilation on Hashirama's wood dragon to make the dragon so hot it glows red and attacks their opponent.
ability.narutorpg.roaring_run_great_stre: Roaring Run: Great Strength Ice Strike

A powerful technique used by Mizore Fuyukuma in which he surfs on his snowboard towards the opponent, after which he attacks the opponent with his Retractable Cable Arm, slamming them into a large chunk of ice.
ability.narutorpg.rock_armour.desc: The user flows earth-chakra through their body, absorbing the properties of earth around them to form a skin-deep armour that is transparent and is only visible when light reflects off it. The armour is shown to be able to defend from all forms of blunt-force trauma.
ability.narutorpg.rock_avalanche.desc: The user causes a rockslide by sending a wave of electric energy into a cliff. However, this technique is extremely location-based and needs to be done uphill of a mountain for it to be effective.
ability.narutorpg.rock_avalanche_formati: Several shinobi enter a formation in which they are standing on one another's shoulders, and then proceed towards the enemy, walling the opponent so they can't escape.
ability.narutorpg.rock_clone_technique.d: The user expels earth from their mouth to form it into one or several identical clones. Unlike other clones, ones generated by this method do not disappear when struck with sufficient force, but rather break apart.
ability.narutorpg.rock_hive.desc: The user creates a bee hive made of rock. This hive houses the giant bee larva which consumes chakra.
ability.narutorpg.rocket_rasengan.desc: Mecha-Naruto uses his Rasengan which is a light purple colour after propelling itself towards the opponent. As the Rasengan hits the opponent, Mecha-Naruto "shoots" his hand along with the Rasengan, further damaging the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.rockslide_genjutsu.des: This technique casts an illusion on multiple targets, making them perceive multiple large explosions going off. From this, the victims will see the ground around them collapsing, disorienting them and leave them confused and panicked.
ability.narutorpg.rolling_pin_shuriken.d: The user throws a rolling pin at the opponent like a shuriken, dealing physical damage.
ability.narutorpg.roof_tile_shuriken.des: This technique allows Hiruzen to remotely control, levitate and hurl spinning tiles in the nearby area. In addition to being able to control the tiles remotely, he was able to pressurise them with chakra to make them far stronger than normal.
ability.narutorpg.root_explosive_entombm: Danzō sprouts large roots from his arm and digs them into the ground rise beneath the opponent.
A tenet of shinobi is that they must escape any situation, no matter how difficult things may seem. Accordingly, this is the first jutsu taught in Konohagakure's Ninja Academy.
ability.narutorpg.rotating_destruction_s: Darui jumps in the air, deliver a series of attacks with his swords, and finishes the string with a powerful, downwards spin, sending his opponent crashing into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.rotating_ferocious_win: This is a technique used with the Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, which creates a large gust of wind. When Seimei united the swords with the other three special weapons from Takumi Village, the gust of wind transformed into a very strong whirlwind.
ability.narutorpg.rotating_funeral.desc: Obito absorbs his opponent and releases them in the middle of multiple detonating explosive tags.
ability.narutorpg.rough_rampage.desc: Jirōbō elbows the opponent, slams them, drags them through the stage and then throws them.
ability.narutorpg.rough_sea_barrier.desc: The Rough Sea Barrier is a Space–Time Ninjutsu that allows Isobu to materalise a bubble-like entrance to a separate dimension in which it could hide its presence until it is ready to return to wherever it chooses.
ability.narutorpg.rough_sea_splash.desc: Yagura knocks the opponent underwater, before transforming into Isobu. While transformed as Isobu, he rams the opponent out of the water, and finishes them off by spitting a stream of water directly at them.
ability.narutorpg.round_moon.desc: Sasuke jumps up in the air, lands a few fast spinning hits with his sword, and crashes down at his opponent with Chidori.
ability.narutorpg.ruining_sand_waterfall: Gaara creates a zigzag fissure of sand under the opponent. The zigzag fissure then erupts into the face of Shukaku which devours and seals the opponent away in 200 metres of sand.
ability.narutorpg.rumoured_endeavour_sta: Might Guy opens several chakra gates, jumps high into the sky shaped like a star and crashes down onto the opponent, creating an explosion.
ability.narutorpg.runt_ball_rasengan.des: The user creates a miniature-sized Rasengan through limited supplies of chakra. The full effect of the technique is unknown as Naruto collapsed before using it.
ability.narutorpg.rupture.desc: The user violently swings their chakra-enhanced sword with the intention of striking an approaching opponent, releasing a wave of chakra to cut a target.
ability.narutorpg.ryumyaku_chakra_contro: By controlling the vast chakra flowing from the , the user is able to convert the chakra and use it in various ways including to power up an entire city and control a large number of puppets. If not stopped, the user would have an unlimited source of energy to feed off of.
ability.narutorpg.ryumyaku_great_dragon_: Mukade shoots purple flames from his puppet body's mouth using the Ryūmyaku chakra. The attack leaves a residue of purple flame around the area.
ability.narutorpg.ryumyaku_super_great_d: Ryūmyaku: Super Great Dragon Fire Technique
Using more of the Ryūmyaku chakra, Mukade shoots a larger, more powerful version of the Ryūmyaku: Great Dragon Fire from his puppet body's stomach. He states that this is his greatest technique.
ability.narutorpg.sadistic_combination.d: Kakuzu delivers multiple punches to the opponent and then finishes them with wind and fire techniques.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_amphibian_tec: This technique is used by Shima and Fukasaku to fuse with Jiraiya. It maximises the sage chakra for the person they are fused to and allows them to access Sage Mode.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_big_ball_spir: Sage Art: Big Ball Spiralling Drop: Instant Lightning
Using both Kurama and Sage Modes, Naruto forms a Giant Rasengan and Tobirama teleports him above the opponent to strike them down.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_five_fire_god: Sage Art: Five Fire Gods' Fan of Flames
While in Sage Mode, the user is able to summon a massive wall of flames, scorching everything around them. The technique can also be used as a smokescreen to conceal their escape.
Sage Art: Five Fire Gods' Fan of Flames: True Fire

Koji traps the opponent in the terrain altered swamp, sets them ablaze with a flame bullet, summons a pillar of flames beneath them, then finishes them by surrounding himself in a large expanding sphere of fire.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_frog_call.des: After focusing Senjutsu chakra to their throats, both Fukasaku and Shima croak together in unison, releasing large, loud and immensely powerful sound waves that effectively annoy, distract and temporarily paralyse any afflicted targets completely.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_frog_call_spi: Jiraiya and Naruto both enter Sage Mode, following with Fukasaku and Shima stunning the opponent with their croaking sound waves as Naruto throws a Rasenshuriken.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_gate_of_the_g: Sage Art: Gate of the Great God
Sage Art: Gate of the Great God is a sealing technique utilised by Hashirama Senju while in Sage Mode.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_goemon.desc: Sage Art: Goemon is a cooperation technique used by Jiraiya with Shima and Fukasaku.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_great_snake_l: A senjutsu enhanced version of the original, the user shoots cyan lightning shaped like snakes.
Sage Art: Great Snake Lightning: White Snake
The user dashes towards the opponent in Sage Mode, attacks them with their snakes and finishes them with the lightning chakra snakes.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_ink_splatter_: After accessing the power of Gyūki, Naruto forms a Rasenshuriken in ink.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_inorganic_rei: The Sage Art: Inorganic Reincarnation allows the user to breathe life into inorganic substances by filling the atmosphere with natural energy.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_lava_release_: A powerful technique whereby Naruto, after accessing Son Gokū's power, creates a Rasenshuriken with a lava-infused nucleus, the heat of which causes the blades themselves to emit steam.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_lightning_cag: Sage Art: Lightning Cage Border Jail
Madara has his shadows take on a square formation and create a beam of lightning, going from shadow to shadow, which close onto the opponent in the middle of the formation.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_magnet_releas: A technique that's available to Naruto after inheriting the Sage of the Six Paths' powers. By combining his Rasengan with Shukaku's Magnet Release to reinforce its suction power, he creates a Rasengan with the beast's cursed seal markings.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_many_ultra_bi: Sage Art: Many Ultra-Big Ball Spiralling Serial Spheres
The Sage Art: Many Ultra-Big Ball Spiralling Serial Spheres is a technique utilised by Naruto Uzumaki which enhances his Rasengan with natural energy.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_scattering_ra: Kabuto expels numerous white dragons to attack the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_storm_release: Sage Art: Storm Release Light Fang

The user infuses Storm Release with senjutsu chakra to fire a sharp, thin stream of light from their mouth. It is powerful enough to cut clean through a Truth-Seeking Ball. As it travels at the speed of light, it is described as being impossible to dodge.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_super_tailed_: Sage Art: Super Tailed Beast Rasenshuriken
This is an "ultimate technique" created by Naruto Uzumaki using the power given to him by the Sage of Six Paths.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_white_rage_te: The Sage Art: White Rage Technique is a senjutsu used by those who studied in the Ryūchi Cave and mastered the Sage Transformation. After forming the necessary hand seals, the user expels a dragon-like entity from their mouth that carries an orb in its left front claw.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_wind_release_: Sage Art: Wind Release Dust Cloud

Shima exhales a massive cloud of dust from her mouth, which is thick enough that it is capable of blocking the target's vision completely. The dust cloud is also large enough to hide a summon as large as Gamabunta.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_wood_release_: Sage Art: Wood Release: Ground Pulse
Hashirama's giant wood statue pokes a finger on the ground, causing wood to erupt from the ground, hitting his opponent.
Sage Art Wood Release: True Several Thousand Hands
The Sage Art Wood Release: True Several Thousand Hands is a technique which creates a titanic, many-handed wooden statue that can be freely controlled by the user.
Sage Art: Wood Release: Wood Dragon Dance Performance
Hashirama's gigantic wood statue causes a wood dragon to erupt from the ground and strike his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.sage_art_yin_release_l: Sage Art: Yin Release Lightning Dispatch
The Sage Art: Yin Release Lightning Dispatch is a ninjutsu used by Madara Uchiha.
ability.narutorpg.sage_combo.desc: While in Sage Mode, Naruto creates four shadow clones, two that attack the opponent and two that help Naruto create Rasenshuriken, the attacking clones kick the opponent up and down and then Naruto throws Rasenshuriken at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.sage_transformation.de: Sage Transformation is a way of attaining Sage Mode, using a bodily reaction exhibited by members of Jūgo's clan. By exposing their special body fluids to natural energy, they gain increased physical capabilities and the ability to perform various shape-shifting feats.
ability.narutorpg.sakura_blizzard_techni: Sakura throws a barrage of kunai attached with bags of small explosive tags and cherry blossom petals to help camouflage the tags. Sakura simply has to throw an additional kunai with an explosive tag to ignite the tags and catch the target in a large explosion.
ability.narutorpg.sakura_special_shurike: Sakura throws five shuriken, which are connected to wires of chakra, chasing her opponent.
ability.narutorpg.samehada_colliding_exp: Kisame delivers several slashes to his opponent with Samehada whilst releasing water blasting his opponent and finishing with a downward slash that results in a pillar of water rising up.
ability.narutorpg.samehada_s_gonna_shank: B begins with a a couple kicks, before standing on one hand and spinning, kicking his opponent with both legs as he does so, and also striking them with one of his swords in his other hand. Using the momentum of the spin, B gets back up and attacks the opponent three times with Samehada.
ability.narutorpg.samehada_wild_dance.de: Kisame slashes downward in a reap, then drags his Samehada along the enemy's shoulder then slashes them with a turn, draining their chakra before stabbing the enemy and slams them into the ground behind him.
ability.narutorpg.samurai_sabre_techniqu: Unique to Samurai, this technique employs the concept of chakra flow in a similar manner to the Flying Swallow and Sword of Kusanagi: Chidori Katana techniques.
ability.narutorpg.sand_binding_coffin.de: Using the sand he keeps stored in his Sand Gourd, Gaara immobilises his targets and captures them. Because the sand is naturally malleable, most of the target's usual methods for defence or escape become ineffective once they've been encased by it. They can only wait until Gaara releases or kills them.
ability.narutorpg.sand_binding_prison.de: A capturing ninjutsu that is characteristic to Gaara. Using ordinary sand, a perfectly airtight space is created, in which the enemy is captured. An enormous quantity of sand completely envelops the target from every direction and captures them.
ability.narutorpg.sand_blade_double_atta: Gaara sends two streams of sand towards the opponent, one stream rises into the sky while the other slides through the ground. The sand stream on the ground hits the opponent and carries him up into the air. Once in midair both streams collide with each other, making the opponent the epicentre of the collision.
ability.narutorpg.sand_body.desc: Firstly deconstructing the sand from his gourd, Gaara's body also changes into sand. In this form, Gaara is invulnerable to damage and can travel over long distances as a rushing sandstorm, as well as maintain control over sand.
ability.narutorpg.sand_bullet.desc: Gaara forms a small sphere made of sand and compresses it to increase its hardness. The sphere can strike opponents with such speed and force that it knocks them unconscious. He can also change its trajectory, to strike down multiple targets.
The user surrounds their target in a vortex of swirling sand, which can be used as a medium for other sand techniques, like creating several Third Eyes, for information-gathering purposes.
ability.narutorpg.sand_characters.desc: Sand Characters is a technique that utilises sand as a method of communication.
ability.narutorpg.sand_cloak_technique.d: The user cloaks the body of an ally with sand, acting like armour, which is strong enough to withstand a strong sandstorm without making the person flinch.
ability.narutorpg.sand_clone.desc: The user shapes their sand into a lookalike of themselves that fights for them. Unlike other clone techniques, the sand clone's composition is usually obvious at all times, only taking user's shape and not their exact appearance.
ability.narutorpg.sand_cloud.desc: Gaara gathers sand in the air that strikes down on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.sand_cloud_circle.desc: Gaara manipulates his sand to create a spinning pillar of sand and dust to rise up from beneath the opponent lifting them into the air.
ability.narutorpg.sand_cloud_dancing_ras: Gaara uses Sand Drizzle to knock out the opponent while Naruto finishes the combo with a well-placed Rasengan, stomping the enemy into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.sand_cloud_dark_coffin: Many Shukaku sand arms come out of the ground near the opponent and form a sphere around the opponent. After it is lifted into the air, a vortex of sand surrounds it and it detonates.
ability.narutorpg.sand_cruel_pursuit_int: Gaara manipulates his sand to create multiple arms of Shukaku rise from the ground and converge on the opponent crushing them into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.sand_drizzle.desc: Gaara forms small lumps of sand high in the air, which he has fall on a target like rain. Gaara can control the sand lumps with his chakra, allowing him to ensure they strike their target and even guide them towards the target's blind-spots.
ability.narutorpg.sand_encampment_wall.d: Gaara summons a series of solid pillars of sand that come out from the ground and rise up beneath the opponent damaging them.
ability.narutorpg.sand_exploding_sand_cl: After using Sand Binding Coffin, Gaara creates a large boulder made of sand above himself. He then hurls the sand boulder at the opponent, crushing them.
ability.narutorpg.sand_formation_combo.d: First, Shishio turns his teammates invisible with his Hot Sand Camouflage so they can attack the enemy undetected, after which the invisible Kōji quickly moves behind the enemy several times, punching them with his sand fist, and finally, Ameno finishes the attack by slicing the enemy with the mantis's enormous aquatic
ability.narutorpg.sand_formation_shisa.d: The user generates one or multiple lion-like sand creatures to attack or subdue a target. They appear to be easily dispersed if struck hard enough.
ability.narutorpg.sand_hail.desc: Sand Hail is a larger scale version of Gaara's Sand Drizzle.
ability.narutorpg.sand_hell.desc: Gaara creates a sand arm beneath his opponent, throwing them up in the air. Then he grabs them with two sand arms, and slams them to the ground.
ability.narutorpg.sand_lightning_needles: This technique is very similar to Sand Drizzle. Gaara launches a large amount of sand in the sky to rain down on the opponent. The sand then forms into needles which stick into the ground and create an electrical charge that drains or otherwise neutralises electricity. Gaara uses this to disable Ranke's Plasma Ball.
ability.narutorpg.sand_mesh.desc: Gaara uses his sand to create an expanding mesh, providing support and footing for his allies going after retreating enemies.
ability.narutorpg.sand_pillar.desc: Gaara can form a sand pillar using the sand from the ground or by warping the lower half of his body into sand. Gaara manipulates the sand to suspend and manoeuvres himself in mid-air at high speeds. The sand maintains contact with the ground, thus creating a pillar-like formation.
ability.narutorpg.sand_prison_spear_atta: Gaara first encases his opponent with sand, immobilising them, and then creates a large drill-like sand spear which he uses to impale them.
ability.narutorpg.sand_restraining_techn: The user immobilises and restrain the target's movements with sand. It's apparently almost impossible for the target to escape from the technique unless the user exhausts their chakra.
ability.narutorpg.sand_shuriken.desc: Gaara, while preparing to enter Tailed Beast Mode, shapes the sand coating his arms into multiple shuriken. By swinging his arms - which are more powerful than normal because of his transformation - the shuriken are launched rapidly, with additional volleys being possible with each additional swing.
ability.narutorpg.sand_stream.desc: Gaara uses his sand to drag his opponents away in a stream to keep them from moving forward.
ability.narutorpg.sand_swift_spear_attac: Gaara creates a drill-like sand spear which he hurls at his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.sand_sword.desc: The user creates a giant blade out of sand to slice through the opponent's body with, which can stretch and slip through shields like a giant snake.
Gaara sends the opponent into the air where Lee kicks the opponent. Gaara then uses Quicksand Waterfall Flow and Lee appears from inside the tsunami of sand, and kicks the opponent into it. As the opponent slowly descends, the sand proceeds, and they drown in it.
ability.narutorpg.sand_waterfall_funeral: After encasing a target with sand, such as by using the Sand Binding Coffin, Gaara clenches his fist to cause the sand to contract. The sand presses in on the target from all directions until they're pulverised, killing them.
ability.narutorpg.sand_waterfall_imperia: After a target has been engulfed by Quicksand Waterfall Flow, Gaara slams his hands onto the sand and activates this technique. As with the regular Sand Waterfall Funeral, the sand compresses upon and grinds down the target, though on a far greater scale than the regular version.
ability.narutorpg.sand_waterfall_mass_at: Gaara strikes the opponent with a ball of sand, then pours sand down on them before raising the sand upwards to knock them into the air.
ability.narutorpg.sand_waterfall_mass_de: Gaara manipulates his sand to swirl around himself, acting as a shield against projectiles.
ability.narutorpg.sand_whip.desc: Gaara raises himself on a sand platform, striking all around himself with a sand whip for any target within reach.
ability.narutorpg.sandstone_fist.desc: The user gathers sand and rock into their fist to form stone-made weapons, like a mallet or a shield. Its hardness is so great, that it can withstand the might of Chōji Akimichi's enhanced fist.
ability.narutorpg.sandstorm_barrier.desc: With the help of pre-existing sand, the user creates a sandstorm barrier that is capable of overpowering other active barriers, like the Sensing Barrier. The technique also disturbs sensing abilities of the opponents. The barrier can be used offensively to surround opponents and limit their sense of vision.
ability.narutorpg.sandstorm_technique.de: With the help of pre-existing sand, the user creates a localised sandstorm, surrounding opponents and limiting their sense of vision.
ability.narutorpg.sannin_mode.desc: After using their Ultimate Jutsu, the user goes into this mode. It increases the range, power, and speed of the user's attacks. Whilst in this mode, the user gains access to their Awakening techniques.
ability.narutorpg.sasuke_uchiha_s_spacet: With his Rinnegan, Sasuke can use an unspecified Space–Time Ninjutsu to travel to different dimensions.
ability.narutorpg.scale_powder.desc: The user releases a large amount of fine powder from their mouth or body, which, due to its luminous quality, shines so brightly that it can temporarily blind multiple targets within its area of effect.
Using Chōmei's wings, Fū strikes her opponent and flies into the air while releasing scales, then fully transforms into Chōmei and delivers a drill-like attack on her opponent.
ability.narutorpg.scale_senbon.desc: Amachi spreads his arms and launches his scales at high velocity at the target. This technique had enough power to burst a shadow clone and throw Naruto back quite some distance. In addition, it had a wide enough range to wipe out six shadow clones at once.
ability.narutorpg.scale_wrapping_rotatin: Fū lands a series of kicks and punches, blinds her opponent with scales, and then flies into it, landing more hits with Chōmei's wings as she rotates.
ability.narutorpg.scarlet_invitation.des: Kurenai strikes the opponent with a combination of an elbow strike and two kicks before creating multiple cherry blossom petals which burst up from the ground lifting them into the air.
ability.narutorpg.scattering_tailed_beas: In his full Tailed Beast transformation, Naruto discharges multiple uncompressed Tailed Beast Balls at once. They can be shot in a widespread manner, and can converge on multiple targets.
ability.narutorpg.scattering_thousand_cr: This technique summons a flock of countless crows, dazzling the enemy. The user can freely manipulate the crows by emitting chakra from his fingertips and altering it into high frequency waves.
ability.narutorpg.scent_blossom_colourin: Kurenai creates a cherry blossom clone which attacks the opponent with several kunai slashes while creating a stream of cherry blossom petals behind it, before spinning around, and delivering a final slash that sends the opponent flying away.
ability.narutorpg.scent_of_illusionary_f: This genjutsu uses a species of white flower that grows near the Valley of Lies as a medium. When victims smell the flowers' scent, they remember things from their lives that will cause them to lose their will to fight.
ability.narutorpg.scientific_ninja_tool_: With their Scientific Ninja Tools, the user can use three different stored ninjutsu:.
Scientific Ninja Tool: Orca and Powerful Breath
Boruto utilises his Shinobi Gauntlet to release a surge water pooling the area and electrify it with a bolt of electricity, electrocuting anyone that is in the water.
Using his shadow clones, Boruto is launched by their boosted wind, and uses Purple Electricity through the use of the Shinobi Gauntlet.
ability.narutorpg.scorch_release_extreme: The user creates several flaming orbs that resemble small suns. These orbs rotate around the user and can be freely controlled to attack enemies. When an orb touches an opponent, it instantly evaporates all the water inside their body, leaving them in a mummified state.
ability.narutorpg.scorch_release_firebal: Pakura creates two flaming spheres that she uses to hover low above the ground, and from this position she fires flaming spheres at her opponent, replacing each thrown sphere with a new one.

Pakura creates two flaming spheres, which she uses to hover low above the ground, and from this position she fires one large sphere at the enemy, connecting two small ones, immediately replacing them with new ones.
ability.narutorpg.scorch_release_great_s: Scorch Release: Great Steaming Explosive Blast

Pakura combines several of her flaming orbs to create a single massive one, which then violently explodes with enough force and power to incinerate a large area around it. When this happens, steam can be seen emitting from the area.
ability.narutorpg.scorch_release_halo_hu: Scorch Release: Halo Hurricane Jet Black Arrow Style Zero
This technique combines Naruto Uzumaki's Wind Release: Rasenshuriken with Sasuke Uchiha's Blaze Release: Kagutsuchi along with their variants.
ability.narutorpg.scorching_heat_sand_bi: As Gaara traps his opponent within an enormous sphere of sand, he also manoeuvres his siblings around it in sand platforms. Kankurō uses the Sasori puppet to set the sphere on fire, while Temari fans the flames. Gaara finishes covering the opponent in sand, and crushes them, causing the flaming sand prison to explode.
ability.narutorpg.scorching_river_great_: Rōshi grabs his opponent and makes a great leap, transforming into Son Gokū. He then puts his opponent between his lava-coated fists, slamming them into the ground. As he raises his arms, the ground beneath him erupts.
ability.narutorpg.scroll_communication_t: The user communicates to another by using a scroll, on which writing appears and disappears.
ability.narutorpg.sea_of_trees_erosion.d: Using the Wood Release, a user can manipulate the terrain, bringing out underground roots of varying sizes to fit various offensive situations, such as using the roots for trickery, misdirection and restriction.
ability.narutorpg.sealed_binding_formati: Sealed Binding Formation: the user raises a wall, then empowers the user. Learned from rank 1.
ability.narutorpg.sealed_iron_wall.desc: A seal placed on the Fire Temple's gate to protect against intruders from the outside world. The two statues placed on either side of the gate form a barrier. Only ninja monks of the temple have access to enter due to the special chakra gifted from the Gift of the Hermit Group.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_release_techni: After throwing prayer beads on the sealed victim, Chūkaku begins to mumble words while performing ritual hand movements, leading the seal formula to slowly disappear. This technique seems to take concentration and strength since Chūkaku looked troubled while performing it.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_tag_barrier.de: A barrier ninjutsu that involves the usage of several sealing tags being concealed beneath the surface. Once anybody steps onto the area, the tag will activate, releasing several thin threads that wrap around the target and restrain them.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_blac: Kuroma unleashes a dark and ominous aura capable of serving multiple purposes. The aura is able to subdue and restrain the opponent. The aura is also able to serve as an attack and defence, deflecting another attack or forcing the opponent into the defensive by blowing them away.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_crim: After executing the necessary hand seals, user creates a seal based on the Fire Release: Heavenly Prison, capable of immobilising and burning the target.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_five: Kuroma uses his sealing tags to use the five element natures.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_four: Sealing Technique: Four Limbs Weighting Seal

This technique is performed by placing prayer beads around the wrists and ankles of the target and then pressing the palm against the target's chest. This increases the weight of the beads exponentially, weighing down the target's limbs.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_frog: The user erects four pillars from the ground around their target. The pillars create a field that paralyses anyone caught inside. The paralysing effect can be countered through the use of another seal.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_lion: This sealing technique completely blocks the target's chakra with a drawn on the ground or a wall. This is done by closing all the tenketsu of the person caught in the middle. When the target is sealed, a stylised kanji for appears in the middle of the sealing formula.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_octo: The Sealing Technique: Octopus Hold is a fūinjutsu unique to Killer B, using his ability to generate clones made of ink.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_phan: Sealing Technique: Phantom Dragons Nine Consuming Seals

The Sealing Technique: Phantom Dragons Nine Consuming Seals is a technique that was used by Pain and the other members of Akatsuki to forcibly seal a tailed beast or to extract a still-living jinchūriki's tailed beast chakra into the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_rele: This technique is a counter-measure that can be used to undo fūinjutsu that may be binding the user. By placing their hand atop the seal, it activates, nullifying the effects of the fūinjutsu casted on them.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_roen: A sealing technique that is passed down within the Kodon clan, allowing its members to seal Rōen, a wolf-like monster that has terrorised them since ancient times. The seal must be placed at Rōen's weak point, on the back of its head.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_spir: This requires a scroll to perform the technique. It allows the user to seal a soul from a human inside the scroll.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_thre: The user, along with two shadow clones, creates a triangular seal around the opponent. Then a tetrahedral form of light traps and sends them up in the sky, leaving a large hole on the ground.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_tige: Sealing Technique: Tiger Vision Staring Bullet

After the user draws a gigantic tiger, the illustration extends from the scroll and while still connected, captures its prey with its teeth and claws, before dragging the victim back into the scroll and pinning them down within the confines of the drawing.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_technique_vita: Tsukino uses her two tantō to perform her fūinjutsu. When using this technique, she can temporarily suppress the chakra of multiple individuals in the area around her.
ability.narutorpg.sealing_trap_explosion: Tsukino prepares a sealing trap on the ground which, when stepped on by an enemy, explodes.
ability.narutorpg.seasickness_fist.desc: Similar to the Drunken Fist, the user harnesses the queasiness caused to them by motion sickness to lend them a degree of unpredictability in combat. They can also vomit on their opponent in order to totally gross them out.
ability.narutorpg.secret_anaesthesia.des: Using Yomi's snakes, Kusuna has them bite a target. The bite leaves a purplish colour around the area bitten and causes the target's veins to swell up, after which they become temporarily paralysed.
ability.narutorpg.secret_ingredient.desc: Chōji headbutts the opponent and rolls into them two times.
ability.narutorpg.secret_sword_flowing_s: Hayate creates several shadow clones that attack the enemy with their swords. During this time, he himself becomes invisible, allowing him to launch a surprise attack at the right moment, even if the clones are destroyed.
ability.narutorpg.secret_sword_moonlight: Hayate dashes to his opponent with great speed before attacking them with a quick lateral sword strike. The tremendous speed leaves a trace of an afterimage in the process.
ability.narutorpg.secret_sword_snowstorm: While focusing their chakra into their sword while still sheathed, the user performs a Battōjutsu strike. From this, the user unleashes a powerful shockwave which becomes a massive tornado surrounding them, repelling everything in the area near the user. Powerful as the technique is, it is not without drawbacks.
ability.narutorpg.secret_taijutsu_super_: Secret Taijutsu: Super Fire Release Illusion Great Shuriken Two-Stage Technique

Hashirama calls on Madara, after which they together deal the enemy several punches and kicks, then Madara paralyzes them with his genjutsu while Hashirama throws giant Fūma Shuriken which spin wildly, cutting the enemy, and in the end, Madara sets them on fire along with the shuriken, burning everything to ashes.
ability.narutorpg.secret_taijutsu_wild_s: Secret Taijutsu: Wild Stone Dance Flame Killing Kunai Endless Style Multi-Shot Technique

Madara calls on Hashirama, after which they begin to furiously throw rocks at the enemy, then Hashirama throws Madara into the air, where he releases a fireball at the enemy, and finally throws several kunai with explosive tags, causing a powerful explosion.
ability.narutorpg.secret_technique_insec: Shino sends his insects that form roots and entangle the opponent and then explode.
The user sends their insects to encase the opponent; the insects then lift the opponent into the air, and crush them.

This unique technique allows the user to accelerate the growth of their insects. As the user's body is already a hive of sorts for the insects, the user will encase themselves in an actual cocoon to further aid the insects.

By simply touching a surface with their palm and fingers, the user releases a small web of chakra that draws bugs to that location. Since the Aburame member can communicate with insects, it can be useful to gain information by gathering local insects.

The user sends their kikaichū to spread over a wide range, and the moment they locate the target, the insects gather at once, forming a sphere around the target. They then attach themselves to the target and begin eating away at their chakra. Even if the target manages to escape, the insects will immediately follow.
This technique covers the enemy's entire body with the kikaichū living inside the Aburame clan member's body.

By releasing a large number of kikaichū, the user creates a massive wall out of them, which protects both himself and allies nearby. The wall is strong enough to protect against large falling objects and Fire Release techniques.
ability.narutorpg.secret_technique_mist_: A technique known by Kirigakure hunter-nin. The user makes rain that absorbs any chakra it comes into contact with, as long as it's not of the same signature as the original user. The effect of this technique is powerful enough to absorb Utakata's Soap Bubble Ninjutsu and Naruto's Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.secret_technique_mouth: The user initiates the technique with a specific technique seal and apparently before asking the target a question. If the target answers, the technique is then immediately invoked causing the person to lose the use of their voice. The target will remain in this state until the technique is dispelled by the user.
ability.narutorpg.secret_technique_seali: Tsukino uses her two tantō to perform her technique. When using this technique, she can dispel seals.
ability.narutorpg.secret_technique_stone: This technique makes use of the user's chakra as a paralysing agent. The user throws kunai with strings attached at the opponent. Once the enemy is hit, chakra is ran through the string to paralyse them, which will serve to either incapacitate or allow the user to attack.
ability.narutorpg.secret_technique_summo: A technique created by Orochimaru. Kabuto uses eight seal tags to summon the Mugen Castle. The castle can absorb the people's vitality and is also capable of destroying the land where it stands. When the castle is destroyed by removing the eight seal tags, it disappears without a trace.
ability.narutorpg.secret_technique_tree_: The user manifests threads made of their own blood to encase the area around them. Anyone stained by the blood will instantly have their body and its actions controlled by the user. The threads are relatively easy to damage, but can regenerate.
ability.narutorpg.self_cursing_seal.desc: Similar to the Cursed Tongue Eradication Seal, this seal can also be applied during combat, and can secretly be placed on the opponent's body. When the user activates it, the curse seal's marks spread around the opponent's body, paralysing them.
ability.narutorpg.self_healing_technique: Upon forming the necessary hand seals, either immediately before or after being struck by an attack, the user's body will regenerate to heal all recent injuries and lost anatomy in seconds, leaving no lingering traces of said wounds. This technique can also negate the effects of venom on the user's body.
ability.narutorpg.self_repairing_barrier: The Self-Repairing Barrier is a Cooperation Ninjutsu that by linking chakra from a team of ninja, will create a barrier which if damaged, will constantly repair itself with said chakra that emanates from their bodies.
ability.narutorpg.self_seal_technique.de: This technique allows the user to turn their body into stone, allowing them to store chakra for many years. The technique also keeps the user from ageing.
ability.narutorpg.self_taught_instant_at: Might Duy opens the Eight Gates and delivers a powerful punch that creates a large vacuum, propelling the enemy away.
ability.narutorpg.self_taught_youth_kick: Might Duy jumps and delivers a powerful drop kick to the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.senbon_shower.desc: This technique requires special umbrellas that have been spring-loaded with hundreds of senbon. The user opens several of these umbrellas and spins them into the air. As they spin, they release the combined thousands of senbon, which the user controls with their chakra.
ability.narutorpg.senrigan.desc: The is a dōjutsu awakened by some members of the Ōtsutsuki Clan, which grants vast clairvoyant abilities. Appearance-wise, it is distinguished by a bright-blue iris, a white-glowing pupil surrounded by a dark, waxing crescent shape, and a darkened sclera.
ability.narutorpg.sensing_barrier.desc: The Sensing Barrier is a giant, dome-shaped barrier placed over a designated area. The barrier is not visible to the standard eye; when viewed with certain dōjutsu, it can be seen that there is a design of several circles which have the kanji for , and inscribed in them.
ability.narutorpg.sensing_barrier_pass_t: According to Pain, Itachi and Kisame were able to enter Konohagakure undetected after Orochimaru's failed invasion because as a former member of Konohagakure's Anbu, Itachi knew how to pass through the barrier surrounding the village undetected.
The user places a hexagram seal on the ground that allows them to sense targets on a wide radius by transmitting waves through the seal. This technique could also identify if an individual was a medical-nin.
ability.narutorpg.sensing_sand_sphere.de: This sphere, made out of sand, can be used to monitor chakra signatures in a given area. The sphere itself is not a great form of detection and needs on-the-field reports to locate targets that should be kept track of. When linked with a Sensing Barrier, this imprecision is mitigated somewhat.
ability.narutorpg.sensing_technique.desc: The Sensing Technique allows sensor type shinobi to mould chakra and change it to the sensor type. This enables them to detect and track down targets through their chakra signatures. The range of this technique varies between sensors.
ability.narutorpg.sensing_transmission.d: By making physical contact with another individual, the user is able to transmit what they are currently sensing directly into the target's mind. The user's perception can then be further transferred to another individual that person is connected to, be it physically or through such means as their shadow.
ability.narutorpg.sensing_water_sphere.d: By forming a sphere of water, the user can use it to monitor chakra signatures in a given area. Individuals or groups are represented as varying-sized bubbles within the sphere, with larger chakra signatures having larger bubbles.
ability.narutorpg.serial_kick.desc: The user kicks their opponent several times in quick succession and finishes with a powerful kick that sends the opponent flying.
ability.narutorpg.seven_coloured_rasenga: The Seven-Coloured Rasengan is a Rasengan, coloured by the light reflecting from the mirror generator in the Land of Snow. This colouring gave the chakra used for the Rasengan the appearance of a rainbow.
ability.narutorpg.seven_lightnings_of_th: Seven Lightnings of the Heavenly Realm
With Susanoo, Indra forms seven bolts of lightning that rain down as a circle around his opponent before detonating.
ability.narutorpg.seven_swords_of_the_bl: Seven Swords of the Bloody Mist

The Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist gather as a thick mist surrounds the battlefield. Ameyuri heads in for an attack, delivering an electricity-enhanced horizontal slash with Kiba, followed by Kisame slashing with Samehada in the opposite direction.
ability.narutorpg.severed_inscription.de: Mifune quickly draws his sword, slashing everything around himself.
ability.narutorpg.severed_land.desc: Wielding Kubikiribōchō, the user leaps in front of the opponent and slashes down at them with the sword, crushing the ground below them.
ability.narutorpg.sexy_boy_on_boy_techni: A technique that implements the Sexy: Girl on Girl Technique. A technique that excites women sexually by changing into two naked men. Unlike when changing into girls, other things are vital besides proportions, like the selection and combination of the men one transforms into and how they pose.
ability.narutorpg.sexy_girl_on_girl_tech: Naruto's Harem Technique, as arranged by Konohamaru, it is consecutively using the Shadow Clone Technique and Transformation Technique, but by having the user himself and the shadow clone change into different people on the moment of transformation.
ability.narutorpg.sexy_reverse_harem_tec: A technique created by Naruto Uzumaki, and a variation of the Harem Technique.
ability.narutorpg.sexy_technique.desc: Naruto Uzumaki created this technique in order to play pranks on men. The user transforms into a beautiful woman, with special attention given to the woman's figure, breasts, and waist.
ability.narutorpg.sexy_technique_pole_da: Sexy Technique: Pole Dance and Nice Body

Another variation of the Sexy Technique, the user and a staff are transformed into a woman with an especially attractive body (hence the "Nice Body" title) wearing a red bikini on a pole. The woman winks, blows kisses and speaks seductively to the victim to add to the effectiveness of this technique.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_arms.desc: The Zero-Tails can create a multitude of tan coloured arms from its body that chase after the opponent. The arms can also absorb chakra from the opponent. When used by Shinnō, he could also form a wall to shield himself with these arms, enough to block Naruto's Tornado Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_bind_combo.desc: Shikamaru restrains the opponent with Shadow Sewing Technique and Naruto uses his clones to attack the trapped opponent.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_bind_crush.desc: Shikaku extends his shadow into multiple tendrils which all wrap around the opponent into sphere that crushes them.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_bind_technique_: Shikamaru's shadow expands into a circular shape, immobilising the opponents caught in it, as Naruto attacks them with the Super-Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan.
The user projects their shadow at target. Upon which, the shadow splits into multiple lines and surrounds the target as solid beams, forming a round cage. The shadow can be maintained and launched away even after the user's personal shadow splits from the structure.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_clone_charging_: Naruto creates and tosses a shadow clone at the opponent, tossing another and then creating multiple clones that are shot at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_clone_elite_bul: Naruto creates several shadow clones, which are thrown toward his opponent, stringing together many hits.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_clone_great_rot: Naruto creates two shadow clones, and they form a chain with each Naruto holding the other by the ankles. Naruto then spins, hitting his opponents with the clones.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_clone_kick.desc: Itachi creates a clone in midair that performs a drop kick on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_clone_roundhous: Naruto uses his shadow clones to deliver a series of hits to his opponent, finishing it by spinning and throwing a shadow clone, that lands a roundhouse kick on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_clone_super_tai: Shadow Clone: Super Tailed Beast Rasenshuriken

Naruto sends out seven shadow clones in the air, which rain down Magnet Release Rasengans to seal any movements from the opponents, and finished with five additional shadow clones throwing Magnet Release, Lava Release, and ink covered Rasenshurikens in the surrounding area, leaving hazardous pools of substances leftove
ability.narutorpg.shadow_clone_technique: The Shadow Clone Technique is a clone technique created by Tobirama Senju.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_clone_twin_ligh: Kakashi sends out a shadow clone, which attacks the opponent with a Lightning Cutter in each hand.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_clone_upper.des: Naruto creates a shadow clone to throw him towards his opponent, delivering an uppercut.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_clutch_techniqu: The user materialises their shadow and increases its power, becoming like steel. The user then captures the target's shadow and forcibly moves them about. The techniques strength is proportionate to the chakra put into it, with enough strength even giants can be moved.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_demon_binding_t: Much like the Shadow Imitation Technique and Shadow–Neck Binding Technique, shadows dart towards the opponent, though they're much larger and have more shadow strips, all going at a fast pace. Once the opponent is caught, small shadow hands wrap their entire body, making them unable to move.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_gathering_techn: This is a ninjutsu using materialised shadows, but compared to the Shadow Sewing Technique from the same line, this technique places emphasis on the minute control of the shadow's movements. It is accurate enough to even make the tentacles go through tiny holes.
Shikamaru uses his Shadow Imitation Technique and makes his opponent fall through the shadow to teleport them to the unknown location, and in seconds, the opponent returns dropped from a set height from a smoke cloud.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_human_bullet_ta: Chōji uses his Multi-Size Technique to do the Human Bullet Tank, then Shikamaru uses his Shadow Imitation Technique to paralyse the opponent then Chōji crushes them.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_imitation_field: This technique is an advanced version of the Shadow Imitation Technique, where the user expands their shadow to cover a wide range, thereby reducing the chance of escape. Due to the technique's concept, multiple targets can be captured simultaneously.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_imitation_shado: The Shadow Imitation Shadow Bind Technique is one of the hijutsu utilised by members of the Nara clan.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_imitation_shuri: The Shadow Imitation Shuriken Technique is a ninjutsu invented by Shikamaru Nara while teaching himself to use Asuma Sarutobi's chakra blades.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_imitation_techn: The Shadow Imitation Technique is the signature technique of the Nara clan.
Shikamaru branches out his shadow, with the tip of each branch holding an explosive tag.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_mirror_body_cha: A technique passed down in the Land of Demons, it was used by Taruho to alter his appearance into that of Shion.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_network_techniq: Shikamaru is able to utilise his shadow to crack the ground around him, possessing nearby opponent. The shadow will spin, forming a small whirlwind, attacking possessed and approaching opponent.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_of_the_dancing_: The user moves close behind a target and carefully matches their movements, following them in the same way that a leaf is followed by its shadow. Simply mimicking a target in this way does no harm to them, but it's useful as a setup for other techniques, such as the Front Lotus or the Lion Combo.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_pressure_palm_t: Shikamaru throws flash bombs behind him, to not only blind his foes but also to extend the range of his shadow indefinitely. Once those preparations are complete, Shikamaru can put any parts of his body in front of the light and it will appear as an enormous shadow.
The Magaki Group wraps their opponent with black rope, to restrict their movements.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_senbon.desc: A simple technique using senbon, the user throws senbon with bells attached and senbon without bells at the same time. The intention is that the opponent will only react to the sound of the bells and won't notice the silent senbon, getting hit by these.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_sewing_techniqu: This is a ninjutsu from among the Nara clan's secret techniques that uses materialised shadows to attack and bind, instead of merely immobilising and controlling like the Shadow Imitation Technique. The user changes the shape of their shadow into several sharp tendril-like needles and controls each separately.
Shikamaru expands his shadow into the field, using the tendrils from it to fling parachutes with explosive tags.
Shikamaru uses the Shadow Sewing Technique to cover all directions, piercing anyone in close proximity.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_sheep_cloud_tec: Shikamaru creates a sheep out of shadows which puts the enemy to sleep.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_shuriken_techni: The user places two shuriken together and throws them both at a target simultaneously; the larger the shuriken that are thrown, the greater the necessary skill. The goal is for targets to focus their attention on whichever of the two shuriken is on top, not noticing the second shuriken travelling below it.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_smokescreen_tec: Shikamaru releases several smoke bombs that engulf the enemy in smoke. Shikamaru then wraps his shadow around the enemy before constricting it to a small egg-like size that he forces to implode.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_stabbing_techni: Shikamaru, while in his awakened state, forces his shadow to rise and form many different needle-like shapes and launches them at his opponent, stabbing and making them fall to the ground.
Shikamaru expands his shadow into five circular fields, four out of the five send out piercing tendrils from beneath the opponents.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_stroke.desc: Isobu (or Yagura while fully transformed into Isobu) can roll into a ball and bulldoze its opponents, making full use of its many spiky protrusions in a manner similar to the Akimichi clan's Spiked Human Bullet Tank. This manoeuvre can also be used to escape attacks.
ability.narutorpg.shadow_sword.desc: Under moonlight, the user can grab at their shadow to manifest a tangible blade to strike with. Unlike Moon Shadow Technique, once created, the blade cannot be dispersed with other sources of light.
ability.narutorpg.shadowneck_binding_tec: This is a variation of the Shadow Imitation Technique, designed for offensive purposes. The user extends their shadow along a target's body, which, because the shadow has physical properties, the target can feel.
ability.narutorpg.shapeshifting_techniqu: Pain allocates a portion of an individual's chakra to a living human sacrifice. This causes the sacrifice to become the individual's identical copy, complete with perfect imitations of the original's kekkei genkai (such as the Sharingan) and unique weapons (such as Samehada).
ability.narutorpg.sharingan.desc: The is the dōjutsu kekkei genkai of the Uchiha clan that appears selectively among its members. It is regarded as one of the "Three Great Dōjutsu", the others being the Byakugan and the Rinnegan.
ability.narutorpg.sharingan_negative_con: Itachi binds the opponent with his Sharingan in confusion.
ability.narutorpg.shark_slaying_slash.de: Kisame charges forward rapidly with his blade drawn, executing a swift slash that leaves a trail of light in its wake. Upon impact, he sheathes his sword as the residual light explodes causing the target to bleed rapidly.
ability.narutorpg.sharp_hair_spear_might: The user extends their hair and hardens it to be as sharp as a spear to pierce through an opponent. It is especially useful against multiple opponents, as it can be used to attack them simultaneously.
ability.narutorpg.shield_of_sand.desc: The Shield of Sand is the first part of Gaara's "Absolute Defence", his Armour of Sand being the second.
ability.narutorpg.shifting_body_techniqu: The user can temporarily increase the size of their body parts or their entire body at will. When using it on their belly, the user can make it spin faster and in great speed. While used on the entire body, the user can easily repel close-range enemy attacks.
ability.narutorpg.shin_uchiha_s_spacetim: Shin Uchiha is able to perform a space–time ninjutsu using his Sharingan.
ability.narutorpg.shining_ostrich_kick.d: Condor, while in the air, slams the opponent down with a powerful kick.
ability.narutorpg.shinra_tensei.desc: Shinra Tensei is a technique used through the Deva Path of the Rinnegan, said to be its pinnacle ability.
ability.narutorpg.shock_wave_blossom.des: Sakura uses her super strength to punch the ground and make it shake, knocking down all the enemies around her.
ability.narutorpg.shock_wave_thrust.desc: After delivering a series of punches to the enemy, Sakura delivers one powerful punch which sends the enemy flying followed by a second punch, which is just as powerful.
ability.narutorpg.short_range_mind_s_eye: Short Range Mind's Eye of the Kagura

Karin uses her Mind's Eye of the Kagura to sense her opponents at a close range. This allows her to sense when a blow is about to connect with her, preventing her from being hit by their melee attacks.
ability.narutorpg.shrike.desc: Itachi and a couple crow clones land a series of punches, kicks, and kunai slashes to the opponent, before stunning them with three thrown kunai, allowing a final crow clone to stab them with one.
ability.narutorpg.shrine_seal.desc: This seal is in the Land of Swamps, and contains the body of the evil spirit Mōryō.
ability.narutorpg.shrine_seal_release.de: After performing the hand seals (or rather, chant them out loud like an incantation), the user releases a dark shock wave that destroys the talismans on the Shrine Seal, and shatters the stone door, releasing Mōryō's entrapped soul.
ability.narutorpg.shuriken_double_knockd: Madara throws a Fūma Shuriken at his opponent, which spins, slicing through flesh, before returning to Madara's hands. He can also deliver a few kicks before throwing the shuriken, or run up and strike while it's spinning. A more powerful version of this attack is performed with two shurikens, attacking from both sides
ability.narutorpg.shuriken_shadow_clone_: This technique was invented by Hiruzen Sarutobi, demonstrating his title as the "Professor" with its conceptualisation and efficiency.
After Hanzō summons Ibuse to toss the opponent into the air and expel poison mist, he sends his kusarigama through the mist and reels it back, slicing the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.sickle_weasel_explosio: Temari punches the opponent into the air, and Shikamaru connects with a kick. Then Shikamaru uses his Shadow Imitation Technique to paralyse the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.sickle_weasel_techniqu: Using her Giant Folding Fan, Temari causes many currents of wind to collide with each other, creating vacuum pockets. On its own, the gust is powerful enough to blow away incoming attacks and knock targets off their feet.
ability.narutorpg.silent_fist.desc: The is a fighting style unique to Shira. With it he is able to render his movements completely silent by cloaking himself in chakra. Neji Hyūga likens its usage to the feathers of an owl, as the chakra cloak makes Shira's movements virtually unpredictable.
ability.narutorpg.silent_killing.desc: As the name suggests, this technique is simply a soundless method of killing an opponent by striking their vital points, usually from behind with a blade. Additionally, because the user moves silently, the attack cannot be anticipated and defended against.
ability.narutorpg.silver_wheel_reincarna: The Silver Wheel Reincarnation Explosion is a powerful technique utilised by Toneri Ōtsutsuki.
Tenma opens the claws of his fiddler crab, charging directly at his target while aiming at the head to cut if off.
ability.narutorpg.six_paths_chakra_rebir: Using Six Paths Chakra, Naruto heals and/or brings back to life any allies in range of him.
ability.narutorpg.six_paths_chibaku_tens: The Six Paths — Chibaku Tensei is a powerful fūinjutsu which can only be used by those who have awakened the Six Paths Senjutsu. It combines the Six Paths Yin and Yang powers.
