ability.narutorpg.towards_the_setting_su: Lee opens several chakra gates and dives into the opponent. He carries them through several mountains before focusing his remaining chakra to brutally drive them through a valley wall.
ability.narutorpg.tracking_technique.des: Upon activation, the user's pupils glow yellow. This allows them to see the lingering energy traces left from a person's footsteps.
ability.narutorpg.transcription_seal_ama: This is a technique that seals the technique Amaterasu within the Sharingan of another person. After being sealed within the person, it is involuntarily activated (indicated by the person's Sharingan taking the form of the sealer's Mangekyō Sharingan) when the eye sees its target, which is predetermined by the user.
ability.narutorpg.transcription_seal_iza: This is a Mangekyō Sharingan technique that seals the technique Izanagi within the Sharingan of the target. After being sealed within the person, it is involuntarily activated when certain requirements, which are predetermined by the user, are met.
ability.narutorpg.transformation_adamant: The user transforms into a staff for their summoner to use as a weapon; Enma's staff form was the preferred weapon of Hiruzen Sarutobi, whose heavy use of it through decades of warfare contributed to his reputation as a "God of Shinobi". The staff is as hard as diamond, making it very destructive.
ability.narutorpg.transformation_techniq: The Transformation Technique allows the user to take the appearance of whatever they choose.
ability.narutorpg.transmission_wood.desc: After turning a wood clone into a seed, the seed can be used to track a target by either planting it on them or having them ingest it. Only the user of this technique can detect the seed's transmissions.
ability.narutorpg.transparent_escape_tec: This technique has never actually been seen in the manga, but it allows the user to spy on others without being noticed. It was invented by Jiraiya during his youth to allow him to spy on girls bathing without the risk of being caught.
ability.narutorpg.trinity.desc: Obito uses Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Fire Technique and Minato throws Flying Thunder God Kunai at the opponent. Kakashi then forms a Chidori and Obito activates his Sharingan and Minato teleports them to the opponent using Flying Thunder God Technique.
ability.narutorpg.triple_strike_breaking: Triple Strike: Breaking Through the Clouds
Asuma delivers three powerful blows to the enemy with his chakra blades, after which he releases a cloud of ash that explodes and burns the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.true_chibaku_tensei.de: The user claps both hands together, forming a black sphere between them, and launches it. The black sphere will then expand and encase a large area. Upon which, it draws in a large quantity of the earth around, effectively creating a "moon" that hovers high in the sky with the consumed area inside.
ability.narutorpg.true_eight_trigrams_si: Neji leaps forward and strikes the opponent several times in the back before dashing in front of them. He strikes several more times until using an Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven-like strike to launch the opponent into the air.
ability.narutorpg.true_fire_of_samadhi.d: This Fire Release technique appears to be initiated remotely upon placing the target in contact with a physical object such as a kunai or even a small toad, and can cause the target to spontaneously burst into flames.
ability.narutorpg.true_rasengan.desc: An enhanced version of the Rasengan, where the user draws more power that lasts for a longer period of time. The Rasengan increases in size to a bigger larger version. When used, the user slowly moves around the area dealing damage to any target in his path. In addition, it absorbs chakra from the user.
ability.narutorpg.true_reverse_lotus.des: After unlocking the sixth of the Eight Gates, Lee pummels his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.true_sand_waterfall_fu: Gaara encases himself in a huge amount of sand, thus creating a giant clone of himself out of sand that will do everything that the engulfed Gaara does. The giant Gaara holds the opponent down and implodes, crushing them. The implosion is so great that it sends a shock wave through the battlefield.
ability.narutorpg.true_several_thousand_: True Several Thousand Hands: Spiralling Praying Palms
Using a massive wooden statue, Asura generates several Amenomihashira on its many hands and unleashes them upon his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.true_shadow_seizing_te: Sending his shadow towards his opponent, it will then crawl up the opponent's body until a shadow-hand reaches the opponent's neck, and breaks it.
ability.narutorpg.true_sickle_weasel_tec: Temari summons Kamatari, who then creates a stronger and larger version of her Sickle Weasel Technique. The wind vortex can reach opponents farther away from her than her original technique.
ability.narutorpg.true_supreme_ultimate_: Naruto hits the opponent with a Rasengan, with Minato and Kushina adding their chakra to Naruto's palm to enhance the strength of his Rasengan which pushes the opponent far away, resulting in an explosion.
ability.narutorpg.true_tailed_beast_rase: Naruto punches his opponent with a tailed beast chakra arm, sending them up in the air and putting some distance between them. He fully manifests Kurama, and creates nine shadow clones, each creating a different Rasenshuriken.
ability.narutorpg.trump_card_of_pair.des: Naruto creates several shadow clones to charge towards and beat the opponent before kicking the opponent into the air. Naruto and Sasuke each form a Rasengan and Chidori that they both use on the falling opponent.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_ball.des: Truth-Seeking Balls are orbs of malleable black chakra, which can alter their form and characteristics in various ways. Though only the size of a fist, each hides within it the power to obliterate an entire forest.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_ball_cyc: The user encases themselves in a Truth-Seeking Ball shell to protect them from any incoming attack. They can also control the shell to ram enemies around them.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_body_fli: Obito forms one or two blades from his Truth-Seeking Balls attached to his hands and instantly passes through the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_chaos_bu: Hagoromo uses his Truth-Seeking Balls to shoot bright blue bullets of chakra at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_kick.des: Naruto combines his Truth-Seeking Balls and kicks the single large ball towards the opponent with great force.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_pure_sha: Obito encases himself in a Truth-Seeking Ball shelling, which he uses to hit the opponent numerous times.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_ruined_e: Madara sends out three Truth-Seeking Balls in front of him to shoot beams of chakra at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_saving_l: Obito fires a Truth-Seeking Ball at the opponent, which lights up and expands, releasing a large explosion. Once released, the ball returns to him.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_scorched: Obito merges his Truth-Seeking Balls into a single sphere in front of himself, and unleashes a beam at his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_sever.de: Obito forms two scythe-like weapons from the Truth-Seeking Balls to swipe at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_shining_: Obito forms four large interconnected arms that spin around shooting beams of chakra.
ability.narutorpg.truth_seeking_umbrella: Obito uses a Truth-Seeking Ball to shape it into a spear-like weapon, impaling any far off opponents.
ability.narutorpg.tsuchigumo_style_forbi: Tsuchigumo Style: Forbidden Life Technique Release: Creation of Heaven and Earth

This technique releases the seal on the Fury technique and then accumulates natural energy from the earth and atmosphere to be used for the technique. The bearer of the seal acts as a passive vessel, continuously gathering natural energy, which makes it possible to use Fury without their cooperation.
ability.narutorpg.tsukuyomi.desc: Tsukuyomi is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu and one of the most powerful genjutsu in existence. Said to represent the , it is the antipode to Amaterasu.
ability.narutorpg.tsukuyomi_mode.desc: This technique is a variation of Tsukuyomi, a high-level genjutsu. The user transforms the Tsukuyomi into a barrier that slows the opponent down. This does not happen physically but rather mentally. It makes the opponent think they are being held back by a barrier.
ability.narutorpg.turbulent_four_seasons: Itachi and Shisui both attack their opponent with Fire Release: Great Dragon Fire Technique. Through the blazing fire, Itachi launches a barrage of kunai at them. Afterwards, Shisui appears behind the opponent, grabbing one of the kunai and in unison with Itachi launch a flurry of attacks with a kunai each in hand.
ability.narutorpg.turning_into_a_frog_te: By touching the forehead of a target and then, according to a mental image the user forms, the target changes into a tree frog. This is mainly used for interrogating several prisoners of war.
ability.narutorpg.twin_fangs_slash.desc: Using their Kunai Blades, Izumo and Kotetsu attack the enemy from two sides and pierce them through.
ability.narutorpg.twin_metal_rods_shootd: Tenten summons a twin-ended Wolf Teeth Mace that is the size of a human.
ability.narutorpg.twin_pole_heavely_drop: After separating, Sakon and Ukon place themselves so that their opponent is in between them. They both lunge at the opponent, switching places and knocking them into the air. While the opponent is airborne, they jump into the air, and both grab an opponent's arm.
ability.narutorpg.twin_rising_dragons.de: The Twin Rising Dragons is a technique created by Tenten that takes advantage of her pinpoint accuracy.
ability.narutorpg.twin_rising_dragons_se: Tenten jumps in the air and opens her giant scroll, releasing a smoke dragon hiding a large number of weapons that she rains down on her opponent.
ability.narutorpg.twin_snakes_mutual_dea: This technique was taught to Anko Mitarashi by Orochimaru. The user grabs one of their intended victim's hands and forces it to assist in performing the necessary hand seals. Once this is done, the user and the victim die, which Rin no Sho likens to a lovers' double-suicide.
ability.narutorpg.twin_swallow_cut.desc: Tenten repeatedly hits her opponent with a pair of tonfa, then strikes them into the air with a three-section staff which she separates to deliver a final blow to the falling opponent.
ability.narutorpg.twin_swift_rasengan.de: Firstly, Jiraiya performs a single Rasengan, deforming the ground. After a moment, while the first one is still in contact with the opponent, he creates a larger Rasengan and combines both of them. Due to the massive power, the slightly deformed ground gets destroyed.
ability.narutorpg.twinkling_maiden_s_hea: Sakura smiles at her opponent before glaring and summoning her giant inner self. Inner Sakura yells "I'm speaking from the heart!" as she punches her opponent. The screen shatters, revealing it all to have been a genjutsu and Sakura herself punched her opponent. The foe flies off into the distance.
ability.narutorpg.twinsword_technique_cr: Chōjūrō unleashes his Hiramekarei, forming a hammer, with which he attacks his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.twinsword_technique_cu: Chōjūrō unleashes his Hiramekarei, forming a long-sword, with which he slices his opponent.
The user gathers their Truth-Seeking Balls to shape them into a drill to drill the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.two_calm_kusanagi.desc: Sasuke first hits the opponent into the air. Orochimaru spits his Kusanagi to Sasuke, and it slashes the opponent on the way. Sasuke grabs the Kusanagi with his free hand and jumps towards the opponent, slicing them repeatedly with his and Orochimaru's swords.
ability.narutorpg.two_lights_beams_of_ku: Entering the first stage of the Jinchūriki form, Kinkaku and Ginkaku deliver several powerful blows to the enemy with increased strength and speed, after which they begin to spin like tops and, pinning the enemy from both sides, destroy them.
ability.narutorpg.two_rays_of_light_amon: Two Rays of Light Among the Clouds

Ginkaku and Kinkaku stand on the front and back sides of the opponent, the former starting by releasing a fire ball with Bashōsen, following with the latter using the suction of Benihisago to kick the opponent and then finishing them by raising the opponent with earth through Bashōsen and channeling electricity through
ability.narutorpg.two_tailed_cat_flame_i: Matatabi begins to build up a Tailed Beast Ball while Yugito attacks the enemy with quick slashes from her long claws, after which the Tailed Beast Ball hits the enemy, and in the finale, Yugito, having coated her sword in Matatabi's blue chakra, delivers a double strike, leaving a trail of chakra behind.
ability.narutorpg.two_tails_exploding_or: Matatabi creates large orbs of flame-like chakra, similar to the flame covering its body. It then manipulates these orbs in order to chase the enemy before they explode. Enemies hit by the explosions of one of these orbs will have their offensive capabilities lowered for a time.
ability.narutorpg.typhoon_flame_formatio: Hagoromo surrounds himself in raging winds, which he promptly ignites.
ability.narutorpg.typhoon_impact.desc: Asura expels a gust of slashing wind that swirls towards the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.typhoon_release_consec: Typhoon Release: Consecutive Bursting Strong Winds
A Typhoon Release technique used by Nowaki through his kekkei genkai.
ability.narutorpg.typhoon_release_great_: Typhoon Release: Great Consecutive Bursting Extreme Winds

Nowaki summons a massive tornado, intense enough to not only dwarf Sasuke Uchiha's Complete Body — Susanoo, but to also be capable of forcing it to the defensive. Despite its power, the technique has an exploitable flaw. The user is left defenseless at the eye of the storm.
ability.narutorpg.typhoon_rotating.desc: The user gathers wind to create a large tornado that swirls towards the opponent. The user can also form the tornado beneath the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.typhoon_water_vortex_t: This cooperation ninjutsu uses the wild rotation of the thrown Wind Release: Rasengan to swallow up the water current created by the Water Release: Tearing Torrent, creating a large quantity of water vapour. Once invoked, a strong wind whirls around inside the highly concentrated mist, turning it into a solid barrier.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_blaze_sword_fir: The user breathes a fireball and then slices through the opponent with their sword.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_cherry_blossom_: Sasuke manifests his Complete Body Susanoo, striking the opponent with its sword, which launches several portions of the floor in the air. Sakura jumps between these floor portions to close the distance with the target, punching them back towards the ground. Sarada finishes it by landing a Chidori.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_family_trinity_: Sasuke and Sarada expel two fireballs, following with Sakura jumping down on the opponent with a powerful punch.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_flame_formation: After manifesting small chakra flames on each finger of one hand, the user then slams their palm on the ground, resulting in the creation of a cylindrical barrier of flames enveloping a location of their choosing. Should the enemy come into contact with the barrier's exterior, they will be quickly set ablaze.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_imprisonment_se: During the Warring States Period, the Uchiha clan would place seal tags surrounding where they are imprisoning their captives. If the prisoners were to touch the bars in their prison, they would catch fire. Any attempts at using ninjutsu would drain the prisoner's chakra.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_return.desc: By utilising the Gunbai Uchiwa to block an incoming attack, the user nullifies the effects of the attack by converting the incoming chakra into Wind nature transformation, which is then reflected.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_shuriken_format: Sarada attacks her opponent with a Fire Release: Phoenix Sage Fire Technique. She jumps out of the smoke, and with her Sharingan, she throws out several shuriken, which ricochet from one another, hitting her target. She finishes them off with a Thunderclap Drill.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_shurikenjutsu_s: Sarada jumps high and throws an explosive tag laden Fūma Shuriken at her opponents, while also throwing healing seal laden kunai at her allies.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_style_blade_tec: By continuously flowing chakra into it, this technique increases the blade's sharpness and durability, preventing it from chipping. At the same time, it is a delicate technique, requiring constant focus to keep active.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_style_dance_of_: Uchiha Style: Dance of the Sun Halo
Shisui coats his tantō in fire and with a quick gesture unleashes a wave of flame towards the opponent.
Uchiha Style: Dance of the Sun Halo – Flame Formation
Itachi slashes the opponent with his sword coated in flames, following with putting them under a genjutsu where they are hit with flame twisters.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_style_four_dire: Shisui powers up his tantō with Fire Release and, using the Body Flicker Technique, attacks the enemy from four sides, burning them with a fiery blade.
The is a unique style of kenjutsu developed and mastered by Sasuke Uchiha, who passed on the skill to his student Boruto.
ability.narutorpg.uchiha_style_shurikenj: Shisui plants a closed Fūma Shuriken into the ground, connected to him by a string. When he pulls on it, the shuriken flies back to him while spinning, fanned out and hitting any opponents on the way back.
The user throws three shuriken, infused with Lightning Release chakra, at the opponent. The addition of lightning-natured chakra increases the lethality and cutting power of the weapons.
ability.narutorpg.ukon_s_mad_dance.desc: Ukon separates from Sakon, kicking the opponent and then finishing them by slicing them with his claws.
ability.narutorpg.ultimate_art_game.desc: While riding his C2 Dragon, Deidara creates a clay clone and the clone strikes down on the opponent from the sky, Deidara sets off the clone causing a huge explosion.
ability.narutorpg.ultimate_death_beyond_: After riding on one of Kakuzu's masked beasts towards the enemy, Hidan slashes the opponent with his scythe and curses them with his Curse Technique: Death Controlling Possessed Blood.
ability.narutorpg.ultimate_poison_scatte: While transformed as Saiken, Utakata releases poisonous gas around himself, poisoning any opponent in close proximity.
ability.narutorpg.ultimate_reverse_lotus: This technique is almost identical to True Reverse Lotus, but Guy slams the opponent down and then tosses them into the air, instead of just kicking them into the air. The light beams are also larger and the punch used at the end is much more intense.
ability.narutorpg.ultimate_summoning_bea: This genjutsu, which is emitted from the beast's eyes, sends rainbow-coloured rays to the targets which immobilises them.
ability.narutorpg.ultimately_hard_absolu: Ultimately Hard Absolute Attack: Sand Waterfall Spear Interment
Gaara claps his hands together, causing a giant mound of sand to rise up from below the opponent, trapping and restraining every part of their body except for the head.
Ultimately Hard Absolute Attack: Spear of Shukaku

The Spear of Shukaku is the attack counterpart of the Shield of Shukaku. Like the shield, Gaara crushes the hardest materials from the ground using sand, this time in the form of a halberd, in the shape of the Shukaku's hand.
Ultimately Hard Absolute Defence: Shield of Shukaku

Using his chakra, Gaara gathers the densest minerals in the soil, compresses their size, and then mixes them together. The resulting sand is formed into a protective shield in front of Gaara, shaped to resemble a miniature Shukaku, the .
ability.narutorpg.ultra_big_ball_rasenga: The Ultra-Big Ball Rasengan is a more powerful version of the Big Ball Rasengan.

While possessing Boruto's body, Momoshiki creates three shadow clones to fire Spiralling Bullets at the opponent. The clones then pin them down while Momoshiki creates a large Rasengan to slam down on them.
ability.narutorpg.ultra_fast_regeneratio: The user gathers a large quantity of chakra to rapidly regenerate any damage done to the body.
ability.narutorpg.ultra_many_spiralling_: After creating a multitude of shadow clones, Naruto and his clones each create a Rasengan to bombard their target with devastating effects.
ability.narutorpg.ultra_viscous_slime_ba: Hiruko used strange viscous liquid in his surrounding during the eclipse immortality ritual. He's able to manipulate the viscosity of the liquid, so he can control it. The movement of the liquid is similar to a metal spring. These chunks of liquid can hit an enemy with enough force to temporarily knock them out.
ability.narutorpg.umbrella_shock_wave.de: After swinging his umbrella, Aoi produces a torrent of water large enough to attack a group of targets. The pressure generated is strong enough to ground his target and crack stone.
ability.narutorpg.uncontrollable_power.d: After entering his initial jinchūriki form, Naruto creates a giant claw out of Kurama's chakra, and slashes the opponent. Afterwards, he enters his Version 2 state.
ability.narutorpg.unite.desc: Mecha-Naruto attaches his mechanical body to Naruto, who wears him as sort of a mechanised suit. Doing this gives the wearer added strength and a few added abilities.
ability.narutorpg.unknown_ability.desc: Tobi teleports behind the opponent and prepares to throw a bomb, only to accidentally drop it at his feet. As he quickly makes a run for it, the bomb detonates, creating a huge explosion.
ability.narutorpg.unsealing_technique.de: A technique used by shinobi to unseal what was sealed within a scroll, or in the anime, a sheet of paper.
ability.narutorpg.unsealing_technique_pa: Using a piece of paper with a sealing formula on it, the user generates thousands of tiny pieces of paper to engulf the target, robbing them of their sight and enabling the user to hide in their presence.
ability.narutorpg.unsealing_technique_se: Tenten summons a large segmented iron dome from one of her scrolls to shield herself or allies from incoming attacks. The dome resembles the shell of an armadillo.
ability.narutorpg.unsealing_technique_sh: Using the sealing formula contained on a sheet of paper or a scroll, the user summons multiple shuriken from it, which are launched directly at the target.
ability.narutorpg.unstoppable_blade_shur: The user throws the Kubikiribōchō at the opponent like a shuriken.
ability.narutorpg.uzumaki_formation.desc: Naruto creates twelve shadow clones, each armed with a kunai, forming a defensive circle, with Naruto in the middle, all prepared for the enemy to strike. The Naruto clones will throw the kunai at the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.uzumaki_sealing_techni: After forming the necessary hand seals, the user slams their hand on the ground after which a sealing formula, that originates from the user's hand, forming underneath the target. When the seal activates, anything above the inscription is sealed within the formula itself.
ability.narutorpg.uzumaki_twin_striking_: Boruto, Naruto, and Hinata charge at their opponent. Boruto accidentally drops his Extreme: Shinobi Picture Scrolls cards, rushing to recover a specific card, while Naruto helps him.
ability.narutorpg.vacuum_sword.desc: The user swings their sword and a gust of wind is released in the arc that it was swung in. The technique is strong enough to stop projectiles that are thrown at the user.
ability.narutorpg.vanishing_facial_copy_: The user applies their hand to a target's face, allowing them to take the face and use it as their own. Because it's the actual face that they're using and not a disguise, the user runs no risk of being discovered due to imperfections or minor flaws.
ability.narutorpg.vanishing_many_spirall: Boruto creates four shadow clones that form Vanishing Rasengans that are thrown at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.vanishing_rasengan.des: The Vanishing Rasengan is a Lightning Release version of the Rasengan, that was created by Boruto Uzumaki, and named by Sasuke Uchiha.
ability.narutorpg.vanishing_rasengan_wax: The user forms a medium sized Vanishing Rasengan and fires it at the opponent, vanishing and then reappearing upon hit. Targets close to it will be drawn into the jutsu. Charging it further will increase its size, damage, and drawing radius.
ability.narutorpg.very_hiden_venomous_in: Torune lands a series of hits on the opponent, poisoning them with his rinkaichū.
ability.narutorpg.veteran_taijutsu.desc: When in front of the opponent, Chiyo kicks them and finishes with a spinning upward kick.
ability.narutorpg.violent_arm.desc: The user enlarges their fist and stretches their arm out, swinging in a punch.
ability.narutorpg.violent_headspinner.de: Karin gets up close to her opponent and does a combo of violent slaps.
ability.narutorpg.violent_heavenly_earth: After using the Earth Release: Earth Flow Wave technique to shape and form the earth, the user creates a large needle out of it to impale the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.violent_leaf_adamantin: Guy deals a severe roundhouse kick to his opponent after entering his Eight Gates state.
ability.narutorpg.violent_stabbing_face_: Karin charges and slaps her opponent with a explosive tag. The force of the slap knocks the opponent across the field, and the explosive tag detonates after the opponent hits the ground.
ability.narutorpg.violent_whirlwind.desc: The user produces a powerful stream of wind from their mouth. This technique was powerful enough to dispel several shadow clones in an instant.
ability.narutorpg.viscous_water_mass.des: Nurari is able to manipulate the strange liquid from his special suit. He is able to contort his body in various ways and even summon extra limbs.
ability.narutorpg.watch_your_steps.desc: Kushina creates a barrier seal on the ground. If the opponent steps on the barrier seal, two frying pans appear in the sky and fall on the opponent, knocking them unconscious.
ability.narutorpg.watchful_eye_s_torrent: Kakuzu uses his Earth Grudge Fear to lift his opponent into the air with his threads. He then use his masks to attack the opponent with a triple elemental blast of lightning, fire and wind.
ability.narutorpg.water_attacking_gorgon: This technique will summon a large amount of water that will then be used to strike at the opponent in several versatile ways. Shizuku has been known to transform it into a dragon with a gaping mouth to attack. The water used will be stationary till it is sent offensively toward the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.water_balloon_techniqu: Gengetsu creates a puddle of water mixed with oil, which he uses to produce bubbles that float up into the air. On his command, the bubbles launch themselves toward Gengetsu's enemy with such speed and force, they can cause great blunt-force trauma upon bursting.
ability.narutorpg.water_characters.desc: This technique allows one to send messages through water. By throwing water on a surface, even a vertical one, the water will rearrange itself into a readable message, which will fade after a while.
ability.narutorpg.water_clone_combo.desc: Attacking the opponent with a series of punches and kicks to force them backwards, Tobirama then creates a small pool of water from which a clone of himself emerges.
This technique originates from Kirigakure. Using water from the surroundings, the user creates one or more copies of themselves. Unlike the standard Clone Technique, these water clones are physically real, allowing them to interact with others and even perform the same jutsu as the user.
ability.narutorpg.water_droplet_reflecti: By dilating her pupils, Yome is able to track down enemies via the reflection on tiny water droplets. According to Sen, once Yome has fixated her sight, her visual range reaches several dozen kilometres. Yome can also use this ability to augment her evasion-skills during combat.
ability.narutorpg.water_flow_sensing_tec: The user is able to create a stream of water that enables them to sense the surroundings of the flow of water. The technique presumably causes great strain to the user, as prolonged usage caused sweating and a bloody nose.
ability.narutorpg.water_gun_quick_shot.d: Gengetsu jumps up in midair and fires several water bullets at his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.water_gun_technique.de: The Water Gun Technique is a technique used by the Hōzuki clan.
ability.narutorpg.water_gun_technique_on: Gengetsu jumps and creates a few water bullets, shooting the opponent with them in quick succession.
ability.narutorpg.water_gun_technique_tw: Gengetsu creates a barrage of water bullets and sends them at the opponent. Then he forms one big water bullet and shoots the opponent with it.
ability.narutorpg.water_gun_two_guns.des: A more lethal version of the Water Gun Technique, where, instead of using one hand, the user uses both hands and fires two powerful shots of water simultaneously as if dual-wielding. This technique was powerful enough to destroy part of Tobi's face.
ability.narutorpg.water_mirror_colliding: Hagoromo forms a mirror of water, which breaks up into small projectiles of water that are shot at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.water_needle.desc: Using the chakra control granted by the Gentle Fist, Hinata concentrates her chakra until water vortexes are created around her. Those vortexes shoot water blasts which turn to needle-like water. By using Byakugan, this technique can be used with great precision to hit very small targets such as bees.
ability.narutorpg.water_palm_blade.desc: Tobirama attacks the opponent with a combination of taijutsu and Water Release.
ability.narutorpg.water_pillar_thrust.de: Tobirama uses his mastery of the Water Release to materialise a small body of water to rise up beneath the opponent and thrusting them into the air.
ability.narutorpg.water_prison_bead_bind: After thrusting their palm out, the user creates a large bubble in front of them, which then disperse into smaller Water Prison Technique traps when targets are near enough to it.
ability.narutorpg.water_prison_shark_dan: After using the Water Release: Great Exploding Water Colliding Wave, Kisame forms the water into a gigantic prison.
ability.narutorpg.water_prison_technique: This technique traps a target in a sphere of water; the water can either be drawn from the surroundings or expelled from the user's mouth. The water that the sphere is made from is noticeably heavy, which restricts the target's movements and can make breathing difficult.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_a_thousa: Water Release: A Thousand Feeding Sharks
A much more powerful version of the Water Release: Five Feeding Sharks, where the user creates one thousand sharks out of water that replicates a giant wave to swarm down and attack the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_angry_bi: After water has been shot into the air, such as with the Water Release: Water Bullet Technique, this jutsu turns the water black. When the black water falls on a target it clings to their body and covers their eyes, blocking their vision.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_archerfi: The user simply creates a jet of water that can be used to extinguish fire.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_azure_dr: Ao dashes towards his opponent pushing his hands forward and when his hands come in contact with them, he unleashes a spiralling torrent of water.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_black_ra: This technique creates a flammable black mist that forms a small cloud. The user can then move the cloud above their target and disperse it, covering the target in flammable oil. This technique was first used to burn down Idate Morino's boat, after it was lit with fire.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_blood_co: The user extracts all the blood in their target to convert into pure water, causing the victims to shrivel into dry husks which results in their immediate death. This technique is useful if there are no nearby sources of water to perform ninjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_bubbles_: Water Release: Bubbles Technique

After blowing dozens of bubbles, the user manipulates them to surround the enemy in all directions. Only the slightest amount of physical contact with an opponent is required to make these bubbles burst, resulting in a small but powerful explosion when they do.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Broad Defence
Utakata uses his Soap Bubble Ninjutsu to create a dome around himself and his allies. This dome is shown to be strong enough to resist large explosions.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Combo
Utakata jumps up in the air and blows six bubbles, four miniature and two large ones. The first five merely stun his opponent, and the last one knocks them far back.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Drift

Utakata creates a single, particularly large bubble with his bubble pipe and quickly jumps inside. Under his command, the bubble will take him wherever he wishes. It's seemingly very capable of both travelling very long distances and floating rather high into the air with no apparent risk of popping.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Galaxy
Utakata transforms into Saiken and spews popping bubbles at the opponent, finishing with a Tailed Beast Ball.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Great River
Transformed as Saiken, Utakata swipes one of his tails at his opponent, followed by two shots of corrosive alkali, and finishes it with a volley of bubbles.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Ink

Using his bubble-blower, Utakata sends a rush of bubbles toward his enemies, who are subsequently encased in a large bubble, which then appears to fill up with a black liquid. The bubble then pops in a black inky splash, obliterating them and leaving no sign of a corpse behind.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Mountain Wind

Utakata blows several bubbles at his opponent, stunning them, ending it with a single great bubble. Upon the great bubble bursting, it turns into several smaller bubbles, which coalesce into an even great bubble on top of his opponent, and floors them.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Ripples
Utakata strikes his opponent using his bubble pipe, followed by two empty-handed swipes, and finishes it with a volley of bubbles.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Rise
Utakata blows a series of bubbles at his opponent, each stunning them, ending it with a downwards cluster of bubbles, which multiply at their feet, throwing them up in the air.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Twist
Utakata blows a series of bubbles at his opponent, each one leaving his opponent stunned, ending it with a great cluster of rotating bubbles, which knocks his opponent back.
Water Release: Bubbles Technique — Wrap
Utakata blows a great bubble near his opponent, trapping them inside it. He then snaps his fingers, bursting the bubble and damaging his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_bullet_o: The user sends a huge surge of water crashing down onto the enemy, which restricts their movements, given the intensity and pressure of the waves produced.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_clear_mi: Water Release: Clear Mirror Still Water
Kagura creates a clear mirror out of water to serve as a shield for incoming attacks.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_cold_sky: Water Release: Cold Sky Water Attack
The user shoots numerous amount of extremely large jets of water from their mouth at high speeds which can easily shatter rock.
The user condenses the water vapour in the air to fire multiple blasts of water at the target.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_droplet_: Mei attacks her opponents with several water orbs, which converge on top of them and come crashing down in the form of spears.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_explodin: Water Release: Exploding Water Colliding Wave

The user spits out a great volume of water from their mouth, swallowing up and crushing the enemy with the advancing surge. The user can ride the wave, allowing them to move at high speed, and attack the enemy, now swept off their feet.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_falling_: By using the existing rain around them, the user infuses their chakra into the individual raindrops, sharpening them into ultra-thin needles to fall down and skew their targets.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_five_fee: The user puts their hand on the surface of a body of water and from the tips of five fingers, chakra is released into the water, changing it into the form of five ferocious sharks.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_five_glu: Kisame slashes a body of water, creating a pillar of water that launches the opponent into the air. He then releases five water sharks that attack the opponent until one devours them before imploding, launching the opponent into the air.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_four_sha: Kisame slams his palm onto a nearby water surface, sending a large surge of water into the air. This water then forms into a group of four water sharks, which then rush towards the target from above.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_furious_: The user draws on nearby water sources to create a large waterspout, capable of tearing through an area with ease. The user must be inside the waterspout in order to control it.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_genjutsu: Water Release Genjutsu: Demonic Phantom Fog Prison
After Kandachi performs the necessary hand seals, the Conch King opens its shell and releases a mist that puts the opponent under a genjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_great_ex: Water Release: Great Exploding Water Colliding Wave
This technique is a larger version of the Water Release: Exploding Water Colliding Wave. With it, the user spews out a massive amount of water, covering an entire area with a ferocious tsunami.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_great_gu: The user spits out a giant pressurised bullet of water from their mouth that goes through and damages the opponent as it hits them.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_great_sh: Water Release: Great Shark Bullet Technique
The Water Release: Great Shark Bullet Technique is a stronger version of the Water Release: Water Shark Bullet Technique.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_great_wa: Water Release: Great Water Arm Technique

By putting the Hydrification Technique into practical use, the muscles of the arm are temporarily enlarged and strengthened. Moisture is gathered from the whole body and compressed into the entire arm, like an instant pump-up.
Water Release: Great Water Arm Technique: Half-Moon Cut

Suigetsu enlarges his arm muscles by using the Water Release: Great Water Arm Technique, then proceeds to use Kubikiribōchō to deliver a straight cut to the opponent, followed up by a moonslice that causes water to erupt from the ground.
Kisame coats Samehada in water, and forms it into the shape of a drill. After drilling the opponent into the ground the water spreads out into a tsunami that drenches the battlefield.
Water Release: Great Water Leg Technique

By isolating the application of the Hydrification Technique, the user's legs can expand and increase in muscle mass. This proportionately increases the user's range and raw strength in their leg attacks as well as accelerated movement in linear paths.
Water Release: Great Water Mass Bullet
Isobu, or Yagura while taking on its form, releases water balls of varying size. These large water projectiles are also powerful enough to destroy an entire cliff side.
Water Release: Great Waterfall Flow Technique
By mixing a source of water with chakra, the user can create a whirlpool of differentiating sizes in order to drown their opponent.

A large volume of water is directed from a preexisting source or expelled from the mouth dozens of metres high into the air; to manipulate so much water at once requires a great deal of chakra. Once high enough, it cascades down onto the targeted area, resembling a giant waterfall.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_great_wh: Water Release: Great Whirlpool Enfolding Technique

Kisame uses a nearby water supply to create a giant water vortex around his Samehada. Kisame wields the vortex as a weapon and then jumps above his opponent and uses his sword to smash the vortex into his targets causing massive damage.
The user creates water in their body using chakra. The user then spits the water from their mouth as orb-shaped projectiles, whose destructive potential are determined by how much chakra is placed in them. The orbs travel quickly towards the target, dealing extensive damage upon impact.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_hail.des: Chino gathers water into large clumps in the shape of massive orb-like formations and then drops them from the sky on to her opponents. The attack covers a large range, making it difficult to dodge.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_hail_bar: This technique freezes water into twelve jagged chunks of hail.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_hard_whi: Water Release: Hard Whirlpool Water Blade

The user makes the water under their opponent explode, launching them into the air. They then jump above them, creating a large whirlpool around their arm that gets concentrated into a water lance, that strikes their opponent.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_hiding_i: Water Release: Hiding in Drizzle Technique
The user generates drizzle to hide themselves and/or their comrades in it. However, the technique is useless in areas with little moisture, as it prevents it from taking effect.
Water Release: Hiding in Rain Technique
The user blends in with the rain to be near by the enemy. When used by Tsurugi, he can summon rain around him at will.
Water Release: Hiding in Water Technique

A technique that allows the user to fuse with water, even in water as shallow as a puddle. By doing so, the user can take advantage of their hidden presence and launch a surprise attack on their target.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_hydrific: Water Release: Hydrification Exploding Funeral Technique

The user dissolves into a big pool of water, engulfing the opponent, then emerges from beneath the opponent's feet and explodes. As the user is able to turn their entire body into water, they do not sustain damage and are able to re-assemble after detonation.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_imminent: The user generates a powerful stream of water that becomes a vortex, able to overwhelm several targets at once. It is able to move with such sudden change in direction as to leave opponents disoriented as they struggle to anticipate it.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_infinite: Kisame creates an orb of water that releases countless water sharks that rapidly assault the opponent. If the orb is released underwater, the strength of the sharks is greatly enhanced and all of them colliding with the target will result in an enormous implosion.
The user holds their arm out with their palms flat at target, launching a powerful stream of water to push them back.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_large_pr: When in Kaima Form, the user is able to attack with a giant blast of water by spitting it as a strong stream from their mouth.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_lotus_li: The user creates drops of water from an outside source, which are then shaped into razor-sharp lotus petals. As the petals expand in size and spin around, emitting explosive energy in every direction, they are launched at the opponent. The petals can be controlled and are able to kill a man with a single petal.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_mouth_sh: A technique where the user spits out a single senbon-shaped droplet of water with high velocity which is hard to avoid. Once the droplet hits anything, it forcefully bursts and injures the target.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_multiple: Water Release: Multiple Water Spirit Wave
An upgraded version of the single-shot technique, the user cups their hands together while points bother their index fingers at the target, mimicking a gun with their fingers.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_pillar_e: The user creates four large water pillars which then circle around the user as a protective barrier.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_raging_j: Funamushi creates a giant water jellyfish, which he rides and controls. With its tentacles, it can cause widespread destruction and attack multiple targets at once. Funamushi only employed it in combat when he had access to a significant amount of water provided by rainfall.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_rampagin: Gamabunta shoots a stream of water from his mouth. This technique appears to tire him.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_rapid_th: Water Release: Rapid Thunder Whip Technique

The user dips their first two fingers into a source of water making a long rope of water rise out from said source. The whip is as sharp as a sword being able to cleanly slice through trees and wrap opponents up. Lightning chakra is also channeled through the whip.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_rising_w: The user summons a linear wave of water that shoots outward from the ground at high speeds to its target. It is strong enough to slice clean through rock.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_running_: After attacking the opponent with multiple water attacks, Mei shapes the remaining water into a spear that strikes them upwards.
After kneading chakra in her mouth, Mei converts it into water before expelling from her mouth in the form a whip, which she uses to lash at her opponent, sending them flying back.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_scatteri: Gengetsu sends a wide volley of water bullets at his opponent, delivering several sequential hits.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_snake_s_: The user generates a spinning column of water which takes the form of a snake with a gaping jaw. This snake can twist and follow its targets and swallow them. After it has swallowed them, it turns into a river that carries the targets away.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_starch_s: Water Release: Starch Syrup Capturing Field

The user expels high viscosity water to cover the ground. This stream of sticky liquid can be used to form an adhesive trap that will inhibit a person's mobility. One can effectively reduce their enemy's area of activity with this technique, giving the user an advantage on the battlefield.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_stormy_b: This technique allows the user to summon a massive amount of water from the sky, crashing it onto the opponent. If needed, the user can cancel the technique in an instant.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_submerge: Water Release: Submerged Shark Scraping Destruction

Kisame spits a lake of water near the opponent from which water sharks come out and force them up. Kisame then jumps up and slashes the opponent back into the lake, where they are devoured by the sharks.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_surfing_: The user creates water underneath their feet in the form of a wave and then proceeds to ride it directly towards the opponent, sending the crashing waves to attack them.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_surging_: After kneading chakra in their stomach and converting it, the user expels a large surge of water from their mouth.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_tate_ebo: After using his Hydrification Technique to merge with a water source, Suigetsu can form a giant wave that resembles a demon-like fish. Suigetsu can use this form to battle larger opponents, or he can use it to shield allies from attack.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_tearing_: This technique creates water that spirals in the user's hand which fires at a high speed towards the enemy. In the anime, it was also shown to be able to be conjured from the surrounding area in the form of a torrential wave.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_torrent_: The user creates a powerful vortex of water and unleashes it on the target.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_transfor: Suien has a durable, jelly-like substance flow onto his enemy. This substance binds, blinds and suffocates the victim.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_ar: Suien covers the entirety of his body with chakra-infused water, making it like a sturdy suit of armour. It can withstand most physical attacks suffered.
Water Release: Water Army Water Demon Technique
This technique gathers a large amount of water to form a large spiralling stream of water. It can be guided to strike a target in a number of angles.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_be: The user manipulates water and transforms it into a giant wolf-like beast. The beast can launch powerful streams of water from its mouth, or sweep the area with its claws to let a powerful torrent of water to wash the enemies away.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_bi: The user produces large tendrils from behind. They are highly malleable, able to twist and constrict as needed. They are also very strong, able to easily lift and subdue a grown man, potentially able to crush their victims.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_bl: The user forms a hand seal and raises a column of underground water from beneath their feet, which takes the shape of a high-pressured water blade. If one were to take a direct hit from the blade, it would cut clean through flesh and bone.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_bo: This technique transforms the user's entire form into water and back at will, granting the user free control of their shape, including slipping through small cracks. This technique allows for high-level infiltration and stealth.
The user emits a continuous jet of water from their hand to strike the enemy and disrupt their attack. Due to the nature of water, this technique works especially well against smoke-based attacks.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_bu: The user spits several blade-like projectiles, strong enough to penetrate protective armor.

The Water Release: Water Bullet Technique is a highly versatile Water Release technique with many variations. After kneading chakra in their stomach, the user expels a large quantity of water in the form of a powerful torrent aimed towards their intended target.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_co: The user creates a massive vortex of water that protects the user from attacks. It explodes from the top of it in the form of a wave that travels at high velocity, covering the entire battlefield. The impact of the technique is similar to a huge tsunami.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_cu: The user slams their hands on the ground, causing a torrent of water to erupt. It sturdy enough for grown men to run across.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_dr: Water Release: Water Dragon Biting Explosion

Tobirama creates a large pool of water that, after firing the enemy into the air, shoots numerous water bullets at them and then finishes by forming the water bullets into a water dragon which attacks the target, sending them crashing into the ground.
Water Release: Water Dragon Bullet Technique
The user moulds water into the shape of a dragon, which they then direct at a target. The water crashes upon the target, dealing significant physical damage.
The user creates a small reservoir from which three water dragons are formed, attacking several opponents at once in different directions.
Water Release: Water Dragon Triple Step Technique
An advanced version of the Water Release: Water Dragon Bullet Technique, where the user launches three water dragons at the target instead of one.

This technique creates an orb of water from which many sharp whips of water emerge that can be directed towards and impale a target or multiple targets. The whips can also change direction in mid-trajectory, bending to seek out the targets.
Water Release: Water Dragon Whirlpool Technique
Gengetsu creates a barrage of water bullets and shoots the opponent in successive hits. Then he creates a whirlpool and sends it to the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_fa: The user forms projectiles underwater; the water that the projectiles are made of is highly pressurised because of how compact they are. The projectiles are then shot from the water at high speeds at the user's target, which can be made more lethal by adding a spinning motion.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_fo: By gathering water around the user's sword, it generates a rapidly swirling stream. Once striking with it, it unleashes a strong surge of water to launch a target.

A defensive technique where chakra kneaded inside the body is converted into water and then expelled from the mouth in a dense, curved torrent, near-instantaneously creating a circular barricade that can be used to intercept incoming attacks.

The user spits a stream of water from their mouth at the ground, which circles around them and rises upward to create a wall. If the user is standing on a body of water, they can instead create the wall from the surroundings.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_gu: This technique is demonstrated as being both a technique on its own and as a two-way cooperation ninjutsu between Gamariki and Jiraiya. Using this technique, Gamariki can blast off a wave of high speed water from his mouth with extreme precision and force.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_ha: The user cups their hands together and stretches their arms outward at the target. They will then unleash a large barrage of water bullets. The bullets are very potent, able to effortlessly demolish large and sturdy trees.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_lo: Tobirama lands a water punch to his opponent, causing a whirlpool to hold them in place. He then jumps up in the air, and comes down at the opponent with a water drill.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_ma: Water Release: Water Mass Crumbling Bullet
Yagura creates a giant ball of water above his opponent before crashing it down on them.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_mi: The user creates a large, flat, circular pool of water in front of their opponent. Its surface acts like a mirror, perfectly reflecting the attacking targets.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_pa: Yagura jumps up in the air, delivers a couple hits with his staff, and finishes with a water blast that knocks his opponent down in the ground.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_pi: The user creates a pillar of water, allowing them to dodge attacks by raising the pillar above their level, or to level themselves with an opponent if they're higher, for example, on a rock.
Water Release: Water Pillar Method Attack
Yagura hooks his opponent with his staff, throwing them up in the air, and hits them with four water pillars.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_qu: The user jumps into the air and stabs down towards the ground. This causes water to burst up around the user, and creates a pillar of water to rise into the air and repel the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_sc: Tenma creates a myriad of fish scales out of water and blasts them at his opponents through his fiddler crab.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_se: After jumping in the air, Mei kneads chakra in her stomach and converts it into water before expelling it from her mouth as a high-pressured stream to strike the opponent down into the ground.
After kneading chakra in the stomach and converting it into water, the user spews it out as a high pressure stream that is powerful enough to cut cleanly through the roots of the God Tree with ease.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_sh: Kisame points Samehada towards his opponent and then envelops it with water, which is then manipulated into the form of a shark. Kisame then thrust Samehada forward, releasing the shark as a projectile that flies towards the opponent and explodes into a burst of water on contact.
Kisame summons a water shark to jump into the air and bolt towards the opponent, striking them.
Water Release: Water Shark Bullet Technique

The user manipulates a volume of water with their hand; by thrusting their hand in a direction, the manipulated water is sent in that direction. As it moves, the body of water takes the shape of a shark, with additional water following in its wake for as long as the user keeps their hand thrust out.
Water Release: Water Shark Shot Technique
Kisame releases several fast-moving water sharks through the ground, one after the other. The sharks rush towards the opponent and falls on top of them.
Water Release: Water Shark Wild Sphere Technique
Merged with Samehada, Kisame surrounds himself with water and summons sharks to attack the trapped opponent.
The user launches a ball of water that turns into a shield capable of pushing back the opponent and blocking their attacks.
The user creates a large amount of shuriken, made out of water, and throws them at the opponent in quick succession.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_sn: The user produces a stream of water from their palms which spreads out into thin threads. The threads can hold a substantial amount of tension, but will throw their user back should they give out under great strain.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_sp: The user produces large spikes capable of impaling clean through a target. This technique can be performed from afar through any existing water source, even mist, to rain down on its foe or erupt from the ground. The user can also produce a spike to act as a makeshift sword for the wielder to strike with at hand.

The user points their hand at a target, mimicking a gun with their fingers. They then generate a ball of water at their fingertip, shooting it at the opponent. The user can also cup both hands together while making the gesture to produce a larger, more powerful ball to launch.
Izumo spews a large stream of water from his mouth, which slithers towards the opponent in waves before exploding beneath their feet, sending them flying into the air.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_su: The user performs a suicide bomb on themselves, emitting steam from their body and then self-destructing. This technique is primarily used to keep intel obtained secret from the enemies.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_tr: The user launches a large jet of water from their mouth through their cupped hand. This gives the appearance of playing a trumpet, hence the name.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_we: By cupping their hands, the user can gather up water and shape it into various weapons. These weapons can be used both in short or long range combat.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_water_wh: The user creates a whip made of water that can wrap around the opponent. The user can also channel lightning chakra to shock anyone wrapped in it. This technique seems to be known by the Kirigakure hunter-nin. It's also strong enough to completely counter Yamato's Wood Release.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_waterfal: This is a technique which creates a waterfall by developing spring water in a place without water veins and manipulating the resulting water current to form a wave. This is a very convenient technique as it can be used for training or relaxation.
While infused with Samehada, Kisame creates a large vortex of water around himself, which defends him from enemy attacks, as well as harms anyone in close proximity.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_waterhea: This technique enables the user to manipulate water and moisture around oneself. In this way, the user can quickly extract and utilise groundwater or water from vegetation, should no other source be available.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_wild_bub: The user spits out a large volume of foam-like bubbles which covers the ground and reduces its friction, considerably limiting the opponents' movements. The bubbles are spit out with violent force that is capable of washing away most attacks, such as oil and fire.
ability.narutorpg.water_release_wild_wat: The user spews water from their mouth in a waterfall-like fashion to wash away the target. One can freely control the power of this technique by the amount of chakra kneaded and then released. While considered to be a basic Water Release technique, it has many variations.
ability.narutorpg.water_replacement.desc: When the user is hit by an attack, this technique will transform the user into water to avoid taking direct damage from any physical attacks.
ability.narutorpg.water_retain.desc: Tobirama punches his opponent then following up with a spinning kick that lifts them into the air, where he follows through with a further three kicks before appearing above the opponent and releasing a blast of water from his hand, pushing the opponent into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.water_vortex_thundercl: Hagoromo sends a vortex of water to the opponent and adds four balls of electricity to it, shaping the twister in an electrified sphere of water.
ability.narutorpg.waterfall_binding_sand: Gaara creates a giant hand out of his sand to grab the opponent and throw them a great distance away.
ability.narutorpg.wave_break.desc: Kisame creates a small wave of water underneath him that he manipulates to carry himself fowards towards the opponent and using Samehada he drills through the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.wave_transmission_tech: With this technique, the user is capable of creating a wave, by touching a solid substance, like a wall, that lets them communicate with their allies. When in use, the wave seems to creates a howling wind-like sound.
ability.narutorpg.waving_pursuit_sand.de: Gaara has his sand barrage the opponent three times and then he finishes it with a slash from a giant sand rope.
ability.narutorpg.waving_sand_waterfall_: Gaara traps his opponent in a swirling sand vortex, sinking them deep into it. When the sand at the border of the vortex reaches the middle of the vortex, Gaara crushes the opponent with the sand the vortex sucked in.
ability.narutorpg.weapon_reverse_control: With this ability, the user throws their weapon, be it a sword, axe or fūma shuriken, at their opponent, controlling it with chakra so that it inflicts damage by spinning wildly and slicing through flesh, after which it inevitably returns to the user's hands.
ability.narutorpg.weather_manipulation.d: A special ability known by his clan, Yota can to freely manipulate the weather around him. Regardless of the natural atmosphere around him, he could manifest many different weather effects, effectively turning them into powerful attacks or defences.
ability.narutorpg.welcoming_approach_tho: This is the ultimate technique of the Fire Temple that is taught only to its ninja monks, and requires the special Gift of the Hermit Group chakra.
By using this technique to move around the battlefield, the user pops up out of the ground in front of their opponent before whacking them with a stick. Unlike its parent technique, this technique is used to quickly attack multiple opponents in succession.
ability.narutorpg.whip_of_love.desc: The user stretches its tongue out with an incredible speed and force, delivering a powerful blow to the opponent. The toad may also use its tongue to wrap around the enemy and smash them into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.whirling_snake_tail.de: Kabuto lands a series of attacks with snakes, kicks, chakra scalpels, and his own navel snake, before grabbing his opponent with the navel snake, and flinging them over his head to the ground.
ability.narutorpg.whirlwind_drop.desc: Temari sends out a gust of wind towards an enemy, trapping them within a powerful tornado. Controling the tornado's movement, she lifts the opponent up into the air and then sends them crashing down into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.whirlwind_gun.desc: Chiriku empowers the spear with golden chakra, similar to that emitted by Welcoming Approach: Thousand-Armed Murder, and attacks the opponent several times before piercing them with a spear throw.
ability.narutorpg.whirlwind_of_feet.desc: The user swings his legs very quickly, creating a kind of vortex around him that repels attacks. With his help, Kajika easily destroyed several of Naruto's clones.
ability.narutorpg.whirlwind_pinching_wal: Temari creates two localised tornadoes by flapping her Giant Folding Fan. The first tornado ensnares the opponent and the second one combines with the first to create a giant tornado that slashes the opponent with razor sharp wind pinions.
ability.narutorpg.whirlwind_sweep.desc: Transformed as Kokuō, Han tramples his opponents twice, by his left and right, rams into them with his horns, and finishes by spinning and swatting at them with his tails.
User quickly spins while holding Jō in his hands and attacks the opponent in this manner. The enhanced version uses Earth Release: Rock Brick Cane.
ability.narutorpg.white_assimilation_poi: After taking on the properties of the unique, red soil situated at the Seventh Front, the White Zetsu Army gains poisonous properties. Whenever they exhale or are cut apart and killed, they expel a red poisonous gas capable of leaving their opponents unconscious.
ability.narutorpg.white_haze_heavenly_da: Hinata's hands turn white, with chakra coating and flowing through them. She takes several swipes at the opponent, and finishes by bringing together both her hands. This creates a large explosion that damages and knocks back the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.white_light_blade.desc: Using his father's White Light Chakra Sabre, a young Kakashi delivers a series of slashes, finishing with a downward cut.
ability.narutorpg.white_secret_technique: White Secret Technique Secret Art: Collection of Illusions
After taking control of several bodies at once, Chiyo lets them attack an entire battlefield, resulting in constant and devastating impacts.
White Secret Technique: The Chikamatsu Collection of Ten Puppets
The White Secret Technique: The Chikamatsu Collection of Ten Puppets is a ninjutsu which was invented by Monzaemon Chikamatsu.
White Secret Technique: The Chikamatsu Collection of Ten Puppets: Earth Attack
Using Monzaemon's puppets, Chiyo uses the number four's cable arm and puppet number three's spinning chakra blade, and finishes with puppet number five's hidden head cables impaling the opponent.
White Secret Technique: The Chikamatsu Collection of Ten Puppets: Heaven Attack

This technique utilizes the unique mechanism of fifth puppet of the Chikamatsu Collection. Ramming it into the target headfirst, five metallic tendrils release from holes in its scalp and pierce the target, as well as anything else behind it.
ability.narutorpg.white_snake.desc: Orochimaru leaves his body in the White Snake form, launching at the opponent damaging them and entering the ground, and then attacks the opponent from behind again before entering his body again.
ability.narutorpg.white_snake_charmer_te: Orochimaru uses the Snake Charmer Technique, but instead of sending a regular snake, he sends his true form, dealing more damage as well as poisoning the target.
ability.narutorpg.white_snake_possession: Orochimaru transfers his consciousness into a white snake and then slithers into his target's body, enabling him to gain control of their body as well as their mind.
ability.narutorpg.white_spirit_release.d: Neji performs a series of high-speed strikes before charging his chakra into his hands and releasing it in a burst.
ability.narutorpg.whole_body_one_shot.de: Naruto while in Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, uses his Body Flicker Technique to jump into the air, then lands on the opponent and punches them at blinding speed.
ability.narutorpg.wicked_gong_mouth.desc: After being summoned by Orochimaru, Manda slithers towards the opponent then dives and runs through them.
ability.narutorpg.wicked_tongue_combo.de: Tayuya sweeps the opponent off of their feet, then kicks them up into the air, where she then dashes behind them. She then activates the first level of her cursed seal, and delivers a bone-breaking punch to the face.
ability.narutorpg.wide_healing.desc: The user is able to heal three characters at a time, or only the fourth, substitute character. It is a basic healing move and is known by almost all medical-nin and others.
ability.narutorpg.wide_range_bombing.des: Deidara has his C2 dragon shoot clay bombs from its mouth while in the air.
ability.narutorpg.wild_boar_spin.desc: Obito lunges forth at the opponent, stabbing them with a kunai and finishing with a spinning kick, sending the opponent into the air.
ability.narutorpg.wild_body_strike.desc: The user concentrates their chakra into one point in their body. They use that point of their body to strike their opponent, causing severe damage. A chance of confusion also might be effected on their opponent because of the damage they have taken.
ability.narutorpg.wild_dance.desc: Kankurō manipulates Karasu to bolt towards the enemy and begins spinning, striking the enemy, and throws kunai around him.
ability.narutorpg.wild_lion_s_mane_techn: This technique uses chakra to temporarily enhance the head's metabolism and manipulate the hair that grows longer as a result of it. There is also chakra flowing through the lengthened hair, making its hardness comparable to that of steel wire.
ability.narutorpg.wild_serpent.desc: Mitsuki stretches his arm, causing it to go into and out of the ground many times before finally grabbing his opponent's leg.
ability.narutorpg.wild_shuriken_dance.de: Sakura releases a barrage of shuriken at the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.will_materialisation.d: This ability allows a user to materialise their itself into a physical form.
ability.narutorpg.will_of_fire_tradition: Kosuke first throws his opponent into the air, creating a water wall under his feet, after which he attacks them with a water dragon, and finishes off with a huge number of shuriken slashing through the water column.
ability.narutorpg.willow.desc: Kimimaro jumps into the air, lands two spinning kicks, followed by two bone sword swipes, and then finishes by growing several bone spikes from his arm and chest and sending them towards his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.wind_and_lightning_rel: Wind and Lightning Release: Typhoon Lightning Spiral
Naruto forms a wind-natured Rasengan and Sasuke adds his Chidori to the sphere, after which the two thrust the technique into the opponent.
This technique requires the Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, and allows the user to divide and neutralise a Wind Release technique, making it harmless. The user can even redirect the opponent's attacks to them.
ability.narutorpg.wind_cyclone_of_lightn: Kakuzu's masks use Wind Release: Pressure Damage and Lightning Release: False Darkness and shoot them at the opponent which trap them in a lightning cyclone that explodes after some hits.
ability.narutorpg.wind_demon_rotating_sp: Wind Demon Rotating Special Attack Bullet
The user delivers a barrage of punches before finishing them with a Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.wind_demon_special_att: Naruto creates a shadow clone which he grabs and transforms into a fūma shuriken that he throws at his enemy. After it hits the enemy the shuriken turns back to a shadow clone and punches the enemy in the face. This can also be done to escape attacks.
Naruto creates a clone to uppercut the opponent into the air where it and the real Naruto merge into a Fūma Shuriken that tears through them.
ability.narutorpg.wind_dust_violent_wave: Orochimaru upon connecting with an initiating blow, performs a Wind Release technique from his mouth, which manages to generate a large wind from behind himself, making his victim forced to stand their ground before being blasted away.
ability.narutorpg.wind_god_and_thunder_g: Wind God and Thunder God Technique

A cooperation ninjutsu used by a Wind Release and a Lightning Release user. The Wind Release user creates a giant tornado which spins towards the opponent, after which the Lightning Release user run an electrical current through the tornado. This has devastating effects on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_air_bulle: This technique shoots multiple bullets of air at the victim with intense speed. The bullets also have great power, enough to subdue a whole group of shinobi.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_air_curre: Wind Release: Air Current Wild Dance
The user creates and controls air currents from the palms of their hands. The technique is able to easily whip up loose dust in the area. It is also performed to create a controllable dust storm.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_breakthro: After gathering chakra in their stomach, the user expels it as a gust of wind. They can also release it as a burst of wind from their hands. This technique is powerful enough to blow away everything within the user's immediate vicinity.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_bursting_: A reversed version of Wind Release: Vacuum Blade, where the user compresses air inside their weapon, which, in the case of it getting destroyed, would cause its fragments to burst apart and take down the opponent.
Using their Giant Folding Fan, the user launches sharp wind currents in the form of a net to slice their target apart. When collaborated with other tessenjutsu users, it was powerful enough to inflict wounds on the Third Raikage — a shinobi renown for his tremendous durability.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_divine_mo: This technique creates a vortex of wind to blast at a target. It can be used in a combo with the Fire Release: Running Fire and the Earth Release: Earth Corridor to release a massive inferno at the opponents while they are trapped within the confined space of the earth.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_divine_wi: The user releases a gust of wind that forms several small tornadoes. Combined with Fire Release: Running Fire that forms a circle on ground level, this creates a massive flaming hurricane.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_dragon_bl: Naruto uses Wind Release: Rasengan, which, when used in tandem with his holding the Dragon Blade, enhances the technique, causing a dragon of wind to swirl around Naruto, damaging the surroundings around him.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_drilling_: Shukaku pounds on its stomach with its arm, producing a loud sound. The external pressure from the pound forces a ball of wind from Shukaku's large mouth, firing it like a bullet. The wind, highly compressed and imbued with chakra, travels in a straight line.
Wind Release: Drilling Air Bullet Pellet

A weaker version of Wind Release: Drilling Air Bullet, in which after fully possessing Gaara, Shukaku exhales two smaller shots of compressed air mixed with chakra. He has the ability merge two shots to make a larger and more powerful shot.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_dust_clou: This technique creates a stream of high-velocity wind containing dust particles, capable of decimating anything caught in it in only a matter of moments. The completed technique is directed through horizontally overlapped hands that are placed in front of the user's mouth after forming the necessary hand seals.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_flag_curr: By swinging their flag, the user can change the flow and shape of the surrounding air currents and use them for various offensive purposes against the opposing threat, like breaking through various defences or cutting through clothing.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_flashing_: The user throws a handful of shuriken into the air like one would throw flowers. With a swing of their Giant Folding Fan, the user then encloses the shuriken in wind, making them hit the floor and spring back up in several sequences.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_flower_sc: This technique allows the user to summon a cyclone of petals to attack their opponent. The user can remain in one spot for the use of the technique, because they can direct it anywhere they desire. Therefore, the user can increase the direction and power of the technique to the maximum as a last resort.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_flower_st: Hana creates a petal filled wind vortex around her target to confuse and distract it.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_flying_lo: The user conjures a powerful gust of wind in the surrounding area. They could use the powerful wind to boost themselves to a higher location. The wind is strong enough to damage unsound structures.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_gale_palm: A Wind Release technique where the user either increases their velocity, or by the user clasping their hands together, wind is compressed and transformed into a powerful gale, which has enough force to knock over a person.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_great_bal: The user gathers an enormous amount of wind and creates a massive twister. Its power can easily repel two men a considerable distance away. The hand seals for the technique differ depending on which direction the user gathers wind.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_great_bre: The user breathes wind from their mouth, blowing away whatever is in front of them.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_great_cas: The Wind Release: Great Cast Net technique works similar to its parent technique whereby the user utilises their Giant Folding Fan to create a multitude of extremely sharp blades of wind to attack their opponent with.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_great_exp: Kakashi shoots a blast of wind on a flame-covered opponent, which intensifies the fire and causes it to blow up.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_great_sic: Wind Release: Great Sickle Weasel Technique

Temari uses her giant fan to create a more powerful and larger-scale version of her Great Sickle Weasel Technique, releasing heavy air currents that collide together to create many vacuum pockets to slash her targets.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_great_sla: Temari, flapping her Giant Folding Fan, creates a minor tornado, which ensnares the opponent, damaging and cutting the opponent, leaving them crashing into the ground after the tornado subsides.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_great_tas: Wind Release: Great Task of the Dragon

The user swings their fan to the sky, causing a giant tornado to descend upon a target. This technique can be set up as a feint as it has a delayed activation. The technique alters weather conditions temporarily and attacks from the sky rather than from the person.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_great_win: Kakuzu, while in his long-range form, releases a wind bullet that can repel a multitude of things and damage multiple enemies all at once.
Wind Release: Great Wind Protective Wall
Using her Giant Folding Fan, Temari creates a wind wall that pushes her opponents away.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_heaven_an: Wind Release: Heaven and Earth Net
Reto condenses chakra and throws several wind blades forward continuously, which form a huge net to cut the enemy and the terrain together.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_infinite_: Wind Release: Infinite Sand Cloud — Great Breakthrough

While preparing to enter Tailed Beast Mode, Gaara covers his body with sand. With this sand, he is able to form mouths all over his body. Gaara inhales with these and his regular mouth, causing his body to swell up. He then exhales this wind, mixing it with sand that's been coated with his chakra.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_multi_lay: The user creates a wall of multiple layers of vacuum that are stacked on top of each other like a mille-feuille. This technique can be used to provide additional support to other defensive techniques.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_obscuring: The user manifests countless dark papers to surround and envelop the area, forming a dome barrier to trap targets inside. Within it, the user can unleash their other techniques to attack from any angle. The user can also project their voice to further confuse the enemy.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_passing_t: The user creates a gust of wind that blows away all weather conditions. It is powerful enough to dispel even the Hiding in Mist Technique.
