ability.narutorpg.wind_release_pressure_: A powerful wind technique released by Kakuzu's wind-element mask. This tornado-like mass is compressed until it has a very high density before being released. The blast can hit a vast range, inflicting massive damage on both the target and their close surroundings.
The Wind Release: Rasengan is an original technique created by Naruto Uzumaki.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_rasenshur: The Wind Release: Rasenshuriken is a shuriken-shaped variant of the Wind Release: Rasengan.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_repeated_: The Wind Release: Repeated Rasenshuriken is a ninjutsu created and utilised by Naruto Uzumaki.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_rotating_: By infusing wind-natured chakra into shuriken, the user can make them spin, as well as control them in the air.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_sand_buck: After Gaara scatters and compresses numerous sand particles into bullet-like projectiles, Shukaku expels a giant gust of wind from its stomach, with the impact of a bomb to increase the force of the bullets, creating a large-scale sandstorm.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_sand_clou: The user unleashes a powerful burst of wind blades from their palm. It is strong enough to repel a large assault of Iron Sand.
The user creates a dome-shaped sandstorm which surrounds the opponent and prevents them from escaping.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_scatterin: Hana attacks her target with a petal filled wind vortex. However, per chakra nature relationships, this jutsu faltered when used against a fire-breathing flame bear.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_shakujo_t: By spinning their shakujō above their head, the user is able to produce a very large twister around himself before launching it out. It is powerful enough to easily repel demonic wind blasts.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_shield_of: Wind Release: Shield of the Wind Count

A self-proclaimed invincible barrier; using hand gestures, the user is able to create a protective barrier of wind capable of repelling any incoming attack they perceive, back on the original user with equal or greater force.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_spirallin: Using a Rasengan, Konohamaru can counter an enemy attack by dispersing the Rasengan with wind chakra, creating a strong wind barrier. This technique proved to be powerful enough to block a Chidori.

This technique allows the user to breathe wind-infused chakra into the palm of their hand, shaping it into a small, whirlwind-like ball. Then the user will shoot it at their opponent. This technique seems to be very fast and powerful, as it is capable of smashing through thick rock.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_sword_of_: Wind Release: Sword of the Wind Count
Through a mere hand motion, the user releases a sharp wave of compressed wind from their hand. This was powerful enough to effortlessly slash through a shadow clone.
The Wind Release: Toad Gun is a two-way cooperation ninjutsu between Naruto and Gamatatsu. It is a wind-infused version of the Water Release: Water Gun technique.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_toad_oil_: This technique is the wind-natured upgrade of the Toad Oil Bullet technique, similar in principle to the Water Release: Water Gun. It was ad-libbed from Naruto's and Gamatatsu's Wind Release: Toad Gun technique, using toad oil instead of water.
Wind Release: Toad Oil Flame Bullet
This is a three-way synchronised cooperation ninjutsu between Naruto, Gamatatsu, and Gamakichi. It is an expansion of the Wind Release: Toad Oil Bullet technique.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_trap.desc: Rin throws a special tag down at her opponent's feet, which unleashes a tornado of wind, launching them up into the air.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_ultra_big: The Wind Release: Ultra-Big Ball Rasenshuriken is a more advanced version of Wind Release: Rasenshuriken.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_vacuum_bl: The user exhales wind-infused chakra onto a weapon in order to increase its sharpness, range and lethality. For example, the user can infuse a kunai to resemble a makeshift scimitar or infuse shuriken to increase their range and cutting power.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_vacuum_ga: Danzō jumps back, firing a vacuum sphere, and while his opponent is stunned, he follows with a vacuum wave.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_vacuum_gr: A stronger version of the Wind Release: Vacuum Sphere technique, where the user instead chooses to compress the entirety of the previously inhaled breath into a single large, crushing sphere of wind chakra that they then proceed to expel from their mouth.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_vacuum_se: The user takes a deep breath and exhales several blades of wind at different angles, by rapidly moving their head in various directions.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_vacuum_sp: The user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatters in different directions, making it very difficult for one to avoid without injury. Due to the properties of this technique, the expelled blasts are capable of piercing into and potentially through an opponent's flesh.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_vacuum_wa: The user takes a deep breath and spins while exhaling, compressing the released air into a solitary blade of wind that covers a substantial area around the user, due to their circular motion.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_verdant_m: By using wind-based chakra, the user can infuse their bladed weapons with it from a distance and manipulate them.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_whirlwind: A technique where the user clads their fist with Wind Release to form somewhat of a typhoon that is a revolving blade of wind. Upon impact against an individual, the technique pierces their body and blows them away with a shock wave.
ability.narutorpg.wind_release_wind_cutt: Using their chakra or a ninja tool such as a war fan to manipulate or create an external source of wind, the user can create one to several blades of wind, which are capable of slicing through their target with ease.
ability.narutorpg.wind_return.desc: Using the Weaknessless Soaring Shortswords, the user of this technique can easily cancel another Wind Release technique and redirect it to its user in the form of a hurricane.
Jigumo can summon his wind spiders, enabling him to spin trails, which can be used to shoot his opponent with webs at high speeds (as shown in Casualty Puppet), trap opponents inside a room crawling with spiders and webs, or to make a windmill of webs.
ability.narutorpg.wind_water_wild_wave_t: In this cooperation ninjutsu, the Water Release user unleashes a wave of water which torrents towards the opponent while the Wind Release user enhances the wave's destructive capability with wind.
ability.narutorpg.wind_waves.desc: The user waves their hand and creates a large blade of wind that can be launched at the opponent. This technique was powerful enough to briefly stop the movements of Sasuke Uchiha's Susanoo.
ability.narutorpg.winding_smoke_techniqu: After revealing a special tag, the user executes a hand seal, releasing a green sort of smoke to disable the sight of all enemies involved in it. This gives the user the opportunity to escape or attack their opponents, depending on their will.
ability.narutorpg.windmill.desc: Kimimaro teleports above the opponent, extending his bones and then spins downwards like a giant drill to rip through the opponent's body.
ability.narutorpg.windmill_hanabi.desc: An imperfect version of the Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven. After countering the opponent's attacks, Hanabi spins while a protective shield surrounds her. Unfortunately for her, she falls down after use.
ability.narutorpg.windmill_throw.desc: Sakura grabs her opponent by the torso, jumps up with them and comes back down, hitting the ground with them, and still holding them, throws them behind her back sideways.
ability.narutorpg.wing_beheading.desc: Using two of Chōmei's wings, Fū spins and unleashes two large blades of wind on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.wing_rotation.desc: Transformed as Chōmei, Fū swirls Chōmei's non-winged tail, creating and directing a small tornado towards her opponent.
ability.narutorpg.wire_bind.desc: After performing the necessary hand seals, the user launches several strands of wire to ensnare an enemy. Once captured, the user can tighten the wire at will, to inflict injury or maim the victim.
ability.narutorpg.wire_cage.desc: This technique uses wire strings to form a powerful protective dome. This dome can repel most basic taijutsu attacks. The user can reshape the wire within the dome as needed, changing it from a defensive structure to a binding string with ease.
ability.narutorpg.wisdom_wolf_decay.desc: The Wisdom Wolf Decay is a ninjutsu unique to Saiken.
ability.narutorpg.wolf_fang_punishing_dr: Asuma delivers two slashes across the opponent's chest and delivers another slash upwards to launch the opponent into the air. Asuma quickly jumps into the air himself, delivers two slashes in the opponent's face and one final slash to send the opponent back into the ground.
The user hits the opponent with a series of punches and slashes, finishing with a rising uppercut that lifts the opponent into the air.
ability.narutorpg.wolf_river.desc: After transforming into a two headed wolf, Kiba and Akamaru leap forward and bite the opponent with both heads sending them flying.
ability.narutorpg.wood_clone_kick.desc: Yamato makes a pillar of wood come out of the ground and hit the opponent, knocking them backwards. A clone then flips over the pillar and slams his leg into the opponent when they are on the ground.
ability.narutorpg.wood_clone_technique.d: A clone that is created by using chakra to alter the user's own cells into vegetation. The clones can be as simple in function as a wooden dummy for use in the Body Replacement Technique or completely mobile and able to perform jutsu.
ability.narutorpg.wood_pillar_climb.desc: Yamato makes a pillar of wood come out of the ground and hit the opponent, knocking them backwards.
ability.narutorpg.wood_pillar_sky_kick.d: Yamato attacks his opponent with a series of punches and kicks before turning their left arm into a pillar of wood that is extended into the ground and lifting him into the air towards the opponent, and kicking them backwards.
Yamato makes a pillar of wood come out of the ground, takes hold of the pillar and then begins spinning around with his leg hanging out to kick the opponent multiple times.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_adamantin: Hashirama uses this technique to make some thick tendrils of wood surround him. This can be used to defend against close range attacks or to strike an opponent when they are near.
Hashirama enhances the physical strength of Wood Release: Wood Human Technique, which jumps and smashes the opponent with its fist, dealing great damage.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_advent_of: Wood Release: Advent of a World of Flowering Trees
Taking advantage of the innate properties of Wood Release which allows the user to force trees to grow on any surface at a rapid pace, the user creates a dense forest of flowering trees.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_all_creat: Hashirama causes multiple wood tendrils to rise up from the ground, weaving into a wooden wall around the opponent's limbs binding them in place. He then concentrates his chakra into his fist and then strikes the opponent, breaking them free of the woven wooden wall.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_beams.des: Yamato causes several wood beams to erupt from the ground and reach high into the sky. They spread out and turn back down, crashing down at the opponent. They end up looking like a willow.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_circular_: Wood Release: Circular Pillar Prison Technique
Yamato creates wooden pillars in a circular formation to trap and crush the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_complete_: Yamato traps his opponent in a wooden dome, and sends several wood beams crashing at it, destroying the dome and hitting his opponent.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_cutting_t: A versatile technique where the user can produce sharp wooden spikes from their body to either fashion short-range weapons akin to a makeshift sword, or use them as projectiles, where the branches' growth can be triggered remotely, skewering the enemy as a result which will usually see the target dying.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_cypress_n: Yamato impales the opponent with Wood Release: Great Forest Technique and hammers the wood with a giant wooden mallet that crushes the opponent to bits.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_firmament: Hashirama slams the ground with his fist, releasing large trees from which rise from underground and capture the opponent, allowing him to finish them off by punching them down through the trees, and into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_foo_dog_h: A technique designed to be used to absorb a tailed beast's chakra. The user produces the kanji on their palm and creates a series of wooden pillars, which are engraved with what resemble foo dog faces and have lit wicks on top of them.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_four_pill: By sending chakra into the ground, the roots of the plants are converted into raw materials. This technique allows for a building to be constructed, by forcing accelerated growth. Just like with the Four-Pillar Prison Technique, the size and shape of the building are taken from the user's imagination or memories.

The user converts chakra into timber under the ground and lets it grow rapidly while forming it into a wooden prison. The size of the prison is based on the user's imagination. From an insect cage to a great prison, one can make it into whatever they want by regulating the amount of chakra used.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_great_for: The user makes trees grow rapidly under the opponent, stabbing them and throwing them quite distantly.

A technique that changes one's own arm into big trees. Using chakra, the tissues are transformed into trees at the cellular level. Then, by activating the trees, stimulating them to grow rapidly, they lengthen at high speed and fork into many branches.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_great_spe: Obito brings up several thick roots from the ground, and uses them to crush his opponents.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_great_tre: Wood Release: Great Tree Crumbling Attack
Hashirama attacks the opponent with thick tree branches growing out towards the opponent.
Wood Release: Great Tree Roaring Nativity
Hashirama summons tree branches to lift himself up in the air towards the opponent and punches the ground beneath them, causing trees to grow underneath and strike them away.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_great_woo: Yamato creates a wood clone with a giant wooden hammer as a hand, which jumps at the opponent and clobbers them with it.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_hand_tool: Using Wood Release, Yamato manipulates his hand to form into a tool, such as a key or a shield.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_hobi_tech: Quickly creating a dome-like structure in the form of a dragon's face, the user is completely surrounded. Taking advantage of the nature of Wood Release, this fūinjutsu substantially weakens incoming attacks whilst protecting the user inside.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_hotei_tec: The user creates a number of gigantic wooden hands that erupt upward from beneath the ground, which then encircle and attempt to restrain a chosen enemy. The size of each of these hands is around the size of a tailed beast.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_kakashi.d: Yamato traps the opponent in a wooden vice, after which he uses carpentry tools to carve a giant head of Kakashi Hatake out of the resulting vice.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_nativity_: Wood Release: Nativity of a Sea of Trees

After forming the necessary seals, Yamato is able to turn an area into a vast forest in a matter of mere moments complete with trees and grass growing out of any terrain he is on. This technique is very similar to Hashirama's signature technique, albeit on a somewhat smaller scale.
Yamato strikes the opponent with Wood Release: Great Forest Technique and makes the wood that struck the opponent form into a tree.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_pillar_cr: Yamato traps the opponent in a wooden prison and turns his wood clone into a giant pillar that ultimately crushes the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_revolt_of: Obito skewers his opponent with wood tendrils, punches and kicks them upwards, followed by a knee to the face. He then phases through them on the way down, and brings up several roots to impale them.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_ruptured_: Hashirama launches an attack across the surface of the ground, causing roots to sprout underground, destroying the battlefield.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_secret_te: Wood Release Secret Technique: Nativity of a World of Trees

Hashirama Senju creates a dense growth of trees, controlling how it grows using his chakra. The trees' life force is immense enough to split the earth as they sprout and further pierce through any other obstructions they encounter.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_serial_pi: Wood Release: Serial Pillar Houses Technique

A larger scaled version of the Wood Release: Four-Pillar House Technique where instead of creating a single house, Yamato creates multiple houses at once. Because of the sheer volume of structures created with this technique, it appears to exhaust him rather quickly.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_smotherin: By transforming their arm into a tree, the user can then create multiple branches which will rapidly grow around the target, immobilising them. This technique is strong enough to restrain a giant squid.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_stocks.de: Yamato creates wooden stocks to restrain a target. These stocks also have the added effect of suppressing the target's chakra, rendering most captives unable to retaliate.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_thousand_: Wood Release: Thousand Core Piercing Technique
Using the giant statue as a medium, Tobi smashes the opponent with a giant wooden hand, and while the enemy is trapped under its giant hand he impales them with wooden spikes.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_transform: Yamato performs the necessary hand seals, then wood emerges and covers his entire body with a puff of smoke or chakra, covering up the transformation. Once the technique is done, the transformation is complete. It acts more like a costume than a transformation, as he is able to leave it behind if necessary.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_tree_bind: Wood Release: Tree Bind Flourishing Burial

This technique lets the user summon a tree around their opponent to bind them. This technique is relatively powerful and holds opponents much more gracefully, with less of a strain on the user, because the user sinks them into the ground. Afterwards, the user can enclose the opponent so that their body is crushed.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_tree_of_f: Yamato kicks the opponent into the air before summoning a bridge of wood that carries the opponent away. Yamato then jumps behind them and uses a beam of wood to run them through the wood bridge and force them to the ground.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wild_pick: Yamato places his hands on the ground to bring forth three cylinder shaped branches to attack the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wood_drag: The user creates a gigantic wooden dragon, which they can use for a multitude of purposes including restraining a target, or for offensive purposes. The dragon that the user creates can vary in terms of appearance.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wood_fett: Yamato creates a spiralling pillar of wood rise up from the ground beneath the intended target causing them damage whist throwing them several feet.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wood_huma: After forming the required hand seals, the user creates an enormous statue-like creature out of wood. This humanoid creature with a full body and an oni-like face is usually created with a wooden dragon wrapped around its torso, and is generally used in battle as an avatar.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wood_lock: An extremely versatile move, this technique uses chakra to activate the roots in the ground and, using the user of the technique as a reference point, makes wooden pillars appear from left and right. The wooden pillars join together in a dome-shape with the user at the centre.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wood_spik: The user creates a semi-circle of wood around a captured target, and then form spikes within the ring, pointing at the target, preventing them from making any sudden movements.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wooden_ma: Yamato creates several pieces of wood from the ground that shoot out and pierce the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_wooden_sp: Wood Release: Wooden Spear Heavenly Tear
After a taijutsu combo, Hashirama summons a large tree branch to send the opponent flying in the air, jumps at them and punches them down.
ability.narutorpg.wood_release_world_of_: Wood Release: World of Trees Wall
The user creates countless wooden branches that grow at high speed from the ground. The branches interlace to form a wide, net-like wall with an impressive defensive power.
ability.narutorpg.wood_stab_palm.desc: Yamato strikes the opponent with a series of punches and kicks leading to him jumping into the air and releasing a wooden spear from his palm that is directed into the opponent and used to drive them into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.wooden_men_possession_: Wooden Men Possession Turnover Manipulation Technique
This technique forces two opponents to fight each other through wooden training dummies, with the intent of tricking them into fighting each other until all but one of them is defeated.
ability.narutorpg.wooden_puppet_manipula: By placing a charm onto the puppet beforehand, this technique allows the user to control its movements through will alone. Alternatively, the puppets can attack the opponent on their own, though the ability to react to their opponent's movements is limited. If the tag is removed, then the technique can then be disabled
ability.narutorpg.wrapping_flame_cat_fir: Transforming into Matatabi, Yugito runs towards the opponent in a fiery tackle.
ability.narutorpg.yachihoko.desc: Yachihoko is a Mangekyō Sharingan dōjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.yachihoko_dazzling_fla: Using Yachihoko to boost her abilities, Hikari dashes around slicing the opponent with her kunai, kicks them up in the air, spews a a fireball and Amaterasu, causing it to burst into towering pillars of blazing fire and black flames.
ability.narutorpg.yachihoko_no_kami.desc: Kaguya opens numerous small portals to shoot hazards from her dimensions at the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.yakusaikazuchinokami.d: Momoshiki first calls forth several lightning bolts to strike the ground before him, then releases a powerful tidal wave of water over the area, forming a large, electrified whirlpool.
ability.narutorpg.yasaka_magatama.desc: Yasaka Magatama is a technique that Susanoo users can use from any of its hands. Due to its structure, it acts in a similar manner to that of a shuriken when thrown by Susanoo — rapidly spinning towards the intended target — and results in an explosion upon impact.
ability.narutorpg.yasaka_magatama_tailed: This Cooperation Ninjutsu is a collaboration technique using the user's strongest long ranged techniques including Naruto's Wind Release: Rasenshuriken, Itachi's Yasaka Magatama, and Killer B's Tailed Beast Ball.
ability.narutorpg.yellow_flash_jutsu.des: Minato blasts the opponent into the air with a Rasengan and then proceeds to throw one of his Flying Thunder God Kunai behind them. As he teleports behind them, he strikes them in the back with another Rasengan that expands to a larger size before exploding and sending the opponent back to the ground.
ability.narutorpg.yellow_flash_naruto.de: Channelling Kurama's chakra, Naruto performs an enhanced Body Flicker Technique to instantly cross vast distances.
Minato kicks the opponent in the air, throws his Flying Thunder God Kunai, teleports to them, and kicks them again, ending the combo with a Rasengan while on the ground as the opponent falls down on the attack.
ability.narutorpg.yin_healing_wound_dest: Kabuto analyses an opponent's facial expression, movements, and the properties of their jutsu to anticipate where and how he will be attacked. He then gathers chakra to the area of his body where the attack will strike, preemptively starting medical treatment in order to minimise the damage he'll receive.
ability.narutorpg.yin_seal_release.desc: The Strength of a Hundred Seal - which takes the form of a diamond on the user's forehead - is used to gradually build up and store the user's chakra over time. Yin Seal: Release opens that seal, giving the user access to the accumulated chakra.
Obito uses Truth-Seeking Balls to block an opponent's attacks, shaping the Truth-Seeking Balls into a different defensive shield each time.
ability.narutorpg.yomito_s_transformatio: Yomito activates this technique by placing the mask he keeps strapped to his right arm on his face. Once activated Yomito transforms into an oni-like creature. His body greatly grows in size and becomes very muscular, his skin becomes grey and his hair becomes crimson. The only clothes that remain are his pants.
ability.narutorpg.yomotsu_hirasaka.desc: Yomotsu Hirasaka is a kekkei mōra technique used by members of the Ōtsutsuki clan, which is said to be the progenitor of all space–time ninjutsu.
ability.narutorpg.yosaku_cut.desc: Using his giant axe, Sabu strikes the opponent with a low, lateral blow.
ability.narutorpg.you_won_t_get_away.des: Kushina jumps and delivers a series of strikes with her frying pan, chasing the opponent. Then, she hits her opponent with a pan, knocking them into the ground.
ability.narutorpg.young_lightning.desc: Kakashi whilst in the air will drop down on his opponent with a lightning-charged hand strike.
ability.narutorpg.young_spirited_embrace: Guy punches the opponent aside, only to apologise and embrace them, fracturing the opponent's back and doing liberal damage.
ability.narutorpg.youth_full_power.desc: The user begins with kicking the opponent into the air. Once airborne, the user will then kick the opponent in the face before finishing with a powerful drop kick that will send the opponent back down to the ground, emitting a light of "youthful" energy.
ability.narutorpg.youth_leaf_lotus_attac: Lee activates the Eight Gates, delivers a barrage of punches and kicks, and delivers one final kick on the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.youth_roar.desc: Guy lets out a loud shout, made to intimidate opponents and invigorate teammates.
ability.narutorpg.zelkova.desc: Kimimaro knocks the opponent into the air and then appears above them before extending a large number of spikes from his arm to stab the opponent.
ability.narutorpg.zero_tails_sealing_tec: This technique is a unique form of sealing which was passed down in the Land of the Sky and used to restrain the Zero-Tails.
ability.narutorpg.zeus.desc: The technique consists of striking the opponent into the air with a Lightning Release-infused uppercut palm attack.
background.narutorpg.academy_prodigy.des: Top of your Academy class. Deep chakra reserves, a head start in rank and the textbook techniques mastered early.
background.narutorpg.anbu_trainee.desc: Pulled from the Academy into the black-ops program. Precise, lethal and trained in silent infiltration.
background.narutorpg.merchant_scion.desc: Heir of a trading or crafting house. Lucky, well connected, and well supplied with the finest ninja tools money can buy.
background.narutorpg.shinobi_orphan.desc: Raised by nobody, you learned to survive on the streets: tougher, quicker on your feet, never without a spare blade.
background.narutorpg.wandering_mercenary: You sold your blade from one war-torn country to the next. Armoured, hard to kill, but with little chakra training.
commands.narutorpg.clan.cannot_choose: You can only choose a selectable clan while clanless
faction.narutorpg.bamboo_village.desc: Bamboo Village is a small village in the Land of Hot Water. It is surrounded by a forest of bamboo, and as such most of the village's buildings and goods are made out of bamboo.
faction.narutorpg.ceramic_village.desc: The Ceramic Village was a small village in the Land of Wind, near the border with the Land of Rivers.
faction.narutorpg.curtain_village.desc: Curtain Village is the capital of the Land of Silence. The city hosts the only black market in the region.
faction.narutorpg.daidai_village.desc: Daidai Village is a small village inhabited by the members of the Yoimura Clan.
This unnamed village is hidden among special trees that produce a genjutsu-like effect, thus protecting the village from invaders.
faction.narutorpg.hacho_village.desc: Hachō Village is a village lying on the outskirts of the border of the Land of Fire. They are on very friendly terms with the Tonika Village.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_cloud.desc: Kumogakure is the hidden village of the Land of Lightning and was founded by the First Raikage.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_dream.desc: is a small village located in a deep forest of a tiny country, near the border of the Land of Fire.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_frost.desc: Shimogakure is the hidden village located in the Land of Frost.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_grass.desc: Kusagakure is located thus far in an unnamed country. Because it had genin participating in the Chūnin Exams organised by Konohagakure, it can be assumed the two villages are allied.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_hot_water.desc: Yugakure is the hidden village of the Land of Hot Water. Like the country in which it resides, Yugakure has strong inclinations towards pacifism.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_leaf.desc: Konohagakure is the hidden village of the Land of Fire. As the village of one of the Five Great Shinobi Countries, Konohagakure has a Kage as its leader known as the Hokage, of which there have been seven in its history.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_mist.desc: Kirigakure is the hidden village of the Land of Water. As the village of one of the Five Great Shinobi Countries, Kiri has a Kage as its leader known as the Mizukage, of which there have been six in its history.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_moon.desc: Tsukigakure is a hidden village led by Tsukino, who succeeded her father after he died. They have a hereditary system and so positions are passed down to the next generation.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_rain.desc: Amegakure is a small but highly industrialised hidden village located in an unnamed country.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_rock.desc: Ishigakure is the hidden village of the country located between the Land of Earth and the Land of Wind.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_sand.desc: Sunagakure is the hidden village of the Land of Wind. As the village of one of the Five Great Shinobi Countries, Sunagakure has a Kage as its leader known as the Kazekage, of which there have been five in its history.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_snow.desc: Yukigakure is a hidden village located in the Land of Snow. Its ninja apparently specialise in manipulating pre-existing ice, typically in the forms of various animals.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_sound.desc: Otogakure is the personal hidden village of Orochimaru, which was founded after he left the Akatsuki for the express purpose of collecting ninja for his experiments and his quest to learn all techniques.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_star.desc: Hoshigakure was introduced during the Star Guard Mission. It is founded by the First Hoshikage two hundred years before the start of the series and is located in the Land of Bears.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_stone.desc: Iwagakure is the hidden village of the Land of Earth. As the village of one of the Five Great Shinobi Countries, Iwagakure has a Kage as its leader known as the Tsuchikage, of which there have been four in its history.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_valley.desc: Tanigakure is the hidden village of the Land of Rivers. Thirty years before the start of the series, this village ambushed Kagerō Village two weeks after they had agreed to a ceasefire with Konohagakure.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_waterfall.desc: Takigakure is a village located in an unnamed country. Their current leader is Shibuki.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_whirlpool.desc: Uzushiogakure was the shinobi village of the Land of Whirlpools. The people of Uzushiogakure were noted to have notoriously long lives, so it gained the epithet "The Village of Longevity".
faction.narutorpg.howling_wolf_village.d: The Howling Wolf Village was originally a settlement of the Kodon clan. Since ancient times, the settlement was periodically attacked by Rōen, a wolf-like monster.
faction.narutorpg.inaho_village.desc: Inaho Village is located near the hills where Genmai was kidnapped.
faction.narutorpg.jomae_village.desc: The Jōmae Village is an anime-only shinobi village located in the Land of Keys. This village's shinobi are experts in espionage in order to gain information for negotiations with larger, more powerful nations.
faction.narutorpg.kagero_village.desc: Kagerō Village, was a small village located in the Land of Mountains.
faction.narutorpg.kisaragi_village.desc: Kisaragi Village is a village south of Konohagakure. It was the subject of attacks by bandits in league with the Shirogane clan in their search for the spirit orbs.
faction.narutorpg.missing_nin.desc: Shinobi who abandoned their village. Free, feared, and hunted by every hidden village.
faction.narutorpg.mount_katsuragi.desc: Mount Katsuragi is a mountain which holds the Tsuchigumo clan's kinjutsu. Hotaru and Tonbee live on this mountain.
faction.narutorpg.mount_myoboku.desc: Mount Myōboku, also known as the "Mountain of Bewilderment" and the "Land of Toads", is one of the big three unexplored sage regions, a legendary place that is equally as famous as the other two, Shikkotsu Forest and Ryūchi Cave.
faction.narutorpg.nadeshiko_village.desc: The Nadeshiko Village is a shinobi village located near the Land of Water. The families of this village are organised through matrilineality.
faction.narutorpg.ryuchi_cave.desc: Ryūchi Cave is one of the big three unexplored sage regions, a legendary place that is equally famous as the other two, Mount Myōboku and Shikkotsu Forest.
faction.narutorpg.shangri_la.desc: Shangri-la was a village located in what was sometimes called the Valley of Lies. It was a haven for those with bounties on their heads who wanted to live their lives without worrying about being pursued by bounty hunters.
faction.narutorpg.shikkotsu_forest.desc: The Shikkotsu Forest is a legendary place and one of the three unexplored sage regions; the other two being: Mount Myōboku and Ryūchi Cave.
faction.narutorpg.sugi_village.desc: Sugi Village is an anime-only ninja village, in an unspecified country.
faction.narutorpg.takumi_village.desc: Takumi Village is an anime-only village that resides in the Land of Rivers. It was founded over one hundred years ago by a man named Seimei.
faction.narutorpg.tonika_village.desc: Tonika Village is a village located on the outskirts of the border of the Land of Fire. It is also where The Hole is located.
faction.narutorpg.tree_felling_village.d: The Tree Felling Village, later renamed to the Tree Revival Village, is a small and peaceful village once controlled by a dark demon called Black Shadow, who protected the village in exchange for human sacrifices every couple of years.
faction.narutorpg.tsuchigumo_village.des: The Tsuchigumo village is the village of the Tsuchigumo clan. It is led by the Tsuchigumo chief.
item.narutorpg.absorbing_eye.desc: Absorbs ninjutsu while guarding; fires the stored energy as an anti-regeneration beam.
item.narutorpg.absorbing_hand.desc: Prosthetic that absorbs incoming ninjutsu; punches drain chakra.
item.narutorpg.adamantine_staff.desc: Monkey King's staff: crushing blows, ground slam, and a solid guard.
item.narutorpg.altering_terrain_diagram_: Draw stone walls, or hide traps in the terrain.
item.narutorpg.ama_no_hoko.desc: A shard of the ancient tower: channels a devastating red beam.
item.narutorpg.antidote.desc: Cures poisons. Sneak: splash nearby allies.
item.narutorpg.araya_puppet.desc: Body double puppet that fights in your place.
item.narutorpg.arm_mounted_drill.desc: Tenrō drill: armour-piercing strikes; drills through rock.
item.narutorpg.artificial_sharingan.desc: Cybernetic Sharingan: perfect vision and predictive reflexes.
item.narutorpg.autonomous_puppet.desc: Runs on stored chakra: no upkeep once summoned.
item.narutorpg.axe.desc: Heavy chop that breaks shields; can be thrown.
item.narutorpg.barrier_puppets.desc: Shirogane guardians: erect a barrier, or summon a guard puppet.
item.narutorpg.barrier_tag.desc: Place for a temporary wall. Three or more placed in sequence link into a lasting Barrier Gate.
item.narutorpg.baryon_mode.lore: Baryon Mode is a unique transformation accessible to Kurama with its jinchūriki.
item.narutorpg.bashosen.desc: Treasured fan producing all five natures. Sneak: hurricane gust.
item.narutorpg.bell_charm.desc: Mystic charm: severing pink rays, or an angelic barrier.
item.narutorpg.benihisago.desc: Treasured gourd that seals the spirit of anyone it records.
item.narutorpg.binding_cloth.desc: Suna cloth: binds targets; with a seal, imprisons them.
item.narutorpg.bingo_book.desc: Read the target's profile; sneak to track every hostile nearby.
item.narutorpg.blowpipe.desc: Silent darts: poison, or sneak for tranquiliser.
item.narutorpg.blue_fire_powder.desc: Explodes violently on contact with water (and anything wet).
item.narutorpg.bo.desc: Long staff: reach, sweeps and parries.
item.narutorpg.book_of_gelel.desc: Secrets of the Stone of Gelel.
item.narutorpg.bow_and_arrow.desc: Precise shot; sneak for a triple volley.
item.narutorpg.box_of_ultimate_bliss.des: Grants a wish of power... or releases what lurks inside.
item.narutorpg.bubble_utilising_pipe.des: Soap-bubble ninjutsu: drifting explosive bubbles; sneak for a bubble guard.
item.narutorpg.chain_wind_staff.desc: Weighted chains on both ends: lash out or spin a wide sweep.
item.narutorpg.chakra_armour.desc: Blocks ninjutsu and genjutsu; sneak to absorb attacks.
Clamps onto a target and drains its chakra.
item.narutorpg.chakra_suppressing_seal.d: Suppresses a target's chakra; sneak to calm yourself.
item.narutorpg.chakra_transmission_commu: Shares the location of every ally and foe.
item.narutorpg.chikamatsu_collection.des: Ten legendary puppets: summons a squad.
item.narutorpg.chilli_pepper_bomb.desc: Fiery cloud that also snaps people out of genjutsu.
item.narutorpg.chomei_seal.lore: Chōmei, more commonly known as the Seven-Tails, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
item.narutorpg.claw_club.desc: Yagura's hooked club: crushing blows and a reflecting guard.
item.narutorpg.cleaver_sword.desc: Darui's folding cleaver, conducts Storm Release.
item.narutorpg.clone_link_awakening.lore: Yanaru possesses a unique Kekkei Genkai, allowing him to mentally exchange information with his shadow clones, just as clones are able to transmit information to the main body.
item.narutorpg.crossbow.desc: Powerful bolt; sneak for poisoned bolt.
item.narutorpg.curry_of_life.desc: Ferociously spicy curry that revives the body.
item.narutorpg.curse_mask.desc: Power at a price: grants great strength while it devours you.
item.narutorpg.cursed_seal_device.desc: Juinjutsu device: borrowed power, borrowed time.
item.narutorpg.cursed_seal_of_earth.lore: The Cursed Seal of Earth is one of the strongest of Orochimaru's cursed seals, the other being its counterpart: the Cursed Seal of Heaven.
item.narutorpg.cursed_seal_of_heaven.lor: The Cursed Seal of Heaven is one of the strongest of Orochimaru's cursed seals, the other being its counterpart, the Cursed Seal of Earth.
item.narutorpg.dako.desc: Iō's extending cross-spear: launch the head, or lunge.
item.narutorpg.demon_shinki.desc: A seed that grows into a chakra-sucking demon tree.
item.narutorpg.demonic_flute.desc: Genjutsu melody; sneak to summon Doki.
item.narutorpg.dojutsu_glasses.desc: Borrow a dōjutsu: see through everything.
item.narutorpg.double_bladed_scythe.desc: Ritual scythe made to draw blood.
item.narutorpg.dragon_blade.desc: A blade that lets its wielder perform any technique.
item.narutorpg.dragon_life_awakening.lor: This unnamed kekkei genkai apparently allows the user to perform Reincarnation Ninjutsu as it allowed Ryūzetsu to perform the Dragon Life Reincarnation technique.
item.narutorpg.elemental_puppets.desc: Red puppet breathes fire; sneak for the blue water puppet.
item.narutorpg.eternal_mangekyo.lore: The Mangekyō Sharingan is an advanced form of the Sharingan that has only been activated by a handful of Uchiha when enduring a traumatic enough experience.
item.narutorpg.exploding_sphere.desc: Kunai-studded sphere with a hidden explosive tag.
item.narutorpg.explosive_tag.desc: Throw for a timed blast; sneak-place as a proximity trap. Thrown kunai carry one from your off-hand.
item.narutorpg.eye_medicine_plant.desc: Rare herb that soothes eye strain.
item.narutorpg.eye_scope.desc: Deidara's scope: spot and range distant targets.
item.narutorpg.fire_gatling.desc: Rotating barrels unleash stored Fire Release.
item.narutorpg.fire_sword.desc: Emits and wields vast flames; sneak to send a light signal beam.
item.narutorpg.fishing_rod.desc: Urashiki's rod: hooks a target and reels out their chakra.
item.narutorpg.flamethrower.desc: Puppet pipes that spew rock-melting fire.
item.narutorpg.flash_bomb.desc: Blinding flash for a quick escape.
item.narutorpg.flying_destruction_machin: Flying bomber: glide and drop bombs; sneak for the explosive beam.
Throw to place a seal; sneak to warp to it instantly.
item.narutorpg.gama_chan.desc: Naruto's beloved toad wallet. Fortune smiles on the thrifty.
item.narutorpg.garian_sword.desc: Wire-guided three-pronged blade that can be shot at foes.
item.narutorpg.gekkoran_flower.desc: Blooms once a decade; saves lives.
item.narutorpg.genjutsu_nullifying_perfu: Breaks genjutsu through smell; sneak to spray allies.
item.narutorpg.giant_folding_fan.desc: Temari's war fan: cutting winds, or a reflecting guard.
item.narutorpg.gold_dust.desc: Magnetic gold dust that buries foes.
item.narutorpg.gunbai.desc: Uchiha war fan: reflects everything; sneak for a fire-wind blast.
item.narutorpg.gyuki_seal.lore: Gyūki, more commonly known as the Eight-Tails, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
item.narutorpg.hashirama_s_artificial_bo: Cells of the First Hokage: tremendous vitality.
item.narutorpg.hero_water.desc: Multiplies chakra greatly, at the cost of life force.
item.narutorpg.hidden_kunai_mechanism.de: Spring-loaded sleeve kunai: snap them out or launch on a wire.
item.narutorpg.hiramekarei.desc: Twin-hilted blade that stores and releases chakra.
item.narutorpg.hiruko.desc: Puppet armour with a poison tail and senbon launcher.
item.narutorpg.hyuga_clan_secret_ointmen: Healing cream; sneak to share with allies.
item.narutorpg.ice_bomb.desc: Releases a torrent of ice spikes.
item.narutorpg.infinite_armour.desc: Tiger chest plate that absorbs nearly all damage.
item.narutorpg.iron_sand.desc: The Third Kazekage's magnetised iron sand.
item.narutorpg.isobu_seal.lore: Isobu, more commonly known as the Three-Tails, is one of the nine tailed beasts. Becoming its jinchūriki grants the chakra cloak.
item.narutorpg.jidanda.desc: Spiked explosive iron ball on a chain.
item.narutorpg.johyo.desc: Rope dart: whip it out or reel targets in.

lineage.narutorpg.aburame.desc: The Aburame Clan is a well-known clan of Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.akimichi.desc: The Akimichi Clan is a well known clan of Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.amagiri.desc: The Amagiri Clan is a clan that founded Yumegakure, and one of the three clans that hail from the village.
lineage.narutorpg.chinoike.desc: The Chinoike Clan was a clan active during the Warring States Period.
lineage.narutorpg.clanless.desc: No bloodline - only the academy basics and hard work.
lineage.narutorpg.fuma.desc: The Fūma Clan is a renowned ninja clan distantly related to the Uchiha Clan, famous in at least Amegakure and the Land of Fire.
lineage.narutorpg.fuma_sound.desc: The Fūma Clan is a shinobi clan from the Land of the Rice Fields, where Orochimaru established the Land of Sound.
lineage.narutorpg.funato.desc: The Funato Clan is a clan of pirates in the Land of Water.
lineage.narutorpg.hagoromo.desc: The is one of the earlier clans which existed during the war-torn era preceding the creation of the hidden villages.
lineage.narutorpg.hatake.desc: The Hatake Clan is one of the many clans that reside in Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.hirasaka.desc: The Hirasaka Clan is one of the three clans that hail from Yumegakure.
lineage.narutorpg.hoki.desc: The Hōki Family is a matrilineal shinobi clan (and family) of medical-nin and information gatherers from Sunagakure, who originated in and moved down to the village of Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.hoshigaki.desc: This shinobi clan is from Kirigakure.
lineage.narutorpg.hozuki.desc: The Hōzuki Clan is a group of ninja that settled in Kirigakure after the ending of the Warring States Period.
lineage.narutorpg.hyuga.desc: The Hyūga Clan or Hyūga Family is a well known clan of Konohagakure, as well as the strongest clan in the village, standing alongside the Uchiha Clan, with the Hyūga said to also possess the oldest and most...
lineage.narutorpg.iburi.desc: The Iburi Clan was a seclusive clan that lived underground in the Land of Fire.
lineage.narutorpg.inuzuka.desc: The Inuzuka Clan or Inuzuka Family is a family of shinobi in Konohagakure known for their use of ninken as fighting companions and are easily identified by the distinctive red fang markings on their cheeks.
lineage.narutorpg.izuno.desc: The Izuno Clan is a family of shinobi in Konohagakure known for their use of cat-inspired ninjutsu.
lineage.narutorpg.jugo.desc: This clan is an unnamed family, which originated from an unknown area.
lineage.narutorpg.kagetsu.desc: The Kagetsu Family hail from Motoyoshi Village within the Land of Fire.
lineage.narutorpg.kaguya.desc: The Kaguya Clan is a now extinct clan, known for their savage battle tactics and archaic values, and as descendants of Kaguya Ōtsutsuki, a select few have inherited a derivative of her original ability to manipulate...

lineage.narutorpg.karatachi.desc: This family was a group of people from Kirigakure, which has produced renowned shinobi.
lineage.narutorpg.kazekage.desc: This shinobi clan from Sunagakure holds high influential authority in its village.
lineage.narutorpg.kedoin.desc: The Kedōin Clan is a small clan led by Agari Kaisen.
lineage.narutorpg.kodon.desc: The Kodon Clan is a clan of the Howling Wolf Village.

lineage.narutorpg.kumanoi.desc: The Kumanoi Clan was a clan of the Howling Wolf Village.
lineage.narutorpg.kurama.desc: The Kurama Clan is a clan of extremely skilled genjutsu users, exclusive to the anime.
lineage.narutorpg.lee.desc: The Lee Clan is one of the many clans that reside in Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.nara.desc: The Nara Clan or Nara Family is one of the many clans of Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.onikuma.desc: The Onikuma Clan is one of the many clans that reside in Konohagakure.

lineage.narutorpg.rinha.desc: The Rinha Clan was a clan with specialists in medical ninjutsu.
lineage.narutorpg.ryu.desc: The Ryū Clan was once a powerful clan of Dragon Guardians entrusted with keeping the Dragon Blade.
lineage.narutorpg.sarutobi.desc: The Sarutobi Clan is an influential clan from Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.sendo.desc: The Sendō Clan is a clan of the Howling Wolf Village led by Jiryū Sendō.
lineage.narutorpg.senju.desc: The Senju Clan was one of the clans responsible for founding the first shinobi village: Konohagakure — the other being their rival Uchiha Clan.
lineage.narutorpg.shiin.desc: The Shiin Clan was a small shinobi clan from the Land of the Rice Fields, where Orochimaru established the Land of Sound.
lineage.narutorpg.shimura.desc: The Shimura Clan is a shinobi clan from Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.shirogane.desc: The Shirogane Clan was a puppet clan from the Land of Wind.
lineage.narutorpg.taketori.desc: The Taketori Clan is a clan, presumably outside of Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.tenro.desc: The Tenrō Clan is a clan of shinobi that hail from Yumegakure.
lineage.narutorpg.tsuchigumo.desc: The Tsuchigumo Clan is a clan that formed a pact with the Third Hokage during the Third Shinobi World War.
lineage.narutorpg.uchiha.desc: The Uchiha Clan is a well-known clan of Konohagakure, reputed to be the village's strongest because of their elite battle prowess and the Sharingan.
lineage.narutorpg.uzumaki.desc: The Uzumaki Clan was a formerly prominent clan in Uzushiogakure.
lineage.narutorpg.wagarashi.desc: The Wagarashi Family is a clan in the Land of Tea.
lineage.narutorpg.wasabi.desc: The Wasabi Family is a clan from the Land of Tea.
lineage.narutorpg.yamanaka.desc: The Yamanaka Clan is a family of shinobi found in Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.yoimura.desc: The Yoimura Clan is a clan that resides in Daidai Village.
lineage.narutorpg.yota.desc: This travelling clan had the ability to manipulate weather, which they used for their trades.
lineage.narutorpg.yotsuki.desc: The Yotsuki Clan is a clan from Kumogakure.
lineage.narutorpg.yuki.desc: The Yuki Clan lived in the Land of Water.

quest.narutorpg.akatsuki_suppression_mis: Akatsuki Strikes

Two newly introduced Akatsuki members, Hidan and Kakuzu, were chasing after the Two-Tails's jinchūriki, Yugito Nii.
